chapters.title: Chapter 3851: Shaking hands
paragraphs: Ling Han suddenly stopped, and saw that those figures had directly descended, not too far from them.
There were a total of five people on the opposing side, three men and two women
respectively, and Ling Han’s eyes were first drawn to a man.
It was not that the other was world-shakingly handsome, but rather that this person’s aura was too strong.
He was clearly just a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, but when he stood there, he was like a black hole, attracting all eyes and attention.

He was indeed quite handsome. He had a dignified appearance, and his features were as sharp as if carved by a knife. His features were well-defined, and his hair was black and shiny, as if every strand was a piece of art that had been meticulously carved.
Then, Ling Han’s sharp eyes turned to look at a woman.
Beautiful, astonishingly beautiful.
Ling Han had to admit that even the empress and Hu Niu couldn’t gain the upper hand in front of her. However, another feeling quickly rose up in him, and that was emptiness.
This woman was clearly standing there, yet it was as if she were empty air, and no one could lock onto her.
-If it was not for the fact that she had an Innate Divine Physique, it would be that she had cultivated some kind of special cultivation technique.
These people were?
When Ling Han’s eyes swept over the two men again, he immediately determined the identity of this group of people.
Lu Qi and Song Lan.
That was because he had seen Zha Hu and Cheng Bao. Thus, it was needless to say that the man they were protecting was definitely Lu Qi, and who would be the woman that could be accompanied by Lu Qi?
Song Lan, an exquisite beauty ranked ninth on the Exquisite Beauty Leaderboard.
Indeed, she was breathtakingly beautiful, and indescribably exquisite.
Lu Qi swept an eye over Ling Han, but did not speak. However, Cheng Bao immediately stepped out, and shouted, “Ling Han, meeting Master, pay your greetings!”
This was an absolutely condescending position. Even a lackey was so arrogant.
Ling Han smiled knowingly, and strode forwards.

Everyone thought that Ling Han had admitted defeat. After all, Lu Qi was a super elite ranked nineteenth on Galaxy Network. Theoretically speaking, only a mere eighteen people could defeat him in Cauldron Forging Tier. With how big the universe was, no one would think that it was inappropriate even if he was a hundred times prouder.

Though Wu Qiyuan, Yuwen Tian and the others also felt extremely displeased, they also knew that this was the best choice for Ling Han. If he did not bow his head now, he would only be asking for his own suffering.
Lu Qi was proud, and there was a hint of disdain at the corners of his lips.
Humph, what number one? He did not have the slightest bit of backbone.
Ling Han had already arrived. He suddenly stretched out a hand, and at an extremely fast speed, grabbed onto Song Lan’s slender, jade-like hand.

This was really too sudden. No one would have thought that Ling Han would actually be so bold. Even Song Lan herself was dumbfounded. Her captivating beautiful eyes turned towards Ling Han. She was 70% surprised, and 30% embarrassed, but very quickly, her pretty face flushed red, and she hurriedly tried to pull her hand back.

How could Ling Han be willing to let go? He said, “Thank you, Miss Song, for speaking up for me. I am truly endlessly grateful. Miss Song is really worthy of being called an exquisite beauty of the world. She is practically indescribably beautiful...”
His mouth was full of nonsense. In short, he was just grabbing onto Song Lan’s hand to express his gratitude.

As a seductive beauty who was ranked in the top ten of the Exquisite Leaderboard, Song Lan was naturally a public figure who knew how to socialize. What had she not seen in this world? But what man would dare to be so bold, and hold onto her delicate hand in public? Just how thick-skinned was he?

She tried her best to slap him, but Ling Han was also grabbing onto her too tightly. Song Lan couldn’t pull her hand out at all. However, in order to maintain the demeanor of a goddess and celestial maiden, she still couldn’t get angry. After all, Ling Han was expressing his gratitude to her.
According to her true thoughts, she really wanted to unleash a celestial technique and kill Ling Han. However, she still had to maintain a smile on her face, which made her extremely
depressed.
But the person who was the angriest here was definitely Lu Qi. It should be known that though he was earnestly courting Song Lan, he had never had any physical contact with her.

He looked at Song Lan’s jade-like hand falling into Ling Han’s “claw”, and his heart was filled with mixed feelings. At first, his face was livid, then it turned black, and finally turned into a murderous intent that could burn the skies.
“You’re seeking death!” he spat out word by word, his voice icy cold, making one feel as if they had fallen into an ice cave.

Wu Qiyuan and the others were also dumbfounded. They had thought that Ling Han had gone to admit defeat, but in the end, this guy was really outrageously bold. Not only had he not admitted defeat, he had even slapped Lu Qi right in the face.
No, this was a hundred times worse than a slap.
However, it was clear that Lu Qi had already been angered, and it was even more impossible for Song Lan to intercede on Ling Han’s behalf. Then, how would Ling Han resolve Lu Qi’s
anger?
Ling Han finally withdrew his hand. Tsk, it felt really good to the touch. As expected of the ninth beauty of the galaxy.
He coughed, looked towards Lu Qi, and asked seriously, “Who are you again?”
In the first place, Lu Qi had already suffered 10,000 points of damage, and now, this was definitely a critical blow.
“Die!” He moved, launching an attack at Ling Han.

Ling Han clenched a fist and replied with a punch. Peng! He instantly felt an unstoppable force surge over, sending him flying. Then, it was as if every bone in his body was about to break. A few of his muscles had already been forcefully torn, and blood was seeping out.

As expected of Eight Cauldrons, with an advantage of three minor levels over him. This was not a weakling like Xue Zhan, but had been obtained through his own hard work. It required great comprehension ability, great intelligence, and strong determination. Thus, in terms of battle prowess, this kind of Eight Cauldrons far surpassed wild beasts of the same level, and was chillingly strong.
Just like Ling Han. He clearly only had five cauldrons, yet could easily slaughter a ferocious beast having eight cauldrons.
If Lu Qi’s strength was solidified, that should be equivalent to a ferocious beast of Nine Cauldrons, or even the peak of Nine Cauldrons.
He was no match for him.
Lu Qi smirked coldly, and charged over once more.
Ling Han activated his eye technique, seizing the opening that his opponent had revealed, dodging this attack. Then, he opened his mouth, and the Sword of Metal shot out, shooting
towards Lu Qi.
Lu Qi did not dare to ignore this either. He sent out a palm strike. Peng, the golden sword was shattered, but a bloody mark had appeared on his palm, and blood was seeping out.
Seeing this scene, both Cheng Bao and Zha Hu were shocked.
There was actually someone in the Cauldron Forging Tier that could wound their master!
It was not one of the top 18 of the Galaxy Network, but rather a “unknown” minor character-
in the Galaxy Network, Ling Han was indeed not well-known.
This was too inconceivable.
Lu Qi raised his hand for a look, and a smile appeared at the corners of his lips, “Amongst those of the same age range, you are the first person that has truly wounded me.”
In the Galaxy Network Level Battles, though he had lost before, that was a battle of Spiritual Power. It was impossible for his physical body to be injured.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “Then you’ll have to get used to it. In the future, you’ll have
many chances to get beaten.”
Lu Qi’s expression darkened. He seemed to be praising Ling Han, but in truth, he was also
promoting his own strength.

“Insolent words, you don’t know what’s good for you!” He charged out again. This time, he had used some kind of celestial technique. Boundless celestial light danced as his palms opened and closed, and every streak was filled with boundless might.
Ling Han took this strike head-on with the Starlight Screen, and it instantly shattered.
It wasn’t that the Starlight Screen was weak, but rather that he was at a disadvantage in terms
of cultivation level. After all, Ling Han was only at Five Cauldrons.
He used the Imminent Skyline, and his figure moved swiftly. Even Lu Qi could not catch sight
of him.
“Interesting,” Lu Qi said coldly. “Thousand Silk Net!”
He shouted lightly, and the boundless celestial light instantly intertwined, turning into a
large net.

chapters.title: Chapter 3852: Fighting Lu Qi
paragraphs: This net surrounded him, locking down all routes of escape.
Lu Qi himself also charged over, his gaze sharp, his aura frightening.
He was already brimming with killing intent, yearning to crush Ling Han into dust.
He dared to touch the woman that he had his eye on?
His only fate was death. No one could save this b@stard.
Ling Han sighed. There was a gap of three minor levels between them. Furthermore, Lu Qi himself was a prodigy ranked nineteenth in Galaxy Network, so his battle prowess was really too powerful.
Weng, the barrage of murderous aura shot out.
So what if Lu Qi was a supreme prodigy? Instantly, his senses were affected, and he fell into a temporary state of confusion.

Ling Han retreated continuously, right until the net disappeared due to exhaustion of energy. Lu Qi came back to his senses, and couldn’t help but feel slightly apprehensive. “Who would’ve thought that you’ve actually mastered a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool!”

A Spiritual Power Spirit Tool could be something like the Heavenly Pattern Jade that could be thrown out, causing physical damage. It could also have direct effects on the divine sense, and could even penetrate the mind.

He definitely did not believe that Ling Han had used some kind of secret technique to affect him, because he believed that with the sturdiness of his divine sense, no one at the same cultivation level could break through it.
Ling Han did not try to explain himself. No matter how he thought about it, it was his business. Firstly, it was meaningless, and secondly, how could someone as proud as Lu Qi believe him?
He unleashed the Imminent Skyline, launching a counterattack.
Lu Qi was calm and composed. His advantage was too obvious. Casually striking out with both palms, he possessed invincible might.

However, once Ling Han unleashed his murderous aura, he would be hit no matter what. Although it was only a short instant, it completely messed up the rhythm of his attacks, and he was still unable to turn his advantage into victory.
After a few dozen moves, Lu Qi felt a little embarrassed.
He was at Eight Cauldrons, while Ling Han was only at Five Cauldrons. Yet, he was actually unable to take down Ling Han even after so long?
It should be known that with a difference of a cauldron in cultivation level, the battle should be completely one-sided. This situation was unacceptable to him.
If news of this got out, he would definitely be humiliated, and others would wonder if his rank of 19th on the Galaxy Network was not real.

He roared in fury. Boom! There was the sound of thunder in his body, and his entire body suddenly enlarged endlessly. In an instant, he had turned from a normal person into a giant that was like a mountain.
Boom!
His palm descended, truly covering the skies with a single hand.
How could he block such an attack?
Peng, the palm strike landed, and the whole ground trembled, as if an earthquake had happened.
Lu Qi’s figure trembled, and he returned to his normal size.

This was not some secret technique, but rather a Mystical Power that he had grasped. –Great Power Diamond Physique, one of the most powerful Innate Divine Physiques. Humph, with this strike, Ling Han should have been blasted into smithereens by now, right? However, he could only see a precious tower rising and falling, sending down streaks of Primal Chaos Qi. Vaguely, he could see a person standing proudly inside.
Ling Han!
Lu Qi couldn’t help but pale. He still hadn’t managed to kill Ling Han?

One had to realize that the Great Power Diamond Physique was far too powerful. In fact, it was so powerful that even he found it extremely difficult to control it. In fact, he could only use it two to three times in a short amount of time.
However, looking at Ling Han’s appearance, it was clear that he was completely unscathed.
He had to be seeing things!

He soon set his eyes on the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. His instincts told him that Ling Han was able to dodge his explosive attack completely because of this precious tool. The more he looked, the more he discovered the extraordinary nature of this precious tool, causing him to feel a strong covetous desire, wanting to take it for his own.
He channeled the Innate Divine Physique again, and his body rapidly enlarged. Then, he grabbed out at Ling Han.
What did being large mean?
His power was tremendous.
For example, ants. Even if they were strong creatures among ants, when they encountered humans? Even if it wasjust a child, he would be able to easily crush the strongest ants.
Thus, after Lu Qi channeled the Innate Divine Physique, his power soared exponentially, and was comparable to the early stage of Core Formation Tier.
He grabbed hold of Ling Han, but the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower exuded Primal Chaos Qi, which formed a powerful defense, protecting Ling Han within.
“Shatter!” Lu Qi roared, his voice as loud as a sudden clap of thunder.
He gripped his right hand tightly, wanting to shatter the Primal Chaos Qi, and then forcibly crush Ling Han.

This wasn’t impossible. Although the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was a future Imperial Weapon, and could be considered the strongest weapon in the Cauldron Forging Tier, it was only limited to the Cauldron Forging Tier. Most importantly, the current Lu Qi was like Core Formation Tier, though he could only match the weakest of Core Formation Tiers.
A Core Formation Tier could easily crush a Cauldron Forging Tier.

Thus, the air of Primal Chaos was rapidly rupturing. Though the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was still continuously pouring down Primal Chaos Qi, it could not compare to the rate of destruction.
Right at this moment, zi, the light of lightning blazed.
“Ah-” Lu Qi released a pained groan, and hurriedly let go.
His current strength was comparable to the Core Formation Tier, but it didn’t mean that his defense was the same. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower’s counterattack was too
fierce.

Xiu, Ling Han and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower fell together. However, in the next instant, Ling Han had already moved on his Tool, launching a counterattack at Lu Qi. The Great Overarching Heaven Technique was used. Brilliant light shone, and multiple seals
circulated.
After Lu Qi had just barely withstood a few moves, his figure shrunk. He could not maintain
this state for very long.
He frowned deeply. The strength of this precious tool had exceeded his expectations. It could actually just barely match a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
Damn it, if his Innate Divine Physique could channel for a while longer, that would be great.

Ling Han also felt a little apprehensive. This Lu Qi was really powerful. After channeling the Innate Divine Physique, he could actually unleash battle prowess on the level of Core Formation Tier. He had almost penetrated the defenses of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and almost forced out his Heavenly Dao Flames.
This top-notch Innate Divine Physique was too terrifying.
Though he was thinking this, he still charged out without hesitation. The Great Overarching
Heaven Technique was used, and he continued to attack madly.
-The Three Styles of the God of War and the Demonic Monkey Fists had both just been used,
and there was still a very long time until he could channel them again, so he could only use the Great Overarching Heaven Technique.
Lu Qi approached. He was also using various amazing techniques, wanting to take down Ling
Han.

However, it was a shame that his attacks could only barely penetrate the air of Primal Chaos. To say nothing of the endless air of Primal Chaos that was pouring down from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, there was also a layer of protection from the Starlight Screen. Thus, it would be wishful thinking if he wanted to wound Ling Han.

After opening up the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, if one wanted to pose a threat to Ling Han, it would have to be those freaks ranked in the top ten of the Network that had formed Nine Cauldrons!
Fight, fight, fight.
Ling Han only needed to attack, and did not need to defend. This naturally meant that he had
the upper hand. After several hundred moves, it was clear that Lu Qi couldn’t hold on any
longer.
He released a furious roar, and withdrew to retreat.
He couldn’t fight any longer. Otherwise, he would only gain a loss.
“If you can, put away your precious tool before fighting me,” he provoked.
Ling Han smiled calmly, “All right. You self-destruct three Celestial Cauldrons, and I will not
use amy Spirit Tool.”
‘Damn!’

Lu Qi almost bent his nose in anger. Was it easy for him to cultivate to eight cauldrons? Even if prodigies were as prodigious as he was, he did not dare to guarantee that he could reach the height of Eight Cauldrons again through re-cultivation. That was because from Six Cauldrons onwards, every cauldron cultivated would be due to natural talent, good luck, and great opportunities. Not one factor could be missed.

“We’re all disciples of the same Holy Land, so we’ll see each other frequently. Let’s enter the abode first,” Song Lan spoke up to mediate the situation. She swept an eye over Ling Han, her expression as cold as ice.

Though the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was still continuously pouring down Primal Chaos Qi, it could not compare to the rate of destruction.
Right at this moment, zi, the light of lightning blazed.
“Ah-” Lu Qi released a pained groan, and hurriedly let go.
His current strength was comparable to the Core Formation Tier, but it didn’t mean that his defense was the same.
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower’s counterattack was too
fierce.
Xiu, Ling Han and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower fell together.
However, in the next instant, Ling Han had already moved on his Tool, launching a counterattack at Lu Qi.
The Great Overarching Heaven Technique was used.
Brilliant light shone, and multiple seals
circulated.
After Lu Qi had just barely withstood a few moves, his figure shrunk.
He could not maintain
this state for very long.
He frowned deeply.
The strength of this precious tool had exceeded his expectations.
It could actually just barely match a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
Damn it, if his Innate Divine Physique could channel for a while longer, that would be great.
Ling Han also felt a little apprehensive.
This Lu Qi was really powerful.
After channeling the Innate Divine Physique, he could actually unleash battle prowess on the level of Core Formation Tier.
He had almost penetrated the defenses of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and almost forced out his Heavenly Dao Flames.
This top-notch Innate Divine Physique was too terrifying.
Though he was thinking this, he still charged out without hesitation.
The Great Overarching
Heaven Technique was used, and he continued to attack madly.
-The Three Styles of the God of War and the Demonic Monkey Fists had both just been used,
and there was still a very long time until he could channel them again, so he could only use the Great Overarching Heaven Technique.
Lu Qi approached.
He was also using various amazing techniques, wanting to take down Ling
Han.
However, it was a shame that his attacks could only barely penetrate the air of Primal Chaos.
To say nothing of the endless air of Primal Chaos that was pouring down from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, there was also a layer of protection from the Starlight Screen.
Thus, it would be wishful thinking if he wanted to wound Ling Han.

After opening up the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, if one wanted to pose a threat to Ling Han, it would have to be those freaks ranked in the top ten of the Network that had formed Nine Cauldrons!
Fight, fight, fight.
Ling Han only needed to attack, and did not need to defend.
This naturally meant that he had
the upper hand.
After several hundred moves, it was clear that Lu Qi couldn’t hold on any
longer.
He released a furious roar, and withdrew to retreat.
He couldn’t fight any longer.
Otherwise, he would only gain a loss.
“If you can, put away your precious tool before fighting me,” he provoked.
Ling Han smiled calmly, “All right.
You self-destruct three Celestial Cauldrons, and I will not
use amy Spirit Tool.”
‘Damn!’
Lu Qi almost bent his nose in anger.
Was it easy for him to cultivate to eight cauldrons?
Even if prodigies were as prodigious as he was, he did not dare to guarantee that he could reach the height of Eight Cauldrons again through re-cultivation.
That was because from Six Cauldrons onwards, every cauldron cultivated would be due to natural talent, good luck, and great opportunities.
Not one factor could be missed.
“We’re all disciples of the same Holy Land, so we’ll see each other frequently.
Let’s enter the abode first,” Song Lan spoke up to mediate the situation.
She swept an eye over Ling Han, her expression as cold as ice.

chapters.title: Chapter 3853 Cuckolded
paragraphs: Song Lan was naturally extremely displeased with Ling Han.

Though she was a goddess that had charmed millions, she had always maintained her chastity, and had never had skin contact with any man. Unexpectedly, Ling Han had forcefully pulled her hand, which made her so furious that she wanted to commit murder.
What made her even angrier?
Ling Han didn’t admire her at all. Instead, he was simply using her to anger and provoke Lu Qi.
What pride would she have left?
Ling Han could clearly feel the coldness in Song Lan’s eyes, which made him feel slightly anxious. It was not fear he felt, but rather guilt.
“Qing Qing, Qing Qing, you resolve the formation.” Song Lan didn’t linger on this matter. Instead, she turned to the other woman and said.
This woman’s appearance was ordinary, but she had an indescribable bearing, making one feel comfortable just looking at her. She smiled slightly, and said, “All right.”
Obviously, she was a Formation Master.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “There’s no need to trouble Miss Qing Qing. I already have a rough idea. You guys can just come with me.”
Song Lan appeared slightly surprised. She had not thought that Ling Han was actually also a Formation Master.
Meanwhile, that Miss Qing Qing looked towards Ling Han, and said solemnly, “The path of formations has myriad changes. The slightest mistake can lead to a great calamity, so don’t show off.”
She had seen too many people show off in front of Song Lan, and what was the result?
Ling Han smiled, and strode into the formation.
Wu Qiyuan bared his teeth in a grin at Song Lan, and followed closely behind Ling Han.

Yuwen Tian and the others followed closely behind. They naturally knew just how amazing Ling Han’s accomplishments in formations were. Previously, he had killed Xue Bingyuan by force, and just now, he had also seen that the Formation Master of the Cao Clan would definitely make mistakes. Just based on these two points, could he not believe Ling Han’s strength?
Ling Han led the way ahead. In just a few steps, he had already entered deep into the formation.
Peacefully, without any turbulence.
Song Lan looked slightly surprised. Looks like she had underestimated this rash person.
“Let’s go.”

They also entered into the formation. Since that Miss Qing Qing was a Formation Master, she would naturally be able to remember Ling Han’s steps just by watching him walk once. This was the lowest level ability of a Formation Master.
With Ling Han and the others in front, the people behind naturally could be at ease and be bold.
Not long after, they walked through the formation, and arrived in front of the main doors.
With a light push, the stone door was opened. The defense of this abode was set up on the formation outside, and there were no more restrictions set up inside.

The abode was very simple. There was a bedroom, an alchemy chamber, and a meditation chamber, but this alchemy chamber was really huge. There were formations on the ground, and they were all different. They were used to concoct different alchemical pills, and there were rows of wooden shelves all around, on which there were many pill bottles.
Everyone hurriedly went to check on the alchemical pills. For most people, this was their greatest gain.
However, Ling Han didn’t. He was searching for pill recipes, and Song Lan also had another target. Her attention wasn’t focused on the wooden shelves, and she instead went to the meditation room.
Neither of them interfered with the other, but very soon, they saw a jade pendant almost at the same time.
Spirit Tool?
Ling Han reached over, and Song Lan also reached over.
This time, the two of them were not shaking hands.
Song Lan’s jade-like hand was as smooth as jade, but when the surge of power from the tap of her finger swept over, it could penetrate through Divine Metal.
This woman’s strength was extraordinary, and she was definitely not just for show.
Ling Han’s Starlight Screen was entwined around his hand, and he immediately switched from defense to offense, grabbing at Song Lan’s wrist.
The finger-generated power arrived, and the Starlight Screen was instantly torn apart. However, it wasn’t torn into pieces, just a sliver away from that extent.
Hiss, this destructive power was shocking enough.
However, Ling Han’s counterattack had already arrived, and was aimed at Song Lan’s wrist.
Song Lan’s wrist turned nimbly, turning into a claw that pecked back at Ling Han’s palm.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He clenched his hand into a fist, and punched out at Song Lan.
Peng!
The two of them finally exchanged a solid blow. A powerful force surged over, and the two of them trembled, taking a few steps back.
Ling Han activated his eye technique and looked toward Song Lan.
Six Cauldrons.
He was slightly surprised. This beauty was actually only Six Cauldrons!
Six Cauldrons, and she was almost evenly matched with him. This woman’s battle prowess was truly formidable.
If Song Lan was also at Eight Cauldrons, would Lu Qi be a match for her?
As he thought this, Ling Han’s hands didn’t stop moving. He grabbed out at the jade pendant again.
Song Lan did not give in either. She similarly rushed forwards, her hands slicing, pressing, tapping and pushing. Like a celestial maiden dancing, graceful and enchanting.
This kind of battle was actually very intense, yet had a kind of pleasing beauty to the eye.
After exchanging a dozen over blows like this, Ling Han’s right hand gripped onto Song Lan’s left wrist, but Song Lan’s right hand had also gripped onto his left wrist, and again, it was a tie.
For cultivators, their vital points were extremely important. If one was controlled by an opponent, it was naturally extremely disadvantageous to oneself.
Thus, the two of them interlocked their vital points and could cause great damage to each other.
However, on the surface, the two of them were holding hands, and could not look more intimate or ambiguous.
“Let go!” Song Lan shouted lowly, not daring to alert the people next door.
Her pretty face was flushed red. It had not even been a day, and Ling Han had already gripped her slender hand twice.
“You let go first.” Ling Han smiled faintly. The person who let go first would definitely be at a disadvantage.
Song Lan naturally wouldn’t let go. She thought for a moment, then said, “I only want a piece of information from the jade pendant. Everything else can belong to you!”
“Oh, you’re that confident? Is that a Spatial Tool?” Ling Han asked.
“That’s none of your business,” Song Lan said. “If that isn’t a Spatial Tool, then there’s no point in us fighting over it, right?”
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “That makes sense. However, I’m sure that things aren’t as simple as that.”

Song Lan took a deep breath, “All right, I can tell you. The reason why Sun Quan could become an Earth Tier alchemist is because he has obtained the inheritance of a Heaven Tier alchemist. What I need is the alchemical pills left behind by that Heaven Tier alchemist. I think that this jade pendant might contain information about the inheritance of that Heaven Tier alchemist.”

Ling Han thought for a moment, “All right. If there really is the inheritance information of that Heaven Tier alchemist, we will explore it together. You can take away the alchemical pills, while I will take the pill recipes.”
Song Lan was also a resolute person. She nodded, “All right!”
“Then we’ll let go on three.”
“One.”
“Two.”
“Ling! Han!”
They had not even said ‘three’, when they heard a voice that was filled with endless hatred through gritted teeth.
Ling Han and Song Lan turned around at the same time, and saw that it was none other than Lu Qi.

The two of them had already reached an agreement in the first place, and now that an “outsider” had appeared, they naturally took advantage of the opening to let go. They both released their grips, and took a few steps back.
However, in Lu Qi’s eyes, this was far too strange.
It was clearly two people having an affair, and after he discovered it, only then did they hurriedly separate.
Just look, Song Lan’s pretty face was flushed red, delicate and beautiful.
He had been cuckolded!
Lu Qi’s expression was livid. He looked menacingly at Ling Han, his killing intent blazing.
Ling Han smiled faintly as he summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. The Tower hovered above his head.
He wanted a battle?
Whatever, who would be afraid of whom?
Song Lan took advantage of the opening to pick up the jade pendant. Then, a hint of pleasant surprise immediately appeared on her pretty face.

chapters.title: Chapter 3854: Surrounded
paragraphs: Lu Qi did not dare make a move.
Even with the use of his natural Mystical Power, it was still unable to penetrate the defenses of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, what more under normal conditions.
If he forcefully made a move, the result could possibly be him asking for his own suffering.
Thus, he only looked angrily at Ling Han and thought that Ling Han was lucky to have obtained such a powerful Spirit Tool.

However, as long as he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, it would be a piece of cake for him to deal with Ling Han. Furthermore, even if Ling Han advanced into the Core Formation Tier, how could it be that the might of this Spirit Tool would also rise accordingly?
Just you wait, he would definitely not let things go like this!
Song Lan hesitated slightly, but still tossed the jade pendant over to Ling Han.
This was not only because she had to keep her word, but also partly because she had a very high opinion of Ling Han’s formation skills, and wanted to borrow them.
Two Formation Masters exploring together was naturally safer than one Formation Master exploring alone.

Ling Han picked up the jade pendant and inserted his divine sense into it. He immediately discovered that this wasn’t a spatial Spirit Tool. However, there were several messages left behind, and they weren’t left by Sun Quan.
It recorded the location of the Heaven Tier alchemist’s inheritance that Song Lan was looking for, and this jade pendant was the key to opening it.
He nodded at Song Lan, and put away the jade pendant.
In Lu Qi’s eyes, this was practically a naked display of affection.
Did they both think that he was blind?
Lu Qi’s eyes were spitting fire, while his fists were tightly clenched, and cracking sounds could be heard. Veins could also be seen popping on his forehead.
However, his reason was still firmly controlling him, and he did not make a move.
Ling Han glanced at him, revealing a pitying expression.
In this kind of situation, one could not be too rational. If it was him, he would either give up resolutely, and never pursue Song Lan in future, or rush up and fight. That was what a man
was.
However, Lu Qi did not make a move, since he knew that he was outmatched. Yet, he was unwilling to give up, so his image was naturally countless times degraded.
“Please take care of me in future,” Ling Han clasped his hands and said to Song Lan.

To Lu Qi, these words sounded like a couple making a solemn vow – I will entrust my future to you. Please take care of me. He stared fixedly at Ling Han, and felt even more puzzled. He had pursued ger for so long and been at her beck and call, yet Song Lan had always been neither cold nor indifferent towards him, but how had Ling Han managed to capture her in just a few moves?
Was it because the two of them had “skin contact”?
This b*tch!
He cursed internally. Thoughts raced through his mind, and all kinds of thoughts that he could not believe appeared in his mind.
“We’ve already plundered this place clean, let’s retreat!” Yuwen Tian also came out of the alchemy chamber, and said to Ling Han.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded, turned to Song Lan and said, “Then we’ll take our leave first.”
Song Lan lightly swept back the silky hair at the side of her neck, and said, “Of course, together.”
Ling Han had taken the jade pendant. It was not just a set of coordinates, but also the key to open the doors. How could she possibly allow Ling Han to act alone?
“Alright.” Ling Han nodded. He had never thought of taking the inheritance of that Heaven Tier alchemist for himself.
Keeping one’s word was the basic moral character of a person.
Yuwen Tian was already watching dumbfounded from the sidelines. What was going on here? Since when had Ling Han courted the great beauty Song?
This was too fast, wasn’t it!
If he had come out a little later, would Song Lan already be pregnant?

He quickly walked to Ling Han’s side, and said in a low voice, “Ling Han, Senior Brother Ling, Boss Ling, you’re too awesome, aren’t you? You won the ninth beauty in the galaxy! Hurry up and teach me how to pick up girls!”
These words were spoken very lowly, but which one of the elites in the room was not a great elite? How could they not hear this little bit of sound?
Ling Han’s expression involuntarily darkened. This guy must have done it on purpose, and his motive was to anger Lu Qi to death.
Sure enough, Lu Qi’s expression instantly became livid. It was so dark that it could drip water.
He stood there without moving, but his hands were trembling slightly. That was because his killing intent was close to being unstoppable.
“Master!” Zha Hu and Cheng Bao also walked out, all smiles. Their gains this time were quite bountiful.
But when they saw Lu Qi’s face, they instantly fell silent out of fear, because they knew that Lu Qi was furious to the extreme.
And at this moment, they were still in high spirits. That was equivalent to courting death.
Lu Qi did not say a word, and strode forwards.

He was not going to give up on Song Lan. Thus, he definitely had to keep a close eye on her, and not give Ling Han another chance to be alone with Song Lan, and the moment he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, he would immediately kill Ling Han.
Definitely.
The group had just walked out of the abode, when their expressions froze, because they had been surrounded.
At least a hundred over people blocked the entrance, but did not enter. Instead, they were looking for someone to break through the formation.
Seeing Ling Han and the others appear, a white-browed old man immediately shouted, “All
of you, come here!”
“Sure enough, someone has entered.”
“This is just right. Let them hand over what they have obtained, and save us the trouble of
going in and taking risks.”
“Yi, that woman is too beautiful!”
“She really is an exquisite beauty. If I could sleep with her for a night, I would even be willing
to live a hundred years less.”
The others also saw Ling Han and the others, and began to talk. The majority’s eyes were focused on Song Lan, their words without any reservations.

Song Lan instantly looked furious. Not only was she the ninth beauty of the galaxy, she had also come from a clan that had a Venerate Tier elite. She had been the beloved daughter of the clan since childhood, and had been doted on to the extreme. When had she ever had such crude words spoken to her face?
However, there were a considerable number of people here that were in the Core Formation Tier. If she went out, she would only be walking into a tiger’s den.
Moreover, once one’s desires exploded, who would still care if you were the heir of a Holy Land, or the descendant of a Venerate Tier elite?
Otherwise, would there still be the word ‘taking risks’?
Lu Qi humphed, and said, “Watch your mouths, and don’t seek your own suffering!” “Hey, pretty boy, who do you think you are?” A great many people turned to look at Lu Qi.
“Pei, you guys don’t even know my Master?” Cheng Bao immediately called out, “My Master
is Galaxy Network’s 19th, Lu Qi, Lord Lu!”
19th on the Galaxy Network!
This title was quite destructive. Those people on the other side all fell into deep thought.

However, it wasn’t long before an old man spoke up, and said, “To say nothing of the 19th place, even the first place is only Cauldron Forging Tier. There is a hierarchy in martial arts, and in front of us, the Core Formation Tiers, how could you be qualified to act arrogant?” “Come out, hand over what you have obtained, and we can let you leave.”
“Hehe, but this woman has to stay!”
Someone pointed at Song Lan and said, their eyes burning, unable to conceal their desire.
This woman was really too beautiful, causing one’s heart to throb wildly, and unable to stop their desire from burning.
Lu Qi humphed, “We are all disciples of the Nine Suns Holy Land, so could it be that you people dare to trifle with us?”
The surroundings instantly fell silent again.
The Nine Suns Holy Land was the strongest force in this galaxy, and any one of them would

have to submit to them. To say nothing of the fact that there were only Core Formation Tier- level forces here, even if Venerate Tier elites came, they would have to consider the consequences of offending the Nine Suns Holy Land.
“Alright, you guys come out. We won’t make things difficult for you,” an elder said with a
smile.

“We’ve already plundered this place clean, let’s retreat!” Yuwen Tian also came out of the alchemy chamber, and said to Ling Han.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded, turned to Song Lan and said, “Then we’ll take our leave first.”
Song Lan lightly swept back the silky hair at the side of her neck, and said, “Of course, together.”
Ling Han had taken the jade pendant.
It was not just a set of coordinates, but also the key to open the doors.
How could she possibly allow Ling Han to act alone?
“Alright.” Ling Han nodded.
He had never thought of taking the inheritance of that Heaven Tier alchemist for himself.
Keeping one’s word was the basic moral character of a person.
Yuwen Tian was already watching dumbfounded from the sidelines.
What was going on here?
Since when had Ling Han courted the great beauty Song?
This was too fast, wasn’t it!
If he had come out a little later, would Song Lan already be pregnant?
He quickly walked to Ling Han’s side, and said in a low voice, “Ling Han, Senior Brother Ling, Boss Ling, you’re too awesome, aren’t you?
You won the ninth beauty in the galaxy!
Hurry up and teach me how to pick up girls!”
These words were spoken very lowly, but which one of the elites in the room was not a great elite?
How could they not hear this little bit of sound?
Ling Han’s expression involuntarily darkened.
This guy must have done it on purpose, and his motive was to anger Lu Qi to death.
Sure enough, Lu Qi’s expression instantly became livid.
It was so dark that it could drip water.
He stood there without moving, but his hands were trembling slightly.
That was because his killing intent was close to being unstoppable.
“Master!” Zha Hu and Cheng Bao also walked out, all smiles.
Their gains this time were quite bountiful.
But when they saw Lu Qi’s face, they instantly fell silent out of fear, because they knew that Lu Qi was furious to the extreme.
And at this moment, they were still in high spirits.
That was equivalent to courting death.
Lu Qi did not say a word, and strode forwards.
He was not going to give up on Song Lan.

Thus, he definitely had to keep a close eye on her, and not give Ling Han another chance to be alone with Song Lan, and the moment he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, he would immediately kill Ling Han.
Definitely.
The group had just walked out of the abode, when their expressions froze, because they had been surrounded.
At least a hundred over people blocked the entrance, but did not enter.
Instead, they were looking for someone to break through the formation.
Seeing Ling Han and the others appear, a white-browed old man immediately shouted, “All
of you, come here!”
“Sure enough, someone has entered.”
“This is just right.
Let them hand over what they have obtained, and save us the trouble of
going in and taking risks.”
“Yi, that woman is too beautiful!”
“She really is an exquisite beauty.
If I could sleep with her for a night, I would even be willing
to live a hundred years less.”
The others also saw Ling Han and the others, and began to talk.
The majority’s eyes were focused on Song Lan, their words without any reservations.
Song Lan instantly looked furious.
Not only was she the ninth beauty of the galaxy, she had also come from a clan that had a Venerate Tier elite.
She had been the beloved daughter of the clan since childhood, and had been doted on to the extreme.
When had she ever had such crude words spoken to her face?
However, there were a considerable number of people here that were in the Core Formation Tier.
If she went out, she would only be walking into a tiger’s den.
Moreover, once one’s desires exploded, who would still care if you were the heir of a Holy Land, or the descendant of a Venerate Tier elite?
Otherwise, would there still be the word ‘taking risks’?
Lu Qi humphed, and said, “Watch your mouths, and don’t seek your own suffering!” “Hey, pretty boy, who do you think you are?” A great many people turned to look at Lu Qi.
“Pei, you guys don’t even know my Master?” Cheng Bao immediately called out, “My Master
is Galaxy Network’s 19th, Lu Qi, Lord Lu!”
19th on the Galaxy Network!
This title was quite destructive.
Those people on the other side all fell into deep thought.
However, it wasn’t long before an old man spoke up, and said, “To say nothing of the 19th place, even the first place is only Cauldron Forging Tier.

There is a hierarchy in martial arts, and in front of us, the Core Formation Tiers, how could you be qualified to act arrogant?” “Come out, hand over what you have obtained, and we can let you leave.”
“Hehe, but this woman has to stay!”
Someone pointed at Song Lan and said, their eyes burning, unable to conceal their desire.
This woman was really too beautiful, causing one’s heart to throb wildly, and unable to stop their desire from burning.
Lu Qi humphed, “We are all disciples of the Nine Suns Holy Land, so could it be that you people dare to trifle with us?”
The surroundings instantly fell silent again.
The Nine Suns Holy Land was the strongest force in this galaxy, and any one of them would
have to submit to them.

To say nothing of the fact that there were only Core Formation Tier- level forces here, even if Venerate Tier elites came, they would have to consider the consequences of offending the Nine Suns Holy Land.
“Alright, you guys come out.
We won’t make things difficult for you,” an elder said with a
smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 3855: Count to ten
paragraphs: Ling Han and the others naturally didn’t believe it.
By the looks of it, he wanted to lure them out, and once they left, their lives would no longer be under their own control.
Cultivators were meant to control their own destiny, so how could they possibly entrust their lives to the kindness of others?

“You’re not coming out?” Outside, a person smirked coldly, “Our Formation Master is about to break through the formations here. You guys are completely like turtles in a jar. Furthermore, there is also a shielding Spirit Tool set up around here. It is impossible for you guys to contact the Galaxy Network or Holy Land, so don’t even think that anyone would come to save you guys.”
Ling Han and the others hurriedly opened the connection device. As expected, whether it was the Galaxy Network or the Holy Land Network, they were both unable to connect.
Instantly, even Lu Qi’s expression changed drastically.
Now, if these people killed them to keep the secret, they would really die here for nothing. But how could these people dare?
There was no concealing the truth. Once the news leaked out, they would all have to bear the fury of the Nine Suns Holy Land. How could a mere Core Formation Tier force withstand that?
However, the words “Core Formation Tier” were the true reason why these people dared to take risks.

-Because this was the abode of a Spirit Transformation True Lord, the secret technique that he had inherited was not taken seriously by Ling Han, Lu Qi and the others, but for Core Formation Tiers, just how valuable was it?
If their obtained it, perhaps he would be able to leap up to become a True Self Tier or even in fact become a Spirit Transformation Tier force.
Every major tier in martial arts was a fundamental change. Thus, the treasure trove of a Spirit Transformation True Lord was an irresistible temptation to a Core Formation Tier force.
Worse come to worst, after obtaining the secret technique, they could flee. No matter how far the reach of the Nine Suns Holy Land was, they couldn’t possibly touch every corner of the universe.
“Master, what should we do?” Cheng Bao and Zha Hu couldn’t help but ask.
The situation now was very dire.

Lu Qi did not speak. He had a rare treasure on him, which was enough to allow him to withstand the attacks of a Core Formation Tier elite without dying. However, that could only protect him alone, so he was naturally hesitant about how he could bring Song Lan out with him. As for Cheng Bao and Zha Hu, he did consider them at all.
He could just find a few more servants in the future.

However, he was also a little pleased. When these people attacked the formation, Ling Han would definitely be killed as well. Merely imagining that scene made him feel overwhelmed and slightly excited.

“You guys, whoever comes out to surrender first can be spared from death.” On the other side, someone laughed loudly, “Time is limited. I will only count to ten, so hurry up and seize the opportunity.”
“One!”
“Two!”

Song Lan also frowned slightly. She came from an extraordinary background, so she naturally had a life-saving Spirit Tool as well. However, Chang Qing Qing was her close friend, and she had also accompanied her to many ancient sites. If she were to escape alone, there would be a regret in her heart that she could not overcome.

“Lan Lan, you can break out of the siege on your own.” Chang Qingqing saw through her hesitation, “As long as you can break out of the siege, you can ask for help from the Holy Land. These people would naturally have reservations, and their only thought would be to flee for their lives.”

“That’s right,” Lu Qi hurriedly replied from the sidelines. Judging by Chang Qingqing’s confident tone, it was clear that Song Lan was capable of protecting himself. This caused her to feel much more at ease. In fact, he even felt a strong sense of satisfaction.

He and Song Lan were alive, while Ling Han was dead. This was the best result. “Celestial maiden Song, the two of us will break out of the siege together. That way, the success rate would be slightly higher,” Lu Qi said, as he glanced very obscurely at Ling Han, his expression filled with pride.
This was saying to Ling Han, “We’re leaving, just wait for your death.”
“Master!” Cheng Bao and Zha Hu were both shocked. Master was going to escape on his own, then what were they going to do?

“Don’t worry. Once Fairy Song and I escape, we’ll immediately ask the Holy Land for help. You two will definitely be fine.” Although Lu Qi didn’t care about the life or death of his two subordinates, he still had to put on an act and comfort Cheng Bao and Zha Hu.
Cheng Bao and Zha Hu both looked terrible. Once Lu Qi and Song Lan escaped, those people outside would definitely launch a mad offensive, tearing them into pieces.
They were trembling all over, completely at a loss.
Ling Han chuckled, and said, “There’s no need to act like we are going to die. Isn’t it just a few Core Formation Tiers?”
Lu Qi and Song Lan were both startled. Wasn’t it just a few Core Formation Tier cultivators?
‘How boastful of you. Don’t you know that the gap of a major tier means a complete one- sided suppression?’

Previously, when Lu Qi had cast his natural Mystical Power, it was merely comparable to the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, and almost broke through the defenses of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. What more when there were so many Core Formation Tier elites here, there should be quite a few that had reached the middle stage, late stage, or even the consummate level.
‘How are you going to withstand this?’
He actually said, “Isn’t it just a few Core Formation Tier cultivators?” What the heck.
“It’s already come to this, so what’s the point of boasting?” Song Lan frowned slightly, extremely displeased.
If it wasn’t for the fact that the jade pendant was still in Ling Han’s hands, she wouldn’t have bothered to care about Ling Han’s life or death. He actually dared to hold her slender hand!
Ling Han ignored her. He decided to use the Heavenly Dao Flames.
Of course, it was not because he had been entranced by Song Lan, and wanted to show off, but rather because Wu Qiyuan, Yuwen Tian and the others were all here.
Would this eventually be discovered by the Holy Land of Metal Element?

Ling Han didn’t pay too much attention to it. Even if it was discovered, how could it be that they could chase him all the way to the Nine Suns Holy Land to apprehend him? Moreover, it wasn’t only the Black Moon Planet that had Heavenly Dao Flames, so how could it be that
Ling Han couldn’t get it elsewhere?
He strode out.

“Ten!” At this moment, the person on the other side also slowly counted to ten. He watched as Ling Han slowly walked out of the formation, and a smile appeared at the corners of his lips, as he said, “Very good, very good. Finally, there is a smart person.”
Ling Han took a few more steps. He stopped, and broke into a grin, “Don’t say that I didn’t give you guys a chance. Retreat immediately, and I can spare your damn lives.”
Er!
When the people outside heard this, their expressions instantly varied.
Some were furious, while others smirked coldly. However, none of them took Ling Han’s
threat seriously.
This was natural. What right did a mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator have to threaten a Core Formation Tier cultivator?
“I’ll count to ten. If you still don’t retreat, I’m going to unleash a powerful attack,” Ling Han said slowly. “One, two, three...”
The man who had counted earlier flew into a thunderous rage. He himself was strong, and that was why he could play a game of cat and mouse. How could a mere Cauldron Forging Tier
like you dare to be so arrogant?
“You’re seeking death!” he said balefully.
He secretly decided that the moment Ling Han came out of the formation, he would
immediately rush up and directly blast Ling Han apart. He would show the others the consequences of a mere Cauldron Forging Tier provoking a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
“Ten!”
Ling Han suddenly stopped, and his eyes swept over the surroundings. Not a single person
stepped back.
This was a very obvious result. If there was anyone who was afraid and retreated, that would be an inconceivable thing.
Ling Han continued to walk forward at a very slow pace.
“Hurry up and break the formation!” the humiliated Core Formation Tier cultivator shouted
at the Formation Master who was breaking the formation. He looked like he wanted nothing more than to immediately charge into the formation and drag Ling Han out.
One was walking out, while the other was breaking into the formation. Thus, the two sides
soon met.
“Die!” The Core Formation Tier elite charged over.

chapters.title: Chapter 3856: Burned to nothing
paragraphs: “Sigh!” Ling Han shook his head. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was unleashed, and instantly, a flame gushed out like a tsunami, rolling towards him.
This speed was too fast. In an instant, the area within a few kilometers of them was
completely enveloped in a sea of flames.
“Ah-“Tragic cries rang out in all directions, but all of them had just cried out, when they suddenly stopped.
The Heavenly Dao Flames were too domineering, and could instantly burn a Core Formation Tier cultivator to death.
This was the case even for Core Formation Tier elites, what more for Cauldron Forging Tiers and Foundation Building Tiers.
As the fiery flames surged past, nothing could not be burned, and nothing could not be destroyed.
In just an instant, the whole world had become peaceful and quiet.

Ling Han turned around, only to see that Song Lan, Lu Qi, Wu Qiyuan and the others were all staring at him in dumbfounded shock. It was as if he weren’t a person, but rather a monster. “Why are you guys looking at me like that?” he asked with a faint smile.
Don’t you f****** know what you have done?
A whole bunch of Core Formation Tier cultivators were burned to death by your flames, and not even a single bone was left behind. How could they not be shocked?

If you were at the True Self Tier or a Spirit Transformation True Lord, then so be it. Killing even more Core Formation Tier cultivators wouldn’t be too shocking, but the problem here was that you are a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator.
Monster, he was definitely a monster.
Song Lan looked meaningfully at Ling Han. This person was really hiding his abilities. She had completely misjudged him.
With how terrifying those flames were, perhaps even True Self Tier elites or Spiritual Transformation Tier elites wouldn’t be able to rival them. Moreover, was this all of Ling Han’s trump cards?
Meanwhile, Lu Qi’s forehead was covered with cold sweat. If Ling Han had spat that flame at him, he would have long since turned into ashes, right?
19th on the Galaxy Network, and he was actually going to die soundlessly?
So what if he had cultivated to the Core Formation Tier? You see, so many Core Formation Tier cultivators had died without even being able to release their screams, so what could he do?
Unless... he launched a sneak attack on Ling Han, so that Ling Han wouldn’t even have the chance to unleash that world-destroying fire.

All of a sudden, many thoughts streaked through Lu Qi’s mind, and his feet moved slightly, unobtrusively turning himself, Song Lan and Ling Han into a straight line. Furthermore, if Ling Han suddenly made a move, Song Lan would be the one to bear the brunt of it. He did not believe that Ling Han would make a move on Song Lan.
There was no need to think about this, and this was a natural reaction.
“Thank you,” Song Lan said solemnly to Ling Han. Otherwise, she could have broken out of
the siege, but Chang Qingqing could possibly be torn to shreds by those Core Formation Tiers.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Let’s leave this place first.”
“All right.”
Everyone exited the formation area, then rode their Tools and headed towards the Transfer Formation.
On the way, everyone was still immersed in the shocking scene of how Ling Han had destroyed all Core Formation Tiers with a single fire, and could not come back to their senses for a long time.

Right until they arrived at the Transfer Formation, did they finally regain their senses. After paying the Dao Stones, they entered the Transfer Formation, and instantly returned to the Nine Suns Planet.
Now that they had set foot on the land of the Nine Suns Holy Land, they were really safe. What force here would dare to trifle with the disciples of the Nine Suns Holy Land?
It wasn’t long before they returned to the Holy Land.
“Ling Han, when can we set out?” Song Lan asked.
“Anytime,” Ling Han replied nonchalantly.

These words that came out of nowhere caused everyone to feel puzzled. However, the expressions of Wu Qiyuan, Yuwen Tian and the others were all “Oh, so you guys have already hooked up”, and Lu Qi’s expression was livid. This adulterous couple had actually reached some kind of agreement behind his back, which made him so furious that he wanted to commit murder.
However, he didn’t say a word, because he was afraid of Ling Han’s terrifying flames. “All right.” Song Lan nodded, “Then I will inform you when the time comes.”
“All right.”
After Song Lan and Chang Qingqing left, they naturally had to discuss this matter as well.

Meanwhile, Ling Han shared alchemical pills with Yuwen Tian and the others. However, Ling Han was more concerned about pill recipes than alchemical pills. Yuwen Tian and the others found a few, and stuffed them all into Ling Han’s hands. However, they were mostly Four Star pill recipes, and Ling Han was currently unable to concoct them.
He would just leave it for now.

Ling Han returned to meet with the empress and the others. He had not gained much from this trip. Instead, he had wasted a Heavenly Dao Flame. However, it had also proven the friendship between Wu Qiyuan, Huang Lingyun and the others, which was quite a
considerable gain.
The peaceful days had only passed for two days, when Song Lan sent a message to Ling Han, asking if he could set out tomorrow.
Ling Han naturally had no objections, so he agreed.
This time, only three people went. Ling Han, Song Lan, and Chang Qingqing went with Ling
Han.
They took the Transfer Formation, and after traveling through a considerable number of galaxies, they arrived on a planet of wilderness.

There were no large-scale forces here, and wild beasts rampaged. In fact, there was no shortage of Venerate Tier-level elites among them. Those wild beasts were too terrifying, so it was not suitable to settle down here at all.

However, precisely because there were many fierce beasts, there were a great many people hunting here. That was because the meat, skin, bones, fur, and internal organs of fierce beasts were all very useful, and could be sold for a very high price. If one could obtain a Demon Core, it was even more likely to be priceless.
A Heaven Tier alchemist actually set up his home here?

Don’t say, this planet was rich in alchemical pills, and the blood, bones, and Demon Cores of wild beasts could also be used to concoct alchemical pills. Thus, for alchemists, the environment here was actually very good.

The three of them followed the coordinates in the jade pendant and crossed mountains and ridges, passing through the territory of a great many fierce beasts. In fact, they even alerted a great beast on the level of Sect Master, forcing Ling Han to summon the Heavenly Dao Flames and burn it to death.

If he could kill a Sect Master Tier-level beast, his gains would definitely be astonishing. Merely its blood and flesh was a super treasure. However, the Heavenly DaoFlames was too domineering, directly burning that great beast to the point that not even a single bone was
left.
This was equivalent to wasting a chance to use the Heavenly Dao Flames.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel gloomy. Meanwhile, Song Lan wore an apologetic expression.
This woman couldn’t have done it on purpose, right?

Previously, they had actually been very careful. Logically speaking, they should not have alerted that great beast, but it just so happened that they had still alerted it. Could it be that this little girl was deliberately expending his Heavenly Dao Flames? With Song Lan’s personality, she was definitely unwilling to be restrained by Ling Han, and Ling Han, who possessed the Heavenly Dao Flames, had the ability to threaten her.

Thus, it was reasonable to use fierce beasts to expend the Heavenly Dao Flames. Hiss, he really could not underestimate this woman. Even though she was as beautiful as a fairy, she was definitely not just a pretty face. Her intelligence was definitely outstanding. Subsequently, Ling Han became even more careful, not giving Song Lan another chance to stimulate the wild beasts.
Of course, it was also possible that it had really been an accident previously, and Song Lan had not planned to deliberately exhaust Ling Han’s trump card.
After spending a whole nine days, they finally arrived at their destination.

It was not that the distance was too far, but rather that the whole journey was too dangerous. Flying on a Tool was a suicidal action. There were a great many Core Formation Tier-level, True Self Tier-level and even stronger fierce beasts in the skies, so they could only walk on the ground obediently. If they encountered powerful Demonic Beasts, they even had to take a different path, so how could they possibly speed up?
They studied the surroundings for quite a while, and only then did they find the entrance to
the abode. Using the jade pendant, they opened the doors.
A Heaven Tier alchemist’s treasure appeared in front of them.

In just an instant, the whole world had become peaceful and quiet.
Ling Han turned around, only to see that Song Lan, Lu Qi, Wu Qiyuan and the others were all staring at him in dumbfounded shock.
It was as if he weren’t a person, but rather a monster.
“Why are you guys looking at me like that?” he asked with a faint smile.
Don’t you f****** know what you have done?
A whole bunch of Core Formation Tier cultivators were burned to death by your flames, and not even a single bone was left behind.
How could they not be shocked?
If you were at the True Self Tier or a Spirit Transformation True Lord, then so be it.
Killing even more Core Formation Tier cultivators wouldn’t be too shocking, but the problem here was that you are a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator.
Monster, he was definitely a monster.
Song Lan looked meaningfully at Ling Han.
This person was really hiding his abilities.
She had completely misjudged him.
With how terrifying those flames were, perhaps even True Self Tier elites or Spiritual Transformation Tier elites wouldn’t be able to rival them.
Moreover, was this all of Ling Han’s trump cards?
Meanwhile, Lu Qi’s forehead was covered with cold sweat.
If Ling Han had spat that flame at him, he would have long since turned into ashes, right?
19th on the Galaxy Network, and he was actually going to die soundlessly?
So what if he had cultivated to the Core Formation Tier?
You see, so many Core Formation Tier cultivators had died without even being able to release their screams, so what could he do?
Unless... he launched a sneak attack on Ling Han, so that Ling Han wouldn’t even have the chance to unleash that world-destroying fire.
All of a sudden, many thoughts streaked through Lu Qi’s mind, and his feet moved slightly, unobtrusively turning himself, Song Lan and Ling Han into a straight line.
Furthermore, if Ling Han suddenly made a move, Song Lan would be the one to bear the brunt of it.
He did not believe that Ling Han would make a move on Song Lan.
There was no need to think about this, and this was a natural reaction.
“Thank you,” Song Lan said solemnly to Ling Han.
Otherwise, she could have broken out of
the siege, but Chang Qingqing could possibly be torn to shreds by those Core Formation Tiers.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Let’s leave this place first.”
“All right.”
Everyone exited the formation area, then rode their Tools and headed towards the Transfer Formation.
On the way, everyone was still immersed in the shocking scene of how Ling Han had destroyed all Core Formation Tiers with a single fire, and could not come back to their senses for a long time.
Right until they arrived at the Transfer Formation, did they finally regain their senses.
After paying the Dao Stones, they entered the Transfer Formation, and instantly returned to the Nine Suns Planet.
Now that they had set foot on the land of the Nine Suns Holy Land, they were really safe.
What force here would dare to trifle with the disciples of the Nine Suns Holy Land?
It wasn’t long before they returned to the Holy Land.
“Ling Han, when can we set out?” Song Lan asked.
“Anytime,” Ling Han replied nonchalantly.
These words that came out of nowhere caused everyone to feel puzzled.
However, the expressions of Wu Qiyuan, Yuwen Tian and the others were all “Oh, so you guys have already hooked up”, and Lu Qi’s expression was livid.
This adulterous couple had actually reached some kind of agreement behind his back, which made him so furious that he wanted to commit murder.
However, he didn’t say a word, because he was afraid of Ling Han’s terrifying flames.
“All right.” Song Lan nodded, “Then I will inform you when the time comes.”
“All right.”
After Song Lan and Chang Qingqing left, they naturally had to discuss this matter as well.
Meanwhile, Ling Han shared alchemical pills with Yuwen Tian and the others.
However, Ling Han was more concerned about pill recipes than alchemical pills.
Yuwen Tian and the others found a few, and stuffed them all into Ling Han’s hands.
However, they were mostly Four Star pill recipes, and Ling Han was currently unable to concoct them.
He would just leave it for now.
Ling Han returned to meet with the empress and the others.
He had not gained much from this trip.
Instead, he had wasted a Heavenly Dao Flame.
However, it had also proven the friendship between Wu Qiyuan, Huang Lingyun and the others, which was quite a
considerable gain.
The peaceful days had only passed for two days, when Song Lan sent a message to Ling Han, asking if he could set out tomorrow.
Ling Han naturally had no objections, so he agreed.
This time, only three people went.
Ling Han, Song Lan, and Chang Qingqing went with Ling
Han.
They took the Transfer Formation, and after traveling through a considerable number of galaxies, they arrived on a planet of wilderness.
There were no large-scale forces here, and wild beasts rampaged.
In fact, there was no shortage of Venerate Tier-level elites among them.
Those wild beasts were too terrifying, so it was not suitable to settle down here at all.
However, precisely because there were many fierce beasts, there were a great many people hunting here.
That was because the meat, skin, bones, fur, and internal organs of fierce beasts were all very useful, and could be sold for a very high price.
If one could obtain a Demon Core, it was even more likely to be priceless.
A Heaven Tier alchemist actually set up his home here?
Don’t say, this planet was rich in alchemical pills, and the blood, bones, and Demon Cores of wild beasts could also be used to concoct alchemical pills.
Thus, for alchemists, the environment here was actually very good.
The three of them followed the coordinates in the jade pendant and crossed mountains and ridges, passing through the territory of a great many fierce beasts.
In fact, they even alerted a great beast on the level of Sect Master, forcing Ling Han to summon the Heavenly Dao Flames and burn it to death.
If he could kill a Sect Master Tier-level beast, his gains would definitely be astonishing.
Merely its blood and flesh was a super treasure.
However, the Heavenly DaoFlames was too domineering, directly burning that great beast to the point that not even a single bone was
left.
This was equivalent to wasting a chance to use the Heavenly Dao Flames.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel gloomy.
Meanwhile, Song Lan wore an apologetic expression.
This woman couldn’t have done it on purpose, right?
Previously, they had actually been very careful.
Logically speaking, they should not have alerted that great beast, but it just so happened that they had still alerted it.
Could it be that this little girl was deliberately expending his Heavenly Dao Flames?
With Song Lan’s personality, she was definitely unwilling to be restrained by Ling Han, and Ling Han, who possessed the Heavenly Dao Flames, had the ability to threaten her.
Thus, it was reasonable to use fierce beasts to expend the Heavenly Dao Flames.
Hiss, he really could not underestimate this woman.
Even though she was as beautiful as a fairy, she was definitely not just a pretty face.
Her intelligence was definitely outstanding.
Subsequently, Ling Han became even more careful, not giving Song Lan another chance to stimulate the wild beasts.
Of course, it was also possible that it had really been an accident previously, and Song Lan had not planned to deliberately exhaust Ling Han’s trump card.
After spending a whole nine days, they finally arrived at their destination.
It was not that the distance was too far, but rather that the whole journey was too dangerous.
Flying on a Tool was a suicidal action.
There were a great many Core Formation Tier-level, True Self Tier-level and even stronger fierce beasts in the skies, so they could only walk on the ground obediently.
If they encountered powerful Demonic Beasts, they even had to take a different path, so how could they possibly speed up?
They studied the surroundings for quite a while, and only then did they find the entrance to
the abode.
Using the jade pendant, they opened the doors.
A Heaven Tier alchemist’s treasure appeared in front of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 3857: Ascending Dragon Gathering
paragraphs: Ling Han and the others entered the abode and searched for a while, but they were all disappointed.
All the treasures had been taken by Sun Quan?

No, the pill recipe that Sun Quan had discovered and the alchemical pill that he had taken were only a part of it, and was the less valuable part of it at that. The truly valuable pill recipes and alchemical pills were still here. However, this was protected by a supreme formation, and could not be entered at all.

Even when Ling Han and Chang Qingqing teamed up, they were still unsuccessful. At most, they could only form a formation that could deal with Core Formation Tier, but if this was only the level of Core Formation Tier, so how could this possibly block Sun Quan? He was a Spirit Transformation True Lord.
Thus, this formation was at least Sect Master-level, or even Venerate Tier-level.
They were naturally at a loss of what to do now.
What could they do?
The three of them exchanged looks, then shook their heads. They could not do anything at all.
Song Lan was extremely disappointed. In fact, she even felt a sense of misery.
“Lan Lan, don’t worry. There must be another way,” Chang Qingqing consoled.

Song Lan smiled bitterly, and said, “The pill recipe for the Tenth Leaf Revival Pill has long since been lost. In the past, only Alchemist Qinghe could concoct this pill. However, he didn’t have a successor, so I had initially thought that Sun Quan would be able to obtain it. Unexpectedly, when I traced it back here, I was still disappointed.”
“What do you want the Tenth Leaf Revival Pill for?” Ling Han asked.
Song Lan paused slightly, then said, “When my great-grandfather was cultivating, he went mad, and can only be saved by the Tenth Leaf Revival Pill.”
Oh, so that was how it was.
Ling Han chuckled, “Then when I reach the level of Sect Master, I’ll break through the formation here and obtain the pill recipe. I’ll help you concoct the alchemical pill.”
He said these words very casually, as if he was just talking about an incredibly simple matter.
Song Lan instinctively wanted to retort, but on second thought, Ling Han was indeed qualified to do so.
– Being able to concoct the Cauldron Heart Pill meant that Ling Han’s natural talent in alchemy was astonishing.
-And now, he had also displayed his outstanding natural talent in formations. He was already a master of both alchemy and formations.
And being able to enter into the Holy Land, there was naturally no need to doubt his natural talent in cultivation.
The question was, how long would Ling Han need to advance to the level of Sect Master? Ten years, a hundred years, a thousand years?
Could Song Lan afford to wait? Could that Venerate Tier elite from the Song Clan afford to wait?
“Then I’ll thank you in advance.” Song Lan nodded. Merely for Ling Han’s good intentions, she still had to thank him.
“When we meet in the future, remember to call me good brother,” Ling Han said seriously. Shua, what greeted him was a gust of wind from Song Lan’s palm.
Ling Han leaped over, dodging the palm strike. He was only joking, and Song Lan also knew that, so this palm strike did not have much destructive power.
“Let’s go back.”

They returned to the Nine Suns Holy Land, and Lu Qi obviously found out that the three of them had gone out together. It was rumored that he had flown into a thunderous rage, and destroyed his own house.
Aside from cultivating, Ling Han also started to wander around the Holy Land.
Where exactly had the Nine Suns Saint hidden the secret technique inheritance?
“Old Black, it’s up to you now,” Ling Han said to the large black dog.
The large black dog was instantly proud, “What is it? You still have to depend on your Grandpa Dog, right?”

“Yes, I need your dog’s nose,” Ling Han said with a smile. “Let’s see if we can find something that the Nine Suns Saint used years ago. I’ll let you smell it, and then dig out even the Nine Suns Saint’s underpants.”
“Woof, Grandpa Dog will fight you to the death!”
However, no matter how hard they searched, they couldn’t find a single trace.

“We have to change our way of thinking. In these close to 100 million years, all the places that could be searched should have been flipped over a few times, yet not a single person has succeeded. Perhaps, this inheritance is not in the Nine Suns Holy Land,” Ling Han deduced.

“Then how are we supposed to find it?” The large black dog shook his head, “Just how big is the Nine Suns Planet? To carefully turn over every inch of it, it would be impossible without a few thousand or tens of thousands of years.”
“So, within the Nine Suns Holy Land, there should be clues that point to the secret technique inheritance, and not the inheritance itself hidden here. Let’s use this line of thought to look for it.”
“All right.”

The man and dog began to search. Not only them, but Lin Luo, Zhou Heng and the others also joined the search team. With the Holy Land’s resources nurturing them, everyone soon broke through to the Foundation Building Tier and became Cauldron Forging Tiers. -To these prodigies, the barrier into Cauldron Forging Tier was really nothing. However, they had not searched for a few days, when a big piece of news came. The Ascending Dragon Gathering of the North Heavenly Realm was about to begin. The entire universe was divided into four super-large regions, which were respectively the East Heaven Realm, West Heavenly Realm, South Heavenly Realm and North Heavenly Realm. Just how big was a Heavenly Realm? Even if one was using Transfer Formations to roam a circle, the time needed would number in dozens of years, which showed just how expansive a Heavenly Realm was.
The Ascending Dragon Gathering was a super-large event of the North Heavenly Realm. Anyone below the True Self Tier could attend. They would be able to enter into a super-large
Mystery Realm, where they could obtain great fortune.
Thus, those who had reached the Foundation Building Tier, the Cauldron Forging Tier, or the Core Formation Tier would try their best to get a ticket to enter.

For example, if Ling Han was currently in the Cauldron Forging Tier, he would be able to capture celestial clouds in the Mystery Realm and nurture them in the Celestial Cauldron. He would then be able to cultivate a Mystical Power, and turn the celestial clouds into an indestructible divine light.
In future, when he broke through to the Core Formation Tier, the celestial clouds could also be fused into the Celestial Core, increasing the quality of the Celestial Core.
And the Mystery Realm also had various opportunities that could speed up the cultivation of cultivators.
In short, this was a chance for a hidden dragon to rise to the heavens, and that was why it was called the Ascending Dragon Gathering.
Ling Han’s heart naturally throbbed wildly. He was sure that he would definitely be able to obtain a spot.
Sure enough, it wasn’t long before the Holy Land announced this. However, Ling Han was overthinking things. Not only did he have a spot, but everyone else did. None of them had
failed.
As a Holy Land, they naturally had enough spots.
Thus, everyone only needed to make some preparations. They would set out in a month’s time, heading towards the Great Forest Planet.

Only now did Ling Han find out why the Holy Land didn’t hold any ranking competition in advance. That was because there was no need. Everyone could go to the Ascending Dragon Gathering, so what was the point of fighting for nothing?

Everyone was very excited. This was a chance for a carp to leap over the Dragon’s Gate. As long as they obtained a great opportunity in the Mystery Realm, it was no daydream to achieve a great breakthrough in cultivation level. Their abilities would also be greatly improved in a battle of equal cultivation levels.
A hidden dragon ascended to the heavens, and from now onwards, this dragon would look proudly down on the heaven and earth.

The empress, Lin Luo, and the others were also filled with wild ambition. The gap between them and Ling Han was very wide, and they hoped that they could use this opportunity to close the gap between them. They couldn’t always have Ling Han charge ahead of them, bringing them great fortune.
This was especially the case for Lin Luo, Zhou Heng, and the others. Which of them wasn’t a big shot of the Genesis World? How proud and arrogant were they?
A month later, everyone set out, heading towards Great Forest Planet. This trip was led by a Venerate Tier elite, and it was precisely the Nine Mountains Venerate. In

this world where Saints almost never appeared, Venerate Tier elites could be considered the strongest battle prowess. With the Nine Mountains Venerate leading the team, what blind fool would dare to attack?
However, the Nine Mountains Venerate did not have a very high status in everyone’s hearts. He actually tricked juniors like them into buying him foor and drink. Though they could not
say anything in public, there would definitely be some discussions in private.
With how powerful the Nine Mountains Venerate was, how could he not know?
Thus, his expression was always livid.
“Achoo!” Amidst the Nine Suns Holy Land, a white cat sneezed. “Yi, which b@stard is cursing
me?”
