chapters.title: Chapter 3858: White Lotus Holy Land
paragraphs: Even if there were Transfer Formations along the way, no one could use them continuously without pause. Thus, they spent a total of seventeen days before finally arriving at the Great Forest Planet.
The Great Forest Planet was a super large planet. There had once been an Ancestral King, and he was respectfully known as the White Lotus Holy Emperor.

This was one of the few female Ancestral Kings who had defeated tens of thousands of prodigies all those years ago. In the end, she had ascended to the throne, and could be considered a hero among women.
It was said that the Mystery Realm here was created by the White Lotus Holy Emperor.

A long time ago, the entrance to this Mystery Realm was not fixed. It could be on some planet, or it could be in the depths of the universe, but the White Lotus Holy Emperor had used a great technique to eternally fix this entrance on the Great Forest Planet.
The Ascending Dragon Gathering would be held once every million years; why did it have to take so long?
It was very simple. This large Mystery Realm would only appear once every million years. Merely from this, it was clear how important this Mystery Realm was.

After arriving at the Great Forest Planet, the Nine Mountains Venerate didn’t bring them to the ancestral grounds of the White Lotus Holy Emperor. Instead, he found a random place to settle down. In any case, it wouldn’t be too late for them to rush over after the Ascending Dragon Gathering began.
In this great Mystery Realm, it had never been the case that one would be able to obtain great fortune by arriving first.
The so-called great opportunity was a coincidence. There was no such thing as first come, first served.

There were more than 400 people in their group, and there were always some people with out-of-character personalities who could not bear the loneliness. Since they were free now, they went out to roam around.

However, this place was now the center of entire North Heavenly Realm. Countless forces had already arrived, or were in the process of catching up to them. The chances of encountering other forces while strolling around outside was astonishingly high. Sometimes, it was inevitable that conflicts would arise.
Some were minor conflicts, while some were quite big. In fact, they had even gotten into a group fight.
Although the Nine Suns Holy Land was well-known in the universe, it didn’t necessarily have the upper hand in this kind of conflict.
The reason was very simple. There was no Core Formation Tier elite.

There would only be enrollment every 10,000 years, and these were the two levels of the Cauldron Forging Tier and the Foundation Building Tier. In a mere year, not a single person had advanced into the Core Formation Tier. How could this compare to other forces?
They only had to send out a Core Formation Tier cultivator, and it would be enough to make the Nine Suns Holy Land’s party fall.
Thus, after a few battles, the youngsters of Nine Suns Holy Land also learned to keep a low profile, and for the moment, it was best not to cause any more trouble.
It was also very lively on the Galaxy Network. Occasionally, there would be people saying that some elite or prodigy had arrived.

Unfortunately, Origin, Myriad Dao, Heaven Crushing, and Number One in the Galaxy were all too mysterious. No one knew what their true identities were, and which Heavenly Realm they belonged to. Thus, it was unknown whether they would be participating in this gathering.

For example, Lu Qi was ranked 19th in Cauldron Forging Tier on the Galaxy Network. His arrival naturally shocked the Galaxy Network. In truth, as long as one could enter into the top 1000, they would be a well-known figure, and would be pursued wherever they went.

Ling Han’s “Ling Han” account had only reached the 100,000s, so it naturally belonged to an unknown category. However, “The Number One in the Galaxy” had already reached the 900s. Every day, it would advance four to five places, and it would take a long time for it to enter the top 100.
As a whole, the strength of the North Heavenly Realm was relatively weak.

Because among the top ten Cauldron Forging Tiers of the Galaxy Network, there was not a single one from the North Heavenly Realm – the highest ranking in the North Heavenly Realm was only 12th in fact. Thus, Lu Qi’s 19th place was naturally awesome, and could even be ranked in the top five in the North Heavenly Realm.
It was not just the Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators. It was the same for Foundation Building cultivators, and Core Formation Tier cultivators.

Although there wouldn’t be any level battles after Sect Master-level, it was said that the number of elites at the Minor Advanced Tier and fourth pinnacle level of the North Heavenly Realm were also the least. Moreover, all of this was caused by a great battle ten million years ago, which seriously affected the fortune of the Heavenly Realm. Thus, it was very difficult for the most top-notch characters to emerge from this place.

Ling Han wanted to find out more about this part of history, yet he discovered that there was a huge blank in history. He actually couldn’t find any information on the Galaxy Network. He only knew that a huge battle had broken out, but he had no idea who exactly was fighting with whom, or what level of elite was fighting.
To be able to cause the fortune of a Heavenly Realm to fall, could it be that it was Ancestral Kings that were fighting?
However, who didn’t know that only one Ancestral King could appear in each era?
-Hold on.

Ling Han suddenly recalled that Brother Monkey had once said that the Ancestral King of his bloodline had gone to some Mystery Realm at the edge of the universe to search for a way to achieve immortality. He had not returned even now, but it was very possible that he was still
alive.
Thus, it was possible that two Ancestral Kings would coexist in this world.

The Ancestral King had gathered the fortune of heaven and earth, and was invincible in this world. The battle between two great Ancestral Kings had shattered the fortune of a Heavenly Realm. This was something that was possible.
Forget it. There was no point in guessing randomly here.
Ling Han placed his focus on the Mystery Realm.

This Mystery Realm was nameless, but because it was forcibly fixed by the White Lotus Holy Emperor, every million years, it could allow the world to obtain good fortune. Thus, to commemorate this Ancestral King, this great Mystery Realm was called the White Lotus
Mystery Realm.
In truth, this Mystery Realm was incredibly colossal, and the environment inside was also extremely complicated.

There were Celestial medicines that could increase one’s cultivation level there, as well as celestial clouds that others would drool over. There were also transcendent minerals that could allow the Celestial Core to evolve the Celestial Cauldron had the difference between bronze, silver and gold, and Celestial Cores naturally had them as well. Some of the active minerals could turn a Copper Core into Silver Core, Silver Core into Golden Core, and allow cultivators to undergo a qualitative change.
Thus, this was a chance for a hidden dragon to rise to the heavens.
It was said that the White Lotus Mystery Realm also had an ultimate good fortune. It was personally said by the White Lotus Holy Emperor, but no one had ever obtained it.
No one knew what that good fortune was, but to be described by the word ‘ultimate’ by an Ancestral King was enough proof of how nature-defying this good fortune was.
Another ten days later, the Ascending Dragon Gathering began.
A blazing light descended from the skies, and then a doorway of light appeared out of thin air. That was linked with another world.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Instantly, countless people flew out on their divine tools, coming out from all corners, heading towards that doorway of light.
The doorway of light was over 500 meters tall and 300 meters wide. It was truly magnificent.
It was clear how powerful the Holy Emperor was.
A great many people directly passed through the doorway of light, but there were also a great many that crashed head-first into it, and then fell straight down.
Why? Some people’s cultivation levels were inconsistent with the requirements.
A True Self Tier cultivator wanted to enter? No way.
Some were not qualified. If they wanted to pass through the stargate, they would first have to
obtain a token issued by the Lian Clan – the Lian Clan was a descendant of the White Lotus
Holy Emperor.
“Go on,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said.
Everyone had long since been unable to restrain themselves. Immediately, they leaped up, and steered the precious tool towards the doorway of light.
Weng!

They all had the tokens of the Lian Clan, and this was something that the Nine Mountains Venerate had just given them. Thus, they naturally passed through the doorway of light, and felt as if they had passed through a layer of mud. Their speed instantly slowed, and the scenery in front of their eyes was also swaying. When they recovered their speed, they had already appeared in a new world.
The surroundings were boundless, and there were rocks everywhere.
Yi, where were the others?
Ling Han looked left and right. He had clearly entered with the empress and Hu Niu, so why
was he the only one left?

sentences.text: Even if there were Transfer Formations along the way, no one could use them continuously without pause.
Thus, they spent a total of seventeen days before finally arriving at the Great Forest Planet.
The Great Forest Planet was a super large planet.
There had once been an Ancestral King, and he was respectfully known as the White Lotus Holy Emperor.
This was one of the few female Ancestral Kings who had defeated tens of thousands of prodigies all those years ago.
In the end, she had ascended to the throne, and could be considered a hero among women.

A long time ago, the entrance to this Mystery Realm was not fixed.
It could be on some planet, or it could be in the depths of the universe, but the White Lotus Holy Emperor had used a great technique to eternally fix this entrance on the Great Forest Planet.
The Ascending Dragon Gathering would be held once every million years; why did it have to take so long?
It was very simple.
This large Mystery Realm would only appear once every million years.
Merely from this, it was clear how important this Mystery Realm was.
After arriving at the Great Forest Planet, the Nine Mountains Venerate didn’t bring them to the ancestral grounds of the White Lotus Holy Emperor.
Instead, he found a random place to settle down.
In any case, it wouldn’t be too late for them to rush over after the Ascending Dragon Gathering began.
In this great Mystery Realm, it had never been the case that one would be able to obtain great fortune by arriving first.
The so-called great opportunity was a coincidence.
There was no such thing as first come, first served.
There were more than 400 people in their group, and there were always some people with out-of-character personalities who could not bear the loneliness.
Since they were free now, they went out to roam around.
However, this place was now the center of entire North Heavenly Realm.
Countless forces had already arrived, or were in the process of catching up to them.
The chances of encountering other forces while strolling around outside was astonishingly high.
Sometimes, it was inevitable that conflicts would arise.
Some were minor conflicts, while some were quite big.
In fact, they had even gotten into a group fight.
Although the Nine Suns Holy Land was well-known in the universe, it didn’t necessarily have the upper hand in this kind of conflict.
The reason was very simple.
There was no Core Formation Tier elite.
There would only be enrollment every 10,000 years, and these were the two levels of the Cauldron Forging Tier and the Foundation Building Tier.
In a mere year, not a single person had advanced into the Core Formation Tier.
How could this compare to other forces?
They only had to send out a Core Formation Tier cultivator, and it would be enough to make the Nine Suns Holy Land’s party fall.
Thus, after a few battles, the youngsters of Nine Suns Holy Land also learned to keep a low profile, and for the moment, it was best not to cause any more trouble.

Occasionally, there would be people saying that some elite or prodigy had arrived.
Unfortunately, Origin, Myriad Dao, Heaven Crushing, and Number One in the Galaxy were all too mysterious.
No one knew what their true identities were, and which Heavenly Realm they belonged to.
Thus, it was unknown whether they would be participating in this gathering.
For example, Lu Qi was ranked 19th in Cauldron Forging Tier on the Galaxy Network.
His arrival naturally shocked the Galaxy Network.
In truth, as long as one could enter into the top 1000, they would be a well-known figure, and would be pursued wherever they went.
Ling Han’s “Ling Han” account had only reached the 100,000s, so it naturally belonged to an unknown category.
However, “The Number One in the Galaxy” had already reached the 900s.
Every day, it would advance four to five places, and it would take a long time for it to enter the top 100.
As a whole, the strength of the North Heavenly Realm was relatively weak.

Because among the top ten Cauldron Forging Tiers of the Galaxy Network, there was not a single one from the North Heavenly Realm – the highest ranking in the North Heavenly Realm was only 12th in fact.
Thus, Lu Qi’s 19th place was naturally awesome, and could even be ranked in the top five in the North Heavenly Realm.
It was not just the Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators.
It was the same for Foundation Building cultivators, and Core Formation Tier cultivators.

Although there wouldn’t be any level battles after Sect Master-level, it was said that the number of elites at the Minor Advanced Tier and fourth pinnacle level of the North Heavenly Realm were also the least.
Moreover, all of this was caused by a great battle ten million years ago, which seriously affected the fortune of the Heavenly Realm.
Thus, it was very difficult for the most top-notch characters to emerge from this place.
Ling Han wanted to find out more about this part of history, yet he discovered that there was a huge blank in history.
He actually couldn’t find any information on the Galaxy Network.
He only knew that a huge battle had broken out, but he had no idea who exactly was fighting with whom, or what level of elite was fighting.
To be able to cause the fortune of a Heavenly Realm to fall, could it be that it was Ancestral Kings that were fighting?
However, who didn’t know that only one Ancestral King could appear in each era?
-Hold on.

Ling Han suddenly recalled that Brother Monkey had once said that the Ancestral King of his bloodline had gone to some Mystery Realm at the edge of the universe to search for a way to achieve immortality.
He had not returned even now, but it was very possible that he was still
alive.
Thus, it was possible that two Ancestral Kings would coexist in this world.
The Ancestral King had gathered the fortune of heaven and earth, and was invincible in this world.
The battle between two great Ancestral Kings had shattered the fortune of a Heavenly Realm.
This was something that was possible.
Forget it.

chapters.title: Chapter 3859: Desolate plains
paragraphs: Ling Han turned on the connection device. Of course, it was Galaxy Network’s. After leaving the galaxy governed by Nine Suns Holy Land, the holy land’s network naturally couldn’t be connected.
However, in this Mystery Realm, the Galaxy Network connection device was also useless.
Looks like he could only return to the most primitive method of communication – face meeting.
face-to-
“This is a desolate plain, followed by a mountain of flames, followed by a desert, followed by an ice valley, and lastly, the Weapon Mountains. This is the first stage.”
Information about the White Lotus Mystery Realm flashed through Ling Han’s mind, but in truth, there was not much information about this Mystery Realm.
-Many great sects and clans regarded this as a secret, so how could it possibly be passed on to outsiders?

And in the case of the Nine Suns Holy Land, because they would only open their doors every 10,000 years, this led to the fact that when the Ascending Dragon Gathering began, there were a great many times when they did not have disciples that could participate – they would either have died, or broken through to the True Self Tier.
Thus, the authorities of the Holy Land did not have much information on this Mystery Realm. Ling Han could only slowly explore with the limited information.

If he wanted to reunite with the empress and the others, he would probably have to pass this first stage, but as for what the second stage was, Ling Han still didn’t know, because in history, there were very few people that could pass the first stage. It would be good enough if even one in a hundred could complete it.
Furthermore, this Mystery Realm did not only contain opportunities, but also dangers.
However, didn’t they have the tokens of the Lian Clan on them?
If he really encountered an irresolvable danger, he only had to crush the token, and he would be immediately teleported out of the Mystery Realm.
However, he only had one chance. Once he left, it would be impossible for him to come back in. Otherwise, he would have to wait another million years.
That was a million years, and even Saints could only live for so long. Who could afford to wait that long?

And precisely because of this, every time the White Lotus Mystery Realm opened, there would always be a great many people who wanted to take a gamble, and for a long time, did not crush their tokens, and lost their lives here.
Ling Han thought to himself as he continued to advance. This was an endless desolate plain. The ground was covered with uneven rocks, and weeds grew between the rocks, showing a strong vitality.

Flying on a Tool could not be done here, and there was a powerful gravity field pressing down on them. Furthermore, it was not just the problem of being unable to fly here. Even travelling was slightly difficult. Under the pressure of the powerful gravity field, one would be out of breath without walking very far.
But this was not the only problem that had to be considered, because there were still a great many traps here.
Some rocks weren’t as sturdy as they looked. Instead, they would shatter with a single stomp, and there was a deep hole beneath them.

Flying on a Tool could not be done here, so if one really stepped into a trap, if he could not escape at the first instant, he would have to use his token to save his life. That was because if he fell to the bottom, he would basically be crushed into pieces. Furthermore, even if he did not die from the fall, with how heavy the gravity field here was, it would be impossible for him to climb out.
Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, wanting to see if the Imperial Weapon could dispel the gravity fields.
However, what disappointed him was the fact that even the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower could do nothing about it.
This wasn’t because the Origin Gold was weak, but rather because the level of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was far too low.
Sigh, he had brought shame to the Origin Gold.
Ling Han pulled himself together. He also had to be careful. He didn’t want to return with his tail between his legs before he had even completed the first area of the first stage.
He strode forward, one step after another, steady and powerful.
‘Hmm?’
He placed a foot down, but the rock beneath his foot was soft and he did not feel any force exerted. Immediately, it shattered.
Ling Han hurriedly channelled the Imminent Skyline, and took another step at an incredibly fast pace, successfully stepping on another rock.
He turned around and saw that the rock from before had completely disappeared. In its place was a pit that was so deep that the bottom could not be seen.
As an extremely curious person, Ling Han didn’t leave immediately. Instead, he activated his eye technique and looked into the pit.
It was really deep. Even with Ling Han’s eye technique, he couldn’t see the bottom. If he fell, it would definitely be terrible.
Ling Han sighed, and continued onwards.
On the way, he encountered a great many such traps, but they were all successfully resolved by him. Unknowingly, the sky had darkened.
Ling Han did not continue his journey. He had to maintain abundant energy. Otherwise, if he worked day and night, his spirit would definitely not be able to bear it. Then, it would not be
worth it.

He then sat down in a cross-legged position on a large rock, channelling the Ancient Sun Scroll, absorbing the weak power of heaven and earth in the surroundings to recover the power that he had expended during the day.
This effect was very poor, but he did not battle during daytime, so his mystical power was limited in expenditure. After more than an hour, his mystical power had completely
recovered.
Ling Han took out the vicious beast meat he had hunted earlier, and started a fire to barbeque. Not long after, a fragrant smell wafted in all directions.

This was a Cauldron Forging Tier-level fierce beast, and its meat contained astonishing energy. Not only could it rapidly replenish physical power, it was also greatly nutritious for the body. After ingesting it for a long time, one’s physique would definitely become even tougher — just look at Wu Qiyuan, who knew just how great the effects of eating fierce beast meat from a young age would be on the body.
However, after a while, Ling Han revealed a stern expression, because he could sense that there was a life aura approaching him.
Was it a competitor that had also entered into this space?

Ling Han was on his guard, but he wasn’t overly nervous, because he was basically invincible in the Cauldron Forging Tier, and if he encountered a Core Formation Tier, he also had the Heavenly Dao Flames, which he could use as a deterrent-he still had five chances to use it.
In a short while, a round creature popped out.
This thing looked a little like a bear, but its body was covered with sharp spikes, and every spike was exuding a cold light.
Ling Han shuddered upon seeing this. This was a ferocious beast, and he could see this from its eyes and from the aura that it exuded. It was filled with ferocity and viciousness.
However, because this guy’s figure was too round, it was very difficult to connect it with a
fierce beast.
This fierce beast did not stop, but rather rushed over at the first instant, launching an attack at
Ling Han.
Good lord, even a small beast in the Foundation Building Tier was so arrogant?
Against fierce beasts, there was naturally no need to be reserved. Ling Han merely shot out a murderous aura attack, and that fierce beast was scared to death, falling head first.
He wondered how this ferocious beast would taste like.
Ling Han mumbled internally. As a glutton, his first thought was naturally to eat.
However, before he could finish his thought, he frowned, because he could sense even more
auras approaching him.
One, two, three, and at least a few hundred round things appeared.
F***, had he poked a hornet’s nest? There were so many fierce beasts, but why hadn’t he seen
a single one in the day?
Had they all been seduced by the aroma of the meat?

Ling Han stood up. The wild beasts here were not only Foundation Building Tier-level, but also Cauldron Forging Tier-level, and there were quite a number of them. Instantly, a few dozen fierce beasts rushed over at the same time. When they had rushed close enough, these fierce beasts all curled up, and like a ball, crashed towards Ling Han. These wild beasts had spikes all over their bodies, which turned into a ball that smashed over.
The destructive power was quite shocking.

Ling Han still shot out a barrage of murderous aura. Peng, peng, peng! Instantly, half of the wild beasts fell directly from midair. Their minds were shattered, and they instantly died on the spot, but half of the wild beasts still charged over.

chapters.title: Chapter 3860: Bragging
paragraphs: About twenty over fierce beasts crashed over. They were like heavy rocks that had been tossed over by catapults, and they were even wrapped with spikes.
Ling Han activated the Starlight Screen. At present, there were pitifully few opponents in the Cauldron Forging Tier that could force him to use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Peng, peng, peng! One after another, fierce beasts crashed over, causing the light screen to tremble. However, it continued to stubbornly exist, and did not crack.
Ling Han humphed, and shot out a punch.
It would be impolite not to reciprocate; they should take a blow from him as well.
Peng!
Instantly, those fierce beasts flew up, and were all sent flying with a single punch from him.

However, even more wild beasts gathered together, using themselves as weapons, and smashed towards Ling Han. Furthermore, there was even light glowing on the spikes of a great many wild beasts, as if they knew that normal impacts could not cause any damage to Ling Han, and thus launched powerful attacks.

Peng, peng, peng! This time, it was different. As the fierce beasts crashed towards him, one after another, cracks appeared on the light screen. There were more and more of them, and it looked like it was about to break open.
This incited an even stronger desire for attack from the wild beasts, and they smashed towards him as if they were mad.
Ling Han smiled faintly. As his Spiritual Power surged, the Starlight Screen was restored to its original state.
With his reserves of mystical power, he was completely capable of standing still like this, allowing these Demonic Beasts to crash to the point of death.

However, he naturally wouldn’t be so passive. He immediately launched a counterattack. With a punch, a dozen over ferocious beasts were immediately sent flying. Some of their hearts were directly shattered, and they instantly died on the spot.

Against Vicious Beasts, he naturally did not need to be reserved. He went all out, and as he shot out punch after punch, there were endless Vicious Beasts that were destroyed by him. Their corpses were like flowers scattered by a celestial maiden, falling down from the skies.
Now that there was blood, his killing intent also rose. He turned into a god of death, endlessly reaping lives.
After close to a hundred of their companions had died, those wild beasts finally knew fear. They all turned around, and broke into a mad run.
Even though they were round, their speed was really fast. Very soon, they had disappeared without a trace.
Ling Han didn’t give chase. The rocks here were filled with traps, and he didn’t want to put himself in danger just because he was chasing a few fierce beasts.
In any case, there was no animosity between them, so what was there to be mad about with this kind of brainless vicious beast?
Ling Han stopped in his tracks. He picked up the corpse of a fierce beast, and planned to roast it for a taste.
In the end, he threw up after taking a bite.
This meat was too unpalatable, bringing with it an indescribable sour taste.
Forget it, he didn’t want a single piece of meat.
Ling Han walked a little further away. There was blood everywhere here, and the smell was not pleasant at all.
The night passed, and the sun rose as usual.
Yi, there was still a sun here?
Ling Han looked at the sky and activated his eye technique. However, he shockingly discovered that this was indeed a sun.
Could it be that he was on some planet in the universe?
But since that was the case, why had it never been discovered before, but rather needed the doorway of light to teleport?
Was it because there was a formation covering this planet?
These thoughts streaked through his mind. Without any hesitation, he hurriedly sat down in a cross-legged position, and began to absorb the power of heaven and earth.
Half an hour later, Ling Han finished his cultivation.
He started to ponder. At first glance, the power of heaven and earth that he had absorbed seemed normal, but upon closer examination, it seemed like something was missing.
That’s right, it was like using natural treasures to increase one’s cultivation level.
Was the power of heaven and earth here a natural treasure?
Of course, it was the lowest grade of natural treasure, more or less the same as cultivating normally.
Interesting.
Ling Han had already felt that this place was a little strange before, and now, this kind of thought was naturally even more intense.
He continued on his way. He travelled by day, and rested by night.

This desolate plain was too big. Three days had already passed, and he actually did not encounter a single person. On the other hand, there were quite a number of fierce beasts. Aside from those round ones, there were also lizards. They were ash grey in colour, close to the colour of the rocks. They would spit out ink-black light from their mouths, which had a very strong corrosive ability. Furthermore, the overall strength of the lizard beasts was stronger as well. There were actually some that were in the Core Formation Tier.

With how ferocious they were, Ling Han naturally couldn’t afford to trifle with them. Thankfully, these ferocious beasts wouldn’t actively hide their tracks, and he could discover them in advance, and he would have long since taken a different path.
The fourth day arrived, and Ling Han was unlucky enough to encounter another Core Formation Tier lizard. He could only take a different path.

He had just circled around, when he saw a man running over from behind him. This person looked to be in his early twenties, and should be very handsome. However, there was a scar that extended from his left eyebrow all the way to the right corner of his lips, instantly ruining his handsomeness without a doubt. This wound was very deep, and the flesh on either side was slightly exposed, making him look a little twisted.
However, Ling Han naturally wouldn’t pay too much attention to other people’s appearances. He only swept an eye over them before retracting his gaze.
Yet the scar-faced man’s expression turned stern, and he asked, “Are you looking at the scar
on my face?”
Er, Ling Han shook his head, “Not interested.”
He didn’t care who the other party was, so he was even less concerned about his appearance.
“This was left behind from my duel with Lu Qi.” Unexpectedly, the scar-faced man said it himself, “This is not a humiliation. Instead, it is a sign of my courage.”
Ling Han was surprised. What kind of shamelessness was this? Having his face disfigured, he actually called it a sign of courage?
However, Lu Qi was only 19th on the Galaxy Network, so what was there to be proud of?

“I understand,” Ling Han said with a nod. Since he liked to brag, he would just let him brag. Yet the scar-faced man did not give up, and continued, “Do you know who Lu Qi is?” Without waiting for Ling Han to speak, he immediately continued, “Lu Qi is the super genius ranked 19th in Cauldron Forging Tier on the Galaxy Network. I was able to exchange 500 blows with him before finally being wounded by him. This is strength!”
Ling Han didn’t know how to complain anymore.
As it turned out, he could also ride on someone else’s popularity like this.
“So what?” He was getting a little impatient.
“So, why don’t you kneel down obediently!” the scar-faced man said proudly. “Otherwise,
just because you disrespected me, I can also take your life.”
Ling Han laughed in spite of himself. He took a step forwards, and grabbed out at the scar-
faced man.
“You’re seeking death!” When the scar-faced man saw this, he immediately drew out a
sword, which sliced towards Ling Han.
Ling Han easily snapped his hand and plucked the sword from his opponent’s hand. He then
placed his hand on his opponent’s neck.
Instantly, the scar-faced man did not dare to move.
If he moved, his head would fall off.
“Let’s talk things over peacefully. Don’t be rash.” He was extremely cowardly, and his
previous arrogance and haughtiness had completely disappeared.
Yet Ling Han’s expression was filled with suspicion, “Have you really exchanged blows with
Lu Qi?” With such strength, how could he possibly battle with Lu Qi for 500 rounds? He was a character that could be killed in a single move.
“Of course!” The scar-faced man revealed an expression of pride again.
Ling Han chuckled, and said, “I’ve fought with Lu Qi before. Although I don’t have any
positive feelings for this person, I think he can insta-kill you a hundred times with a single
finger.”
The scar-faced man instantly looked awkward, and explained, “When I fought with him, it was still several decades ago. He was far from being as powerful as he is now.”
Ling Han laughed in spite of himself, “Lu Qi is only in his thirties, at most. And you fought with him a few decades ago?”

chapters.title: Chapter 3861: Hard to Guard Against
paragraphs: The scar-faced man’s mouth was agape, but the flaw in this lie was too big. He didn’t even know how to cover it up.

He thought for a moment, then sighed, and said, “Actually, I had really fought with Lu Qi before, but at that time, I was only a nameless pawn, and there were also other people. However, I was struck by a flash of Sword Qi from Lu Qi, and was disfigured.”
The truth of these words was much higher.
In truth, Ling Han had no intention to pursue the matter of whether this person had fought with Lu Qi or not. He had only pursued the matter out of curiosity.
He smiled, “Judging by your tone, it seems like you are no longer a nameless nobody?”
“Of course.” The scar-faced man’s tail was about to stick up again.
“Dare I ask how should I address this elite?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

“I’m Li Zisuan.” The scar-faced man raised his head high, yet when the blade of the sword scraped past him, blood instantly gushed out, causing him to hurriedly shrink his neck. His image was completely ruined.
Ling Han patted that person’s shoulder, “Come, tell me about your understanding of the White Lotus Mystery Realm.”
Li Zisuan didn’t dare to hide anything, and he revealed everything he knew.

His strength could only be considered average, but the clan he had come from was still quite strong, and had given him an entry spot. And because he had always boasted that he had fought with Lu Qi, he did have some reputation. Otherwise, merely having the reputation of the clan was not enough.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel surprised. He was actually qualified to boast like this; this person was quite capable.
After talking for half a day, Ling Han nodded, “You can leave now.”
“Really?” Li Zisuan was delighted, and also in disbelief.
“Could it be that you still want to stay?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Hehe, thank you, thank you.” Li Zisuan hurriedly bowed and thanked him, then slipped away.
Ling Han naturally would not take this kind of minor character to heart. However, from the other party’s words, he had gained a little more understanding of this Mystery Realm.
He also continued on his way. Another two days later, he finally reached the end of this desolate plain.

In these two days, he had also encountered a few people, but no conflicts broke out. Without involving any treasures, very few people would provoke him for no reason. After all, there were not many people who were as arrogant and domineering as that.
At the end of the desolate plain, there was a mountain of flames.
This was not a mountain that was burning fiercely, but was rather filled with holes. Occasionally, a flame would spew out of these holes, and shoot out to a height of six to nine meters.

Boom, boom, boom! Multiple flames rose and fell, as if they were playing a piece of music. Ling Han didn’t immediately walk up. Instead, he observed for a while, and saw that there were also shattered seals flickering in the flames.
Tsk, this destructive power would be different in that case.

Ling Han activated the Starlight Screen, then walked over and stood there without moving. Boom, a flame shot out, and a hole was immediately burned into the Starlight Screen. Then, the flame blasted towards him.
He was already prepared, and hurriedly leaped out, dodging the flames.
Thankfully, though the destructive power of the flames was great, the speed at which they gushed out could not be considered very fast.

However, even the Starlight Screen was unable to block a single strike. The might of these flames was at least on the level of the Core Formation Tier. In fact, even a Core Formation Tier could possibly be severely wounded.
There were many holes on the mountain, and occasionally, a surge of flames would rush out. It was practically impossible to guard against.
Of course, this was unless he could find a pattern to it.
Ling Han stood upright and still, but his eyes could see everything clearly.
He was analyzing and calculating, but though the gushing of the flames seemed to be very rhythmic, they kept changing, as if there wasn’t any repetition at all.

However, just as Ling Han was feeling a headache coming on, he shockingly discovered that someone had taken out two rocks and tied them under each foot respectively. Then, he stepped into the volcanic area.
A miraculous scene appeared. Flames surged out, but did not burn these two rocks.
Though that person’s appearance was comical, he successfully left into the distance.
Ling Han saw very clearly that the rocks had come from the desolate plain behind them. There were a great many of them.
He couldn’t help but sigh. This was experience.

He turned around and returned to the desolate plains. Ling Han stowed away two rocks and placed them into his Spatial Tool. After some thought, he took a few more rocks. What if they burned for too long and still broke?
He returned, and did the same thing. Then, he headed up the mountain.
Boom, a flame rushed out, instantly burning the rock to burst.
Ling Han hurriedly used Imminent Skyline, narrowly dodging this attack.
He couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. He had almost been hit head-on, and with the might of the flames, it was enough to severely injure him.
Why couldn’t he?
Ling Han took out the stones in his Spatial Tool, one after another, and threw them up the mountain to fill in the holes.
Boom, pa! Boom, pa! Boom, pa!
Each stone was thrown, one after another, and would be burnt to burst, infuriating Ling Han so much that he threw out all the remaining stones.
Pa, pa, pa, pa! Explosions rang out endlessly, and those rocks shattered one after another.
Hold on.
Ling Han’s sharp gaze stopped on a rock. It had not shattered, but had rather suppressed a
hole.
He spent some effort to retrieve this stone.
What was so special about this stone?
Ling Han looked closely, and soon discovered that there was a very thin black pattern on this
rock.
Was this the key?
Ling Han returned to the desolate plain, and examined carefully. True enough, the majority of the stones did not have any black patterns.

He found a few stones with black patterns, and brought them back to the Flame Mountain to make another attempt. As expected, the stones with black patterns could suppress the holes. No wonder that person had not avoided him at all, allowing him to see how he should cross the mountain of flames. As it turned out, that person was not being generous at all, but was deliberately screwing him over.
-Who would have thought that there was actually requirements for this stone?
Previously, if it was not for the fact that Ling Han’s reaction speed was fast enough, he would either be severely injured or dead by now.
What a treacherous guy.
Ling Han thought back to that person’s appearance, and very soon, outlined it in his mind.

Fine, when he saw him in future, he would definitely give him a good beating. Ling Han didn’t need to tie the rocks to his feet. His feet generated a suction force that was enough to firmly lock the rocks that weighed several thousand kilograms.
Xiu, he shot out, and leapt on the flaming mountain as if he was flying.
The width of this mountain of flames was incredibly shocking, but its depth was considerably limited. Ling Han only crossed two mountains, and a desert appeared ahead of him.
He leaped down, and saw that the two rocks had endured the barrage of flames many times,
and were more or less burnt. If his speed was slightly slower, he would have to replace them
with new rocks.
Ling Han turned around to take a look before continuing to advance.

This desert was extremely large. The sun was at the top of the sky, and the sunlight was blazing, turning this place into a furnace. Even if Ling Han had a high cultivation level, sweat still rolled down his forehead. He had not walked for too long, when he felt dehydrated.
F***, he couldn’t bear it.
He activated the Starlight Screen, and the scorching heat instantly subsided by a significant
amount.

However, Ling Han discovered that this kind of high temperature had a very strong destructive effect on the Starlight Screen. He had to continuously replenish the energy expenditure of the Starlight Screen.
If his reserves of mystical power weren’t close to unlimited, he really wouldn’t be able to withstand this kind of expenditure. But now, it didn’t matter. What was a little expenditure
worth?

chapters.title: Chapter 3862: Endless desert
paragraphs: Ling Han strolled around in the desert.

The blazing sun shone directly overhead, and it was very difficult to believe that this was a real sun. That was because the temperature was unbelievably high, and waves of heat were rising from the air. They had all distorted, seriously affecting visibility.
This desert was boundless, and one would become lost as they walked, wondering where they should go next?
Especially in such high temperatures, it was very easy to become dizzy from the heat, and one’s intelligence would drop drastically.
Thankfully, Ling Han had the protection of the Starlight Screen, so there was not a single wave of heat that could invade his body. He felt very refreshed.
The problem was that he discovered that the electromagnetic field here was too chaotic. How was he supposed to determine north, south, east, and west?
In a natural magnetism field, the north and south were two poles, so the remaining east and west directions were easily determined.

Especially for a Formation Master, determining the location was the most basic requirement, but Ling Han discovered that the electromagnetic field here was constantly switching, extremely chaotic, as if east, west, north, and south did not exist.
Was it because there was a large-scale formation here that had affected the natural magnetism field?
Then there was nothing else that could be done. He could only use a more primitive method. Just look at the sun.
Ascending from the east and descending from the west were the most basic principles.
Ling Han stopped, and began to record the trajectory of the sun’s course. However, after an hour, he revealed an extremely shocked expression.
-If he had drawn out the orbit of the sun, there would definitely be no one who would believe him. Instead, they would think that this was a child’s graffiti.
Twists and turns, this was practically a joke.
In other words, the circulation of the sun was completely illogical.

After another few hours, the sun set and disappeared from the horizon. The temperature immediately began to drop rapidly. Previously, it could still make people dizzy from the heat, but now, it was so cold that he was about to shiver.
This was too abnormal.

Ling Han had initially thought that there was a formation here that concealed the existence of this planet in the universe. It was also because of this formation that it had affected the magnetism of heaven and earth. However, through observing the trajectory of the sun, he came to a conclusion. There was indeed a super-large formation that directly created this world.
He definitely wasn’t in any corner of the universe. Instead, he was in a separate dimension. Here, a massive formation controlled everything, and that was why there were so many strange phenomena.
The sun in the sky may be real, but it was definitely captured by a supreme great elite, and forcefully stuffed into the Mystery Realm.
Hiss, just how powerful was this existence to be able to be so generous?
Was it an Ancestral King?
Ling Han sighed inwardly. He removed the Starlight Screen. Although it was cold now, it was completely within tolerable limits. Of course, there was no need to waste the mystical power.
He started a fire and prepared dinner for himself.

After resting for a night in the desert, on the morning of the second day, the sun rose from some unknown corner of the sky. Ling Han immediately began to cultivate. The power of heaven and earth surged over, helping him raise his cultivation level.
Yi, the power of heaven and earth here was so dense, it was comparable to cultivating in his abode in the Nine Suns Holy Land.
Ling Han nodded. As expected, there was still a lack of something in this energy, so this should be a simulation of the power of heaven and earth.
The power of great dao?

Ling Han pondered deeply. No matter what natural treasures, they could not possibly replace the effects of the power of heaven and earth, because there would always be something inconceivable. An elite once said that was the Dao of Heaven and Earth, the most fundamental force of life in the world.
This also indirectly proved that this place was cut off from the normal heaven and earth.
After Ling Han finished cultivating, he continued to advance.
However, the problem now was that he had really lost his way.
Where should he go?
Ling Han thought for a moment, and decided to go all the way to the end.
Regardless of north, south, east, and west, he was simply walking in one direction. He refused to believe that this desert had no bounds.
He firmed his resolve, and continued to fly forwards.

There was no gravity suppression here, so Ling Han quickly began to fly on his Tool. In fact, he even began to fly into the sky, wanting to find the end of the world from this angle. However, after flying to a height of tens of thousands of meters, he was unable to go any higher.
There was a powerful force suppressing him, preventing him from flying any higher.
Looks like it was impossible to break out of the situation at this point.
Ling Han flew down, and obediently walked in a specific direction.
This flight took ten days.
Time and space seemed to have frozen. It would always be a boundless desert. If it was not for the fact that there was still day and night, it would really drive one crazy.
This was too lonely.
Ling Han didn’t believe it. Although this desert was huge, he had already walked for more than ten days, so how could he not encounter a single person?
But in front of this super great formation, even Ling Han was helpless.

In fact, he didn’t even know that this was a formation. However, the phenomenon like the sun’s circulation path and the chaotic nature of the magnetism field indirectly proved that this should be a formation that affected everything.
If this continued, it was believed that a great many people would not be able to tolerate it,
and choose to give up.
Fine then, just treat this as a test of willpower.
Ling Han was firm in his resolve, and he continued to advance in a single direction. Another 20
or so days passed, and as he flew, suddenly, sand flew up in front of him.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han faltered for a moment before coming to his senses.
There was a change.
Previously, it had only been the blazing sun shining down from the skies. There were no clouds for miles, and there was not the slightest bit of wind, but now, there was dust and sand
rising. What did this mean?
The wind was blowing.

Any change was a good thing, which meant that he was heading in the right direction. However, Ling Han immediately revealed an expression of shock, because this flying sand immediately turned into an eye of the storm, and began to wreak havoc in his direction. Not only was it extremely fast, the range of the eye of the storm was also expanding continuously. It could be clearly seen that there were terrifying seals flickering in the eye of the storm.
If he was swept up in this, then if he was hit by the grains of sand that had seals attached to them, just how much damage would it cause?
It was already too late for Ling Han to dodge. The eye of the storm had already expanded to a diameter of 5km, and he hurriedly tunneled downwards.
The sand was soft, so it naturally couldn’t stop him. He continued to dig deeper and deeper
into the ground.
However, Ling Han immediately sensed that the storm was approaching. A large amount of sand on the upper layer had been swept away, and he was presently exposed.
Ling Han hurriedly tunneled downwards again, contending in speed with the eye of the storm.
After walking downwards for several hundred km, he finally sensed that the eye of the super
storm had left.
He broke out of the ground, and was once again stunned.
That was because the initially flat desert seemed to have turned into an ocean, with a huge
concave area.

However, what was even more astonishing was the fact that the sand from an endless distance was presently filling in, like a tsunami. Its speed was astonishingly fast, and in just over ten minutes, everything had returned to its original state, as if the storm had not been blown over
at all.
This was truly a strange place.
Ling Han hesitated for a moment before setting off again.
Now, nothing could stop him.
Ling Han flew all the way on his Tool, and didn’t walk too far before three small black dots
appeared ahead of him. Ling Han activated his Eye Technique, and couldn’t help but tense up.
He hurriedly descended.
These weren’t cultivators who had entered, but rather three vultures. They were all at the
level of the Core Formation Tier.
However, the three vultures had obviously discovered him as well. They all let out a sharp cry, and flapped their wings as they flew towards him.

chapters.title: Chapter 3863: Cover
paragraphs: Ling Han hurriedly descended. After storing away the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he activated Imminent Skyline and searched for a place to dodge.
However, this was a desert, so where could he hide?

Though his speed was fast, surpassing all Cauldron Forging Tiers, and could even match the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, those three vultures were in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier or even the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, so their speed was faster than his, though not by much.
The distance between the two sides was slowly closing in.
Ling Han frowned slightly. Could it be that he could only use the Heavenly Dao Flames?
Right at this moment, his eyes suddenly lit up.
In the distance, a valley appeared.
Very good, Ling Han quickened his pace, and raced towards that valley.
After a few leaps and landings, he was already close to the valley, yet shockingly discovered that there was presently a group of seven people walking out of the valley.
When they saw Ling Han, the seven of them were stunned. Then, they also saw those three vultures, and all of them cursed. They turned around and ran into the valley.
Ling Han followed them into the valley, and immediately discovered that the expressions of those seven people were extremely unfriendly.
What, did I offend you guys?

However, everyone’s attention was now focused on the three vultures outside. What surprised Ling Han was that these three vultures seemed to be very wary of the valley. They only circled above the valley, and not a single one flew down.
After a long time, the three vultures flapped their wings and left, as if they had given up on hunting.
“Brat, you’ve wasted so much of our time. How are you going to compensate us?” a man in green said.
Ling Han spread his hands and said, “Adventuring in ancient sites together is a very common thing, right? Fine, I can apologize to all of you.”
“Apologize?” The man in green humphed, “What is the use of an apology? Can it exchange for the time that we have wasted?”
Tsk, did he have to be so overbearing?
Ling Han cracked his knuckles as he clenched his fists. By the looks of it, someone was asking for a beating.

“What, you want to fight?” The man in green sneered. There were seven of them, and they were all at the cultivation level of the Cauldron Forging Tier. The strongest person was at Four Cauldrons, and his abilities were enough to rank in the top 1000 of the Galaxy Network. Was there any need for him to fear Ling Han?
He was only a Cauldron Forging Tier.
Ling Han merely cracked a smile. It seemed like these seven people were quite familiar with this place, so it was a good opportunity for him to make some queries.
“How dare you!”
“Stop!”
The man in green was just about to rush forwards with his fists out, but a loud shout suddenly rang out, causing him to involuntarily stop.

At first, he had thought that this was a call from a companion, because there were only eight people in the valley. Since Ling Han did not speak, it must be a companion. However, when he turned his head, he was surprised, because an unfamiliar man had just entered into the valley. It was that man who had spoken up to stop him.
F***, the man in green was instantly displeased. Who do you think you are?

He sized him up. This man was also a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, and there was a scar on his face that extended from his left eye to the right corner of his mouth, making him look extremely malevolent.
“Yi, could it be that you are Li Zisuan?” The man in green was just about to flip out, when he saw a companion rush out, cupping his hands in respect towards the scarred man.
“That’s right,” the scar-faced man said proudly.
Li Zisuan? Who was he?

The man in green did not dare to be rash, because that companion was the only Four Cauldrons among them, and was also the strongest elite. Even he was so polite, so this scar- faced man should be very powerful.
When the Four Cauldrons cultivator saw the puzzled expressions on his companions’ faces, he hurriedly said, “You may not have heard of Brother Li’s name, but Lu Qi knows, right?”
Of course, Lu Qi was ranked 19th on the Galaxy Network, and he was ranked in the top five of the North Heavenly Realm. He was practically their idol.

The Four Cauldrons cultivator nodded, and said, “Brother Li had once exchanged blows with Lu Qi, and only after exchanging five hundred moves, was he no match, and this scar was left behind at that time. Thus, this is definitely not a humiliation, but rather a symbol of honour and courage.”

A look of admiration appeared on the faces of the man in green and the others. This was too awesome. He had only been defeated after exchanging 500 blows with Lu Qi, and he had even survived. This was practically inconceivably powerful.

Pu, Ling Han couldn’t help but splutter in laughter. He had never thought that he would encounter Li Zisuan so soon. What was even more unexpected was that there was actually a market for Li Zichuan’s lies.
“What are you laughing at!” The man in green immediately shouted at Ling Han.
Without waiting for Ling Han to speak, Li Zisuan coughed, and said proudly, “You dare to be rude to my friend?”
“This is actually Brother Li’s friend?” the Four Cauldrons cultivator asked in surprise.
“Of course!” Li Zisuan said proudly, but he was a little anxious internally. That was because
he was actually not worthy of being associated with Ling Han, and feared that Ling Han would immediately act up.
However, Ling Han didn’t say anything, which was equivalent to tacit agreement.
He was actually very curious about how far this Li Zisuan could pretend.
“Since he’s Brother Li’s friend, then we’re all a family!” The Four Cauldrons on the other side chuckled, then nodded at the man in green. “Yue Zhi, apologize to this friend.”
The man in green hurriedly clasped his hands in Ling Han’s direction, saying, “Please don’t take my previous offense to heart.”
There was not the slightest bit of reluctance in this, which showed how useful Li Zisuan’s
reputation was.
And in truth, all this was based on Lu Qi’s great reputation.

The seven people all introduced themselves. The Four Cauldrons was called Geng Xing, and ranked 966th on the Galaxy Network. The man in green was called Lao Yuezhi. As for the others, Ling Han didn’t care.
Ling Han asked about this valley, and the seven people on the other side immediately answered with everything they knew.

As it turned out, there were many other valleys like this in this desert, and they were all shelters. If they encountered ferocious beasts that they could not match, or encountered a terrifying natural disaster, they could enter into the valley to hide.
None of the wild beasts dared to enter into the valley, and natural disasters, such as the super storm, would cause extremely limited damage here.

Ling Han nodded. These were all experience that had been passed down through the generations, and the Nine Suns Holy Land’s situation was unique. They did not have the slightest bit of information about this, so he could only guess blindly.
“Brother Li, Brother Ling, how about we move together?” Geng Xing earnestly invited.
Li Zisuan didn’t dare to make a decision without permission. He looked at Ling Han.
Ling Han was unconcerned, and said with a smile, “Brother Li can decide.”
Li Zisuan couldn’t help but feel secretly grateful. Ling Han gave him face like this, which made him feel extremely touched.
“Then let’s go together,” he said reservedly. Though he was putting on airs, he still had to
take advantage when he should.
They exited the valley, and continued onwards.
After walking for half a day, the terrifying sandstorm appeared again.
“Quick, there’s a valley ahead,” Geng Xing said, pointing ahead.
Their luck was not too bad. Not too far away, there was a valley where they could hide, so
there was no need for them to dig another few hundred miles.
Taking advantage of the fact that the storm had not completely taken form, they quickened
their pace, and entered into that valley.
However, there were others in the valley.
“Yi, Geng Xing!” There were more people on the other side, and the person in the lead
recognized Geng Xing with a single glance.
“Yu Feiming!” Geng Xing also recognized him, and his expression immediately darkened,
with a sliver of wariness.

chapters.title: Chapter 3864: Resolving the Trouble
paragraphs: Geng Xing was somewhat apprehensive, because this Yu Fei Ming was also Four Cauldrons, and was an old rival of his.
Not only were they old enemies on the Galaxy Network, but they had also fought countless times in the real world.
That was because they both came from the same planet, and knew each other very well.
“I’m really sorry. We arrived here first, so please go somewhere else,” Yu Feiming said calmly.
Geng Xing sneered, “You guys don’t own this place, what right do you have to chase us away?”
“Hehe, because our abilities are stronger!” Yu Feiming said with a smile, “If we are strong enough, we can do as we please.”
“Stronger?” Geng Xing shook his head, “Not necessarily!”

His and Yu Feiming’s strength should be about the same. The two sides had already fought almost a hundred times, with victories and losses on both sides. He did not dare to say that he could defeat Yu Feiming, but Yu Feiming did not dare to say that he was stronger than him either.
Thus, the other party’s words now seemed to be lacking in confidence.
“Hehe, though you can contend against me, but if it was this one, would you still dare to speak tough?” Yu Feiming pointed at a white-robed young man beside him.
Which one was this?
“Let me introduce.” Yu Feiming smiled slightly, and said with a hint of mockery, “This is Shi Deze, Brother Shi. I’m sure you’ve heard, Brother Shi is ranked in the 700s on the Galaxy Network.”

The white-robed young man smiled proudly. Even though there was only a gap of around two hundred rankings between them, after entering into the top thousand, every gap of a hundred ranks meant that the gap in strength was like the gap between heaven and earth, what more when there was a gap of two hundred.
Geng Xing’s expression immediately changed. Over seven hundred, this was too strong.
However, when he thought of Li Zisuan, he immediately became bolder.
This person was a man who could exchange 500 blows with Lu Qi, so what was a Galaxy Network ranking in the 700s worth?
“Haha!” He laughed loudly, “So it’s Brother Shi. You have really found a powerful helper. However, do you know who this Brother Li beside me is?”
‘Hmm?’
Yu Feiming and Shi Deze both looked towards Li Zisuan. Who are you?
“Li Zisuan, Brother Li, an existence that can exchange five hundred moves with Lu Qi.” Geng Xing declared proudly.
Right, Lu Qi’s limelight was borrowed again.

Li Zisuan was naturally feeling uneasy. He could only bluff. If they really fought, his strength wouldn’t even be able to squeeze into the top 10,000, so how could he stand against an existence ranked above 700?
But now, he had to stick to his words no matter what. Could it be that he could say that he had just been boasting previously?
“Hehe, thank you for your praise, Brother Geng. I have only exchanged a few hundred moves with Lu Qi, so there is no need to mention it,” Li Zisuan said calmly, putting on a very high air.

Meanwhile, Yu Feiming and Shi Deze’s expressions changed slightly. Who was Lu Qi? He was a super genius ranked 19th on the Galaxy Network. Being able to exchange 500 moves with Lu Qi, his abilities would at least be able to squeeze into Galaxy Network’s top 100, or perhaps even higher.
Compared to them, this kind of person was practically a god.
Could they afford to offend him?
Yu Feiming hesitated for a moment, then opened his mouth, and said hoarsely, “So it is Brother Li, apologies for not recognizing you.”
Li Zisuan instantly felt relieved. He had fooled him again.

However, Shi Deze’s words caused him to feel anxious again, “So Brother Li has actually fought with Lu Qi before. I am really envious! I wonder if I can spar with Brother Li, so that I can broaden my horizons.”
‘F*ck you!’
Thoughts flashed across Li Zixing’s mind. What should he do?
He definitely couldn’t agree. Once he was beaten, he would be exposed, but if he didn’t agree, how could he refuse so that he wouldn’t show his cowardice?
But no matter how he thought about it, he could not think of a suitable reason.

“Hehe, let me spar with you.” Ling Han walked out with a smile, “Brother Li’s cultivation has improved greatly recently. Probably, even Lu Qi is no match for him. It would not be good if he hurts Brother Shi.”
Seeing Ling Han step out, Li Zisuan was practically moved to the point of wanting to cry.
His savior.
“You?” Shi Deze swept an eye over Ling Han, “Who are you?”
“Ling Han.”
“What’s your ranking in the Galaxy Network?” Shi Deze asked.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before replying, “About 100,000.”
Indeed, this account of his was only ranked at this place for the moment. Even Number One in
the Galaxy had only just broken into the top 1000.
“Haha!” Shi Deze immediately smirked coldly. How could a guy ranked merely in the
100,000s be worthy of challenging him?
Defeating this kind of opponent would be an unjust victory, and would further degrade his
status.
“You are still not qualified!” He shook his head.
Ling Han sighed, “Why do there always have to be people who think so highly of themselves, and are always condescending?”
‘F*ck! You are ranked over 100,000 in the Galaxy Network, so how can others look up to you?’
Everyone thought. Those like Geng Xing and the others were still fine, but Yu Feiming and the others all began to mock him, all of them merciless in their words.
Towards this kind of “mediocre character”, did they need to take into account Ling Han’s feelings?
Ling Han wasn’t angered, and he said calmly, “If you don’t dare to fight me, then step aside.”
‘Tsk, you’re getting arrogant?’
“Scram, what right do you have to exchange blows with Brother Shi!” A man rushed out, stretching out a hand to grab Ling Han.
It was beneath Shi Deze to make a move on Ling Han, so he would do it for him.
Ling Han stood with his hands clasped behind his back, acting as if he didn’t know.

If the large black dog saw this, he would definitely pout and say that Ling Han was going to show off again. However, in the eyes of others, this was clearly because Ling Han had no time to react at all. The other man was too strong, while he was too weak.
That person had already charged over, and his hand was aimed directly at Ling Han’s chest, intending to throw him out.

Just when the other was about to touch him, Ling Han moved. He was as fast as lightning, and grabbed the other’s chest in a single move. Then, with a toss, peng, that person was thrown onto the mountain wall. Then, he slid down, and lay on the ground, unable to move in the
slightest.
Instantly, the surroundings fell silent.
Hiss, this guy ranked in the 100,000s on the Galaxy Network was actually so powerful?
“So you’re pretending to be a pig to eat a tiger.” Shi Deze finally took Ling Han seriously. He looked at Ling Han, and nodded slowly, “Let me experience how strong you are.”
He strode forwards, walking towards Ling Han.
Ling Han still crossed his arms behind his back.
This time, everyone knew that it wasn’t that Ling Han didn’t react in time, but that he was
deliberately showing off.
However, your current opponent is Shi Deze, an existence ranked in the 700s on the Galaxy Network. Is he someone you can show off to?
Shi Deze had already neared, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han.
After all, he was an elite in the 700s on the Galaxy Network. His strength could be said to be astonishingly strong, and as his palm pressed down, streaks of divine light circulated.
Ling Han also moved, grabbing back at the other.
Pa, their hands clasped together.
This time, it was a clash of strength between the two sides. Whoever had the stronger power
and stronger physique would emerge victorious.

Shi Deze smirked coldly. The Dragon Elephant Prajna Technique that he cultivated was focused on cultivating power and physique. To clash head-on with him like this, even those ranked fifty places higher than him would have to kneel.
You are really courting death.
His fingers exerted force, wanting to make Ling Han moan and scream. Then, he felt that the bones in Ling Han’s hand were extremely hard, and could not be kneaded at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 3865: The team expands
paragraphs: Shi Deze looked at Ling Han in shock. ‘Are you really ranked in the 100,000s on the Galaxy Network?’
“Are you sure?”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “What is it? Feeling like you’ve bitten a hard nut?”
That really was the case.

A string of curses raced through Shi Deze’s mind. ‘You’re far too good at showing off, aren’t you? You’re clearly powerful enough to rival me, yet your ranking in the Galaxy Network is only around 100,000. Aren’t you afraid of showing off too much and being struck by lightning?’
“You’re cursing me in your heart.” Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I despise people like you. You have to understand that it’s extremely immoral to speak ill of others in secret.”
Then how much better would it be for you to show off like this?
Though Shi Deze was filled with wariness towards Ling Han, it was not to the extent that he feared him. He asked coldly, “So what about it?”
“I’m naturally going to thrash the one who does it.” Ling Han smiled, and suddenly burst out with power.
How powerful was he? How could Shi Deze withstand such an explosive burst of power? Instantly, he was pressed onto the ground, and served with a flurry of punches.
Seeing this scene, everyone was shocked speechless.

Shi Deze was ranked in the 700s in the Galaxy Network. He could be regarded as one of the super geniuses in any galaxy. However, in front of Ling Han, he couldn’t fight back at all and was beaten like a punching bag.
Then, they turned to look at Li Zisuan.
Judging by Ling Han’s tone, Li Zisuan was even more powerful than him. Just how powerful would he be then?
Li Zisuan was also very confused.
He knew that Ling Han was very strong, but had definitely not foreseen that he would be this strong.
However, with so many people staring at him, he couldn’t reveal any flaws, right?
Thus, his nonchalant expression made people think that he was even stronger than Ling Han, and that was why he didn’t take it to heart at all.
In this way, everyone looked at him with even more reverence.
As expected of a fierce man who could battle Lu Qi for 500 rounds. Just look at that scar, exuding such a powerful and heroic aura.

Ling Han only pummeled him for a while before withdrawing. There was no animosity between him and Shi Deze, and he was only a little annoyed that the latter wanted to chase him out, and that was why he had pummeled him.
“Alright, we’re all here to adventure. It’s unknown whether we’ll be in trouble or good fortune now. It’s better to unite and face unknown dangers together.” Li Zisuan mediated.

Now that his identity was completely different, his words naturally carried a lot of weight, causing the people on both sides to nod endlessly. They felt that not only was this person’s abilities unfathomable, he was also benevolent and generous, which was rare.

In a sparring match in martial arts, it was very normal for one’s skill to be inferior. Shi Deze also very quickly returned to normal. He had already believed in Li Zisuan’s “identity”. This was a man that could challenge Lu Qi, and was much, much stronger than him. And once he was strong to the point that others could only look up to him, even if he was defeated by the latter, that could still be considered an honour.
―Though he had actually lost to Ling Han.
Thus, it wasn’t long before the animosity between them disappeared. They silently waited for the super storm to end before setting off together and continuing to advance.

The environment here was really too terrible. In the evening, they encountered another great storm, and had no choice but to go to another valley to hide. Now, it was already late, so they simply decided to rest here for a night.
Not long after they entered into the valley, another team quickly entered into the valley to hide.
Li Zisuan immediately stepped out, calling on everyone to unite.
At first, the opposing team was not on good terms with them, but as Shi Deze and Geng Xing came out respectively to explain, “convincing others with virtue”, this team was instantly convinced.
Coincidentally, a few more people entered the valley at night. They had all come alone, and had also been recruited into this team.

There would always be those who were ambitious, unwilling to be a lackey, and wanted to challenge Li Zisuan. In the end, Shi Deze, Geng Xing and the others moved, and easily suppressed him, causing Li Zisuan’s prestige to become higher and higher.

You see, even Shi Deze, an elite that was ranked more than seven hundred in the Galaxy Network, was willing to be inferior to him, so what did they have to be dissatisfied about? On the second day, they continued onwards.
This time, they were relatively lucky. They didn’t encounter any great storms for an entire day.
However, they didn’t encounter a single valley on their way, and at night, they started a large bonfire to prepare dinner.

Because there were so many people, the atmosphere was naturally lively, especially after they had drunk some wine. Everyone was fawning madly on Li Zisuan, and Li Zisuan had been pretending all this while. He had become accustomed to it, and began to boast about the great battle between himself and Lu Qi. Those five hundred moves were vividly described by him, fierce and exciting, and they caused everyone to exclaim endlessly in shock.

Ling Han listened from the sidelines, and smiled internally. Going by how Li Zisuan was going on like this, this guy’s fame would definitely become bigger and bigger. When Lu Qi heard about this, who knew what kind of expression he would have.
-The reason why he would cover for Li Zisuan’s lie was actually because of this simple
mischief.
Everyone was making a fuss, and toasting one another. It was very lively.
In the middle of the night, they finally finished drinking, and all of them fell asleep.
The next morning, the sun rose, and the temperature immediately soared, waking everyone
up one by one.

They all sat cross-legged and cultivated, but there were also people practicing fist techniques. This was also a kind of cultivation method. Half an hour later, everyone packed up and prepared to set out.
“Yi, why is there one less person?” Li Zisuan’s eyes wandered around, and couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise.

Everyone counted heads. There was really one person missing. His name was Huang Liang. He did not come as part of a group, but rather blended into the group all by himself. “Strange, Huang Liang was still drinking with us yesterday. It can’t be that he left alone,
right?” someone said.
Someone flew on a Tool, and when they arrived at a higher altitude, they looked around, but
did not find anything.
“Forget it. Perhaps he doesn’t want to be with us.”
“Let’s go.”
Everyone set out, and Ling Han was a little surprised. Li Zisuan was quite a responsible leader,
wasn’t he? These people were all unfamiliar with him, and he could actually tell that someone
was missing with a single glance.
Ling Han fell into deep thought. Though he had also fallen asleep, his divine sense was sensitive. If there was the slightest movement, he would immediately be awakened, but he
did not sense anything at all.
Had Huang Liang really left on his own?
This desert seemed to be shrinking in size. In the afternoon, they encountered another team, consisting of fourteen people. Shi Deze stepped out, and successfully subdued this group of
people, uniting under the leadership of Li Zisuan.
Unintentionally, they also said that there were originally fifteen of them, but one of them had
left this morning.
Everyone hurriedly asked, and the result was that the situation on both sides was the same. They had both only discovered that the person had quietly disappeared in the morning.
Yi, so coincidental?
That night, no one dared to drink anymore. Instead, they arranged for sentry guards to take
turns keeping watch.
However, on the morning of the second day, something happened again. Not only were there
fewer people, there were three of them missing.
This was a huge problem.
Was this a ghost? Three people had suddenly disappeared into thin air?
Everyone felt their hair stand on end.
