was missing with a single glance.
Ling Han fell into deep thought.
Though he had also fallen asleep, his divine sense was sensitive.
If there was the slightest movement, he would immediately be awakened, but he
did not sense anything at all.
Had Huang Liang really left on his own?
This desert seemed to be shrinking in size.
In the afternoon, they encountered another team, consisting of fourteen people.
Shi Deze stepped out, and successfully subdued this group of
people, uniting under the leadership of Li Zisuan.
Unintentionally, they also said that there were originally fifteen of them, but one of them had
left this morning.
Everyone hurriedly asked, and the result was that the situation on both sides was the same.
They had both only discovered that the person had quietly disappeared in the morning.
Yi, so coincidental?
That night, no one dared to drink anymore.
Instead, they arranged for sentry guards to take
turns keeping watch.
However, on the morning of the second day, something happened again.
Not only were there
fewer people, there were three of them missing.
This was a huge problem.
Was this a ghost?
Three people had suddenly disappeared into thin air?
Everyone felt their hair stand on end.

chapters.title: Chapter 3866: Mysterious Kidnapper
paragraphs: “I was on the last shift. When I changed shifts, I counted the number of people, and there still wasn’t anyone missing,” someone said.
But the problem was, when he was on shift, he did not discover the slightest bit of
abnormality. It was just when it was almost dawn, and he counted heads again, he discovered that there were suddenly three people missing.
How was this possible?
He could clearly see that there was definitely not a single person approaching from the surroundings, what more kidnapping three people soundlessly.

Everyone’s expressions were ugly. Though the three people who had been kidnapped were not all that strong, they were still Cauldron Forging Tier, and they had actually been kidnapped before they could even make a sound. Just how powerful was the culprit?
What if... it was their turn tonight?
At present, they could still crush their tokens and leave, but if they were taken down in a single move, then their lives would completely be out of their control.
“Don’t panic. Everyone, stay alert tonight. We must find the reason,” Li Zisuan said, his expression calm, making everyone calm down.
However, no one knew just how anxious he was.

They continued onwards. A day had passed, and their team had epanded again. Not only had five lone travellers joined them, there were also two teams. Their numbers had exceeded ten, so the total number of their group had exceeded fifty.
As the leader, Li Zisuan was both a little vain and anxious. F*ck, if he was exposed, that would be a huge joke. There would probably be too many people who wanted to tear him to pieces.
It was night, and everyone was gathered around the bonfire. The atmosphere was slightly oppressive.
“According to yesterday’s situation, the person should have suddenly disappeared when it was close to dawn, so there’s no need for everyone to be so nervous now.”
“That’s right. If we stay tense all night, we won’t have the energy to travel during the day. Furthermore, how are we going to spend tomorrow night?”
“Everyone, relax.”
That was what he said, but who would want to disappear so soundlessly?
Some people deliberately joked, but only a few responded. The atmosphere was still very awkward.
Time passed second by second, but everyone felt that time was especially slow. Why was it that only half an hour had passed after such a long time?
One hour, two hours, everyone was counting the time.
Unknowingly, a sliver of white had appeared in the east.

Ling Han looked like he was meditating with his eyes closed, but his divine sense was spread out. Previously, though he had maintained vigilance, it was only directed at himself. This time was different. His divine sense had enveloped the entire area.
‘It’s here!’
With a thought, his eyes suddenly snapped open.
The eye technique activated, and he saw the flow of sand forming some kind of rhythm.

A man fell forward soundlessly, as if he had suddenly dozed off. However, before he fell headfirst, his body actually sank into the sand. Like a clay ox sinking into the sea, he disappeared extremely quickly.
“Humph!”
Ling Han dashed out, stretching out his right hand to grab that person’s left shoulder.
However, the speed at which this person was descending had far exceeded Ling Han’s expectations. Before Ling Han could catch him, that person had already completely disappeared into the sand.
Strangely, there wasn’t any crater left on the ground, and it was as smooth as before.
Ling Han’s action instantly alerted the others. They all looked over, and they all saw the last scene of that person sinking into the sand.
What the hell?
Ling Han charged over, directly tearing open the sand, and charged downwards.
His speed was extremely fast, and his hands were like sharp blades, forcibly squeezing the sand in front of him to either side, opening up a passageway.
He had locked onto the life force of the person in front of him all this while, and this had become his guiding light.
However, the mysterious abductor seemed to have realized this as well. All of a sudden, this aura of life disappeared.
Ling Han chased for about another 5km, then suddenly stopped.
He had lost him.

He returned to the ground, yet his expression became even uglier. That was because when he had been pursuing, another two people had sunk into the sand, and thus disappeared. Now, he had found the method of how the culprit had executed the kidnapping. He had launched an attack from the bottom of the sand, and had used some unknown method to knock the victim out. Then, he would drag him into the sand and bring him away from below the ground surface.
He did know, but the crux of the matter was, how was he supposed to resolve this problem?
The crux of the matter lay in what method this mysterious culprit had used to knock someone unconscious?
As for whether the victim would be steamed or braised after he had been kidnapped, that was a completely different matter.
“Ling Han, how is it?” Li Zisuan asked Ling Han. By now, he was already very engrossed in his new role.
Ling Han shook his head.

Everyone was disappointed. Ling Han was the first to discover the abnormality, and was also the first to chase after the culprit. Even he couldn’t catch up to the culprit, which naturally made everyone’s mood worse.
“What do we do now?”
Everyone looked towards Li Zisuan. This was their backbone, and now, it was naturally up to
him to decide.
Li Zisuan thought to himself that he was also terrified, so how could he have any good ideas?
He thought for a moment, then said, “We have to quickly walk out of this desert.”
This was nonsense. He had not thought that it would win everyone’s general agreement.
As long as they walked out of the desert, it was naturally impossible for the mysterious culprit
to charge out of the ground again.
Everyone set out, speeding up, wanting to leave this place as soon as possible.
However, while their wishes were beautiful, reality was cruel. One day passed, and they still couldn’t walk out. Instead, the scale of their team expanded again.
“Let’s go. We’ll continue our journey at night.”

Experience from the past few days told them that this desert was only large now, and there was no longer any danger like a great storm. Thus, they could completely journey at night. Instead, it was stopping here that was dangerous. Didn’t they see how many people had disappeared in the last few nights?
No one had any objections, and they all continued their journey.
On the way, no one made a sound, as if they were afraid of attracting the mysterious culprit.
However-
One of them was running, but when his foot landed, it was as if the pile of sand had turned into empty air, and his whole person had sunk in.
“Ah-” That person instantly exclaimed in shock, but his voice came to an abrupt stop. He
had already fallen into a coma.
This time, Ling Han could see very clearly. A hand stretched out from the sand, grabbed that person’s ankle, and then pulled that person into the sand.
Judging by the size of the hand and the smoothness of the skin, it should be a female hand.
As he thought this, Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all. He immediately unleashed a murderous
aura.
He had succeeded.
The woman couldn’t see it, but the person who had sunk into the sand suddenly paused,
leaving his head exposed.
Ling Han leaped over, grabbed the man’s head, and pulled him out first. However, when he
dug up the sand, there was no sign of the culprit.
She had still fled!
Ling Han frowned, slightly displeased.
But a round of applause rang out all around him. He swept his gaze around, and saw that
everyone was indescribably excited.
This was their first victory after clashing with the mysterious culprit. No one was kidnapped by the latter, which gave everyone a strong confidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 3867: Sand Maiden
paragraphs: When Ling Han attacked for the first time, he discovered the mysterious culprit. When he attacked for the second time, he even forced the culprit to give up on the “prey” that she was about to obtain. Then, if Ling Han attacked for the third time, wouldn’t he be able to capture the culprit?
Furthermore, this also indirectly proved that the culprit was actually not very strong. Otherwise, why would she be afraid of Ling Han?

Then, they had an elite on their side that was even stronger than Ling Han, Li Zisuan who could battle Lu Qi for 500 rounds. If he made a move, wouldn’t that mysterious kidnapper be captured without a fight?
All of a sudden, everyone turned to look at Li Zisuan.
‘F*ck! Don’t look at me like that! The pressure is immense!’
Li Zisuan mocked in his heart. His true strength was weaker than most of the people here. If he made a move, he would definitely reveal his true strength.
However, he had already put on such airs, so there was naturally no way out for him. Immediately, he said calmly, “Don’t worry, I’m here!”
Everyone nodded in agreement. Since the prodigious Li Zisuan had already spoken, what else could they be worried about?

However, Ling Han was pondering over this. The mysterious culprit who had kidnapped them was most likely a female. Moreover, she was skilled at travelling under the sand. This might be a unique ability. At the very least, he couldn’t travel underground at such a rapid speed. Who exactly was she? And why had she kidnapped people?
Everyone continued to set out, heading forwards.
‘Hmm?’
After taking a few steps, Ling Han suddenly felt a sense of danger.
Someone was attacking him, and they had come from underground.
Ling Han forcibly suppressed the thought of attacking or dodging. He only acted as if he didn’t know. When he took a step, a hand suddenly appeared from the sand, grabbing onto his ankle.
This hand was incredibly slender, possessing an indescribable beauty, but it was also filled with power.
Suddenly, a mysterious power assaulted him, directly heading towards his mind, instantly causing his vast mind to dim, as if it had become a dead sea.
Ling Han felt as if his consciousness had stopped working, and he was about to sink into eternal darkness.

However, when this power came close to his Celestial Cauldron, it could not advance the slightest bit further. His Celestial Cauldron had evolved from the Primitive Celestial Gate, and even an Ancestral King could not suppress it, what more when it was a power of this level.
Ling Han pretended to be restrained, and his whole person fell forwards.
That hand seemed to hesitate for a moment, but it immediately dragged him further into the sand.

Ling Han discovered that a power was wrapped around him, turning the sand into air, and could not stop him at all. It was like he was running on a plain, and he was being dragged at an astonishing speed.
Outside.
“Ling Han!”
“F***, even Ling Han has been captured!”

Everyone was exclaiming in shock. Everyone knew that Ling Han was the second elite that was only inferior to Li Zisuan, but now, Ling Han had been hit soundlessly. This naturally caused everyone to feel anxious.
All of a sudden, everyone’s eyes turned to look at Li Zisuan.
This was their only hope.
Don’t look at me, I was just boasting.

Li Zisuan called out mentally, but his expression was calm. No matter what, he had to f****** hold on. Otherwise, without Ling Han’s protection now, once the truth was revealed, The would be torn into pieces at any moment.
And underground, Ling Han was being dragged by someone, endlessly heading towards the land’s heart.
5km, 50km, 250km!
Ling Han did some calculations. They were about 500km underground. At this moment, he suddenly stopped, and the hand that was holding onto his ankle also loosened.
“Stop pretending. I know you didn’t lose control!” A woman’s voice sounded in his mind.
Yi, he had been exposed?
Ling Han opened his eyes, smiled, and stood up.
He was not in the layer of sand, but rather in a mud chamber. Unknown rocks were adorned all around him, exuding a weak light.
In front of him stood a woman. She was completely naked, but it did not cause anyone to have any inappropriate thoughts at all. They would only feel that it was terrifying.

This was because this woman didn’t have a single hair on her body. Moreover... she didn’t have any facial features. If it weren’t for the undulating curves of her body, no one would think of her as a woman.
This was the true face of the mysterious culprit?
No wonder she had used her divine sense to directly transmit a message in his mind. That was because she did not have a mouth at all, so how could she speak?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and also used his divine sense to transmit a message, saying, “Since you discovered that I was pretending to be restrained, why did you bring me down?”
“Because you’re walking right into a trap,” the woman said.
Since she was living at the bottom of the desert, why not call her the Sand Maiden?
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Then you should have already informed your companions to surround me, right?”
It was clear that there was more than one Sand Maiden.

“That’s right.” That Sand Maiden nodded, and as she did so, multiple heads appeared from above their heads, beneath their feet, as well as in the walls around them. They were all bare- headed, featureless Sand Maidens. Strangely, there was actually not a single one that was
male.
“Haha, this can’t be called walking into a trap, but like a tiger entering a flock of sheep,” Ling Han said with a laugh.
“Capture him!” the first Sand Maiden said. She seemed to be the leader of the Sand Maidens.
Instantly, one after another, the Sand Maidens moved. Weng, every single one of them
released a sliver of intent, that surged towards Ling Han.
Ling Han’s mind started to dim again, turning into a sea of death.
Previously, a single Sand Maiden had almost caused him to lose consciousness, what more
when there were so many Sand Maidens here?
These divine senses surged over, causing Ling Han’s mind to rapidly fall, turning into an eternal zone of darkness.

However, when these divine senses reached the vicinity of the Celestial Cauldron, it was like a flood that had encountered an indestructible dam. No matter how tumultuous the waves were, they could only retreat in defeat.
The Celestial Cauldron that was modeled after the Primitive Celestial Gate was unstoppable
and invincible.
Ling Han launched a counterattack. His divine sense rippled, and the invading consciousness instantly melted like snow that had encountered boiling water. Then, they hurriedly
retreated.
“Ah!” One after another, screams of agony rang out via divine sense. Every single Sand Maiden was grabbing their heads with both hands, appearing to be in extreme pain.

“You!” The female leader of the Sand Maidens couldn’t help but feel shocked. Previously, she had not been able to conquer Ling Han’s mind, and had only thought that Ling Han’s consciousness was too strong. She could not accomplish it on her own, but as long as she gathered the power of the women, she would definitely be able to subdue Ling Han.
She had never imagined that even if everyone attacked together, the result would still be a terrible defeat at Ling Han’s hands.
Heavens, w’as this really a Cauldron Forging Tier?
Could it be?
A thought flashed through her mind, and then she communicated with the other Sand
Maidens.

Ling Han humphed, and asked, “What exactly did you guys kidnap people for?” “Sir, could you let us take a look at your Celestial Cauldron?” Yet the leader of the Sand Maidens said something that Ling Han did not expect through her divine sense.
Yi?
Ling Han hesitated slightly, but still released the Celestial Cauldron.
It was as if the Celestial Cauldron had been forged from stone. It looked ordinary and plain,
but an incredibly terrifying pressure reverberated slightly, as if it was the emperor of martial
arts.
“Master!” All the Sand Maidens knelt down, paying their respects to Ling Han.

Ling Han humphed, and asked, “What exactly did you guys kidnap people for?” “Sir, could you let us take a look at your Celestial Cauldron?” Yet the leader of the Sand Maidens said something that Ling Han did not expect through her divine sense.
Yi?
Ling Han hesitated slightly, but still released the Celestial Cauldron.
It was as if the Celestial Cauldron had been forged from stone.
It looked ordinary and plain,
but an incredibly terrifying pressure reverberated slightly, as if it was the emperor of martial
arts.
“Master!” All the Sand Maidens knelt down, paying their respects to Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 3868: Acknowledged Master
paragraphs: Yi, what was going on here?
After taking a look at the Celestial Cauldron, they were calling him Master?
“Why do you address me as Master?” Ling Han asked.

The leader of the Sand Maidens was incredibly respectful, “According to our ancestral teachings, if we encounter someone who has cultivated a stone Celestial Cauldron, and is not affected by our Soul Extinguishing Technique, that would be our Master!”
Who had created this setting?
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before asking, “Who are you people?”
“We don’t know where we come from either. We’ve only lived here for generations, guarding a key,” the Sand Maiden in the lead said.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. The White Lotus Holy Emperor had said before that there was an ultimate fortune in this Mystery Realm. Could it be that it was opened by this key?
“What key?” Ling Han asked.
The leader of the Sand Maidens immediately turned around, and with a swoosh, melted into the wall.
Ling Han couldn’t help but grumble. Since you guys can pass through sand as if it was air, then why did you have to build a house? Wasn’t that superfluous?
He had just finished complaining, when he saw that the Sand Maiden had returned, and as expected, she was holding a key in her hand.
She walked in front of Ling Han, knelt down on one knee, and respectfully handed him the key.
Ling Han caught it, and couldn’t help but feel his hand sink.
So heavy.
What kind of power did Ling Han possess? Yet, the key actually felt heavy in his hand? This was a clear sign of just how heavy this key was.
What material was it made of?
Ling Han examined it carefully. At first glance, this key looked like it was made of bronze. It should be extremely ancient, and there were even spots of rust on it.
Would Divine Metal rust?

Yes, but that would require an astonishingly long time, and this key was incredibly heavy. The materials used should be considerably precious, and it was very possible that they were Four Stars, Five Stars or even higher grade. To make this kind of Divine Metal rust, how many years would it take?
Ling Han sent his divine sense into it, but there was no reaction.
This most likely wasn’t a Spirit Tool, but rather a key forged from a high-level Divine Metal. Whatever it was, he would put it away first.
Ling Han placed the bronze key into his Spatial Spirit Tool, then asked, “Where are the people you guys kidnapped?”
“In reply to Master, we did not hurt those people. We were only using them to breed,” the leader of the Sand Maidens said.
Br-breed?
Ling Han couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. Could she not use such strong words? He was curious, “Don’t you have any male members?”

“No,” the leader of the Sand Maidens replied. “If we mate, we’ll only give birth to a girl.” “Then what if there are no men?” Ling Han’s desire for gossip burned. This Mystery Realm would only open once every million years, and even Saints would die of old age. How could you guys hold on for a million years until a new batch of men came?

“After we die, a life core will be left behind, nurtured with the energy of the land’s heart, and a new life will be formed,” the leader of the Sand Maidens replied. She was really telling him everything she knew.
Asexual reproduction? How boring.
However, this kind of life was really amazing. If there were men, they would copulate, and if there were no men, they would die and come back to life.
Of course, life couldn’t be duplicated. If one died, that was the end.
“Will a new life maintain its previous memories?” Ling Han asked. This was the key.
“No.” The leader of the Sand Maidens shook her head.
That’s right. All beings only had one life. Even if they reincarnated from the dead, they would only have the same body, and their souls were completely two different people.
“What about those men?” Ling Han asked.
“They are here. Master, please follow me,” the leader of the Sand Maidens said.
Ling Han followed her, and soon arrived at a very, very large house. He saw that there were multiple men lined up neatly on the ground. However, they were all naked.
Er, were they being treated like a stud pig?
“Master, we won’t hurt them. After mating, we’ll send them back to the surface,” the leader of the Sand Maidens emphasized.
Ling Han mocked internally. If these men knew who he had “mated” with, just this kind of damage alone would be enough to leave a psychological scar in their minds for the rest of
their lives.
However, thinking about how these Sand Maidens were quite pitiful, and how they called him Master, Ling Han decided to pretend that he didn’t know about this.
“You guys have always lived in the desert. Do you know how big this place is?” Ling Han asked.
“Master, it’s actually very simple to leave the desert,” the leader of the Sand Maidens said.
“Oh?”
“We only need ten minutes to leave if we set out from here,” the leader of the Sand Maidens said. Then, she drew a diagram for Ling Han.

As it turned out, this desert was indeed astonishingly huge. Furthermore, the sand was still flowing. It looked like you had been walking forwards, but in truth, you could possibly be walking in circles. Thus, whether you could walk out or not actually depended on luck.
If you were lucky, you would be able to walk out in one or two days, but if you were not, trapping you for a few months would be no big deal.
However, if he directly went to the end from underground, that would only be a matter of ten
minutes.
Of course, if you weren’t extremely familiar with this place, even if you went underground, you wouldn’t know which direction you should go. You would still be trapped.
Ling Han felt that this adventure was quite worth it.
-After unravelling the mystery of the mysterious kidnapper, he had obtained a bronze key,
and could even leave this desert quickly.
“Master, I don’t know if you need this.” The leader of the Sand Maidens seemed to have suddenly recalled something, and turned to leave. When she returned, she was holding some
crimson beads in her hands.
“What is this?” Ling Han asked.
“We call it the Crimson Sun Cold Dew,” the leader of the Sand Maidens said. “The energy of the blazing sun gathers underground, condensing into dew, forming ice crystals.”
It sounded very high-end.
“We’ve been eating this since childhood,” the leader of the Sand Maidens said.
Ling Han was extremely curious, and he asked, “You people don’t have a mouth, so how are
you going to eat?”
The leader of the Sand Maidens began her demonstration. She took out a bead, and gripped it in her hand. The size of the bead rapidly shrunk, and soon disappeared.
So that was how it was eaten.
Ling Han also took one and channeled the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll. Instantly, a scorching energy was transmitted from the bead, surging into his body.
Yi, this was equivalent to natural treasures.

Ling Han showed a hint of pleasant surprise. This was not an alchemical pill, but rather a naturally formed natural treasure. Thus, it possessed one of the unique traits of natural treasures, and that was being devoid of alchemic poison, so no matter how much of it was consumed, the effects would only be slightly inferior, and there would not be any alchemic poison left behind.
More importantly, how many pearls were there?
Ling Han asked. The leader of the Sand Maidens thought for a long time, then directly brought him to the place where the Crimson Sun Cold Dew was stored.
Good lord, there was an entire room!
“How much can I take?” Ling Han asked.

“If Master wants it, you can naturally take it all,” the leader of the Sand Maidens said respectfully. “In this place, we can gather dozens of Crimson Sun Cold Dew every day. Even if we give birth to newborn babies, it would be enough.”
True, otherwise how could they have saved up a whole room?
“There are still too many that have turned back into energy and disappeared because too
much time has passed,” the leader of the Sand Maidens said.
What a waste, what a great waste!
Ling Han didn’t stand on ceremony. Rather than letting them go to waste, it would be better
for him to keep them.

In a few moments, he had moved almost all of the Crimson Sun Cold Dew in this room into his Spatial Tool, leaving behind close to a hundred. These Sand Maidens also needed this thing to replenish their stamina.

chapters.title: Chapter 3869: Six Cauldrons
paragraphs: “Oh, that’s right, Master. If these Crimson Sun Cold Dewdrops were brought to the surface, they would immediately evaporate,” the leader of the Sand Maidens said.
What?
Ling Han turned to look at her, and instantly felt speechless.
F***, if he couldn’t bring it outside, what was the use of taking so much?
Ling Han sighed, “All right, I understand.”
His joy turned into disappointment. However, being able to refine them here was still better than nothing.
He asked for a room, and told the Sand Maidens not to disturb him. Then, he began to refine the Crimson Sun Cold Dewdrops.
One drop after another, and his cultivation level instantly began to soar.

In truth, the effects of this thing was not much better than the Cauldron Forging Pill, but it could be considered natural treasures. They were purely natural without any side effects, and no matter how much he ingested them, there was no need to worry that he would be harmed by alchemic poison.
Half a month later, Ling Han’s cultivation level had still reached peak stage Five Cauldrons. He settled down for two days, then began to break through to Six Cauldrons.

For ordinary people, even breaking through to Four Cauldrons was incredibly difficult. This was something that required breaking through limits. However, for Ling Han, Six Cauldrons was far from his limit. Thus, in just two days, he had completed this leap.
Six Cauldrons!
Ling Han broke into a grin. Breaking the limit again, just how strong would his battle prowess be?
If he fought with Lu Qi now, even if he didn’t use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he would still be able to fight Lu Qi to a tie.
Continue.
Ling Han continued to refine the Crimson Sun Cold Dewdrops, but he discovered that the effects were getting worse and worse.

It couldn’t be helped. Though this could also be considered natural treasures, one would still have immunity after ingesting too many, and their effects would become weaker and weaker. Otherwise, as long as there was a treasured medicine that could extend one’s lifespan, wouldn’t elites never die?
Another twenty plus days later, Ling Han stopped cultivating.
That was because the Crimson Sun Cold Dewdrops was completely ineffective now.
Unfortunately, he was still a little bit away from the peak stage of Six Cauldrons, and could not break through another limit in one go, and cultivate to Seven Cauldrons.

However, one had to be content. In just over a month, he had cultivated from the middle stage of Five Cauldrons to the peak stage of Six Cauldrons. His advancement could be considered extremely shocking.
He decided to leave. There was no longer any need for him to stay here.
“Master, you’re leaving?” the leader of the Sand Maidens asked.
Ling Han nodded.
“Master, we sisters are already pregnant, so these men are useless,” the leader of the Sand Maidens said.
Er, the mating was completed so quickly; it was quite efficient.

Ling Han mocked internally. However, he stretched out a hand and grabbed all the men with his mystical power. Then, he broke through the layer of sand and headed towards the ground. With the Sand Maiden’s guidance, Ling Han naturally knew where Li Zisuan and the others were. He headed straight for them, and in just over ten minutes, he broke out of the ground. Peng! Dust flew into the air.
“Who goes there!”
“Are they here to kidnap someone again?”
Li Zisuan and the others all shouted, all of them extremely nervous.

Though since Ling Han had been kidnapped, the mysterious kidnapper had not committed any further crimes, and there had already been close to two months’ time, but even Ling Han, the “number two elite”, had been taken down without any preparations, so who would not feel a chill in their hearts?
Thus, now that the situation had suddenly changed, everyone was extremely nervous.

However, Shi Deze was an elite ranked over 700 on Galaxy Network, after all. He recognized Ling Han with a single glance, and immediately looked pleasantly surprised, as he exclaimed, “It’s Ling Han!”
“What, Ling Han!”
“It really is Ling Han!”
Peng! Immediately afterward, Ling Han also brought the captured men out. However, these people were all pressed together, so it was as if he had plucked out a carrot.
“Huang Liang!”
“Fu Donglin!”
Everyone recognized these men one by one, but there were even more people that they did not recognize, because the Sand Maidens had not targeted them specifically.
These were the people who had been kidnapped.
Not only was Ling Han unscathed, but he had even brought back those who had been captured
by the mysterious kidnapper.
At this moment, everyone was extremely excited.
“Ling Han, what’s going on?” they all asked.
Ling Han had long since prepared his words. He did not reveal the secret of the Sand Maidens, and only said that he did not know the true identity of the culprit either. They were just
human-like figures.
The two sides fought fiercely, and he finally chased off the culprit. He spent a lot of time to finally find the people who had been kidnapped, and caught up to them.
Everyone shook Huang Liang and the others awake again, and asked about the situation.

However, Huang Liang and the others didn’t know what had happened. They only said that they seemed to have had a beautiful dream. In the dream, they had spent a night of pleasure with countless beauties. It was indescribably wonderful.

Ling Han listened intently, shaking his head internally. He couldn’t bring himself to tell them. Otherwise, their beautiful dreams would become nightmares, and they would be traumatized for the rest of their life.
Even so, everyone was still filled with admiration for Ling Han.
You see, they were completely helpless against the mysterious kidnapper, but Ling Han was
able to send him running. This was strength!
Yet Ling Han smiled, and pushed the credit onto Li Zisuan.
When everyone heard this, they all exclaimed in surprise.
That’s right. Ling Han was only the second strongest elite after Li Zisuan, and he was already able to chase away the mysterious kidnapper. Then what if it was Li Zisuan?
“If Brother Li makes a move, then the culprit would definitely be captured without putting up
a fight!”
“That’s right.”
“Unfortunately, he did not make a move on Brother Li. Otherwise, he would be asking for his
own suffering.”
“He must know how powerful Brother Li is, so the culprit didn’t dare to attack Brother Li at
all.”
Everyone praised him one after another, expressing strong praise for Li Zisuan.
Li Zisuan’s expression was filled with pride as he accepted everyone’s praise. However, he was
really about to cry in his heart.
Heavens, it was fortunate that Ling Han had returned. Otherwise, he would really have
collapsed.
“Let’s go,” Ling Han said. “I know how to get out.”
Ling Han led the way, bringing everyone forwards. However, he did not walk in a straight line. Instead, he twisted here and there, as if he was walking randomly.
This caused some people to be displeased, and begin to doubt him.
“Those who disrespect Ling Han are disrespecting me,” Li Zisuan said loudly, appearing very
domineering.
Everyone sighed ruefully. Li Zisuan really trusted Ling Han very much.
However, Li Zisuan knew very well that his current status and reputation were all given to him
by Ling Han. Would he dare not treat Ling Han like a grandfather?
Two days later, a valley appeared ahead of them, enshrouded in white snow.
“He, we have walked out!”
“Haha, we’ve finally walked out!”
Everyone was excited. How long had they been in the desert? All of them had been anxious,
and now that they had finally seen the way out, they were naturally feeling extremely pleased.
“Thanks to Brother Ling’s guidance,” someone said.
“No, it’s all thanks to Brother Li’s leadership.” Someone began to flatter Li Zisuan.
“That’s right. Brother Li is our leader, and all of this is thanks to Brother Li.”
Li Zisuan felt uneasy. He was afraid that Ling Han would be angered, and quit from now on.
Thankfully, Ling Han didn’t care at all.
Ahead of them was... an ice valley.

“He must know how powerful Brother Li is, so the culprit didn’t dare to attack Brother Li at
all.”
Everyone praised him one after another, expressing strong praise for Li Zisuan.
Li Zisuan’s expression was filled with pride as he accepted everyone’s praise.
However, he was
really about to cry in his heart.
Heavens, it was fortunate that Ling Han had returned.
Otherwise, he would really have
collapsed.
“Let’s go,” Ling Han said.
“I know how to get out.”
Ling Han led the way, bringing everyone forwards.
However, he did not walk in a straight line.
Instead, he twisted here and there, as if he was walking randomly.
This caused some people to be displeased, and begin to doubt him.
“Those who disrespect Ling Han are disrespecting me,” Li Zisuan said loudly, appearing very
domineering.
Everyone sighed ruefully.
Li Zisuan really trusted Ling Han very much.
However, Li Zisuan knew very well that his current status and reputation were all given to him
by Ling Han.
Would he dare not treat Ling Han like a grandfather?
Two days later, a valley appeared ahead of them, enshrouded in white snow.
“He, we have walked out!”
“Haha, we’ve finally walked out!”
Everyone was excited.
How long had they been in the desert?
All of them had been anxious,
and now that they had finally seen the way out, they were naturally feeling extremely pleased.
“Thanks to Brother Ling’s guidance,” someone said.
“No, it’s all thanks to Brother Li’s leadership.” Someone began to flatter Li Zisuan.
“That’s right.
Brother Li is our leader, and all of this is thanks to Brother Li.”
Li Zisuan felt uneasy.
He was afraid that Ling Han would be angered, and quit from now on.
Thankfully, Ling Han didn’t care at all.
Ahead of them was... an ice valley.

chapters.title: Chapter 3870: Ice Valley, Ice Tiger
paragraphs: “I wonder what dangers lie ahead.” Someone looked at the ice valley, with a sliver of longing and at the same time, a sliver of worry.
After entering this space, they didn’t obtain any great opportunities, but dangers came one after another, which naturally made some people feel afraid.
Many people nodded in agreement.

Ling Han strode into the valley. Previously, it was still a large desert with bright sun, but after entering into this valley, the temperature dropped abruptly, enough to freeze one into an ice statue.

Starlight Screen spread out, and instantly, all the coldness was blocked outside. Ling Han continued to advance, but every step he took was cautious. Who knew if there was an ice hole here, and if one fell in, he would be consigned to eternal damnation.
Yi, there was no gravity suppression here?
Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, planning to fly by on his Tool.
However, he had just soared into the air, when he saw a cold stream turn into an ice blade that stabbed towards him.
He clenched his hand into a fist and threw a punch. Peng! The ice blade was shattered, but Ling Han’s fist also broke open, bleeding dark red blood.
Shua, shua, shua! More ice blades appeared.

Ling Han hurriedly descended. These ice blades were too terrifying. One of them was enough to make him bleed, and if several of them attacked him at the same time, even he wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
However, once they landed, peace returned to this place.

In other words, if you had the ability, you could completely do as you liked in the skies. You only had to shatter the ice blades. However, if you did not have that ability, you had best just obediently walk on the ground.
Ling Han walked around for a while, and discovered that aside from extreme cold, there were no other frightening traps here.
He turned around to take a look, and couldn’t help but shake his head.

He had the Starlight Screen, so it was naturally no problem for him to walk here. However, for others, this place was no different from hell. The majority of them were shivering from the cold. To say nothing of fighting, it would already be good enough if they could just continue walking like this.
The valley was extremely open, and the further they walked, the wider it became. After walking for more than ten minutes, a team suddenly walked out of a cave in the valley wall.
“Everyone, don’t advance any further,” someone said.
“Why?”
“There’s an ice tiger ahead. It’s a Core Formation Tier, and it’s blocking our path. If we don’t kill it, we’ll be stuck here,” the person on the other side explained.
“Core Formation Tier!”
Everyone was exclaiming in shock. The people here were all Cauldron Forging Tiers, and if they encountered a Core Formation Tier, their only fate would be defeat.

Speaking of which, it was quite coincidental. There was clearly no shortage of Foundation Building Tier and Core Formation Tier cultivators that had entered, so why had they all encountered Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators?
“Brother Shi!” Even more people walked out of the cave. A great many people had recognized Shi Deze, and all of them were incredibly cordial.
He was ranked 700s in the Galaxy Network; it was too awesome.

How could Shi Deze possibly dare to be rash? Hurriedly, he said, “This is Li Zisuan, Brother Li. He is the one who had fought with Lu Qi for 500 rounds! This time, it was all because of Brother Li that we managed to walk out of the desert.”
“What, this is Brother Li!” Everyone was stunned.
Meanwhile, the people on Li Zisuan’s side were all proud, sharing the glory.
Everyone came over to greet him. There was no one here whose rank in the Galaxy Network
was above Shi Deze. Thus, even Shi Deze admitted that he was far inferior to Li Zisuan, so who would dare not be extremely respectful towards Li Zisuan?
“Brother Li, you’re finally here!”
“With you leading the way, we will definitely be able to defeat that ice tiger, and successfully charge over.”
“Brother Li, you take command!”
Everyone spoke one after another, all of them filled with anticipation.
Li Zisuan felt apprehensive. What a joke; he was going to battle with a vicious beast of the Core Formation Tier?
Wasn’t this taking his life?
However, at this moment, how could he back down?

“Everyone, don’t be rash. After all, this is an existence of Core Formation Tier. To say nothing of me, even if Lu Qi was here, he would not dare to be rash.” He used Lu Qi to blow things over again. This signboard was really too useful.
Instantly, everyone nodded. If even Lu Qi did not dare to use force, then they would naturally have to be even more cautious.
“Let’s wait for a while longer. Having more people would increase the power on our side. This way, we can minimize casualties,” Li Zisuan continued.
He was clearly cowering, but in everyone’s ears, this was a display of Li Zisuan’s benevolence and righteousness. Just look, he was actually concerned about everyone’s lives.
“Brother Li, I am impressed!
“Frank and straightforward!”
“Brilliant!”
Everyone was rueful. By now, what other person would have such strong abilities, yet be so kind-hearted?

The various teams talked about how they had traversed the desert. What depressed Li Zisuan and the others was the fact that only they had wasted so much time in the desert. The others had only spent two days at minimum, while at maximum, others had only spent six days to
traverse the desert and arrive here.
What else could be said? It was a matter of luck.
Meanwhile, Ling Han surveyed his surroundings. He wanted to see if he could set up the Three
Elements Treasure Bottle Formation and kill that ice tiger.
However, he was disappointed. The environment here was not suitable for setting up
formations, because this place was within a formation in the first place, and he wanted to
make use of power of heaven and earth further?
This was as difficult as ascending the heavens.
Heavenly Dao Flames?
Ling Han shook his head. He couldn’t think of borrowing the Heavenly Dao Flames whenever
he encountered difficulties. He would become reliant on it, and when the five times of the Heavenly Dao Flames was used up, what else could he rely on?
This was used to save his life.
Then he would just wait. When there were enough of them, he would then attack that ice tiger.
A few days later, teams and lone travelers appeared one after another, but Ling Han did not discover the empress, Hu Niu, Lin Luo, or the large black dog.
In terms of abilities, there were a great many Human Cauldrons and Earth Cauldrons here.
Thus, if it was claimed that the empress and the others were unable to walk here because their abilities were inferior, this seemed to be impossible. At the very least, a few of them could
reach here, right?
Thus, Ling Han was more inclined to believe that there were still many deserts and ice valleys
like this, which had the effect of dividing them up. Otherwise, if all the Cauldron Forging Tiers came, then so what if it was a Core Formation Tier? Even if they saw them, they would have to
flee in fear.

More and more people came, but there was no one that could shake Li Zisuan’s position – even if there came another person ranked in the 400s in the Galaxy Network afterwards. Though he was eager to give it a try, he was more afraid that he would lose to Li Zisuan and embarrass himself, so he chose to keep a low profile.
However, because of his tacit agreement, everyone thought that he was afraid of Li Zisuan.
Hence, a few more ranked in the 200s of the Galaxy Network came later, but all of them chose to tacitly acquiesce to Li Zisuan’s leadership.

In the eyes of others, this was only natural. Being able to battle Lu Qi for 500 rounds, how could it be that his abilities could not be ranked in the top 100 of the Galaxy Network? However, Li Zisuan was constantly worried that his heart would explode. This was taking things too far. Once his true strength was exposed, wouldn’t he be trampled to death? However, it was impossible to stop halfway. At this time, he could only go all the way to the
end.
Yet Ling Han still announced that Li Zisuan’s cultivation level had greatly improved, and even
Lu Qi was no match for him.

There were very few people who believed him. After all, Lu Qi’s reputation was too well- known, and this was proven by the Galaxy Network. However, Li Zisuan almost fainted in fright, and the eyes he directed at Ling Han were filled with resentment.
Brother, do you have to mess with me like this?

chapters.title: Chapter 3871: Battling Lu Qi again
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

At this moment, the number of people gathered in the ice valley had already exceeded 200, and there were more than 30 people ranked in the top 1000 of the Galaxy Network. This filled everyone with confidence. With such a lineup, they should be able to challenge that ice tiger.
“Brother Li, issue the command!”
“As long as you lead the way, we’ll charge.”
“Brother Li, my saber is already thirsting for blood.”
Everyone shouted.
Li Zisuan really wanted to beat someone up. If he was the leader, they definitely wouldn’t be charging towards victory. Instead, they would be charging straight into the stomach of the ice tiger.
—With his ranking in the Galaxy Network, merely in the 10,000s, wasn’t taking the vanguard just sending himself to his death?
However, as the leader, he naturally had to take the lead. If the strongest person didn’t take the lead, who would be at the front line?
In fact, this was also one of the reasons why those who ranked higher in the Galaxy Network chose to remain silent. This was indeed impressive, but there was also a price to be paid.
Just when Li Zisuan was still racking his brains for a way to refuse, a person suddenly ran over, his face filled with excitement, “Lu Qi is here! Lu Qi is here!”
This was a sentry, and his mission was to welcome those who had walked through the desert.
When everyone heard this, they were all excited.

That was Lu Qi, the super elite ranked nineteenth in the Galaxy Network. If he led a team to charge at the ice tiger, then not only would their chances of success be higher, their casualties would also be lower.
However, Li Zisuan began to shiver.
Oh no, now that the main character had appeared, his lies would naturally be exposed to the world. He would definitely be torn into pieces by countless people who had been deceived.
Everyone went out to receive him. That was Lu Qi, the elite cultivator who was ranked nineteenth in Galaxy Network and ranked in the top five in North Heavenly Realm.
Sure enough, it wasn’t long before Lu Qi was welcomed by the prodigies as if they were stars revolving around the moon.
He wasn’t alone either. Instead, he was leading a team. However, Song Lan wasn’t in the team. It was clear that the people who had entered were in an extremely chaotic state.

“Humph, I have heard that there is someone here that can exchange 500 blows with me.” Lu Qi spoke up, his voice icy cold, “Step out, and let me see. I, Lu Qi, do not remember who would be able to exchange 500 blows with me without losing!”
Li Zisuan was about to cry. What kind of luck did he have? How had he met the real deal so quickly?
He had even planned to deceive them for a while, and then disappear without a trace.
“Lu Qi, are you even worthy of fighting Brother Li?” Ling Han laughed loudly, and shot out like an arrow.
“Ling Han!” Lu Qi’s expression instantly became extremely ugly, and there was an unconcealable killing intent in his eyes.
“You can’t even defeat me, and you still want to fight Brother Li?” Without another word, Ling Han immediately charged over to fight.
Faced with Ling Han, even Lu Qi did not dare to be careless. Hurriedly, he went up to greet him, and at the first instant, unleashed his full battle prowess. Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two of them went all out, with rolling waves of energy blasting the heavens and earth. The whole valley was swaying, and innumerable accumulated snow was boiling into the skies, creating a terrifying commotion.
However, this valley was really sturdy. Even after being beaten like this by them, it did not collapse.
Everyone was dumbfounded. Lu Qi had actually been blocked.
Hiss!
Then, Li Zisuan should not have lied.
You see, Ling Han said that he was no match for Li Zisuan, and he was able to fight Lu Qi to a stalemate. Then, Li Zisuan naturally had a chance of defeating Lu Qi.
—It was true that they had fought for 500 rounds, and now, it was highly possible that Lu Qi was no match for Li Zisuan.
Misunderstanding, it was really a misunderstanding.

Everyone looked towards Li Zisuan, all of them bearing reverence and lingering fear. They actually dared to doubt Li Zisuan’s strength. And those prodigies ranked in the top two hundred were also sighing endlessly. Thankfully, they had not issued a challenge. Otherwise, they would have long since been beaten to the ground and conquered.
Yi, how could there be such a miraculous turn of events?

Li Zisuan had not expected this either. He was also extremely dumbfounded. It was as if... this bullsh*t had reached a new height. In future, there was no need for him to say anything about battling Lu Qi for 500 rounds. It could completely be claimed that even Lu Qi was no match for him. Just look, everyone here today could be his witnesses.
Then, he looked at Ling Han in horror. Who exactly was this guy? He could even match Lu Qi, so why had he never heard of him on the Galaxy Network?
Li Zisuan was astonished, and so was Lu Qi.
It was not that he had not exchanged blows with Ling Han before, but a few months ago, Ling Han definitely did not have that kind of strength.
Previously, Ling Han could only just barely match him by a bit. If it was not for the fact that the other had an incredibly amazing Spirit Tool, he had full confidence that he could kill Ling Han.
But now, Ling Han already possessed the strength to completely oppose him.
This was too freakish, wasn’t it?
Just how long had passed?
At this rate, before he broke through to the Nine Cauldrons or reached the Core Formation Tier, Ling Han would have already surpassed him and become an elite of Core Formation Tier.

Lu Qi roared in fury, and unleashed a series of amazing moves. Energy surged, and one move was enough to insta-kill a large swathe of Cauldron Forging Tiers. However, in front of Ling Han, even this was not enough.
Ling Han exchanged blows, not falling into a disadvantage at all.

Lu Qi naturally had a trump card, and that was channeling his Innate Divine Physique. This could allow him to possess the battle prowess of a cultivator at the early stage of Core Formation Tier. However, the problem was that Ling Han also had that powerful weapon that he had yet to use. It was completely capable of resisting his natural Mystical Power.
After several hundred more exchanges, Lu Qi could only stop reluctantly.
He had to admit that the present Ling Han was completely capable of matching him. There was no meaning to continue the battle.
Unless he could obtain a great fortune, capture the celestial light, and cultivate a supreme divine light. He was sure that even Ling Han would not be able to withstand the might of a single slash.
Ling Han didn’t press his advantage. Instead, he shook his head and said, “Lu Qi, be more modest in the future. How can you possibly be a match for Brother Li?”
The matter was very simple. Ling Han and Lu Qi were evenly matched, and Ling Han was no match for Li Zisuan. In that case, Lu Qi was naturally no match for Li Zisuan either.
Everyone nodded, and the gazes they directed at Li Zisuan were filled with strong reverence and admiration.
Just look, he had been provoked by Lu Qi previously, yet Li Zisuan did not say a word about it. Just how broad-minded was he?
Lu Qi almost spat out a mouthful of blood.
F***, he had never seen that so-called Li Zisuan before, so how could they have fought for 500 moves?
He suddenly understood. This was f****** Ling Han deliberately causing trouble for him.
Most importantly, this move was really effective.
Even if he said that Li Zisuan was no match for him now, who would believe him?
They would only say that he was a sore loser!
Depressing, this was too depressing.
Lu Qi wanted to kill Li Zisuan on the spot, and everything would naturally be clear. However, Ling Han was standing by Li Zisuan’s side, clearly protecting this person.
If he made a move, Ling Han would definitely make a move as well. That would be the same irresolvable situation as before.
‘Motherf*cker!’
An elite like Lu Qi would not even bother to curse, but now, he really wanted to curse all eighteen generations of Ling Han’s ancestors.
Why are you so mean?
“Brother Li, now that we have such supreme elites like you, Brother Ling, and Brother Lu, it should be enough to attack that ice tiger!” someone said.
The current Li Zisuan was naturally filled with confidence.. Immediately, he waved his hand, “Let’s go!”

It could completely be claimed that even Lu Qi was no match for him.
Just look, everyone here today could be his witnesses.
Then, he looked at Ling Han in horror.
Who exactly was this guy?
He could even match Lu Qi, so why had he never heard of him on the Galaxy Network?
Li Zisuan was astonished, and so was Lu Qi.
It was not that he had not exchanged blows with Ling Han before, but a few months ago, Ling Han definitely did not have that kind of strength.
Previously, Ling Han could only just barely match him by a bit.
If it was not for the fact that the other had an incredibly amazing Spirit Tool, he had full confidence that he could kill Ling Han.
But now, Ling Han already possessed the strength to completely oppose him.
This was too freakish, wasn’t it?
Just how long had passed?
At this rate, before he broke through to the Nine Cauldrons or reached the Core Formation Tier, Ling Han would have already surpassed him and become an elite of Core Formation Tier.
Lu Qi roared in fury, and unleashed a series of amazing moves.
Energy surged, and one move was enough to insta-kill a large swathe of Cauldron Forging Tiers.
However, in front of Ling Han, even this was not enough.
Ling Han exchanged blows, not falling into a disadvantage at all.
Lu Qi naturally had a trump card, and that was channeling his Innate Divine Physique.
This could allow him to possess the battle prowess of a cultivator at the early stage of Core Formation Tier.
However, the problem was that Ling Han also had that powerful weapon that he had yet to use.
It was completely capable of resisting his natural Mystical Power.
After several hundred more exchanges, Lu Qi could only stop reluctantly.
He had to admit that the present Ling Han was completely capable of matching him.
There was no meaning to continue the battle.
Unless he could obtain a great fortune, capture the celestial light, and cultivate a supreme divine light.
He was sure that even Ling Han would not be able to withstand the might of a single slash.
Ling Han didn’t press his advantage.
Instead, he shook his head and said, “Lu Qi, be more modest in the future.
How can you possibly be a match for Brother Li?”
The matter was very simple.
Ling Han and Lu Qi were evenly matched, and Ling Han was no match for Li Zisuan.
In that case, Lu Qi was naturally no match for Li Zisuan either.
Everyone nodded, and the gazes they directed at Li Zisuan were filled with strong reverence and admiration.
Just look, he had been provoked by Lu Qi previously, yet Li Zisuan did not say a word about it.
Just how broad-minded was he?
Lu Qi almost spat out a mouthful of blood.
F***, he had never seen that so-called Li Zisuan before, so how could they have fought for 500 moves?
He suddenly understood.
This was f****** Ling Han deliberately causing trouble for him.
Most importantly, this move was really effective.
Even if he said that Li Zisuan was no match for him now, who would believe him?
They would only say that he was a sore loser!
Depressing, this was too depressing.
Lu Qi wanted to kill Li Zisuan on the spot, and everything would naturally be clear.
However, Ling Han was standing by Li Zisuan’s side, clearly protecting this person.
If he made a move, Ling Han would definitely make a move as well.
That would be the same irresolvable situation as before.
‘Motherf*cker!’
An elite like Lu Qi would not even bother to curse, but now, he really wanted to curse all eighteen generations of Ling Han’s ancestors.
Why are you so mean?
“Brother Li, now that we have such supreme elites like you, Brother Ling, and Brother Lu, it should be enough to attack that ice tiger!” someone said.
The current Li Zisuan was naturally filled with confidence..
Immediately, he waved his hand, “Let’s go!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3872: Joint Attack on the Ice Tiger
paragraphs: Everyone set out, preparing to challenge that ice tiger that was in the Core Formation Tier.
Lu Qi was considerably displeased.
Of course, he would go and battle that ice tiger, but he should definitely be the leader, not like now, when he had actually become someone’s lackey.
Thus, his expression was dark the entire time.
They arrived at the end of the valley, and sure enough, there was a massive fierce tiger standing guard there. It was completely snow-white, and with a breath, a cold wind instantly howled.
This was a vicious beast of Core Formation Tier that had blocked their path.
Seeing this group of people walk over, that fierce beast only cast a lazy look at them, and did not stand up to attack them. As if it had not seen them at all, it lowered its head again.
“This beast can’t pursue us. There’s a formation blocking it,” someone said.

Some people had already challenged this ice tiger at the beginning, and they were naturally defeated. Now, there were still a few corpses that had been frozen into ice sculptures lying there, looking like they were about to flee, but they had long since been covered in ice.
“Brothers, attack with me!” Li Zisuan roared. He felt too good now, as if he had become a Great General, commanding an invincible army.

In truth, though there were only over 200 of them, there was no shortage of Galaxy Network’s top 1000. Which one of them was not one of the strongest in their own galaxy, and it was not too much to call them an invincible army.
Perhaps, in future, there would be a few Venerate Tier elites among them, or even a Saint among them. Then, Li Zisuan would really be able to boast for the rest of his life.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said to Lu Qi, “How about it? Do you want to compete again?” “Compete in what?” Lu Qi naturally would not cower.
“Who would cause more damage to that ice tiger?” Ling Han asked.
“Humph, if you unleash that invincible flame, how am I supposed to compete with you?” Lu Qi asked coldly.
Ling Han smiled and said, “I promise I won’t use it.”
“All right!” Lu Qi nodded. He naturally did not think that he would lose to Ling Han, no matter which aspect he was in.

The two of them charged at the forefront, and seeing these two fierce people charge at the forefront, the others’ confidence naturally increased greatly. They roared repeatedly, and followed closely behind.
“Die!”
Everyone roared loudly, their voices reverberating, their might extremely great.
Only then did the ice tiger stand up. With a shake of its body, a powerful aura spread out, chilling to the bone.

Everyone couldn’t help but shiver. They suddenly realized that this was a Core Formation Tier-level vicious beast, not a Cauldron Forging Tier-level one. Instantly, a considerable number of people felt fear rise up in their hearts.
Ling Han humphed, and spat out a golden sword. He was the first to attack.

The ice tiger was disdainful, and opened its mouth as well. Instantly, a burst of cold air gushed out. Pa, the golden sword was wrapped, and condensed into layers of ice. It suddenly dropped down from midair, shattering into pieces on the ground, turning back into Metal Element energy, which returned to the heaven and earth.
Lu Qi smirked coldly. He drew out a long silver whip. Shua, he lashed out with the whip, and the whip stretched out endlessly, lashing out at the ice tiger.
Pa, this whip landed on the ice tiger’s body.
Without waiting for Lu Qi to show an expression of delight, he saw that there was ice attacking from one end of the whip, spreading out towards him through the whip at an astonishing speed.
He hurriedly shouted loudly, and divine light flickered on the silver whip. Then, he rapidly retreated.
The combined attack of the two supreme prodigies had failed, and they were completely at a disadvantage in front of this ice tiger.
As expected of a fierce beast on the level of Core Formation Tier. In terms of level, it completely overwhelmed the Cauldron Forging Tier.
Everyone moved one after another, but none of them dared to rush close enough. They all attacked from afar.
Peng, peng, peng! Energy continued to explode from the ice tiger’s body, but no attack could penetrate its defense.
However, this seemed to have angered it. The ice tiger stared at the masses, and suddenly opened its mouth. Shua, a cold stream sprayed out, surging rapidly towards the masses.
Everyone hurriedly dodged. As the cold stream surged past, there were still two people who had not managed to dodge in time, and were forcefully turned into ice statues.
“There’s still life force.”
“Quick, carry them to the side, and immediately melt the layer of ice with fire energy. There should still be hope.”
These two people were carried to one side, and naturally, there were people that were proficient in fire-element energy that moved to save them, while the others continued to attack the ice tiger.

Ling Han gave a loud shout, and the Great Overarching Heaven Technique was used. He fully displayed the secret technique of Venerate Tier-level. Every move, style, punch and palm strike had boundless might.
Lu Qi was not outdone either. At present, he was not in the mood for internal strife either. He had to defeat the ice tiger to pass the test, and he alone could not deal with it. He had to join
forces with Ling Han.
Since that was the case, just like the previous agreement, let’s see whose battle prowess was stronger, and see who could cause greater damage to the ice tiger.

Their battle prowess definitely couldn’t be underestimated. If they were allowed to unleash their full power, even those at the early stage of Core Formation would have a headache. Thus, after the ice tiger was hit a few times, a great amount of fur instantly fell off.
However, this was still unable to enrage the ice tiger, and it still maintained its original rhythm of attack.
Ling Han was surprised. This didn’t make sense. As a fierce beast, why did it have the word “fierce” in its name?
That was because they only had the nature of beasts, but did not have intelligence. They were cruel and domineering.
He had been blasted to the point that his fur had fallen off quite a bit, and he actually still did
not have any temper?
Yi!
Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. Could it be that this ice tiger wasn’t a genuine ferocious beast? Could it be that it was just an empty shell? Perhaps it was actually a puppet controlled
by the formation?
This was very possible. Only then could it explain why it had been standing guard here all this
while.
However, being able to guess the truth didn’t mean that he could end the battle. Ling Han attacked with his full strength, trying to cause the most damage to the ice tiger.
On the other side, Lu Qi also couldn’t help but use a powerful move.
His figure suddenly enlarged, even surpassing this ice tiger. Then, with a palm strike, all the accumulated snow in the valley was sent flying into the skies.
“Virtuous Wisdom Heavenly Mountain Palm!”
Multiple veined patterns lit up on that massive palm, intertwining to form incredibly
complex seals. It was as if they had been boosted with some kind of powerful power, and
could penetrate heaven and earth with a single strike.
He used the power of his bloodline, and this battle prowess directly soared to the early stage
of Core Formation Tier.
Boom, this palm strike descended, and the heaven and earth swayed.
The ice tiger roared in fury, and sent a palm strike into the skies.
Peng!
Its colossal body instantly sank downwards, and was forcefully pressed onto the ground.
“All right!” Everyone exclaimed in shock. Lu Qi was truly powerful. He had actually been able to defeat a vicious beast of the Core Formation Tier! Just how powerful was his power?
However, his handsomeness only lasted for three seconds. Lu Qi’s face immediately paled, and it was as if his body had been emptied, rapidly shrinking in size.
However, the ice tiger shook its body, and stood back up. There were a few more injuries on its body, and it had lost a lot of fur, but it did not suffer any serious injuries.
After all, he was a Core Formation Tier, so how could he possibly be severely wounded by an attack of early stage Core Formation Tier?
The ice tiger set its eyes on Lu Qi. It seemed to know that he was a great threat, and wanted to
kill him.
It charged out, but Ling Han still charged forwards. Using the Three Styles of the God of War,
his battle prowess instantly soared to a new height.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
He barely managed to parry the ice tiger, but even if he used the Three Styles of the God of War, he was still no match for the ice tiger. He was blasted back repeatedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 3873: Taken Down
paragraphs: After three moves, Ling Han hurriedly stepped aside.
This was like three axe strokes. After using it, he could only fall into a disadvantage.
Thankfully, Lu Qi also approached, and took over the position of Ling Han’s position as the main force, clashing head-on with the ice tiger.

But there was a gap of a major tier in cultivation level. Even if he was Eight Cauldrons, so what? In a head-on confrontation, he had only blocked two to three moves, and his whole body was trembling, as if his blood was about to freeze.
Ling Han charged forwards, and continued to exchange blows with the ice tiger.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The others also moved, blasting towards the ice tiger. They couldn’t just let Ling Han and Lu Qi go all out, right?
Ling Han released a battle cry. He channelled out the Demonic Monkey Fists.
This was his strongest technique at this moment. Once he channeled it, his entire aura was different. It was as if a Great Emperor had revived, exuding an endless aura.
Lu Qi’s eyes involuntarily turned cold. Though Ling Han’s attack was aimed at the ice tiger, it still gave him tremendous pressure.
If Ling Han’s punch was aimed at him, would he be able to block it?
-He had to use the power of his bloodline, or he would definitely be severely injured.
He inhaled sharply. As powerful as he was, he was actually forced to use his Natural Mystical Power to oppose a fist technique. Just how inconceivable was this?
Then how many more punches would his opponent throw?
No, no, no. With such a terrifying fist technique, Ling Han definitely wouldn’t be able to -channel more than a few punches.
Boom!
This punch landed on the ice tiger, and directly sent the ice tiger flying, showing an incomparably terrifying might.
However, after this punch, the ice tiger immediately got up and shook its body, as if it had not sustained any injuries.
F***, this was really too hard to deal with. He had already used an Imperial Technique and a Natural Mystical Power was also used, yet this guy was still completely unscathed.
However, what could he do? He could only continue.
Everyone continued to attack, blasting madly at the ice tiger, wanting to exhaust this fierce beast to death with the advantage of numbers.
Hu! Hu! Hu!

Cold winds swept over, and the ice tiger was extremely impressive. As long as anyone was hit by its cold currents, they would definitely be frozen solid. They had to save the person at the first instant, or they would definitely die.
Thankfully, this was not a fatal blow, so everyone was able to hold on, and there was no serious loss of members. A great many people had their ice melted, and continued to join the battle.

Li Zisuan took the position of battle commander again. He distributed the manpower, and had everyone split into several groups to charge. The people with the weakest abilities was responsible for thawing the ice. Otherwise, they might be frozen the moment they advanced. Not only would they not be able to help, they would even be a hindrance.
-If it was someone else commanding, who would listen? Who here was not proud and arrogant?
However, Li Zisuan was an existence that was superior to Lu Qi, so his words naturally convinced the masses.
Hu!

A cold breeze swept by. Though Ling Han had the Starlight Screen protecting him, it instantly shattered in front of the cold breeze. He could clearly sense that the blood in his body was instantly frozen.
He immediately channelled the Heavenly Dao Flames. Boom, a flame swept past, and the blood in his body revived, beginning to flow again.
It took him at least ten seconds to completely recover.
Sigh, the attacks of a Core Formation Tier were truly terrifying.
“Ling Han, hurry up and block him!” Lu Qi urged. He had actually managed to block him for
ten seconds all by himself, and he had almost died.
“It’s only a mere ten seconds, and you can’t hold up to it?” Ling Han asked calmly.
“Of course, why don’t you try blocking ten seconds?” Lu Qi humphed.
That was a Core Formation Tier, not some random nobody.
Ling Han smiled and summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to greet the ice tiger.
One, two, three... ten, eleven, twelve.

Ling Han easily survived 10 seconds. With the protection of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, as well as the second layer of defense from the Starlight Screen, it was no big deal for Ling Han to last for more than 10 seconds under the attack of the ice tiger.
Lu Qi was rendered speechless. Who asked Ling Han to possess such a precious tool, while he did not?
Everyone gritted their teeth and fought a tough battle. Though there was only one opponent, he was too strong.
Half a day, one day, two days!
Everyone was persisting, and by the second day, they could clearly feel that the power of the ice tiger was waning. Compared to the first day, it was much weaker.
However, because they had taken turns fighting, they had a certain amount of time to recover their mystical power. Thus, the situation was naturally much better.
The key was Ling Han and Lu Qi.
That was because neither of them could be missing. They would definitely have to be on the front lines. Whichever one of them could not hold on, it would cause the entire team to
crur
in instant.
The problem was, they didn’t have the time to rest.

Ling Han was unconcerned. His mystical power was endless. To say nothing of a day, even a year and a half wouldn’t be a problem, but it was a different story for Lu Qi. Though he was the super genius ranked 19th in the Galaxy Network, with mystical power that definitely surpassed the average Cauldron Forging Tier, in a high-intensity confrontation with a vicious beast of Core Formation Tier, the expenditure of mystical power was also astonishing..
He could barely hold on any longer.
Sure enough, after battling for a while longer, Lu Qi retreated to the side. If he continued to fight, that would simply be courting death.
Ling Han couldn’t help but curse. He could retreat, but he would have to inform him in advance. Now, the ice tiger’s attack was instantly pressing down on him, and he almost
couldn’t withstand it.
What a vile character, not forgetting to screw him over even at a time like this.
-If he could use this ice tiger to kill Ling Han, that would be a great thing for Lu Qi.

Ling Han resisted with all his might. With the boost from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he had a certain amount of capital to resist this fierce beast. After all, there were still 200 people behind him. Furthermore, the battle prowess of the ice tiger had also decreased
greatly.
However, he would not allow Lu Qi to be so at ease either. He drew the ice tiger closer and closer to Lu Qi, wanting to drag the latter into the battle as well.
In this manner, Lu Qi naturally did not have the time to recover properly. He had no choice but to move, and continuously dodged.

Thankfully, the pressure on this ice tiger was even greater. It had been madly bombarded by over 200 Cauldron Forging Tiers all this while. So what if it was a Core Formation Tier? It was riddled with wounds, and blood had dyed its white fur red.
After battling for a while longer, this fierce beast finally collapsed loudly, and could no longer stand up.
Everyone breathed a long sigh of relief. This fierce battle was really arduous, but in the end, it
ended with their victory.
Ling Han’s eyes suddenly turned, and focused on Lu Qi.
‘Die!’
He leaped out, and charged towards Lu Qi.
“Ling Han, are you planning on kicking me to the curb after I’ve outlived my usefulness?” Lu
Qi was both shocked and furious.
“Hehe, you have the face to say these words?” Ling Han smirked coldly, and punched out
furiously with both fists.
Lu Qi hurriedly parried, but he had been continuously disturbed by Ling Han previously, and had not been able to recover much at all. Very soon, he was on the back foot.
He was both furious and shocked. They had both experienced a bloody battle, so why was Ling Han’s battle prowess still so powerful? It didn’t seem like it had weakened at all.
How was this possible?
However, under Ling Han’s barrage of attacks, it was becoming more and more difficult for
him to rival Ling Han.
If this continued, he would definitely be blasted into smithereens. “What are you all standing around for? Come and help me!” Lu Qi roared furiously at the
masses. They had worked together to kill a vicious beast of the Core Formation Tier, so there
was naturally no problem for them to defeat Ling Han as well. “No one is allowed to make a move!” Li Zisuan suddenly spoke up.
