Thankfully, this was not a fatal blow, so everyone was able to hold on, and there was no serious loss of members.
A great many people had their ice melted, and continued to join the battle.
Li Zisuan took the position of battle commander again.
He distributed the manpower, and had everyone split into several groups to charge.
The people with the weakest abilities was responsible for thawing the ice.
Otherwise, they might be frozen the moment they advanced.
Not only would they not be able to help, they would even be a hindrance.
-If it was someone else commanding, who would listen?
Who here was not proud and arrogant?
However, Li Zisuan was an existence that was superior to Lu Qi, so his words naturally convinced the masses.
Hu!
A cold breeze swept by.
Though Ling Han had the Starlight Screen protecting him, it instantly shattered in front of the cold breeze.
He could clearly sense that the blood in his body was instantly frozen.
He immediately channelled the Heavenly Dao Flames.
Boom, a flame swept past, and the blood in his body revived, beginning to flow again.
It took him at least ten seconds to completely recover.
Sigh, the attacks of a Core Formation Tier were truly terrifying.
“Ling Han, hurry up and block him!” Lu Qi urged.
He had actually managed to block him for
ten seconds all by himself, and he had almost died.
“It’s only a mere ten seconds, and you can’t hold up to it?” Ling Han asked calmly.
“Of course, why don’t you try blocking ten seconds?” Lu Qi humphed.
That was a Core Formation Tier, not some random nobody.
Ling Han smiled and summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to greet the ice tiger.
One, two, three... ten, eleven, twelve.
Ling Han easily survived 10 seconds.

With the protection of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, as well as the second layer of defense from the Starlight Screen, it was no big deal for Ling Han to last for more than 10 seconds under the attack of the ice tiger.
Lu Qi was rendered speechless.
Who asked Ling Han to possess such a precious tool, while he did not?
Everyone gritted their teeth and fought a tough battle.
Though there was only one opponent, he was too strong.
Half a day, one day, two days!
Everyone was persisting, and by the second day, they could clearly feel that the power of the ice tiger was waning.
Compared to the first day, it was much weaker.
However, because they had taken turns fighting, they had a certain amount of time to recover their mystical power.
Thus, the situation was naturally much better.
The key was Ling Han and Lu Qi.
That was because neither of them could be missing.
They would definitely have to be on the front lines.
Whichever one of them could not hold on, it would cause the entire team to
crur
in instant.
The problem was, they didn’t have the time to rest.
Ling Han was unconcerned.
His mystical power was endless.
To say nothing of a day, even a year and a half wouldn’t be a problem, but it was a different story for Lu Qi.

Though he was the super genius ranked 19th in the Galaxy Network, with mystical power that definitely surpassed the average Cauldron Forging Tier, in a high-intensity confrontation with a vicious beast of Core Formation Tier, the expenditure of mystical power was also astonishing..
He could barely hold on any longer.
Sure enough, after battling for a while longer, Lu Qi retreated to the side.
If he continued to fight, that would simply be courting death.
Ling Han couldn’t help but curse.
He could retreat, but he would have to inform him in advance.
Now, the ice tiger’s attack was instantly pressing down on him, and he almost
couldn’t withstand it.
What a vile character, not forgetting to screw him over even at a time like this.
-If he could use this ice tiger to kill Ling Han, that would be a great thing for Lu Qi.
Ling Han resisted with all his might.
With the boost from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he had a certain amount of capital to resist this fierce beast.
After all, there were still 200 people behind him.
Furthermore, the battle prowess of the ice tiger had also decreased
greatly.
However, he would not allow Lu Qi to be so at ease either.
He drew the ice tiger closer and closer to Lu Qi, wanting to drag the latter into the battle as well.
In this manner, Lu Qi naturally did not have the time to recover properly.
He had no choice but to move, and continuously dodged.
Thankfully, the pressure on this ice tiger was even greater.
It had been madly bombarded by over 200 Cauldron Forging Tiers all this while.
So what if it was a Core Formation Tier?
It was riddled with wounds, and blood had dyed its white fur red.
After battling for a while longer, this fierce beast finally collapsed loudly, and could no longer stand up.
Everyone breathed a long sigh of relief.
This fierce battle was really arduous, but in the end, it
ended with their victory.
Ling Han’s eyes suddenly turned, and focused on Lu Qi.
‘Die!’
He leaped out, and charged towards Lu Qi.
“Ling Han, are you planning on kicking me to the curb after I’ve outlived my usefulness?” Lu
Qi was both shocked and furious.
“Hehe, you have the face to say these words?” Ling Han smirked coldly, and punched out
furiously with both fists.
Lu Qi hurriedly parried, but he had been continuously disturbed by Ling Han previously, and had not been able to recover much at all.
Very soon, he was on the back foot.
He was both furious and shocked.
They had both experienced a bloody battle, so why was Ling Han’s battle prowess still so powerful?
It didn’t seem like it had weakened at all.
How was this possible?
However, under Ling Han’s barrage of attacks, it was becoming more and more difficult for
him to rival Ling Han.
If this continued, he would definitely be blasted into smithereens.
“What are you all standing around for?
Come and help me!” Lu Qi roared furiously at the
masses.
They had worked together to kill a vicious beast of the Core Formation Tier, so there
was naturally no problem for them to defeat Ling Han as well.
“No one is allowed to make a move!” Li Zisuan suddenly spoke up.

chapters.title: Chapter 3874: Splitting up
paragraphs: The present Li Zisuan had astonishingly high prestige.
Thus, once he spoke, who would dare make a move?
Lu Qi was practically mad with fury. This guy, who in his eyes was only an ant, had actually become the last straw that would crush him to death!
This was practically a great humiliation.
Li Zisuan looked at Lu Qi, his heart beating wildly. There was a kind of fear in his heart, as well as an indescribable excitement.

Though he had been boasting all this while, saying that the battle in which he was disfigured had been so glorious, in truth, he naturally hated Lu Qi in his heart. Who would want a handsome face to become so hideous? However, he had previously known that he and Lu Qi were from two completely different worlds, and there was not the slightest possibility that he could get his revenge, so he could only suppress his fury at the bottom of his heart.
But now that the opportunity had come, he resolutely grabbed it, and it had become the last straw that broke the camel’s back.
He looked at Lu Qi, completely unconcerned about the murderous look in his eyes, and felt a kind of pleasure from revenge.

Lu Qi was truly filled with grief. He was one of the top five prodigies in the Cauldron Forging Tier in the North Heavenly Realm. However, he hadn’t even completed the first stage, and he would already be giving up?
But if he didn’t give up, how could it be that he would lose his life here?
Lu Qi was also a resolute person. He stared at Ling Han and said, “I’ll remember this!”
He crushed the token, and instantly, a ray of light wrapped around him, disappearing in a flash.
He was gone.
-He had been teleported out of the Mystery Realm.
Unfortunately, he had not managed to kill him.

Ling Han sighed upon seeing this. However, this didn’t matter. He had ruined a great opportunity for Lu Qi this time, so he would let him stew in his depression for a while. When he left this place in the future, he would just kill him.
Everyone looked at Ling Han with reverence.
This was a fair battle. In fact, Ling Han and the ice tiger had battled for a longer time, and Lu Qi was outmatched. There was no excuse at all.

Of course, if Li Zisuan had not interfered, and there was someone who could help Lu Qi, the situation would definitely be different. At the very least, it would not be difficult for him to act as cover for Lu Qi’s retreat.
However, it was too late to talk about this now. The result was that Ling Han was still here, and Lu Qi had already been sent out of the Mystery Realm.
“Let’s go.”
Everyone continued onwards, and very soon, the matter of Lu Qi had been pushed to the back of their minds. Everyone was naturally concerned about themselves.
Behind the ice valley was the Weapon Mountains.

This was a mountain range that was filled with weapons, and after crossing this mountain range, one would be able to enter into the true White Lotus Mystery Realm, and seek out the heaven-defying great fortune.
Everyone began to climb the mountain. This naturally wasn’t difficult. Although there was a super gravity field here that prevented flight, climbing the mountain was naturally no problem at all.
Weng, right at this moment, everyone felt the mountain tremble slightly, and then all the weapons were shaking.
This time, everyone did not dare move, and looked guarded.
In this Mystery Realm, where was it safe?
Xiu, a broken sword suddenly broke away from the mountain, and slashed towards the person beside it.
What, a weapon that had no one controlling it could still kill on its own?
That person hurriedly brandished his weapon to parry. With a ding, he was instantly sent backwards. At first, his face was flushed red, which quickly turned pale.
Xiu, even more weapons left the mountain, and began a massacre.
At this moment, everyone could barely take care of themselves.
“Don’t panic. Everyone, stand together,” Li Zisuan said loudly. By now, he was getting more and more accustomed to his new role.
Everyone approached each other. In this way, only those in the outermost circle needed to battle, while the others could rest, and then take their turns.
They advanced slowly. These weapons seemed to want to throw them off the mountain, making every step forward extremely difficult for them.

Ling Han walked in front. He didn’t need to go all out. These weapons didn’t pose much of a threat to him, and what interested him was the formations here. They could actually control weapons to kill.

Oh, that’s right. The ice tiger from before was indeed not a fierce beast, but rather a mechanical beast that had been constructed from formations. However, it was too life-like, and no flaw could be seen from its appearance at all. In fact, it had flesh and blood. Everyone slowly advanced. Originally, these people were all proud prodigies, so they were naturally unruly and intractable, but now under the leadership of Li Zisuan, they had all united and faced the difficulties together.

This stage was not too difficult. Half a day later, they finally walked out of this area. Ahead of them, there was a massive plain. The grass was light, and just barely reached the instep of their feet.
Finally, they had entered the second stage of the White Lotus Mystery Realm.
Everyone was overjoyed. This meant that an astonishing opportunity could appear at any time, allowing their strength to increase several times in an instant.
“Thank you for taking care of me all the way, Brother Li. However, now that we’re here, it’s time for us to part ways.”
“Brother Li, the green mountains never change, and the waters flow forever. We’ll meet again
in the future.”
“Brother Li, farewell.”
Everyone left one after another. If they stayed together, who would the fateful opportunity that appeared belong to? Who would be able to compete with Li Zisuan?
Li Zisuan also breathed a sigh of relief. He was really afraid that he would reach a point that he could not resolve in future because of his boasting.
Thus, everyone could be considered to have broken up peacefully.
“Brother Ling, you’re leaving too?” Li Zisuan saw that Ling Han was also walking forwards,
and couldn’t help but speak up.
Ling Han smiled, “What is it? Do you still want me to continue being your lackey?”
“I wouldn’t dare! I wouldn’t dare!” Li Zisuan hurriedly smiled apologetically. This person was
the real fierce one, who had sent Lu Qi out of the Mystery Realm.
At first, he had wanted to bask in Ling Han’s glory again, but when he thought about it, it was indeed embarrassing enough.
“Brother Ling, I’ll remember your kindness. I’ll definitely repay you in the future,” he said
seriously.
Ling Han nodded, and said, “All right.”
Who knows, Li Zisuan might surprise him in the future.
Ling Han smiled, and strode off.
After walking for a short while, Ling Han discovered that this place was brimming with life.
There were herds of cows, goats, and deer grazing, as well as lions, panthers, and wild dogs hunting here. Goshawks flew by in the skies, also looking for prey.
After walking for a while, a village appeared ahead of him.
Yi?

Ling Han strode over, and saw that a wall made of wood had been built outside the village, and there were also a great many sharpened pieces of wood stabbed into the wall. This should be used to resist the invasion of wild beasts.
When Ling Han came closer, he saw multiple people emerge above the wall. They were all holding bows and arrows, aimed straight at him.
Ling Han smiled, raised his hands, and said, “I have no malicious intent.”

“Who are you, and where have you come from?” someone asked. This was an old man, and only he did not wield a bow and arrow. Instead, he was holding onto a walking stick. Ling Han was just about to speak, yet he suddenly paused and turned around to look behind
him.
In a short while, a large group of wild dogs came in a pack, and there were at least over a hundred of them.
This kind of scale was very frightening. Probably, any lion that was left alone would have to turn around and run when it saw them, and only a pride of lions could stand against them.
“Not good, the wild dogs are here!”
“Prepare for defense!”
The people in this village appeared very nervous, as if a great calamity was about to bef
them.
The herd of wild dogs had already rushed over, and targeted Ling Han at the first instant.
He was really too conspicuous.

chapters.title: Chapter 3875: Lightning High Priest
paragraphs: Over a hundred wild dogs rushed forwards, all of them baring their teeth, drooling, appearing very malevolent.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and an aura swept out. Pa, pa, pa! Over a hundred wild dogs all collapsed.
What, it was settled?
The people on the wall all looked stunned, finding it hard to believe.
This was too shocking. The wild dogs that were like demons in their eyes actually collapsed all
at once.
What had happened?
They looked at Ling Han. Though they did not know exactly what had happened, no matter how they thought about it, it must be related to this man.
Someone mustered up the courage to come out, and circled around the herd of wild dogs. Then, they became even more stunned.
“They’re all dead,” he said.
It wasn’t long before the villagers all rushed over and surrounded Ling Han. It was as if they were looking at a god.
“Lord!” These villagers all fell to their knees, “How could it be that you are the Priest from Karish?”
What the hell?
Ling Han pretended to be profound. With a wave of his hand, he led the way into the village.
Everyone hurriedly followed, falling behind by three to four positions, appearing to be extremely reverent.
After entering the village, Ling Han discovered that there was a flight of steps on the inside of the wall. These people were standing on the steps just now.

However, everything was too primitive. Previously, the wild dogs were not vicious beasts, but rather wild beasts that could not be any more ordinary. Furthermore, not one of the villagers here was a cultivator, so they could not even defeat ordinary wild dogs.
Ling Han began to probe for information, and soon found out what he needed to know.
The villagers here had lived here for generations, and their main livelihood was hunting and rearing livestock, and their greatest enemy was the carnivores on the grassland.

There were many other villages like theirs on this large grassy plain, but there were territories demarcated among them. Unless they encountered an especially great calamity, they would not enter into each other’s territory.
Every once in a while, they would go to Karish to trade for some salt and medicine.

Karish, a town. There was a powerful Priest there, who could stimulate the lightning in the skies to execute evil people. It was also because of this that Karish had also developed from a small village into a small town, a trading platform for exchanging resources for various villages. It was also the Holy Land in the hearts of all the villagers.
To the villagers, if they could migrate to Karish, they would not have to live in fear every day, because with a large-scale invasion of wild beasts, it was possible that their homes would be gone.
A thought suddenly flashed in Ling Han’s head. To stimulate the lightning in the skies to kill? Was that a cultivator?
After he understood the situation in more detail, he set out towards Karish.
In a mere two hours, Ling Han arrived at the Holy Land in the hearts of the people of this grassy plain.
The structures were built next to the water, forming a small town. It was really not very big, and looked to contain only a few hundred households.

However, compared to the village, this place could already be considered a large place. Ling Han had already changed into the attire of a villager from the plains. He quietly blended in, planning to first test out the strength of that High Priest, not wanting to alert him.

That high priest was respectfully addressed as the Lightning High Priest. His real name could not be distinguished. It had been almost twenty years since he had become the High Priest, and he was living in the most luxurious manor in the town.
Of course, this mansion was only in relative terms. In this place, it could be called a mansion, but in the outside world, it could only be considered ordinary.
He released his divine sense and scanned the mansion.
Yi, he did not discover any cultivators. Everyone’s life force was very weak, as if they were ordinary people.
Could it be that the High Priest was not here?
Or could it be that the other was too strong, that he could not sense him at all?
Ling Han thought for a moment, then decided to be more cautious. He took out the Void Beast
hide and put it on, concealing his figure. Then, he snuck into the mansion.
He soon discovered a middle-aged man who was almost fifty years old. He had a big belly,
and he was dressed in colorful clothes, appearing extremely exaggerated.
In the manor, everyone was incredibly respectful towards this middle-aged man. In fact, they were extremely reverent towards him.
Yi, could it be that he was the Lightning High Priest?
Ling Han activated his eye technique to take a closer look. This was clearly a mortal.
How could a mortal stimulate lightning to kill?
Ling Han put away the Void Beast hide, and strode towards the middle-aged man.
“Who are you?”
“How did you get in?”
There were many servants here, and when they saw Ling Han suddenly appear, they were all shocked, and began to question him. However, though they were shocked, not one of them
was afraid.
That was because their Master was the Lightning High Priest, and was the representative of the gods in this world.
“So you are the Lightning High Priest?” Ling Han looked at the middle-aged man.
“Since you know who I am, hurry up and kneel!” the middle-aged man shouted, a hint of displeasure on his face.
Yi, this guy was really the Lightning High Priest?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “What right does a mere mortal have to be called an envoy of gods?”
The middle-aged man was furious, and pointed a finger at Ling Han. Zi, instantly, a bolt of lightning shot out, like a divine light, blasting towards Ling Han.
Interesting.
Ling Han stretched out a hand to grab it, and this bolt of lightning fell into his hand. After flickering for a while, it completely lost its lustre.
Pu!
The middle-aged man looked as if he had seen a ghost. How was this possible?
The surefire lightning was actually grabbed in someone’s hand, and the other party was
completely unscathed!

Ling Han was also curious, and said, “You’re only a mortal, yet you’re able to unleash Cauldron Forging Tier-level lightning energy. It’s clear that you possess a precious tool. However, what kind of Spirit Tool can actually be controlled by a mortal?”
The middle-aged man didn’t completely understand Ling Han’s words, but he knew what he meant. Ling Han had seen through him.
He couldn’t help but touch the ring on his finger, then pointed at Ling Han, “Those who disrespect the gods, I shall sentence you to extreme punishment!”
Zi, another bolt of lightning struck over.
Ling Han casually grabbed it, and extinguished the lightning again.
He strode forward, closing in on the middle-aged man.
This time, to say nothing of the middle-aged man, all the servants were also shocked beyond
belief.
Was this a demon that walked on the mortal plane? Otherwise, how could it be that even the envoy of the gods and the Lightning High Priest could do nothing against him?
The middle-aged man pointed repeatedly at Ling Han. One after another, bolts of lightning shot out, but their might was getting weaker and weaker.
Ling Han walked over and grabbed the middle-aged man in a single move. Then, he removedree
the ring.
However, this ring was very ordinary.
With a thought from Ling Han, he opened the ornamental bead on the ring, and saw that there
was a stone the size of a grain of rice inside. It was completely dark blue in colour, and was entwined with the light of lightning.
Zi, the power of lightning struck over, causing Ling Han’s palm to go numb. He almost couldn’t hold this small rock.
However, after he activated the Starlight Screen, the power of lightning couldn’t affect him
anymore.
It was this thing that allowed the middle-aged man to unleash the power of lightning.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Come, explain this to me.”

Furthermore, not one of the villagers here was a cultivator, so they could not even defeat ordinary wild dogs.
Ling Han began to probe for information, and soon found out what he needed to know.
The villagers here had lived here for generations, and their main livelihood was hunting and rearing livestock, and their greatest enemy was the carnivores on the grassland.
There were many other villages like theirs on this large grassy plain, but there were territories demarcated among them.
Unless they encountered an especially great calamity, they would not enter into each other’s territory.
Every once in a while, they would go to Karish to trade for some salt and medicine.
Karish, a town.
There was a powerful Priest there, who could stimulate the lightning in the skies to execute evil people.
It was also because of this that Karish had also developed from a small village into a small town, a trading platform for exchanging resources for various villages.
It was also the Holy Land in the hearts of all the villagers.
To the villagers, if they could migrate to Karish, they would not have to live in fear every day, because with a large-scale invasion of wild beasts, it was possible that their homes would be gone.
A thought suddenly flashed in Ling Han’s head.
To stimulate the lightning in the skies to kill?
Was that a cultivator?
After he understood the situation in more detail, he set out towards Karish.
In a mere two hours, Ling Han arrived at the Holy Land in the hearts of the people of this grassy plain.
The structures were built next to the water, forming a small town.
It was really not very big, and looked to contain only a few hundred households.
However, compared to the village, this place could already be considered a large place.
Ling Han had already changed into the attire of a villager from the plains.
He quietly blended in, planning to first test out the strength of that High Priest, not wanting to alert him.
That high priest was respectfully addressed as the Lightning High Priest.
His real name could not be distinguished.
It had been almost twenty years since he had become the High Priest, and he was living in the most luxurious manor in the town.
Of course, this mansion was only in relative terms.
In this place, it could be called a mansion, but in the outside world, it could only be considered ordinary.
He released his divine sense and scanned the mansion.
Yi, he did not discover any cultivators.
Everyone’s life force was very weak, as if they were ordinary people.
Could it be that the High Priest was not here?
Or could it be that the other was too strong, that he could not sense him at all?
Ling Han thought for a moment, then decided to be more cautious.
He took out the Void Beast
hide and put it on, concealing his figure.
Then, he snuck into the mansion.
He soon discovered a middle-aged man who was almost fifty years old.
He had a big belly,
and he was dressed in colorful clothes, appearing extremely exaggerated.
In the manor, everyone was incredibly respectful towards this middle-aged man.
In fact, they were extremely reverent towards him.
Yi, could it be that he was the Lightning High Priest?
Ling Han activated his eye technique to take a closer look.
This was clearly a mortal.
How could a mortal stimulate lightning to kill?
Ling Han put away the Void Beast hide, and strode towards the middle-aged man.
“Who are you?”
“How did you get in?”
There were many servants here, and when they saw Ling Han suddenly appear, they were all shocked, and began to question him.
However, though they were shocked, not one of them
was afraid.
That was because their Master was the Lightning High Priest, and was the representative of the gods in this world.
“So you are the Lightning High Priest?” Ling Han looked at the middle-aged man.
“Since you know who I am, hurry up and kneel!” the middle-aged man shouted, a hint of displeasure on his face.
Yi, this guy was really the Lightning High Priest?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “What right does a mere mortal have to be called an envoy of gods?”
The middle-aged man was furious, and pointed a finger at Ling Han.
Zi, instantly, a bolt of lightning shot out, like a divine light, blasting towards Ling Han.
Interesting.
Ling Han stretched out a hand to grab it, and this bolt of lightning fell into his hand.
After flickering for a while, it completely lost its lustre.
Pu!
The middle-aged man looked as if he had seen a ghost.
How was this possible?
The surefire lightning was actually grabbed in someone’s hand, and the other party was
completely unscathed!
Ling Han was also curious, and said, “You’re only a mortal, yet you’re able to unleash Cauldron Forging Tier-level lightning energy.
It’s clear that you possess a precious tool.
However, what kind of Spirit Tool can actually be controlled by a mortal?”
The middle-aged man didn’t completely understand Ling Han’s words, but he knew what he meant.
Ling Han had seen through him.
He couldn’t help but touch the ring on his finger, then pointed at Ling Han, “Those who disrespect the gods, I shall sentence you to extreme punishment!”
Zi, another bolt of lightning struck over.
Ling Han casually grabbed it, and extinguished the lightning again.
He strode forward, closing in on the middle-aged man.
This time, to say nothing of the middle-aged man, all the servants were also shocked beyond
belief.
Was this a demon that walked on the mortal plane?
Otherwise, how could it be that even the envoy of the gods and the Lightning High Priest could do nothing against him?
The middle-aged man pointed repeatedly at Ling Han.
One after another, bolts of lightning shot out, but their might was getting weaker and weaker.
Ling Han walked over and grabbed the middle-aged man in a single move.
Then, he removedree
the ring.
However, this ring was very ordinary.
With a thought from Ling Han, he opened the ornamental bead on the ring, and saw that there
was a stone the size of a grain of rice inside.
It was completely dark blue in colour, and was entwined with the light of lightning.
Zi, the power of lightning struck over, causing Ling Han’s palm to go numb.
He almost couldn’t hold this small rock.
However, after he activated the Starlight Screen, the power of lightning couldn’t affect him
anymore.
It was this thing that allowed the middle-aged man to unleash the power of lightning.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Come, explain this to me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3876: Celestial light?
paragraphs: Seeing that Ling Han could hold that peculiar stone in his hand, the so-called Lightning High Priest was already dumbfounded, astounded.
He knew that he was an imposter, but Ling Han’s performance completely matched the characteristics of a god.
He hurriedly said, “Exalted Immortal, I’ll tell you everything you want to know.”
As expected, he revealed all his secrets without reservations.

More than 20 years ago, he was still an ordinary villager, living the same life as the others. However, he was a very ambitious person, and was unwilling to accept this kind of mediocre lifestyle. Thus, he left the village, wanting to take a look at the end of the great grassy plain.

He walked out of the grassy plains and arrived at a valley. At night, he inadvertently saw the flicker of lightning. Driven by curiosity, he went over to check on the situation, and discovered that there were presently a great many people mining.

According to him, these people were all strong men. With a single hoe, they could forcefully peel off the mountain rock, and he had tried later. Even if he tried his best, he would still need half a day to dig off a corner.
He didn’t dare to move recklessly, and simply watched.
These people dug out the stones, loaded them onto carts, and pulled away one cart after another.
After dawn, he followed the tracks of those carts, and he discovered a rock that was imbued with the power of lightning.
This should have fallen off the cart, and was slightly smaller than a fist.

He unexpectedly discovered that there was a kind of thick leaf that could block the power of lightning. Thus, he wrapped this leaf around the rock. After a long period of study, he discovered that the power of lightning in this rock could be guided out through a special method. Hence, he knocked out a small bit and stored it in a ring.
Thus, in a transformation, he had become the Lightning High Priest, and could use the power of lightning to kill.
Ling Han was astonished. A lightning-aligned ore?
Was there such a thing?
He believed that this person had not lied. Thus, the Lightning Stone should be a specialty of this place.

Ling Han carefully examined the Lightning Stone. Because it had already been used for more than 20 years, the stone that was the size of a fist at that time was now less than the size of a finger the power of lightning was not endless.
He couldn’t help but think that if someone could stimulate all the power of lightning in here all at once, the might would probably be able to reach Four Cauldrons, Five Cauldrons or even stronger.
And this was only the size of a finger. What if it was the size of a human head, or even the size of a mountain?
If they were hit, then would even a True Self Tier collapse?
The miners that this “Lightning High Priest” had seen should be cultivators. Thus, it was not that there were no cultivators here, but the people here had not embarked on the path of cultivation.
Ling Han questioned the High Priest in detail, then set out.

At that time, the Lightning High Priest had walked for a whole half year’s time, but Ling Han had only run for over an hour, and he had already walked out of the grassy plains. A continuous stretch of green mountains appeared ahead of him.

So many years had passed, and the memories of the Lightning High Priest definitely had a certain degree of error. Thus, Ling Han was not in a rush either. He began to run in the mountains, searching for the location of that mine.
It shouldn’t be difficult to find, because the traces of mining were very obvious.
Half an hour later, Ling Han saw people digging rocks in the distance.
These people... were all only at the mortal level.
Ling Han did not go over. He began to study the stones here.

Indeed, this whole mountain was filled with the power of lightning. If he could guide it according to power of heaven and earth, then constructing a killing formation of lightning would not be difficult. It would not be difficult to kill even a Core Formation Tier.
Ling Han dug out a few rocks to examine, and saw that though every rock carried the power of lightning, there was a difference in strength.

If it was weaker, it would probably take half a day, and the power of lightning would disappear completely. However, even the stronger stones were not as strong as the piece that the Lightning High Priest had obtained. Looks like that guy had really gotten lucky. Coincidentally, a high quality lightning-aligned ore had fallen, and he had picked it up.
How had these lightning-aligned ores been formed?
Ling Han was filled with curiosity. He began to dig a hole, heading towards the center of the mountain.
It was very easy to judge where the power of lightning was strongest, and where the core was.
He was too powerful, forcibly digging out a passage, and storing the stones he dug into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
He could not store them into a Spatial Spirit Tool. At the beginning, Ling Han had indeed done so, but the power of lightning immediately penetrated the Spatial Spirit Tool.
Yi, could this kind of ore be used as an energy source for the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, allowing the Imperial Weapon to explode with even greater might?

With this thought, Ling Han immediately wanted to carry out an experiment, but he hurriedly suppressed the urge. If he were to experiment here, it was possible that he would be buried alive, or even alert those miners.
The miners, on the other hand, did not take Ling Han to heart. More importantly, what level was the force behind them?
Ling Han continued to advance. He continued to venture deeper, but this vein of ore was astonishingly huge. Furthermore, it even guided Ling Han underground.
The source of the power of lightning came from underground?
Ling Han continued downwards. A whole two days had passed, and he had already penetrated more than 50km deep into the ground.
This was an ore layer, after all, and with the power of lightning wreaking havoc, Ling Han’s speed was naturally greatly affected.
Yi?
When Ling Han advanced a few more feet, his whole person suddenly dropped down.
He had actually entered into an underground river, and what was running in the underground
river was blazing white lightning.

Ling Han was shocked, and hurriedly used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to expel streaks of Primal Chaos Qi. This power of lightning was too terrifying. At least, it was on the level of Core Formation Tier.
Zi!

Lightning flashed madly. Even with the protection of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, Ling Han’s skin was still charred and crisp from the lightning. He hurriedly leaped back into the tunnel from before.
With this one move, half of his body was charred black, exuding waves of meaty fragrance.
F***, he had almost been screwed over.
Ling Han stuck his head out of the hole, and observed this underground lightning river.
He would go upstream.
He immediately came to a decision, and put it into action.
Every time he advanced, he would dig through the rocks to see if the lightning river was
below. Just like that, Ling Han slowly dug forward. In the blink of an eye, five days had passed.
Five days later, he looked downwards as usual. Yi, he actually saw the end.
The source of the lightning river... was actually a streak of light!
A ray of light turned into a lightning river, and the lightning river affected the entire mountain, causing the rocks to be tainted with the power of lightning, turning into
lightning-aligned ores?
Hiss, this light was too powerful, wasn’t it?
Hold on.
Ling Han’s heart suddenly thumped against his chest. Could it be that this was the legendary
celestial light?
If this thing could be fused into the Celestial Cauldron, then with a strike, what would not be
severed?
But the problem was, with such terrifying celestial light – if this was really celestial light, how could it be stored into the Celestial Cauldron?
Merely the lightning river it manifested was already so terrifying, so how powerful would its
own destructive power be?
Even if he could absorb it into his body, wouldn’t that be like inviting a wolf into his house
and instantly killing him?
What should he do?
Should he take it or not?
If he was going to retrieve it, how could he do so?

chapters.title: Chapter 3877: Refining the Light of Lightning
paragraphs: Regardless of whether that streak of light was a celestial light or not, Ling Han was determined to get to the bottom of this.
He dug forward for a while longer, and just happened to be right above that streak of light.
In this place, he could sense the powerful power of lightning. Though there was still a distance between them, it caused even his soul to tremble, as if it was about to be shattered.
The power of lightning was indeed extraordinary.
Putting aside the question of whether he could refine it or not, the first question was, how was he supposed to retrieve it?
This thing was probably something that even Core Formation Tier elites didn’t dare to come into contact with, so how was he supposed to retrieve it?
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower!
This was Origin Gold, and it could even contain the Heavenly Dao Flames that could burn Saints to death. So, why couldn’t it absorb this light of lightning?
Ling Han unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, which enshrouded towards the light of lightning.
Unexpectedly, the reaction speed of that light was astonishingly fast. Shua, in a flash, it had left, following the couse of the lightning river, and there was no sign of it.
F***, was there any need to be so fast?

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel gloomy. He wasn’t even given a chance to make an attempt. Shua, a flash of light streaked past, and a scene that surprised Ling Han appeared. That flash of lightning actually ran back on its own, and even circled around the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. It was like a child that had encountered a playmate, appearing to be very excited.
Ling Han faltered for a moment before coming to a realization.

This was the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, which had been nurtured in Primal Chaos and then baptized in the pool of lightning of heaven and earth. Thus, it had two elements, and from a certain aspect, it was a pool of lightning.
Thus, the light of lightning naturally felt an affinity towards it.
This was a good opportunity.
Ling Han controlled the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and in a flash, absorbed this light.
Success!

A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face as he hurriedly retrieved the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. This was a wisp of his divine sense, and it was his personal Spirit Tool. Thus, he could naturally store it into his mind.
Now, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was floating in his mind, and what Ling Han needed to consider was how to refine this light of lightning.
He was 99% sure that this was the legendary celestial light, but how to refine it was a big problem.

If it was directly unleashed, he would probably be instantly corroded from the inside out. No matter how strong he was, he would not be able to match a barrage of attacks of Core Formation Tier, what more when the might of this light had perhaps reached the peak stage of Core Formation Tier.
What should he do?
Ling Han thought for a long time, and decided to use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to erase the air of violence in the light of lightning, leaving only the core.

This naturally decreased the might of the light of lightning greatly, but on the other hand, if Ling Han could completely grasp the core, as he grew, the light of lightning would return to its previous strength, or even become even stronger.
Fine, let’s do that.
Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position and used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to grind away at the light of lightning, so that it would disintegrate and he could analyze the core.

He could clearly sense that the might of this light was decreasing, but it itself was becoming purer. After an unknown amount of time, Ling Han discovered that the light of lightning had already turned from blazing white to brilliant blue. Furthermore, it was no longer light, but rather seals that were continuously evolving.
This was the core of the light of lightning, the essence.

Ling Han released the light of lightning from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. He then opened a Celestial Cauldron and absorbed the light of lightning into it to nurture it. The light of lightning appeared extremely obedient, and also seemed to like the Celestial Cauldron very much. When it swam in the cauldron, it was like a fish.
Ling Han couldn’t help but be filled with anticipation. He had now captured a streak of celestial light, so what kind of attack could he deliver?

He hurriedly returned to the ground, and with a wave of his hand, the Celestial Cauldron stimulated the light of lightning. Pa, pa, pa! A bolt of lightning immediately shot out from his palm, striking the mountain opposite him, directly blasting out a cave that was 300 meters deep.
Hiss, that was awesome.
Ling Han switched to an ordinary fist technique. Boom, with a punch, the mountain trembled, but only a hole that was about three meters deep was created.
The gap was so wide?

Ling Han switched to using the Three Styles Styles of the God of War. He delivered three palm strikes, and a deep hole appeared on the mountain, measuring about 210 meters in depth. Hiss, even the Three Styles of the God of War was no match for the light of lightning!
Ling Han switched to using the Demonic Monkey Fists again. This time, there was another three hundred meter deep hole in the mountain.
Awesome, the light of lightning was actually capable of matching the Imperial Technique.
Ling Han was stunned. If the light of lightning possessed endless growth, then this would be equivalent to an Imperial Technique in the future.
“And this is only refining a streak of celestial light.”
“Theoretically speaking, a Celestial Cauldron would be able to absorb one streak of celestial light. Then wouldn’t the limit be nine streaks?”
“Hiss, nine flashes of divine light striking at the same time, what kind of destructive power is
that?”

Even with Ling Han’s strong willpower, his heart still beat faster. That would be equivalent to having nine Imperial Techniques attack at the same time. Then let’s ask, who in this world could match the combined attacks of nine young Great Emperors of the same cultivation level?
He immediately made up his mind. He would definitely gather all nine streaks of celestial light here, and cultivate a supreme Mystical Power.
“Who goes there!”
“To dare make noise here, don’t you know that this is an important place of the Zhou Clan?”
“Brat, tell me your name.”
Right at this moment, a team of soldiers rushed over, all of them aiming their spears at Ling Han.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over them, and couldn’t help but feel surprised. That was because these people were all Foundation Building Tiers, but they were too young. They were all only
in their twenties.
This world was so terrifying, and such young Foundation Building Tiers could only be guards?
It should be known that if one could set foot on the Celestial Path in his twenties, he would at least be worthy of the title of prodigy.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “I just happened to pass by, so I don’t know where this is. May I ask where the Zhou Clan is? Please allow me to pay my respects.”
“Enough with the nonsense. The fact that he dares to appear in the mine is most likely
because he wants to steal the Lightning Stone.”
“Capture him!”
This group of soldiers all shouted. Xiu, several flashes of lightning shot out from the tip of
their spears, blasting towards Ling Han.
So fast.

Ling Han was completely unguarded, and was actually struck by these few flashes of lightning. However, the power of lightning had just entered his body, and it was as if the light of lightning in the Celestial Cauldron had come to life. It immediately showed its might, and with a zi, absorbed all the power of lightning.
F***, he almost met with an unexpected failure.
Ling Han secretly reflected on himself. He had been too careless, and thought that these

people were all Foundation Building Tiers, and could not possibly pose a threat to him, so he was completely unguarded. However, he had never imagined that the Spirit Tool in their hands was extremely powerful, and the lightning they shot out was astonishingly fast. Probably 99% of Cauldron Forging Tier elites would be hit.
If he didn’t want to be hit, he could only maintain his high-speed movement and not be locked down by the soldiers.
Thankfully, the fact that these people’s spears could shoot out the light of lightning should
be because they used lightning-aligned ores as their energy source, and what was the light of
lightning in his Celestial Cauldron?
The source of all the lightning energy.
Thus, when these attacks landed on Ling Han, they were naturally like clay ox sinking into the
sea, completely ineffective.
This did not mean that Ling Han was immune to all lightning attacks, but at least in this
place, no Lightning Element Tool would be able to threaten him.
“Pu!”
“What!”
However, the soldiers didn’t know this, and when they saw that Ling Han was completely
unscathed even after facing the barrage of lightning, they couldn’t help but gape in shock. They were astounded to the extreme.

Shua, in a flash, it had left, following the couse of the lightning river, and there was no sign of it.
F***, was there any need to be so fast?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel gloomy.
He wasn’t even given a chance to make an attempt.
Shua, a flash of light streaked past, and a scene that surprised Ling Han appeared.
That flash of lightning actually ran back on its own, and even circled around the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
It was like a child that had encountered a playmate, appearing to be very excited.
Ling Han faltered for a moment before coming to a realization.
This was the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, which had been nurtured in Primal Chaos and then baptized in the pool of lightning of heaven and earth.
Thus, it had two elements, and from a certain aspect, it was a pool of lightning.
Thus, the light of lightning naturally felt an affinity towards it.
This was a good opportunity.
Ling Han controlled the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and in a flash, absorbed this light.
Success!
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face as he hurriedly retrieved the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
This was a wisp of his divine sense, and it was his personal Spirit Tool.
Thus, he could naturally store it into his mind.
Now, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was floating in his mind, and what Ling Han needed to consider was how to refine this light of lightning.
He was 99% sure that this was the legendary celestial light, but how to refine it was a big problem.
If it was directly unleashed, he would probably be instantly corroded from the inside out.

No matter how strong he was, he would not be able to match a barrage of attacks of Core Formation Tier, what more when the might of this light had perhaps reached the peak stage of Core Formation Tier.
What should he do?
Ling Han thought for a long time, and decided to use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to erase the air of violence in the light of lightning, leaving only the core.

This naturally decreased the might of the light of lightning greatly, but on the other hand, if Ling Han could completely grasp the core, as he grew, the light of lightning would return to its previous strength, or even become even stronger.
Fine, let’s do that.
Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position and used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to grind away at the light of lightning, so that it would disintegrate and he could analyze the core.
He could clearly sense that the might of this light was decreasing, but it itself was becoming purer.
After an unknown amount of time, Ling Han discovered that the light of lightning had already turned from blazing white to brilliant blue.
Furthermore, it was no longer light, but rather seals that were continuously evolving.
This was the core of the light of lightning, the essence.
Ling Han released the light of lightning from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
He then opened a Celestial Cauldron and absorbed the light of lightning into it to nurture it.
The light of lightning appeared extremely obedient, and also seemed to like the Celestial Cauldron very much.
When it swam in the cauldron, it was like a fish.
Ling Han couldn’t help but be filled with anticipation.
He had now captured a streak of celestial light, so what kind of attack could he deliver?
He hurriedly returned to the ground, and with a wave of his hand, the Celestial Cauldron stimulated the light of lightning.
Pa, pa, pa!
A bolt of lightning immediately shot out from his palm, striking the mountain opposite him, directly blasting out a cave that was 300 meters deep.
Hiss, that was awesome.
Ling Han switched to an ordinary fist technique.
Boom, with a punch, the mountain trembled, but only a hole that was about three meters deep was created.
The gap was so wide?
Ling Han switched to using the Three Styles Styles of the God of War.
He delivered three palm strikes, and a deep hole appeared on the mountain, measuring about 210 meters in depth.
Hiss, even the Three Styles of the God of War was no match for the light of lightning!
Ling Han switched to using the Demonic Monkey Fists again.
This time, there was another three hundred meter deep hole in the mountain.
Awesome, the light of lightning was actually capable of matching the Imperial Technique.
Ling Han was stunned.
If the light of lightning possessed endless growth, then this would be equivalent to an Imperial Technique in the future.
“And this is only refining a streak of celestial light.”
“Theoretically speaking, a Celestial Cauldron would be able to absorb one streak of celestial light.
Then wouldn’t the limit be nine streaks?”
“Hiss, nine flashes of divine light striking at the same time, what kind of destructive power is
that?”
Even with Ling Han’s strong willpower, his heart still beat faster.
That would be equivalent to having nine Imperial Techniques attack at the same time.
Then let’s ask, who in this world could match the combined attacks of nine young Great Emperors of the same cultivation level?
He immediately made up his mind.
He would definitely gather all nine streaks of celestial light here, and cultivate a supreme Mystical Power.
“Who goes there!”
“To dare make noise here, don’t you know that this is an important place of the Zhou Clan?”
“Brat, tell me your name.”
Right at this moment, a team of soldiers rushed over, all of them aiming their spears at Ling Han.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over them, and couldn’t help but feel surprised.
That was because these people were all Foundation Building Tiers, but they were too young.
They were all only
in their twenties.
This world was so terrifying, and such young Foundation Building Tiers could only be guards?
It should be known that if one could set foot on the Celestial Path in his twenties, he would at least be worthy of the title of prodigy.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “I just happened to pass by, so I don’t know where this is.
May I ask where the Zhou Clan is?
Please allow me to pay my respects.”
“Enough with the nonsense.
The fact that he dares to appear in the mine is most likely
because he wants to steal the Lightning Stone.”
“Capture him!”
This group of soldiers all shouted.
Xiu, several flashes of lightning shot out from the tip of
their spears, blasting towards Ling Han.
So fast.
Ling Han was completely unguarded, and was actually struck by these few flashes of lightning.
However, the power of lightning had just entered his body, and it was as if the light of lightning in the Celestial Cauldron had come to life.
It immediately showed its might, and with a zi, absorbed all the power of lightning.
F***, he almost met with an unexpected failure.
Ling Han secretly reflected on himself.
He had been too careless, and thought that these
people were all Foundation Building Tiers, and could not possibly pose a threat to him, so he was completely unguarded.
However, he had never imagined that the Spirit Tool in their hands was extremely powerful, and the lightning they shot out was astonishingly fast.
Probably 99% of Cauldron Forging Tier elites would be hit.
If he didn’t want to be hit, he could only maintain his high-speed movement and not be locked down by the soldiers.
Thankfully, the fact that these people’s spears could shoot out the light of lightning should
be because they used lightning-aligned ores as their energy source, and what was the light of
lightning in his Celestial Cauldron?
The source of all the lightning energy.
Thus, when these attacks landed on Ling Han, they were naturally like clay ox sinking into the
sea, completely ineffective.
This did not mean that Ling Han was immune to all lightning attacks, but at least in this
place, no Lightning Element Tool would be able to threaten him.
“Pu!”
“What!”
However, the soldiers didn’t know this, and when they saw that Ling Han was completely
unscathed even after facing the barrage of lightning, they couldn’t help but gape in shock.
They were astounded to the extreme.

chapters.title: Chapter 3878: Thunder God
paragraphs: “Who exactly are you?” A soldier mustered up the courage to ask.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind. He stood with his hands clasped behind his back, and said calmly, “I am the Thunder God!”
God!
All the soldiers were slightly doubtful. Did Immortals look like this? Why was he not much different from them? But if he was not a god, how could he allow them to attack him without being injured?
“Don’t believe him!” a soldier suddenly said. “Perhaps, he’s wearing an inner vest refined from a rubber tree.”
“En!”
The other soldiers all nodded, and there was no longer any reverence in their eyes as they looked at Ling Han.
Ling Han thought for a moment, and suddenly came to a realization.

The Lightning High Priest had said before that the reason why he had been able to collect the lightning ore was because there was a kind of tree leaf that was actually immune to lightning. Thus, extracting the essence of this kind of tree and forging it into an inner armor would naturally be able to defend against lightning strikes.

Ling Han smiled faintly, and stretched out his hands. With a thought, he stimulated the lightning within the Celestial Cauldron. Instantly, the spears in the hands of those soldiers crackled with lightning.
F***, what was going on?
This time, the soldiers were once again dumbfounded.
If Ling Han was immune to lightning attacks, it was possible that he was wearing a special internal armor. However, being able to remote control the weapons in their hands was definitely a miracle.
They no longer had any doubts. They all put down their weapons, and bowed.
“Greetings, Thunder God!”
“Long live the Thunder God!”
All of them were in fear and trepidation, incredibly reverent.
Ling Han raised his hand, and said, “Rise.”
“Yes, Lord Thunder God!”

“I’ve lived for a long time in the Nine Heavens, and I’ve only just descended to the mortal world. Thus, I’m not familiar with the matters of the mortal world. So, who wants to tell me?” Ling Han casually said.
“Me!”
“Me!”
“Me! Me!”
Those soldiers all scrambled over one another, wanting to perform well in front of the “god”. Who knows, they may be able to live forever.
Ling Han asked questions, and they answered. Those that didn’t manage to seize the opportunity would even supply additional information.
In this area, the Zhou Clan was the ruler.

The Zhou Clan was a Core Formation Tier-level force, and there were as many as four Core Formation Tier grand elders. They mined the Lightning Stones to accumulate power, planning to conquer the Heavenly Clouds Mountain in a single stroke, and expand their force to a farther range.
The Heavenly Clouds Mountain was the territory of wild beasts, which also halted the course of the Zhou Clan’s expansion westward.
Why didn’t they expand east, north, and south?

That was because north and south were boundless seas, with inconceivably powerful wild beasts, as well as terrifyingly harsh weather, and east was a large grassy plain, with few people. Furthermore, there were no precious Celestial medicines, ores, so what was the use of occupying it?

Thus, the Zhou Clan could only accumulate power, and prepare to launch an attack on the Heavenly Clouds Mountain. As long as they could take down this bridgehead, they would be able to expand towards the west.
Ling Han asked a crucial question. These people were so prodigious, but why were they willing to become guards?

However, these people’s answers stunned Ling Han. This was because there were many people here who had reached the Foundation Building Tier in their twenties. They couldn’t be considered prodigies at all.

Even for Cauldron Forging Tier, the fastest would be around thirty years old, while the slowest would be forty years old, those who could reach that level would definitely have reached it. If they couldn’t reach it, then when their life force dried up, it would be even more impossible to reach it.
Hold on!
“Your vitality dried up after forty years old?” Ling Han asked.
“That’s right.” All the soldiers nodded. What was so strange about that?
“Your lifespans... are roughly?” Ling Han asked again.
“Usually seventies. If they maintain themselves well, it will be in the eighties or nineties. There are also some people who can live to a hundred years old.”
“Sigh, there are too few hundred-year-olds.”
“En, it can’t be helped. We cultivate with great exhaustion, and with additional injuries, it
would be good enough if we can live to eighty.”
‘F*ck! Foundation Building cultivators can only live to 70 or 80 years old?’
No, no, no, everyone, including Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators, Core Formation Tier cultivators, could only live for seventy to eighty years?
How was this possible?
Ling Han asked again, but it was still the same. The people of this world cultivated extremely fact, the lifes of those who cultivated in truth was
quickly, but they also died very
usually inferior to that of ordinary people.
It was as if they had expended all of their lifespan on cultivating, and paid the price of sacrificing a great amount of their lifespan to welcome the high speed of cultivation.
Thus, it wouldn’t be strange for a large number of Foundation Building Tier cultivators in their twenties to appear.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. After a moment of silence, he decided to pay a visit to the
Zhou Clan.
He flew on his Tool, and instantly disappeared.
This caused the soldiers to revere him as if he was a god, and they all knelt down. In this place, there was no such thing as flying on a Tool.
Thus, how could one fly unless they were a Heavenly God?
After Ling Han flew over multiple mountain ranges, he descended, and once again travelled on foot. If he used the Imminent Skyline, this was actually even faster than flying on a Tool.
After walking for a while longer, a city appeared ahead of him.
This city was very simple and crude, and there were no city walls either. If it was attacked, it was practically defenseless.

In truth, there was no need to build the city wall either, because this was the territory of the Zhou Clan, and there were no external enemies, so what need was there for the city wall? Ling Han entered the city and casually asked around. He discovered that he wasn’t the first outsider to enter this place. Instead, others had already arrived half a month ago.
The Zhou Clan was very polite towards outsiders, and treated all of them as esteemed guests, receiving them with fine wine and good food.
As a matter of fact, the most outstanding Young Master of the Zhou Clan, Zhou Miyang, was presently entertaining the outsiders that had just arrived at the Celestial Crane Pavilion.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before deciding to head over to take a look.
The Celestial Crane Pavilion was very close. After all, this city was only so big, so Ling Han
quickly arrived.
With a thought, he altered his appearance slightly. Then, using the Soul Awakening Technique, even his soul underwent a slight change. Only then did he walk into the building.
“Milord, are you here to attend Young Master Zhou’s banquet?” A waiter immediately
approached.
Ling Han nodded.
“Then please come with me.” This waiter brought him through the pavilion. The Celestial
Crane Pavilion was definitely not just a single pavilion, but had multiple courtyards that occupied an extremely large area.

After walking for a while, they arrived at a large garden. At this moment, a great many tables had been set up here, and each table was filled with people. Cups of wine exchanged, and the atmosphere was incredibly lively.
Seeing Ling Han appear, everyone looked over. Seeing that he looked unfamiliar, they
withdrew their gazes.
Ling Han also swept an eye over them, feeling slightly disappointed. That was because he had
been thinking whether the empress, Lin Luo, and the others would appear here, but in the
end, there was only one person that he recognized.
-Song Lan.
No matter where this beauty ranked ninth on the Exquisite Leaderboard was, she would be
revered like the moon that was surrounded by stars. It was naturally no exception here, as countless people fought to gain her favour.
And beside her, there sat a handsome man. He was only in his early twenties, exuding a strong
heroic spirit.
Song Lan also cast a second look at Ling Han, because she felt that Ling Han looked very

familiar to her, but upon a closer look, not only was his looks not worthy of being remembered, even his spiritual fluctuations were completely unfamiliar to her. “Celestial maiden Song, what is it?” the man beside her asked, appearing extremely
concerned.
“Nothing.” Song Lan shook his head.
The young man looked towards Ling Han. Shua, his eyes were like blades, piercing painfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 3879: Banquet of the Zhou Clan
paragraphs: This was truly an undeserved calamity.
Ling Han didn’t provoke anyone. In fact, he even changed his appearance and soul fluctuation, but he was still targeted at the first moment.
F***, was he really a man that had developed a halo of trouble?
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t back down. He glared back at the young man.
“Hehe, this newcomer, how should I address you?” the young man asked calmly.
Ling Han crossed his arms over his chest, pretending not to hear.
“Hey, my young master is asking you a question,” one of the servants couldn’t help but shout.
However, Ling Han still ignored him.
“Hehe, how dare you ignore even my words?” This young man already had a sliver of anger in him.
Only then did Ling Han say, “Before asking others, shouldn’t you introduce yourself first?”
A flash of killing intent appeared in the young man’s eyes, but he still suppressed it, and said, “I am Zhou Miyang.”
As expected, this guy was Zhou Miyang.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Han Lin.”

Song Lan’s beautiful eyes lit up. Not only was she astonishingly beautiful, she also had outstanding intelligence. Han Lin was Ling Han in reverse, and she felt that Ling Han gave off a familiar feeling. Thus, she was already somewhat certain that the person in front of her was Ling Han in disguise.

Zhou Miyang’s attention was completely focused on Song Lan. This woman was really too beautiful, causing his heart to throb wildly. The first time he set eyes on her, he had already made up his mind that he would definitely marry her.
Thus, when he discovered that Song Lan was actually paying attention to Ling Han, this naturally caused his jealousy to burn.

“If you want to sit down at this young master’s banquet, you have to first prove that you have that kind of ability,” Zhou Miyang said coldly. He wanted to humiliate Ling Han in public, and try as much as possible to tarnish the latter’s image.
The reason why Ling Han had come here was to see if the empress and the others were here. Since they weren’t here, what was the point of him staying?
He waved his hand, turned and left.
F***, chickened out?

Zhou Miyang’s killing intent blazed. This guy had come in to strut around, and in the end, he wanted to run the moment he flipped out. There was no way he would let him off so easily. He nodded at a large man in black by his side, and the latter immediately understood. “Brat, what kind of place do you think this is? Do you think you can come and go as you please?” The large man in black leaped out, and was already standing in front of Ling Han. “Are you born in the year of the dog?” Ling Han asked.
What was the meaning of this?
The large man in black subconsciously shook his head, “My zo-”
“Since you’re not a dog, why are you blocking the way?” Ling Han interrupted him. ‘F*ck!’
The large man in black faltered for a moment before coming to his senses. Ling Han was playing around with him, calling him a dog.
He flew into a thunderous rage, and with a single step, rushed towards Ling Han. Then, he threw out a punch.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and tapped out a finger.

The large black-robed man’s fist was the size of a clay bowl, and compared with Ling Han’s slender finger, its size was completely disproportionate. Furthermore, the aura of both sides were completely different. This punch from the large black-robed man condensed the endless power of heaven and earth, and his battle prowess was terrifying. Ling Han, on the other hand, was limp and without the slightest bit of force.
Many people had already closed their eyes, unable to bear the sight.
Peng!
There was a loud bang, and a person was already sent flying. Then, there was an endless series of loud bangs. As it turned out, a great many walls had been forcefully crashed through.
Yi?
Everyone could not believe it. The person that had been sent flying was actually not Ling Han, but rather the large man in black.
How was this possible?
Ling Han withdrew his finger. He was also slightly surprised, because this lackey was actually a Four Cauldrons.
Four Cauldrons, and he had become someone’s servant?

This could only appear in this kind of Mystery Realm, where the rapid increase of cultivation level was obtained through overdrafting one’s life force. In fact, one could even reach a height that only super geniuses could reach.

“Good, very good.” Zhou Miyang sat upright and still, but his eyes were cold, his killing intent blazing. “You have come to the territory of the Zhou Clan, and still dare to commit a crime. How impressive!”
This was naturally a sarcastic remark. Shua, a row of soldiers appeared. Though they were all Foundation Building Tier cultivators, all of them held spears in their hands.
Instantly, everyone’s expressions changed slightly.

They had witnessed the might of this spear before, and the attacks that it delivered were extraordinarily fast. There were not many in the Cauldron Forging Tier that could dodge this. Once they were hit, they would be numb to the point of losing all ability to resist, and at worst, they would be directly burnt into charcoal. Naturally, everyone would be wary.

The reason why everyone was willing to attend the banquet was firstly, because they wanted to further understand the situation here, and secondly, because they wanted to know the origins of this spear-type Spirit Tool. If they could bring it out of the Mystery Realm, it could easily help a force become stronger.
Ling Han was completely unconcerned. In fact, he didn’t even activate his movement technique, to stop the soldiers from locking onto him.
“Han Lin, don’t forget yourself in your conceit!” Song Lan spoke up, “There is no great enmity between you, just some minor misunderstandings. There is no need for you to become enemies like this.”

She was afraid that Ling Han would be too arrogant, and completely had no idea of the might of this spear. That was why she had opened her mouth to speak. On the surface, she was rebuking Ling Han, but in truth, she was trying to mediate.
However, Ling Han couldn’t possibly listen to her, and Zhou Miyang definitely wouldn’t let go of a suspected “rival in love”.
Instantly, zi, ten spears shot out blazing white lightning at the same time, incredibly fast.
Ling Han didn’t dodge, and he was instantly hit head-on.
Sigh.
Everyone shook their heads. Wasn’t this just asking for trouble?
They were all very clear that the lightning shot out by this spear was incredibly frightening, and could not be taken lightly just because the person controlling it was a Foundation
Building Tier.
See, he was too arrogant, wasn’t he? This was karma.
Hence, one should not show off too much, or else... f***!
The lightning dissipated, but everyone was shocked to see that Ling Han was still standing there perfectly fine. To say nothing of turning into charcoal, or his whole body turning numb,
not even a single strand of his hair was disheveled.
They had to be seeing things.
Are you a f****** monster?
Everyone’s mouths were wide open, big enough to fit a bun.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Is there anyone else that wants to stop me from leaving?”
Zhou Miyang’s expression was dark. He finally stood up.
He had no choice but to stand up. First, his lackeys had failed, and then the Spirit Tool had lost
its effect. If he still did not make a move, wouldn’t the reputation of the Zhou Clan be
completely ruined?

“You’re wearing that kind of armor, right?” Zhou Miyang said. He wouldn’t be as shocked as everyone else. Instead, he immediately guessed that Ling Han wasn’t immune to lightning attacks. Instead, he was wearing that kind of specially made armor.
Ling Han smiled, “I am the Thunder God, and can naturally control the power of lightning. Playing with lightning in front of me is really biting off more than you can chew.”
“Ha! Ha!” Zhou Miyang laughed it off. He naturally did not believe it the slightest bit.
Did he think he was an idiot?
“Continue shooting!” he said. “Even if you wear that kind of armor, after sustaining enough
attacks, it will still crumble.”
“Yes.” Those soldiers also pulled themselves together, and controlled their spears, launching
another attack at Ling Han.
Zi, zi, zi, lightning flashed madly.
Ling Han stood, arms crossed behind his back, and asked calmly, “Are you done yet?”
No one paid attention to him, and was still releasing lightning. Zi, zi, zi!
Did they really think that he was a living target? Ling Han humphed, and stretched out a hand.

sentences.text: This was truly an undeserved calamity.
Ling Han didn’t provoke anyone.
In fact, he even changed his appearance and soul fluctuation, but he was still targeted at the first moment.
F***, was he really a man that had developed a halo of trouble?
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t back down.
He glared back at the young man.
“Hehe, this newcomer, how should I address you?” the young man asked calmly.
Ling Han crossed his arms over his chest, pretending not to hear.
“Hey, my young master is asking you a question,” one of the servants couldn’t help but shout.
However, Ling Han still ignored him.
“Hehe, how dare you ignore even my words?” This young man already had a sliver of anger in him.
Only then did Ling Han say, “Before asking others, shouldn’t you introduce yourself first?”
A flash of killing intent appeared in the young man’s eyes, but he still suppressed it, and said, “I am Zhou Miyang.”
As expected, this guy was Zhou Miyang.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Han Lin.”
Song Lan’s beautiful eyes lit up.
Not only was she astonishingly beautiful, she also had outstanding intelligence.
Han Lin was Ling Han in reverse, and she felt that Ling Han gave off a familiar feeling.
Thus, she was already somewhat certain that the person in front of her was Ling Han in disguise.
Zhou Miyang’s attention was completely focused on Song Lan.
This woman was really too beautiful, causing his heart to throb wildly.
The first time he set eyes on her, he had already made up his mind that he would definitely marry her.
Thus, when he discovered that Song Lan was actually paying attention to Ling Han, this naturally caused his jealousy to burn.
“If you want to sit down at this young master’s banquet, you have to first prove that you have that kind of ability,” Zhou Miyang said coldly.
He wanted to humiliate Ling Han in public, and try as much as possible to tarnish the latter’s image.
The reason why Ling Han had come here was to see if the empress and the others were here.
Since they weren’t here, what was the point of him staying?
He waved his hand, turned and left.
F***, chickened out?
Zhou Miyang’s killing intent blazed.
This guy had come in to strut around, and in the end, he wanted to run the moment he flipped out.
There was no way he would let him off so easily.
He nodded at a large man in black by his side, and the latter immediately understood.
“Brat, what kind of place do you think this is?
Do you think you can come and go as you please?” The large man in black leaped out, and was already standing in front of Ling Han.
“Are you born in the year of the dog?” Ling Han asked.
What was the meaning of this?
The large man in black subconsciously shook his head, “My zo-”
“Since you’re not a dog, why are you blocking the way?” Ling Han interrupted him.
‘F*ck!’
The large man in black faltered for a moment before coming to his senses.
Ling Han was playing around with him, calling him a dog.
He flew into a thunderous rage, and with a single step, rushed towards Ling Han.
Then, he threw out a punch.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and tapped out a finger.
The large black-robed man’s fist was the size of a clay bowl, and compared with Ling Han’s slender finger, its size was completely disproportionate.
Furthermore, the aura of both sides were completely different.
This punch from the large black-robed man condensed the endless power of heaven and earth, and his battle prowess was terrifying.
Ling Han, on the other hand, was limp and without the slightest bit of force.
Many people had already closed their eyes, unable to bear the sight.
Peng!
There was a loud bang, and a person was already sent flying.
Then, there was an endless series of loud bangs.
As it turned out, a great many walls had been forcefully crashed through.
Yi?
Everyone could not believe it.
The person that had been sent flying was actually not Ling Han, but rather the large man in black.
How was this possible?
Ling Han withdrew his finger.
He was also slightly surprised, because this lackey was actually a Four Cauldrons.
Four Cauldrons, and he had become someone’s servant?
This could only appear in this kind of Mystery Realm, where the rapid increase of cultivation level was obtained through overdrafting one’s life force.
In fact, one could even reach a height that only super geniuses could reach.
“Good, very good.” Zhou Miyang sat upright and still, but his eyes were cold, his killing intent blazing.
“You have come to the territory of the Zhou Clan, and still dare to commit a crime.
How impressive!”
This was naturally a sarcastic remark.
Shua, a row of soldiers appeared.
Though they were all Foundation Building Tier cultivators, all of them held spears in their hands.
Instantly, everyone’s expressions changed slightly.
They had witnessed the might of this spear before, and the attacks that it delivered were extraordinarily fast.
There were not many in the Cauldron Forging Tier that could dodge this.
Once they were hit, they would be numb to the point of losing all ability to resist, and at worst, they would be directly burnt into charcoal.
Naturally, everyone would be wary.

The reason why everyone was willing to attend the banquet was firstly, because they wanted to further understand the situation here, and secondly, because they wanted to know the origins of this spear-type Spirit Tool.
If they could bring it out of the Mystery Realm, it could easily help a force become stronger.
Ling Han was completely unconcerned.
In fact, he didn’t even activate his movement technique, to stop the soldiers from locking onto him.
“Han Lin, don’t forget yourself in your conceit!” Song Lan spoke up, “There is no great enmity between you, just some minor misunderstandings.
There is no need for you to become enemies like this.”
She was afraid that Ling Han would be too arrogant, and completely had no idea of the might of this spear.
That was why she had opened her mouth to speak.
On the surface, she was rebuking Ling Han, but in truth, she was trying to mediate.
However, Ling Han couldn’t possibly listen to her, and Zhou Miyang definitely wouldn’t let go of a suspected “rival in love”.
Instantly, zi, ten spears shot out blazing white lightning at the same time, incredibly fast.
Ling Han didn’t dodge, and he was instantly hit head-on.
Sigh.
Everyone shook their heads.
Wasn’t this just asking for trouble?
They were all very clear that the lightning shot out by this spear was incredibly frightening, and could not be taken lightly just because the person controlling it was a Foundation
Building Tier.
See, he was too arrogant, wasn’t he?
This was karma.
Hence, one should not show off too much, or else... f***!
The lightning dissipated, but everyone was shocked to see that Ling Han was still standing there perfectly fine.
To say nothing of turning into charcoal, or his whole body turning numb,
not even a single strand of his hair was disheveled.
They had to be seeing things.
