chapters.title: Chapter 3880: Introduction
paragraphs: Ling Han stretched out his hand. With a thought, zi, a bolt of lightning shot out from the palm of his hand, striking back at those soldiers.
Pa! Pa! Pa!
Instantly, the spears in the hands of these soldiers exploded one after another.

Though the destructive power of this kind of spear was great, the material it was made of was not very high grade. With a sweep of the divine light of lightning, it naturally exploded. This time, everyone was dumbfounded.
Could it be that this guy was really the Thunder God? Otherwise, how could he have possibly shot out a bolt of lightning with a wave of his hand, which was even more terrifying than those spears?
“Interesting.” Zhou Miyang stared at Ling Han, “You seem to be hiding some kind of secret.” “You speak too much nonsense.” Ling Han shook his head.

“When I take you down, you will explain everything clearly.” Zhou Miyang strode over. Boom, his aura immediately changed, and his whole head of hair flew in the wind. There was even lightning flickering, crackling madly.
This guy was so terrifying.

The outsiders couldn’t help but feel apprehensive. Previously, they had completely looked down on the natives here. Even if they were wary, that was because of the Zhou Clan’s Core Formation Tier elites, as well as the spear-type Spirit Tool that released lightning.
However, now that they saw Zhou Miyang unleash his might, they suddenly realized that the natives here were extremely strong. In fact, they were stronger than the majority of them.
As Song Lan watched, her beautiful face was calm and unperturbed. It was unknown what she was thinking.
This woman was extremely subtle.

Zhou Miyang walked step by step towards Ling Han. With every step, his aura would become slightly stronger, and the lightning entwined around him would also become slightly more terrifying. When he was about three meters away from Ling Han, he had already turned into a bolt of lightning. His body had become transparent, and was completely entwined with lightning.
Was this a kind of physique, or had he cultivated some kind of lightning cultivation technique?
Ling Han was unconcerned. Even if he didn’t retrieve the light of lightning, he was confident that he could defeat all Cauldron Forging Tiers.
“Outsider, I’ll show you what true power of lightning is!” Zhou Miyang declared coldly. Zi, his whole person turned into a bolt of lightning that “slashed” towards Ling Han.
Ling Han casually raised his hand and grabbed the bolt of lightning.

“Haha, you’re seeking death!” Zhou Miyang turned back into human form, and sneered. He actually dared to catch him. Didn’t he know that he was a bolt of lightning now? Even Divine Metal would be pierced through if it took a hit from him.
However, no matter how much power he channeled, Ling Han was still completely unscathed.
In fact, he could even feel that Ling Han’s body had become a bottomless pit that was devouring his power of lightning.

This was not his misconception, but it was not completely right either. That was because it was not Ling Han that was engulfing his power of lightning, but rather the light of lightning from the Celestial Cauldron.

-The Zhou Clan’s cultivation technique was based on the light of lightning, and was formed by an incredibly outstanding ancestor of the Zhou Clan absorbing the power of the Lightning Ore. Thus, the members of the Zhou Clan could refine the Lightning Ore, rapidly increase their cultivation level, and possess the might of lightning.
However, this also led to all those who cultivated this technique to feel like a son that was facing his father in front of Ling Han.
This was an intrinsic restraint.
Zhou Miyang was scared now. At present, it was not him that was attacking Ling Han, but rather Ling Han wanted to suck him dry.

He wanted to flee, but Ling Han grabbed onto him. He was completely unable to break free, and could only watch helplessly as his power was endlessly sucked away. Even if he did not actively channel his power, it was as if a valve had been turned on in this mystical power. He could not shut it down at all.
Th-Thunder God.
This thought streaked through his mind. If it was not the Thunder God, how could Ling Han possibly suppress him like this?
“Lord Thunder God, spare me!” He lowered his head.
How could a human be a match for a god?
“Convinced?” Ling Han asked calmly.
“I concede.”
“Are you afraid now?”
“I am.”
Zhou Miyang appeared very humble, completely losing the domineering air he had previously.
Only then did Ling Han let go, and prepared to leave.

“Lord Thunder God, please wait!” Zhou Miyang hurriedly said, “My ancestor, my father and the others would definitely be very pleased to see you, and hope that Lord Thunder God can give our humble clan a chance.”
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han looked at Zhou Miyang with a faint smile, causing Zhou Miyang to involuntarily break out in a cold sweat.
“Sure,” he finally nodded.

Perhaps this was a trap, but if Ling Han used the Imminent Skyline, he was extremely confident that he could escape. If he was really forced into a corner, the Heavenly Dao Flames would definitely be no pushover either.
However, since the Zhou Clan was so determined to obtain the Heavenly Clouds Mountain, they must have studied it deeply. Thus, Ling Han wanted to obtain the information that they
possessed.
“Lord, please.” Zhou Miyang’s expression was respectful as he led the way ahead.
Ling Han ignored everyone else, and walked forwards with his hands clasped behind his back.
“Can I go with you?” A fragrant figure fluttered in the air, and Song Lan had already leaped over. She hummed softly and smiled faintly, and was indescribably beautiful.
Why was this woman joining in on the excitement?
Ling Han frowned slightly. He had never underestimated this woman’s intelligence. Now that
she had suddenly interfered, she must be scheming something.
“Since Celestial maiden Song is willing to grace us with her presence, I naturally clap my
hands in welcome.” Zhou Miyang was overjoyed.
The three of them left, leaving behind a group of guests who were extremely confused.
What was going on here? They were just left here like this?
What happened to the hospitality of a host?

Zhou Miyang led the way, and they soon arrived at the Zhou Clan Residence. Since they were the rulers of this place, the Zhou Clan naturally occupied a very large area, with continuous levels of buildings, looking ancient.
“Young Master.” Upon seeing Zhou Miyang, the guards at the entrance hurriedly paid their
respects.

Zhou Miyang waved his hand, his arrogant demeanor reappearing. He brought Ling Han and Song Lan through the doors, and arrived at the main hall. Then, he invited them to wait for a moment, before he himself left.
“We’re already old friends, so why don’t you show your true face?” Song Lan asked calmly.
Ling Han pretended to be surprised, “Yi, I remember that your hand was very fair and tender.
Where does the word ‘old’ come from?”
Shua, Song Lan instantly delivered a palm strike.
Ling Han slanted his head to the side, dodging the attack. This time, he was really shocked, because Song Lan’s strength had improved again.
Eight Cauldrons, right?
This woman really could not be underestimated. In a short few months, she had advanced
another step further.

“En?” Song Lan was also surprised. She had come across a fortuitous encounter in her adventures previously, and her cultivation level had soared from Seven Cauldrons to Eight Cauldrons. Even if it was Lu Qi, she would be able to fight him. She had not thought that Ling Han would have so easily dodge this blow.
“You’re not the only one who’s improved,” Ling Han said with a faint smile. He returned to his original appearance. After all, to constantly maintain his appearance was extremely
troublesome.
Song Lan was slightly displeased. After she had advanced into Eight Cauldrons, what she
wanted most was to thrash this lecherous Ling Han. Did he really think that her hand could be touched as he liked? But she had not expected that while she had improved, Ling Han had also
improved, and she was still unable to do anything against this guy.
Right at this moment, three people walked in, one after another.
Two of them were middle-aged men in their forties, while the third was Zhou Miyang.
“Let me introduce. This is my father, Zhou Mi, and this is my Second Uncle, Zhou Lou,” Zhou Miyang said with a smile, no longer having the previous fear.
That was because both Zhou Mi and Zhou Lou were in the Core Formation Tier.

chapters.title: Chapter 3881: Turning the tables
paragraphs: “These two young friends have come from afar, so it’s been hard on you,” he said with a smile. He was the current clan leader of the Zhou Clan.
Young friend?
Ling Han chuckled internally. Previously, he had still been Lord Thunder God, and now, his status had been degraded to that of ‘young friend’. This gap was really huge.
Song Lan bowed daintily, and said, “Greetings, Lords.”
She was well-versed in social relations, and travelled the world in the image of a celestial maiden. She would not deliberately offend anyone.
“Please rise.” Zhou Mi was all smiles, and stretched out a hand, motioning her to rise.
“Celestial maiden Song, we’re all a family, so there’s no need to stand on ceremony,” Zhou Miyang said in a timely manner.
Family?
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Little Zhou, this is my wife. Since when did she become a family member with you?”
These words caused a few people’s expressions to change at the same time.
“Nonsense, when did Celestial Maiden Song become your wife? Stop dreaming!” Zhou
Miyang immediately stood up, slightly flustered and exasperated.
Meanwhile, Song Lan rolled her eyes at Ling Han, and said in annoyance, “Brother Ling, don’t spout nonsense.”
“Brother Ling?” Zhou Mi carefully glanced at Ling Han’s, and said, “So it turns out that young friend’s surname isn’t Han.”
‘F*ck! Woman, you’re trying to undermine me!’

Ling Han smiled. He was impersonating the Thunder God, but the Zhou Clan were not idiots. They had only deduced from the subtle relationship between Ling Han and Song Lan that Ling Han should also be an outsider, and not some so-called Thunder God.
Thus, Zhou Miyang’s attitude immediately changed.
In the eyes of the Zhou Clan, Ling Han’s ability was far too astonishing. If they could obtain it, the Zhou Clan would definitely become even more powerful.
“My name is Ling Han.” With a thought, Ling Han’s appearance returned to normal.

“So it is Young Friend Ling.” Zhou Lou spoke up, “Let’s be frank. If Young Friend Ling is willing to hand over your technique of controlling lightning, the Zhou Clan would definitely satisfy Young Friend Ling.”

The secret behind Ling Han’s ability to control lightning was the light of lightning in the Celestial Cauldron. This was a supreme opportunity that could match an Imperial Technique, so how could Ling Han possibly surrender it to someone else?
He wouldn’t even trade for an Imperial Technique.
Ling Han shook his head, “Not interested.”
“Young friend, please reconsider,” Zhou Lou said with a smile. However, there was already a powerful threat in his voice.
Ling Han chuckled, “No need to consider.”
“Sigh, young friend, you are refusing a toast only to drink a forfeit,” Zhou Lou said balefully.
“Second Brother, don’t scare our guests,” Zhou Mi shouted, pretending to stop him.
Zhou Lou merely smiled, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han. Crackle, crackle, lightning flickered on his hand.

If it was another cultivator of the Core Formation Tier, even if they were also cultivating the power of lightning, Ling Han would definitely be outmatched. He would either immediately turn around and flee, or draw out the Heavenly Dao Flames, but in this place, the situation was too unique.
Ling Han did not move, and allowed Zhou Lou to grab onto him.

Song Lan was speechless as she watched. In her eyes, Ling Han’s intelligence was not inferior to hers at all. Thus, since Ling Han dared to come, he must have something to rely on, but now, he had fallen into Zhou Lou’s hands just like that, which really made her jaw drop.
Have you come to walk right into a trap?
“Young friend, can you reconsider now?” Zhou Lou asked with a smile.
“I said I’m not interested, so I’m not interested,” Ling Han said calmly.
“Stubborn!” Zhou Lou humphed, and the power of lightning surged, blasting out towards Ling Han’s body.
He controlled his power very well. He would make Ling Han suffer greatly, but would not really kill Ling Han.
However, when power surged out, it was like a clay ox entering the sea.
What was going on?
Though he had heard Zhou Miyang speak of Ling Han’s “strangeness”, but just think, with his cultivation level of Core Formation Tier, he was superior to Ling Han in terms of level of
being. This kind of thing naturally could not possibly happen to him.
However, there just so happened to be such a strange thing in this world. His power was actually completely absorbed by Ling Han, and he could not cause the slightest bit of damage.
They had to be seeing things.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Now, do you believe that I am the Thunder God?”
Zhou Lou naturally didn’t believe this. If the Thunder God had truly descended into the mortal
world, how could his cultivation level only be at the Cauldron Forging Tier?
He increased his power, but no matter how much power he activated, Ling Han was
completely unscathed.
“Haha, young friend’s ability is truly shocking!” Zhou Mi carefully mediated the situation, “Second Brother, don’t be rude to esteemed guests.”

It’s my turn.” He pondered for a moment, then said, “Give me the information on Heavenly Clouds Mountain.” Zhou Mi laughed in spite of itself, “Young friend, do you think you can threaten us? Though you have grasped a secret technique, and are immune to our attacks, you are only a Cauldron Forging Tier, after all.” He said disdainfully.

“Oh?” Ling Han smiled faintly. He stood up, and with a casual wave of his hand, a bolt of lightning shot out. With a pa, all the tables and chairs in his path were turned into dust, and his power did not decrease. A hole was blasted into the wall, and he continued to charge forwards, blasting out a passage that was several hundred meters long.

And this was only something that Ling Han had done casually.

Clan?

voice.

They had miscalculated. This woman had a rare treasure to protect her, so it was impossible for them to use her to threaten Ling Han.
Ling Han was also surprised. He had not thought that Song Lan would actually possess such a
treasure?
This should be something that she had obtained later. Otherwise, if she would rather sit by and watch her companion be trapped than save him, wouldn’t that be too cold-blooded and
heartless?
Song Lan only showed off a little of her strength, and smiled beautifully, as if nothing had
happened.
She indeed had a rare treasure on her, but there was a limit to how many times she could use
it. Thus, if she could avoid using it, it was naturally best not to.

Zhou Mi was helpless, and asked, “Young friend, what do you want to know?”
“The distribution of wild beasts in the Heavenly Clouds Mountain, as well as... what is that place outside the Heavenly Clouds Mountain?” Ling Han asked.

Young friend?

This gap was really huge.
Song Lan bowed daintily, and said, “Greetings, Lords.”

“Please rise.” Zhou Mi was all smiles, and stretched out a hand, motioning her to rise.
“Celestial maiden Song, we’re all a family, so there’s no need to stand on ceremony,” Zhou Miyang said in a timely manner.
Family?

Stop dreaming!” Zhou
Miyang immediately stood up, slightly flustered and exasperated.

‘F*ck!
Woman, you’re trying to undermine me!’

The secret behind Ling Han’s ability to control lightning was the light of lightning in the Celestial Cauldron.

being.
This kind of thing naturally could not possibly happen to him.

They had to be seeing things.

chapters.title: Chapter 3882: Heaven Hunting Crossbow
paragraphs: “Young friend Ling, this is information that our Zhou Clan has spent decades to gather. Who knows how much manpower and material resources we have sacrificed. Do you want to reap the rewards without so much as a scratch?” Zhou Mi said in a deep voice, still wanting to bargain.
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded, honestly and without reservations.
Er!

Both Zhou Mi and Zhou Lou were rendered speechless. Who was this guy? Why did he not have the arrogance and haughtiness of a young man at all? He was astonishingly shameless, and he was not provoked at all.

“Hehe, there is no problem for you to want the information.” Zhou Mi suddenly smiled, “However, I can tell you very clearly that even if you were given the information, you would not be able to cross over Heavenly Clouds Mountain. There are a total of eight Demonic Beasts at the Core Formation Tier there, and each of them has blocked a path out of the mountains. Hence, at least, you would have to kill one first.”
“It’s not that I look down on you, young friend, but aside from being able to restrain lightning-element mystical power, could it be that you’re immune to other powers?”
Old fox.
Ling Han thought internally, but his expression did not change, “Oh, then does Clan Leader Zhou have any good suggestions?”
“Cooperate.” He smiled carefully, “If you help us clean up the Heavenly Clouds Mountain, then naturally, everyone would be happy.”

What the Zhou Clan wanted was to eternally pass through the passageway of the Heavenly Cloud Mountain, and not temporarily. Otherwise, they would be able to kill off one of the weaker vicious beasts of Core Formation Tier, but not too long after, a new Beast King would appear, and once again become a roadblock for them.
Thus, only by completely occupying the Heavenly Clouds Mountain would they be able to settle the matter once and for all.
Ling Han laughed in spite of himself, “Just now, Clan Leader Zhou has already said that I am no match for any beast king. Why is it that all of a sudden, you need my help again?”
Zhou Mi laughed loudly, “Then there is naturally a reason for it.”

Zhou Lou continued, “Our Zhou Clan has developed a weapon with astonishing might, capable of killing top grade Core Formation Tiers. However, that weapon needs an incredibly pure Lightning Ore to be able to channel. Going by the present rate of progress, it is possible that it would take another two to three hundred years to be successfully extracted. Thus, we need young friend to control this weapon.”
Ling Han had astonishing control over lightning. Who knows, he may be able to do something that was difficult for ordinary people to do.
Yi, the Zhou Clan actually had such a secret weapon?

“Furthermore, after leaving the Heavenly Clouds Mountains, that would be the Demonic Origin Realm. Elites are everywhere, and with your Cauldron Forging Tier cultivation level, you would not be able to claim a stand at all.” Very carefully, he continued, “However, if our Zhou Clan can pass through the Heavenly Clouds Mountains, and establish our own branch in the Demonic Origin Realm, we would be able to become your backer.”
“I’ll consider it.”
Ling Han paused slightly. He felt that it should not be too difficult for him to cross the Heavenly Clouds Mountain, because he had the Void Beast hide, but it was hard to say for the others.
More importantly, where exactly was the empress and the others?
Perhaps they were not in this area, or perhaps they were in this area. It was just that they had not rushed over yet.
Then if he left alone, wouldn’t he have trapped the empress and the others here?

Additionally, he also wanted to take a look at that deadly weapon. It was actually capable of killing an ultimate Core Formation Tier. If he could steal it while he was at it, he would have another trump card in the future.
“If that so-called deadly weapon really has such might, then let’s cooperate,” Ling Han said.
“All right!” Both Zhou Lou and Zhou Mi smiled at the same time.
Very soon, Ling Han saw this deadly weapon.
This was a crossbow, and it was only fitted with three arrows. Because whether it was the body of the crossbow or the arrow itself, the materials used to forge it were all rare treasures.
Ling Han could tell with a single glance that this was a Four Star Divine Metal.
Thus, merely forging this crossbow and the three arrows, the Zhou Clan should have spent innumerable time and effort.
The crossbow was a Spirit Tool, but it needed to be injected with energy to push the arrow to explode with terrifying destructive power.

And this energy source was the Lightning Ore – not the kind that had been mined, but rather purified. Because it required a short period of super-input, only then would it be able to kill a Core Formation Tier.

The requirement for the purity of this energy was too high, so even the Core Formation Tier elites such as Zhou Lou and the others couldn’t do it. Although they should have been the ones to control it when designing it, they discovered that they couldn’t activate it at all after forging it. In other words, the effects were far from what they expected.
In Ling Han’s mind, though his cultivation level was only at the Cauldron Forging Tier, his lightning energy was too pure, so perhaps it could be used.
This was natural, because that was not Ling Han’s power at all, but rather the light of lightning in the Celestial Cauldron, the source of all Lightning Ore.
If even Ling Han couldn’t do it, then there should be no one who could activate it.

Ling Han began to experiment. He mounted an arrow, then injected power into the crossbow. Bit by bit, there was a pool of energy in the crossbow, which was presently slowly filling up. Ten minutes later, the energy pool was filled to the brim.
Ling Han didn’t attack at the first instant. Instead, he waited for another five minutes, then aimed at the target in front of him and pressed the switch.
Boom, an arrow was shot out.
Fast, like the lightning in the skies, leaving behind traces of lightning behind it. Then, with a loud bang, a mountain ahead of them was directly gone.
All of a sudden, all the members of the Zhou Clan that had followed him here, including Zhou Lou, all had their mouths agape, completely rendered speechless.
This attack was practically world-shaking.
“It’s probably at the early stage of the True Self Tier,” Zhou Mi deduced. He hadn’t seen a True Self Tier before, so he could only speculate based on his cultivation level.
“Killing a top grade Core Formation Tier elite would be as easy as the turn of a palm.”
“Destroying the Heavenly Clouds Mountain would be as easy as blowing off dust.”
“Haha, who would be able to stand against our Zhou Clan now?”
The members of the Zhou Clan were all very excited. Of course, someone immediately charged out and retrieved the arrow. There were only a total of three arrows, so they naturally had to
be recycled.
Even Song Lan was extremely stunned.She had not thought that this Heaven Hunting
Crossbow would actually be able to unleash such terrifying might in Ling Han’s hands.
“Young friend Ling, let us have a pleasant cooperation.” With a smile, Zhou Mi stretched out
his hand.
Ling Han also stretched out his hand, and shook hands with the other.
He naturally wouldn’t work for them for nothing. Although he also wanted to cross the Heavenly Clouds Mountain, it was only natural that he would receive some benefits. He
couldn’t be soft-hearted.
The Zhou Clan also knew his value, and immediately delivered a great many Celestial medicines, and promised Ling Han that after conquering the Heavenly Clouds Mountain,
their gains would be shared equally with Ling Han.

-Not only were there fierce beasts in the Heavenly Clouds Mountain, there were also Celestial medicines. However, fierce beasts were too frightening. If one wanted to harvest Celestial medicines here, he would usually have to pay with his life.
The Zhou Clan began to contact those outsiders, hoping that everyone could cooperate. After passing through the Heavenly Cloud Mountain, the path ahead would still be wide.
This was beneficial for all of them. Thus, the outsiders also decided that they would flatten the Heavenly Clouds Mountain with the Zhou Clan.
“Brother Ling, do you really trust the Zhou Clan?” Song Lan came to pay him a visit, very
calm, looking ethereal.
However, Ling Han knew that even though this little girl looked as beautiful as a celestial maiden and unshackled by the mortal world, she was actually extremely scheming. She had a
lot of tricks up her sleeve.
He smiled, “Why not?”

“I heard that there are a great many Celestial medicines in Heavenly Clouds Mountain. In fact, they can even help a Core Formation Tier cultivator advance one step further. Do you think that the Zhou Clan would be willing to surrender such Celestial medicines to us?” Song Lan
asked calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 3883: Insta-kill with a single arrow
paragraphs: According to the Zhou Clan, if they were willing to split the rewards of the Heavenly Cloud Mountain equally with Ling Han, then if it involved Core Formation Tier or even the True Self Tier-level Great Herbs, then it would naturally be divided equally.
The Zhou Clan was willing?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Little Lan Lan, are you trying to drive a wedge between us?”
Song Lan’s pretty face involuntarily darkened. No one had ever been so bold, to actually dare call her Little Lan Lan.
This was blatant teasing!
“Brother Ling, with your strength and talent, is there any meaning to take advantage of me verbally?” she asked calmly, as if she did not take it to heart at all.
“So this is boring,” Ling Han said with a smile. “Then, Little Lan Lan, let’s discuss the true meaning of life.”
Shua, Song Lan delivered a palm strike.
Ling Han reached out to block it. Hehe, he liked to provoke this calm and two-faced celestial maiden into losing her cool.

“Let me give you a reminder. The Zhou Clan would definitely not be so generous that they would foolishly count money for others even after being betrayed.” Song Lan immediately regained her composure, as if she was a celestial maiden that would never lose her composure.
With that said, she left gracefully.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t trust the Zhou Clan, but cooperation was necessary. That Heaven Hunting Crossbow was practically tailor-made for him, and he wanted to possess it.
After preparing for a day, the Zhou Clan mobilized everyone to set out, heading towards Heavenly Clouds Mountain.
For the sake of this day, the Zhou Clan had already waited several hundred years. Generation after generation of hard work and struggle had become a long-cherished wish.
After walking for two days, they arrived at the foot of the Heavenly Clouds Mountain.
This mountain was tall enough to reach the skies, and there were clouds and mists curling around the waist of the mountain.
“Ang!”
“Ao!”
Before entering the mountains, they could already hear the roars of beasts, which directly penetrated into their souls, causing chills to run down their spines.
This was a great beast of Core Formation Tier.

“Be careful. Vicious beasts aren’t the only thing we need to guard against. There’s also the environment here,” Zhou Mi warned. “There are some plants here that look inconspicuous, but their stings are specialized in breaking through a shield of mystical power. Once pierced, the strong poison will turn people into mush in a short few seconds.”

Hearing these words, everyone shivered. Thankfully, everyone was prepared when they entered into the White Lotus Mystery Realm and wore armor. This would definitely be able to block any piercing stings.
Now, killing a Core Formation Tier great beast shouldn’t be too difficult. The problem was, how were they supposed to be found?

There were a total of eight Demonic Beasts in Heavenly Clouds Mountain, and three of them were at the peak stage of Core Formation Tier. For example, it was very easy for four, five, or even seven or eight cauldrons to appear among wild beasts, but cultivators were basically three cauldrons. the Iron Scale Sheep.

Someone in front of them was drawing the Iron Scaled Sheep over. Of course, it was a Core Formation Tier elite from the Zhou Clan. Otherwise, the other people would be caught up with by a Core Formation Tier vicious beast in a few moves, and then crushed into dust.
It had appeared.

This Iron Scaled Sheep was over 30 meters tall, and its length was around 60 meters. What covered its whole body was not fur, but scales, exuding the coldness of metal, and on top of its head, there were two giant goat horns that were more than 30 meters long, as if they were
two heavenly spears.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The Iron Scaled Sheep charged past, and the mountain rocks that were touched by its aura were shattered into dust, turning into flying sand.
It rampaged all the way, and occasionally, a mountain peak would collapse.
Ling Han turned his head and said to Zhou Mi, “Make that Iron Scale Sheep stop, or I won’t be able to lock onto it easily.”

Zhou Mi frowned deeply. If he wanted the Iron Scale Sheep to stop, he would have to face the Iron Scale Sheep head-on. With the strength of this Beast King, it could easily severely injure the clan’s Core Formation Tier cultivator.

However, there was nothing that could be done. Ling Han was only a Cauldron Forging Tier, so it was normal that he couldn’t lock onto a Core Formation Tier. This, on the other hand, made him feel slightly relieved.
He immediately moved, wanting to force the Iron Scale Sheep to stop. The four Core Formation Tier elites had to work together.
Ling Han stood on the high ground, leisurely and relaxed, waiting patiently.
“You have it easy,” Song Lan said.
“Same to you,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Not long after, the Iron Scaled Sheep indeed stopped.
Ling Han raised the Heaven Hunting Crossbow and aimed. Previously, he had already started
to accumulate power, so he immediately pressed the trigger.
Boom, the arrow shot out. Pa, pa, pa! Lightning flashed, and it was extremely fast.

Its trajectory was practically untraceable. After jumping a few times in the air, it had already shot in front of that Iron Scaled Sheep, and then penetrated straight through. The incomparably sturdy scales of the Iron Scaled Sheep were completely useless. Peng, so what if it was in the late stage of Core Formation Tier? That Iron Scaled Sheep did not
even manage to release a wail before collapsing loudly.
And on the other side, the body of the arrow had already pierced through.
The destructive power of this arrow was truly terrifying. The entrance was very small, but the
exit formed a huge hole that was about three meters wide. The internal organs and bones
inside had all been shattered.
Otherwise, it would have been impossible to insta-kill this great beast with a single strike.

Instantly, everyone erupted in cheers. A King-level great beast had actually fallen so easily. Even Ling Han was slightly stunned. Although he had long since known that this arrow was extremely powerful, he was still filled with shock when he saw it with his own eyes. However, even though this battle had ended so quickly, in order to draw the Iron Scaled Sheep
over and slow it down, the Zhou Clan had still paid a certain price. A few clansmen had died, and even three of the four great Core Formation Tier elites had been wounded, and one of
them was severely wounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 3884: A narrow victory
paragraphs: The ideal situation was that they would discover the lair of the Iron Scaled Sheep, and then draw out the beast king. Then, they would deliver a fatal strike. In that way, there would be no casualties.
It could not be helped. Reality and expectations could not possibly be completely in sync.
At first, they had wanted to kill all eight of the beast kings in one go, but by the looks of it now, that was obviously impossible.
Thus, everyone could only rest and reorganize here.
This was good too. This area was now their territory, so they could go and find the Celestial medicine.
Ling Han was completely unscathed. He naturally couldn’t just sit there. He also went to look for Celestial medicines.

-That Heaven Hunting Crossbow and arrow had been taken back by the Zhou Clan. The reason was that they had to calibrate it. After all, the might of the arrow was too great. Every shot would affect the crossbow and arrow, so in order to ensure the accuracy of the next shot, they had to calibrate and maintain it.
Ling Han naturally knew that it was because the Zhou Clan was worried. After all, this powerful weapon was too terrifying.
He did not refuse. Now, it was the honeymoon period of their cooperation, so they both had to show their sincerity.

After two days, he had really found a few Two Star Celestial medicines, but he did not ingest them immediately. Instead, he wanted to refine them into alchemical pills, so as to increase the efficiency rate.
On the third day, Zhou Mi came to find Ling Han, informing him he could hunt down a second beast king.
All right, then let’s set out.
Everyone was even more careful. After entering the territory of the second beast king, they still split up and went off to find the lair of that beast king.
This time, it was surprisingly smooth. That was because someone had seen that the beast king just happened to return from a hunt, so naturally, the lair was exposed.
After arriving at their destination, the Zhou Clan handed the crossbow bolts over to Ling Han.
After Ling Han had accumulated enough power, he had the Zhou Clan go and lure out the beast king. In the end, the moment it appeared, he shot it dead.
Everyone cheered. This time, there were no casualties. This was practically a miracle. Continue.
They continued to search for the third beast king.

The reason why it was so smooth was also because the second Demonic Beast was only in the early stage of Core Formation Tier. Whether it was its abilities or sensory abilities, they were considerably inferior. However, if it was a peak stage Core Formation Tier, it was very possible that it would discover danger ahead of time.
And what followed was this kind of great test.

The third beast king was a great beast at the peak stage of the Core Formation Tier. If it really came down to it, the four elites of the Core Formation Tier from the Zhou Clan would probably be killed completely within a few minutes.
Thus, everyone was extremely careful. If they were the slightest bit careless, the entire team could possibly be wiped out in an instant.
However, they still continued their good luck and found the beast king’s lair very smoothly.
As per usual, Ling Han began to make preparations, and then had the Zhou Clan go and lure out the beast king.

This was a black wolf, but it was not very big in size. It was not much different from an ordinary wild wolf, but its eyes were terrifyingly ferocious. Even a single glance at it would make one’s heart shudder, or even lose all battle prowess directly.
Xiu, Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all. His mind was calm, and he was unafraid of any aura or viciousness.
This arrow was still as domineering as ever.
Boom!
The arrow shot over, directly shattering the black wolf along with the mountain behind it.
“Killed again!”
“So awesome!”
“Five more times, and we’ll be done.”
Everyone cheered. However, someone immediately let out a tragic cry, which then came to an
abrupt stop.
“Ah!” “Ah!” “Ah!”
Tragic wails rang out endlessly, as if they were playing a musical piece.
What was going on?
Amidst the dust and dirt, everyone was horrified to discover that there was a black shadow rapidly shuttling through, easily reaping human lives.
Hiss, it was that black wolf!
It did not die, but with the latter half of its body missing, it could be seen that the damaged intestines were still dragging out, which was both terrifying and disgusting.
However, it was an existence at the peak stage of the Core Formation Tier. Even with such heavy injuries, its battle prowess was still incredibly terrifying.
Without the slightest hesitation, Zhou Mi said to Ling Han, “We will detain it, and you fire the second arrow as soon as possible.”
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.
The four Core Formation Tier cultivators from the Zhou Clan charged forward. Apart from them, no one else could withstand a single strike from this black wolf, even if it was severely
wounded.
However, that black wolf had absolutely no intention of tangling with the four of them. It was just using its two forelegs to burst out with speed, and was still going on a killing spree in the
-crowd.
All of a sudden, blood flowed like a river.

The people who had died were basically all members of the Zhou Clan. When outsiders saw that the situation was dire, they would naturally immediately shatter their tokens and teleport out of the Mystery Realm to save their lives. Meanwhile, some people had powerful backgrounds, possessing life-saving rare treasures. In fact, the might of their counterattacks was extremely terrifying, and even the black wolf was wary, turning around to attack the
others.
Ling Han continued to observe as he accumulated power. Although this was an unexpected turn of events, it gave him a chance to check out everyone’s trump cards.

However, Song Lan was far too smart, and she immediately retreated from the battle. In fact, she hadn’t even come close to Ling Han before. Now, she could stay out of this battle and watch from the sidelines.
Yi, there were really crouching tigers and hidden dragons among them.

Ling Han saw that there were a few people who were quite extraordinary. They had probably reached Seven Cauldrons of even Eight Cauldrons in battle prowess. Though they were far from being a match for the black wolf, they all had rare treasures on them, which allowed them to stubbornly survive.

Thankfully, the black wold was severely injured after all. Though it had launched a counterattack in its fury, ignoring its injuries, after venting its anger, it was exhausted. Very soon, it was trapped by Zhou Mi and the others, and could no longer attack the others.
Seeing this, Ling Han naturally wasn’t in a hurry. After a whole fifteen minutes, he finally
fired an arrow.
Boom!
This time, it was no longer possible for the black wolf to escape. His head was directly blown off, and he was completely and utterly dead.
The vicious beast at the peak stage of the Core Formation Tier was truly terrifying. It couldn’t kill the sneak attacker, and instead counterattacked, killing at least a few dozen people.
A narrow victory.

The members of the Zhou Clan were all unable to feel happy. Initially, they thought that after they had obtained a deadly weapon, they would be able to sweep aside all opposition in the Heavenly Cloud Mountains. They had not thought that they would encounter a Core Formation Tier beast king, which immediately taught them a bloody lesson.
This time, their raid had to be postponed again. With so many casualties and injuries, they
naturally had to make some adjustments.
Thus, those who were still alive continued to search for Celestial medicines.
They were willing to take the risk, naturally for the sake of their gains.

A great many people were still thinking of supreme great opportunities. Aside from Celestial medicines, there was also the legendary celestial light here, which could be cultivated to become supreme divine light, destroying everything in the world. There was also divine substance, which could stimulate the evolution of Celestial Foundations, Celestial Cauldrons, and Celestial pills, so that they could charge towards a perfect level.
It had to be said that there were really people who had encountered great fortune.
“It’s Liu Chuang.”
“He obtained a divine substance, and raised the level of the Celestial Cauldron.”

“What? He was originally a golden cauldron, the strongest Celestial Cauldron in the world. If he advances another step further, how can he be any stronger?” “You don’t understand. The golden cauldron is not the strongest Celestial Cauldron. Impurities can be further removed, and it can become a special Celestial Cauldron like the platinum cauldron, crystal cauldron, golden jade cauldron, and so on, crushing the golden
cauldron.”
“Hiss, why have I never heard of it?”
“Hehe, that is because you are ignorant and ill-informed.”
When Ling Han heard about this, he was also slightly surprised. He had seen this Liu Chuang

before. Previously, when the black wolf wreaked havoc, this Liu Chuang was the one who had displayed Seven Cauldrons in battle prowess, ranking eighth in the Galaxy Network. Now that he had obtained the divine substance, allowing the Celestial Cauldron to evolve, his battle prowess would definitely increase greatly. However, whose Celestial Cauldron could evolve to his level?

Previously, when the black wolf wreaked havoc, this Liu Chuang was the one who had displayed Seven Cauldrons in battle prowess, ranking eighth in the Galaxy Network.
Now that he had obtained the divine substance, allowing the Celestial Cauldron to evolve, his battle prowess would definitely increase greatly.
However, whose Celestial Cauldron could evolve to his level?

chapters.title: Chapter 3885: Divine Substance
paragraphs: The length of time that the sweep operation had been halted had exceeded Ling Han’s expectations.
Half a month had passed, and there was still no movement from the Zhou Clan.
Ling Han was in no hurry either. The Heavenly Clouds Mountain was too big, and there were opportunities everywhere. He had no plans to leave immediately.
He too wanted to obtain the divine substance. Who knew if he could still evolve his Celestial Cauldron.
When this luck came, there was no way to block it.

Ling Han entered into a valley, and found a Celestial medicine. Then, beside the Celestial medicine, he saw a rock that was like white jade. He could clearly see that there was a golden substance flowing within. There was no need to cut open the rock, and he could already sense a powerful activity.
This was... a divine substance.
Ling Han brought the Celestial medicine and stone back. Then, he sliced open a corner of the stone, and drew out the divine substance within. It took effect on the Celestial Cauldron in his mind.

Then, Ling Han immediately discovered that his Celestial Cauldron was completely ignoring this divine substance. Even the sixth cauldron that he had not completely cultivated had no intention of absorbing this divine substance to construct itself.
In other words, his Celestial Cauldron was far superior in quality, so the so-called divine substance had no effect on him at all.

Ling Han was both happy and depressed. What he was happy about was naturally how high the level of his Celestial Cauldron was. Even if someone had endless divine substance, they could not possibly improve the Celestial Foundation, Celestial Cauldron or Celestial pill to the level of being his equal. And what depressed him was the fact that the treasures that others fought over were completely useless to him. Wasn’t that a waste?
Yi?
He suddenly discovered that the divine substance in the rock was being lost. Though the rate was very slow, at this rate, it would completely dissipate in less than a day.
F***, this could only be naturally sealed?
What should he do?
If he used it on himself, it would be equivalent to a waste.
He could sell it.

Ling Han’s eyes lit up. If he wanted to sell it, he naturally had to sell it to someone rich and imposing. It would be best if he could auction it off. That way, the profits would definitely be maximized.
Unfortunately, there was no time now.
He had no option but to seek out Song Lan.
-In such a short amount of time, if he wanted to find someone familiar, and one that was rich and imposing at that, who else could it be but Song Lan?
He went to look for Song Lan. Unexpectedly, Liu Chuang was also there. The two of them talked about something, and the atmosphere was quite good.
“Lan Lan, I have something to tell you.” Ling Han spoke without thinking. He wanted to see how Song Lan would lose her composure but be unable to do anything to him.
However, this time, Liu Chuang’s face had already turned green before Song Lan had even lost her composure.
Ling Han did not give him the chance to show his anger, and beckoned Song Lan over, “Are you coming or not? Otherwise, if you regret it in future, don’t come looking for me.”
Song Lan only hesitated for less than half a second, then smiled apologetically at Liu Chuang, “Brother Liu, I’ll be right back.”
Hearing Song Lan’s words, Liu Chuang could only pretend to be gentlemanly as he clasped his hands and said, “Celestial maiden Song, please.”
Song Lan followed Ling Han to a small forest, then said, “Don’t pretend to be profound and mysterious. What’s the matter?”
“I’ll sell you something good,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“What is it?”
“Nutritious tonic for pregnancy.”
Shua, Song Lan delivered a palm strike, “Be serious.”
Ling Han took out the jade stone, and said, “Here, I accidentally obtained some divine substance, and plan to sell it. Are you interested? If not, I’ll find someone else.”
No kidding, of course I’m interested.
Song Lan’s eyes immediately lit up, but a puzzled expression appeared on her face, “Why do you not want it yourself?”
‘I’m too awesome. Even divine substances have no effect on me.’
Ling Han didn’t reply with such words that could garner jealousy. Instead, he said, “I’ll sell,
you buy, and if you don’t buy, I’ll find someone else.”
What he meant was to quickly make a bid, and stop blabbering nonsense.
Song Lan couldn’t help but feel enraged. She was the ninth beauty on the Exquisite Leaderboard, so what man would not curry her favour?
But what about Ling Han?
It was either that he was glib-tongued with her, or that he completely ignored her. In short,
he actually did not take her seriously.
How could this not infuriate her?
“What do you want?” she asked calmly, suppressing her fury. Divine substances were too important to her.
“Imperial Technique.” Ling Han made an exorbitant demand.
“Hehe.” Song Lan rolled her eyes.
What a joke. Just how awesome was the Imperial Technique? Even the resources of a Holy Land could not be exchanged for it.

Ai, it was clear that he would not be able to deceive her out of an Imperial Technique. However, Song Lan had only come from a Venerate Tier force. If she had really grasped an Imperial Technique, then her luck would be too nature-defying.
Even Ling Han had only mastered one style of the Demonic Monkey Fists, and the “An” character in the Six Characters Bright King Curse.

“Then, Saint Technique.” Ling Han settled for the next best thing. Though Song Lan did not come from the Holy Land, for a prodigy like herself, Ling Han would not find it strange if she had obtained a Saint Technique.
Song Lan shook her head, “I can teach you a palm technique of the fourth pinnacle level.”
“Hehe.” This time, it was Ling Han’s turn to roll his eyes. Though Venerate Tier-level palm techniques were also astonishingly valuable, they were clearly considerably inferior to divine
substances.
“Saint Technique,” he insisted.
“Impossible.” Song Lan did not give in either.
At this moment, it was naturally time to make an exorbitant bid, bargaining on the spot.
After a tug-of-war, Song Lan finally agreed to trade for an incomplete Saint Technique.
Ling Han also agreed, because it was impossible for him to drag things out for too long. Otherwise, if the divine substance was completely lost, he would not be able to get anything
out of it.
The two of them exchanged the goods. Ling Han obtained a jade piece, while Song Lan
obtained that stone.
Both sides immediately used their divine sense to scan the object in their hands, and both of
them smiled.
Very good, the other party had not played any tricks.
“Pleasure trading with you.” Song Lan smiled beautifully.
“Then give me a hug.” Ling Han spread open his arms.
Song Lan rolled her eyes at him before turning around to leave.
However, after taking a few steps, she stopped, turned around and glared harshly at Ling Han.
Then, she sped up and left.
Obviously, she had discovered the loss of divine substance, which made her feel regret. If she had known earlier, she could have ruthlessly bargained. The initiative was completely in her
hands.
Too bad, too unfortunate.
There was no time for her to argue with Ling Han. She had to refine the divine substance at the
first instant. Every second that passed was a massive waste.
Ling Han snickered, and he too turned around and left. However, he had just walked out of the small forest when he saw Liu Chuang.
This young prodigy’s expression was considerably ugly. Because he was worried, he had tailed
them, and thus waited outside the forest. In the end, not too long after, he saw Song Lan race
out, her expression sullen.
Obviously, Ling Han must have greatly offended this Celestial maiden, or even made some
inappropriate request.
This was really too despicable.
“Ling Han, you actually dare to blaspheme Fairy Song. Today, I will definitely not spare you,”
he said balefully.
Yi, what was he talking about?
Ling Han shook his head, “Has your brain gone muddled from fever?”
“Kneel!” Liu Chuang charged over, every move swift and fierce. He was going to beat Ling
Han to the ground.

He was extremely extraordinary. Before entering into the Mystery Realm, he had already ranked in the top 80 or so on the Galaxy Network. Now that the quality of the Celestial Cauldron had increased greatly, his battle prowess had naturally improved further. Perhaps, he could reach the top 60, or even the top 50.

chapters.title: Chapter 3886: Wind God Kick
paragraphs: However, it was a shame that even Lu Qi, the elite ranked 19th in the Galaxy Network, was no match for Ling Han, much less Liu Chuang.
That’s right. Galaxy Network battles and real-life battles were two different things.

The Galaxy Network Battles disregarded all external factors, such as Spirit Tool, Talisman Weapon, and so on. Thus, in a real battle, those who were ranked lower might be able to win against those who were ranked higher. However, the ranking of the former wouldn’t be too low either, especially when one had reached the level of Liu Chuang. The gap between them was definitely withing the range of ten rankings.
-Unless it was someone like Lin Qi, who could combust his Imperial Blood. That was too unique.
At the very least, Liu Chuang wasn’t from an Imperial Clan.

Thus, even if his abilities had improved greatly, he would still be helpless against Ling Han. He would not be able to use his full abilities at all, and very soon, Ling Han would be beating him down.
“Go!” Liu Chuang made his final struggle. He summoned the Celestial Cauldron, wanting to use the Celestial Cauldron to suppress Ling Han.
However, this was completely useless.
It was already enough that Ling Han didn’t use the Celestial Cauldron to suppress him. He still wanted to suppress Ling Han? What a joke!

Ling Han gave Liu Chuang a good beating, but did not intend to take his life. After all, there was no deep hatred between them. Furthermore, if he really showed killing intent, Liu Chuang would also be able to shatter his token and escape from the Mystery Realm.
But it was this kind of indifference that made Liu Chuang even more furious.
“I will definitely get my revenge!”

He was presently at Seven Cauldrons, and was only a sliver away from Eight Cauldrons. He was sure that when he advanced into Eight Cauldrons, with his Celestial Cauldron that surpassed the Golden Celestial Cauldron, he would definitely be able to suppress Ling Han.
Yet Ling Han did not take it to heart at all. After he returned to his tent, he began to study the Saint Technique that Song Lan had given him.
This was called Wind God Kick, and as the name implies, it was naturally a kicking technique. If one cultivated it to an absolute high level, he would be able to destroy planets with a single kick.
However, this Wind God Kick was an incomplete version, and was inferior to a Saint Technique by a whole lot, but it was much stronger than a technique of the fourth pinnacle level.
Ling Han began to study it.

A Saint Technique was a Saint Technique, and it was extraordinarily difficult to cultivate it. Furthermore, this was only an incomplete version. Its might was weaker, but it was even more difficult to understand, because there were a great many gaps that needed to be filled in with one’s own understanding.
But how could a Cauldron Forging Tier compare to the martial arts comprehension of a Saint?
Thus, cultivating this cultivation technique was extremely slow, and its might was even inferior.
However, as Ling Han’s cultivation level increased, he would naturally be able to repair the shortcomings of this Saint Technique, turning it into a true Saint Technique.
After spending a total of seven days, Ling Han finally grasped the basics.
With a thought, he began to study the Demonic Monkey Fists again.

There were a total of nine styles in the Demonic Monkey Fists, and he had only mastered one style. Moreover, he had only mastered it when he had been in the Foundation Building Tier. Now, not only had he advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier, he had already stood at the height of Six Cauldrons. Could he cultivate another style, or even two styles?
Ling Han began to comprehend. Imperial Techniques were definitely not something that could be attained through hard work. One could only comprehend them through hard work.
If he understood, he understood, and if he didn’t, he didn’t.

This was incredibly difficult. Ling Han’s advancement through the levels of the Demonic Monkey Fists was slow, but he revealed a joyful expression, because in the past, he did not have the slightest bit of hope. Now, though it was still slow, but he had a very high chance of cultivating the second form of the Demonic Monkey Fists.
Ling Han was filled with anticipation. This was an Imperial Technique.

He cultivated diligently for another three days, and decided to go out and relax. That was because he had encountered a bottleneck. It did not mean that he would definitely be able to comprehend it through hard cultivation. Thus, he might as well change his mood, and come back to comprehend it. Who knows, he would be able to comprehend it.
He had not taken too many steps, when he saw Song Lan.
Yi, he immediately discovered that the present Song Lan had changed. It was not in terms of appearance, but rather in terms of bearing.
She appeared even more ethereal. In layman’s terms, her Celestial Qi had become even heavier.
Obviously, not only had she refined the divine substance, she had also greatly improved the Celestial Cauldron, which was why there was such an obvious change in her bearing.
“Yo, my Little Lan Lan has become even more beautiful,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Song Lan merely looked at him quietly, and couldn’t even be bothered to bicker with him. This would greatly lower her class.
“Let’s spar for a while,” Song Lan said, appearing to be filled with confidence.
Her cultivation level had not changed much, but the quality of the Celestial Cauldron had increased greatly, which made her eager to give it a try.
“Sure.”
Ling Han nodded in understanding. He also wanted to test out the might of the Wind God Kick.

The two of them battled, and Ling Han immediately discovered that Song Lan’s strength had improved greatly. The quality of this Celestial Cauldron had increased, and the effect on her battle prowess was also immediately apparent.
However, Song Lan was even more stunned.

She was the one who had taught the Wind God Kick to Ling Han. Thus, she naturally knew it as well. With a comparison, she was very clear that Ling Han’s accomplishment in the Wind God Kick was already very, very high, and was not inferior to her at all.
This guy’s comprehension ability was also terrifying, wasn’t it?

In the past, when she had obtained this Saint Technique, she had spent a whole three months to master it. It could not be helped. The incomplete version was too difficult to learn, and this was already considered fast enough. In the Song Clan, the person with the second highest natural talent had spent a whole two years to be able to learn it.
However, compared to Ling Han, they were all trash.
This guy’s comprehension ability was practically freakish.
The two of them battled for a while, and then both of them stopped.
Ling Han had a whole new respect for this woman who was as beautiful as a fairy. Previously,
he had only thought that she was two-faced, but now, there was another impression, and that
she was an elite.
With a gap of two cauldrons, Song Lan was not inferior to him at all. Her battle prowess could be considered extremely shocking.
“Brother Ling’s strength and comprehension ability is truly astonishing,” Song Lan said with
a serious expression.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Little Lan Lan, have you been charmed by me? Decided that you
are not going to marry anyone but me?”
Yet Song Lan looked up at the skies, and said calmly, “My ideal husband would be like ‘Number One in the Galaxy’, breaking the records of all eternity, looking down on all past and
present.”
This!
Ling Han rubbed his nose. If it wasn’t for the fact that he had protected his own secrets very well, he would have suspected that this woman was deliberately expressing her affection for
him.
“Sigh, I really didn’t expect that you would actually have a crush on me.”
Song Lan chuckled, and couldn’t be bothered with a narcissistic guy like him. “To be honest with you, I’m Number One in the Galaxy,” Ling Han said with a smile.
If he hadn’t been so cheeky, perhaps Song Lan would have believed him a little. Now, however, she naturally felt that Ling Han was deliberately taking advantage of her.
Oh, I say, I admire this kind of man, and you say that you are Number One in the Galaxy. That would be too deliberate, too obvious, and too low-level.
Right at this moment, a member of the Zhou Clan walked over and said, “Young Master Ling,
the clan leader invites you over.”
Very simple, the Zhou Clan had mostly recovered, and could continue to sweep through the
Heavenly Clouds Mountains.
Fine, then let’s continue.
This time, their target was still a Beast King at the peak stage of the Core Formation Tier. This
was a large gorilla, but it also had a pair of wings on its back.
Tough to deal with.

In this place, Foundation Building Tiers, Cauldron Forging Tiers couldn’t fly on their weapons, and Core Formation Tiers couldn’t roam the heaven and earth with their physical bodies, as if there was something; lacking. However, those with wings weren’t included. This Gorilla King could fly, and this “gave it a boost”, making it even harder to deal with. This time, they didn’t dare to be careless anymore. Even outsiders were equipped with lightning spears. Although this wasn’t as powerful as the Heaven Hunting Crossbow, if many people attacked at the same time, its might would still be considerable.
Two days later, they found the lair of the Gorilla King.

Ling Han nodded in understanding.
He also wanted to test out the might of the Wind God Kick.
The two of them battled, and Ling Han immediately discovered that Song Lan’s strength had improved greatly.
The quality of this Celestial Cauldron had increased, and the effect on her battle prowess was also immediately apparent.
However, Song Lan was even more stunned.
She was the one who had taught the Wind God Kick to Ling Han.
Thus, she naturally knew it as well.
With a comparison, she was very clear that Ling Han’s accomplishment in the Wind God Kick was already very, very high, and was not inferior to her at all.
This guy’s comprehension ability was also terrifying, wasn’t it?
In the past, when she had obtained this Saint Technique, she had spent a whole three months to master it.
It could not be helped.
The incomplete version was too difficult to learn, and this was already considered fast enough.
In the Song Clan, the person with the second highest natural talent had spent a whole two years to be able to learn it.
However, compared to Ling Han, they were all trash.
This guy’s comprehension ability was practically freakish.
The two of them battled for a while, and then both of them stopped.
Ling Han had a whole new respect for this woman who was as beautiful as a fairy.
Previously,
he had only thought that she was two-faced, but now, there was another impression, and that
she was an elite.
With a gap of two cauldrons, Song Lan was not inferior to him at all.
Her battle prowess could be considered extremely shocking.
“Brother Ling’s strength and comprehension ability is truly astonishing,” Song Lan said with
a serious expression.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Little Lan Lan, have you been charmed by me?
Decided that you
are not going to marry anyone but me?”
Yet Song Lan looked up at the skies, and said calmly, “My ideal husband would be like ‘Number One in the Galaxy’, breaking the records of all eternity, looking down on all past and
present.”
This!
Ling Han rubbed his nose.
If it wasn’t for the fact that he had protected his own secrets very well, he would have suspected that this woman was deliberately expressing her affection for
him.
“Sigh, I really didn’t expect that you would actually have a crush on me.”
Song Lan chuckled, and couldn’t be bothered with a narcissistic guy like him.
“To be honest with you, I’m Number One in the Galaxy,” Ling Han said with a smile.
If he hadn’t been so cheeky, perhaps Song Lan would have believed him a little.
Now, however, she naturally felt that Ling Han was deliberately taking advantage of her.
Oh, I say, I admire this kind of man, and you say that you are Number One in the Galaxy.
That would be too deliberate, too obvious, and too low-level.
Right at this moment, a member of the Zhou Clan walked over and said, “Young Master Ling,
the clan leader invites you over.”
Very simple, the Zhou Clan had mostly recovered, and could continue to sweep through the
Heavenly Clouds Mountains.
Fine, then let’s continue.
This time, their target was still a Beast King at the peak stage of the Core Formation Tier.
This
was a large gorilla, but it also had a pair of wings on its back.
Tough to deal with.

In this place, Foundation Building Tiers, Cauldron Forging Tiers couldn’t fly on their weapons, and Core Formation Tiers couldn’t roam the heaven and earth with their physical bodies, as if there was something; lacking.
However, those with wings weren’t included.
This Gorilla King could fly, and this “gave it a boost”, making it even harder to deal with.
This time, they didn’t dare to be careless anymore.
Even outsiders were equipped with lightning spears.
Although this wasn’t as powerful as the Heaven Hunting Crossbow, if many people attacked at the same time, its might would still be considerable.
Two days later, they found the lair of the Gorilla King.

chapters.title: Chapter 3887: Tide of breakthroughs
paragraphs: This time, everyone was naturally even more careful.
If one didn’t learn his lesson after suffering once, how could such a person be worthy of living in such a dangerous world?

After the Gorilla King was drawn out, Ling Han shot out an arrow from his bow, directly exploding the left side of the large gorilla’s body. Then, everyone simultaneously used their lightning spears to attack, and added with the four Core Formation Tier cultivators restraining it, they actually managed to kill the Gorilla King at the price of the deaths of a mere three people.
This battle merit was truly astonishing, causing everyone to cheer endlessly.

After a short rest and reorganization, they began to search for the third Core Formation Tier Beast King these three Beast Kings occupied the most essence part of the Heavenly Cloud Mountain. Here, there were the largest number of Celestial medicines, and power of heaven and earth was the most concentrated, so they also grew near to one another.
The last Core Formation Tier Beast King was a giant python that was snow-white all over and several hundred meters long.
The hearing of snakes was extremely sharp, and this python was no exception. Before they surrounded it completely, it had already charged out, and began a massacre.

This python king was so colossal, so it naturally didn’t have any weaknesses. Ling Han aimed directly for its head, and shot out an arrow. Peng, the python’s head immediately exploded, but like a centipede, even if it was dead, it didn’t become stiff, what more when it was a vicious beast of the Core Formation Tier. The python’s eyes had turned into bloody holes, but it was still in a great killing spree, its temperament terrifyingly enduring.

Thankfully, its eyes were blind, and its ears were gone. At present, the python could only rely on its divine sense to sense the location of every single person. However, in a state of fury, its judgement would definitely be affected.

Everyone went all out. This giant python was too terrifying. One whiplash from its tail was enough to break a mountain rock, and if it was wrapped around a mountain, it would be able to forcibly shatter the mountain. If one was not careful, he would die.
After battling for two hours, the battle finally ended.

Unlike before, when the Beast King had been killed, and there was practically nothing left behind, the python’s damaged part was only its head, and the majority of its body was still unscathed. Thus, there was a large amount of vicious beast meat to be used.
The meat of a Core Formation Tier beast would definitely be extremely nutritious.
At night, everyone feasted to their heart’s content, and a full snake feast was held. With a bite of snake meat, they felt warm all over, and vitality diffused. It was indescribably refreshing.

On the spot, a few members of the Zhou Clan completed their breakthrough, leaping from the Foundation Building Tier to the Cauldron Forging Tier, and there was a “veteran” Cauldron Forging Tier whose cultivation level had loosened, probably breaking through to the Core Formation Tier in a few days’ time.
It couldn’t be helped. The people of this world simply cultivated faster.
The outsiders were all extremely envious, but when they thought about how the advancement of this kind of cultivation level would consume one’s life, it was enough to scare them off.
Right at this moment, a terrifying aura surged from one of them, causing the people in the surroundings to hurriedly leave.
Liu Chuang.
“Hiss, this guy is about to break through.”
“I heard that this guy has long since reached Seven Cauldrons. If he wants to break through again, then it would either be Eight Cauldrons, or it would be the Core Formation Tier.”

“It shouldn’t be the Core Formation Tier. Stepping into the Core Formation Tier is a qualitative leap, and although his aura is terrifying now, he still hasn’t crossed that line.” “En, he should be about to advance into Eight Cauldrons.”

“Actually, this is even more terrifying, because it is a sure bet that a prodigy like him would be able to break through to the Core Formation Tier. Then, breaking through from Seven Cauldrons is a completely different concept than breaking through from Eight Cauldrons.” “That’s right. In future, among the top prodigies, there should be a place for him.”
“Sigh, obtaining divine substance to improve the quality of the Celestial Cauldron is already a great fortune. And now, he has actually advanced into Eight Cauldrons. How am I supposed to live?”

Everyone was exclaiming in shock, and some people’s eyes were flickering. Should they secretly make a move to ruin Liu Chuang’s breakthrough this time? Then, even if Liu Chuang could still find an opportunity in future, that could possibly be a matter of a few years later. For top-notch prodigies, could they afford a few years of difference?
Xiu, Liu Chuang’s figure flashed, and instantly disappeared into the horizon.

He wasn’t stupid, so how could he possibly break through here? Previously, after consuming the python’s meat, his cultivation that had already reached the critical point had obtained an opportunity to break through. Now that he had grasped this opportunity, he naturally had to find an uninhabited place to break through.
No one pursued him. That would be too obvious.
Meanwhile, Ling Han asked for a large amount of python meat from the Zhou Clan. He wanted to concoct the Spiritual Movement Pill.

This could increase one’s cultivation level, and the raw ingredients were the meat of a vicious beast and Celestial medicine. The combination was a little casual, and different grades of Vicious Beast Meat and Celestial medicine would affect the effects of the alchemical pill. A beast king of the Core Formation Tier, wasn’t it awesome? Of course it was. Add to that the Celestial medicines that he had harvested a few days ago, and there just happened to be a few that were suitable for concoction. Thus, Ling Han immediately began concocting alchemical pills.
He had only failed once, and Ling Han had concocted three cauldrons of Spiritual Movement Pills in a single go.
He took out a pill and ingested it. Instantly, the energy in his body surged like the tide.

Ling Han smiled. In the first place, he was only a sliver away from the peak stage of Six Cauldrons. If he ingested the Spiritual Movement Pill every day, he would probably only need three to four days to cultivate to the consummate level of Six Cauldrons.

It just so happened that the team also needed to rest and reorganize. Furthermore, the three most troublesome peak stage Core Formation Tier Demonic Beasts had already been killed, and the remaining three Demonic Beasts would definitely be much easier to deal with. Ling Han ingested a Spiritual Movement Pill every day, and by the fourth day, he had already reached consummate level of Six Cauldrons.
All right, he began to charge towards Seven Cauldrons.
Ling Han left quietly, finding a cave. Then, he sealed the cave entrance, sat cross-legged inside, and began to charge towards Seven Cauldrons.

He still didn’t feel like he had reached a bottleneck. Everything went smoothly, and two days later, he found the trigger for his breakthrough. He ingested a few drops of Earth Spirit Milk, then began to condense the Celestial Cauldron’s core.
At this moment, he finally felt pressure.
-The other six cauldrons had developed a repelling effect on the new Celestial Cauldron, but the repelling effect was not strong. Thus, he still managed to form the core of the seventh
cauldron very smoothly.
However, if he wanted to condense the eighth cauldron, the pressure would probably increase considerably, and the ninth cauldron would undoubtedly be even more difficult.
He had to hurry up and obtain the celestial light. Otherwise, when he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, he would no longer be able to absorb the celestial light, and cultivate divine
light.
Another two hours later, the seventh cauldron was completed. It floated in his mind. It had clearly just formed, but it had an ancient feel to it, as if it could connect the past, present, and
future.
Peng, Ling Han blasted open the rock, and strode out.
He was Seven Cauldrons now; what other Cauldron Forging Tier in the world was a match for
him?
He returned to the camp, only to see two people calling out at the same time.
“Ling Han, hurry up and leave. Liu Chuang is here to challenge you to a duel!” “Young Master Ling, hurry up and meet the clan leader. He’s been looking for you for several
days.”
Huh, one wanted him to leave, and the other told him not to leave. Who would he listen to? Ling Han naturally wouldn’t listen to either of them. He had his own ideas.
Liu Chuang?
Oh, he had broken through to Eight Cauldrons, and thought that he could be invincible now.
Hehe.
Ling Han was completely unconcerned, and said to the members of the Zhou Clan, “I need to take a bath first, and after I’m done, I’ll go back to see Zhou Mi.”
That member of the Zhou Clan opened his mouth to speak, but could not speak. Now, they still had to depend on Ling Han, so he definitely could not afford to offend him.
