chapters.title: Chapter 3888: Merely a single strike
paragraphs: Ling Han leisurely took a bath, then changed into clean clothes, and only then did he walk out of the tent.
However, Liu Chuang was waiting outside, and there were still some outsiders behind him.
‘Heh, are you here to watch the excitement?’

Liu Chuang was proud, and the haze of his previous defeat to Ling Han was swept away. This was natural. He had broken through to Eight Cauldrons, and added with the fact that the Celestial Cauldron had surpassed the level of Gold, he naturally had explosive confidence, and thought that he was invincible in this world.
“Ling Han, kneel!” he shouted coldly.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. “You’ve only broken through to Eight Cauldrons. What, you think you’re invincible in this world?”
Everyone shook their heads, thinking that Ling Han was too confident.
Just how wide was the gap between Seven Cauldrons and Eight Cauldrons?

In terms of the Galaxy Network’s ranking, a Seven Cauldrons was roughly between 50 and 100, while an Eight Cauldrons was between 10 and 50-only supreme prodigies who had formed nine cauldrons could squeeze into the top 10.
Unfortunately, no one in the North Heavenly Realm managed to form nine cauldrons, so naturally, no one managed to squeeze into the top ten.

It was said that after attaining Nine Cauldrons, when battling, the nine Celestial Cauldrons would appear at the same time, possessing great might. There was no need for them to make a move at all, and they would be able to make elites of Eight Cauldrons fall to the ground.
This was a digression.

Since the North Heavenly Realm didn’t have supreme elites with nine cauldrons, then Eight Cauldrons was the highest grade. At least in the area of the North Heavenly Realm, that was indeed invincible in their cultivation level.
Liu Chuang laughed in spite of himself. He shook his head, “You are just an ant, so how would you know how strong Eight Cauldrons is!”
Ling Han crooked a finger at him, “Come, I will teach you how to behave!”

“Ling Han, you are too arrogant!” Liu Chuang strode towards Ling Han. One after another, the Celestial Cauldrons channelled out. It looked like pure gold, yet had a kind of jade-like halo, which was extremely beautiful.
However, as the Celestial Cauldron shook lightly, everyone’s expressions changed.
This was too terrifying. One after another, vicious auras surged out, causing a chill to rise up from the bottom of one’s heart.

This was the Celestial Cauldron that had surpassed the Golden Celestial Cauldron. Furthermore, it was eight cauldrons at that. With the two added together, it was as if Liu Chuang had become an invincible god.
“The current Liu Chuang, what position can he charge up to on the Galaxy Network rankings?”
“I think that even Lu Qi is not that strong.”
“Hiss, then wouldn’t that be in the top twenty, at least?”
“Naturally. Eight Cauldrons is already not inferior to Lu Qi, what more when Liu Chuang’s Celestial Cauldron has advanced another step further?”
“Golden Jade Celestial Cauldron, he has advanced to a higher level!”
Everyone sighed ruefully. Even those who had personally witnessed Ling Han defeat Lu Qi felt that he did not have much of a chance of winning.
That was because Liu Chuang was really too strong.
Liu Chuang walked very slowly, like a cat toying with a mouse. He wanted Ling Han to
experience that deep chill, and only then would he be defeated by him in public, and be looked at with disdain by everyone.
“Submit!” he declared proudly.
Ling Han smiled, and raised his right hand, “To defeat you, I only need one move.”
Arrogant, he was really too arrogant.
Liu Chuang took a deep breath. He planned to use his strongest ultimate move to defeat Ling Han in a single strike.
Right at this moment, Ling Han tapped him lightly.
Zi!
A flash of lightning shot out, its speed ridiculously fast.
Then, Liu Chuang was sent flying. Peng, he blasted a hole into a mountain in the distance, and then disappeared within.
Sand and rocks filled the air, and dust flew into the sky.
Everyone was dumbfounded, staring numbly at Ling Han’s right hand.
With just a snap of his fingers, Liu Chuang was sent flying.
F***, you are too freakish, aren’t you?
That was Eight Cauldrons!
Even Eight Cauldrons was no match for Ling Han. Hiss, could it be that Ling Han was Nine Cauldrons?

—Just think, when Ling Han was still at Six Cauldrons, he was already capable of fighting Lu Qi, who was at Eight Cauldrons, to a tie. Now, not only had he advanced into Seven Cauldrons, the divine light of lightning could match an Imperial Technique.

Thus, even though Ling Han had only snapped his fingers lightly, it was no different from using his full strength to blast out the Demonic Monkey Fists. How difficult would it be to defeat Liu Chuang with a single move?
‘That’s right!’
Thinking of the Demonic Monkey Fists, Ling Han suddenly came to a realization. He turned around and returned to his tent to begin comprehending.
This...
Everyone was speechless. He had defeated an Eight Cauldrons, and actually returned to his tent as if nothing had happened. Just how much did he not take Liu Chuang to heart?
This time, Liu Chuang was truly asking for his own humiliation. Not only had he failed to defeat Ling Han, he had instead been ruthlessly humiliated.
He did not even treat him as a rival!
Only an hour later, Ling Han suddenly erupted into loud laughter.
He had finally grasped the second form of the Demonic Monkey Fists!
This made him very excited, because this was an Imperial Technique.

He mulled over it carefully. The two styles of Demonic Monkey Fists were connected from the beginning to the end. If they were used separately, then the might of the first style and the second style would not be much different. However, if they were used together, the might of the second style would be double that of the first style.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel expectant. Then what if he used three or four styles consecutively, or even nine styles in fact? Could the might still be stacked like this?
“Ling Han!” At this moment, an impatient shout was heard from outside.
Ling Han opened his tent and saw that it was Zhou Miyang who was standing outside.
“Why aren’t you calling me uncle?” Ling Han asked calmly.
His relationship with Zhou Mi was one of equals, so it was disrespectful for Zhou Miyang to address him directly by name.
Zhou Miyang humphed, naturally extremely displeased, but when he recalled his father’s instructions, he still lowered his head, and said, “My father has been waiting for you for a
very long time.”
“Oh.”
Ling Han nodded, and did not explain, nor did he say anything to apologize, which made Zhou
Miyang even more furious.
They went to see Zhou Mi. In truth, it was not a big deal. The Zhou Clan had already reorganized themselves, and they could continue to sweep through the remaining three
Demonic Beasts.
The sixth beast king was a late stage Core Formation Tier great beast. Of course, it wasn’t easy
to deal with either. More importantly, it would also summon its lackeys, attracting beast tides all over the mountains and plains.
Though this beast king was very quickly killed, the beast tide had already formed, and still caused great damage.
Right, this time, they needed more time to recover.
Ling Han walked in the mountains. He was searching for divine substance. This time, he definitely wouldn’t open it again. Instead, he would store it away for the empress, Hu Niu,
and the others.
Of course, he wouldn’t complain about having too much of such good stuff.
Don’t say, Ling Han’s luck was really not bad. After roaming around in the mountains for
three days, he actually found two portions of divine substance. If this was known to others, they would definitely die of envy.

Everyone more or less had some gains. Some had obtained Celestial medicines, while others had obtained divine substances, but no one had obtained the even more precious celestial light aside from Ling Han, but this had not been obtained from the Heavenly Clouds
Mountain.
After resting for a few days, the sweep continued.
After a battle, everyone practically did not expend any energy.

“Continue, kill the last beast king, and the Heavenly Clouds Mountains will be completely cleared,” Zhou Mi said. This was the long-cherished wish of more than ten generations of the Zhou Clan. Now, it was only a sliver away from being fulfilled, which naturally excited the members of the Zhou Clan, though they had also paid the price of several hundred lives for it. Zhou Miyang glanced at Ling Han, and a smile appeared at the corners of his lips. However, it was filled with killing intent. Thus, he quickly withdrew his smile. Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I’ll leave the final beast king to you guys.”

There was no need for them to make a move at all, and they would be able to make elites of Eight Cauldrons fall to the ground.
This was a digression.
Since the North Heavenly Realm didn’t have supreme elites with nine cauldrons, then Eight Cauldrons was the highest grade.
At least in the area of the North Heavenly Realm, that was indeed invincible in their cultivation level.
Liu Chuang laughed in spite of himself.
He shook his head, “You are just an ant, so how would you know how strong Eight Cauldrons is!”
Ling Han crooked a finger at him, “Come, I will teach you how to behave!”
“Ling Han, you are too arrogant!” Liu Chuang strode towards Ling Han.
One after another, the Celestial Cauldrons channelled out.
It looked like pure gold, yet had a kind of jade-like halo, which was extremely beautiful.
However, as the Celestial Cauldron shook lightly, everyone’s expressions changed.
This was too terrifying.
One after another, vicious auras surged out, causing a chill to rise up from the bottom of one’s heart.
This was the Celestial Cauldron that had surpassed the Golden Celestial Cauldron.
Furthermore, it was eight cauldrons at that.
With the two added together, it was as if Liu Chuang had become an invincible god.
“The current Liu Chuang, what position can he charge up to on the Galaxy Network rankings?”
“I think that even Lu Qi is not that strong.”
“Hiss, then wouldn’t that be in the top twenty, at least?”
“Naturally.
Eight Cauldrons is already not inferior to Lu Qi, what more when Liu Chuang’s Celestial Cauldron has advanced another step further?”
“Golden Jade Celestial Cauldron, he has advanced to a higher level!”
Everyone sighed ruefully.
Even those who had personally witnessed Ling Han defeat Lu Qi felt that he did not have much of a chance of winning.
That was because Liu Chuang was really too strong.
Liu Chuang walked very slowly, like a cat toying with a mouse.
He wanted Ling Han to
experience that deep chill, and only then would he be defeated by him in public, and be looked at with disdain by everyone.
“Submit!” he declared proudly.
Ling Han smiled, and raised his right hand, “To defeat you, I only need one move.”
Arrogant, he was really too arrogant.
Liu Chuang took a deep breath.
He planned to use his strongest ultimate move to defeat Ling Han in a single strike.
Right at this moment, Ling Han tapped him lightly.
Zi!
A flash of lightning shot out, its speed ridiculously fast.
Then, Liu Chuang was sent flying.
Peng, he blasted a hole into a mountain in the distance, and then disappeared within.
Sand and rocks filled the air, and dust flew into the sky.
Everyone was dumbfounded, staring numbly at Ling Han’s right hand.
With just a snap of his fingers, Liu Chuang was sent flying.
F***, you are too freakish, aren’t you?
That was Eight Cauldrons!
Even Eight Cauldrons was no match for Ling Han.
Hiss, could it be that Ling Han was Nine Cauldrons?
—Just think, when Ling Han was still at Six Cauldrons, he was already capable of fighting Lu Qi, who was at Eight Cauldrons, to a tie.
Now, not only had he advanced into Seven Cauldrons, the divine light of lightning could match an Imperial Technique.
Thus, even though Ling Han had only snapped his fingers lightly, it was no different from using his full strength to blast out the Demonic Monkey Fists.
How difficult would it be to defeat Liu Chuang with a single move?
‘That’s right!’
Thinking of the Demonic Monkey Fists, Ling Han suddenly came to a realization.
He turned around and returned to his tent to begin comprehending.
This...
Everyone was speechless.
He had defeated an Eight Cauldrons, and actually returned to his tent as if nothing had happened.
Just how much did he not take Liu Chuang to heart?
This time, Liu Chuang was truly asking for his own humiliation.
Not only had he failed to defeat Ling Han, he had instead been ruthlessly humiliated.
He did not even treat him as a rival!
Only an hour later, Ling Han suddenly erupted into loud laughter.
He had finally grasped the second form of the Demonic Monkey Fists!
This made him very excited, because this was an Imperial Technique.
He mulled over it carefully.
The two styles of Demonic Monkey Fists were connected from the beginning to the end.
If they were used separately, then the might of the first style and the second style would not be much different.
However, if they were used together, the might of the second style would be double that of the first style.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel expectant.
Then what if he used three or four styles consecutively, or even nine styles in fact?
Could the might still be stacked like this?
“Ling Han!” At this moment, an impatient shout was heard from outside.
Ling Han opened his tent and saw that it was Zhou Miyang who was standing outside.
“Why aren’t you calling me uncle?” Ling Han asked calmly.
His relationship with Zhou Mi was one of equals, so it was disrespectful for Zhou Miyang to address him directly by name.
Zhou Miyang humphed, naturally extremely displeased, but when he recalled his father’s instructions, he still lowered his head, and said, “My father has been waiting for you for a
very long time.”
“Oh.”
Ling Han nodded, and did not explain, nor did he say anything to apologize, which made Zhou
Miyang even more furious.
They went to see Zhou Mi.
In truth, it was not a big deal.
The Zhou Clan had already reorganized themselves, and they could continue to sweep through the remaining three
Demonic Beasts.
The sixth beast king was a late stage Core Formation Tier great beast.
Of course, it wasn’t easy
to deal with either.
More importantly, it would also summon its lackeys, attracting beast tides all over the mountains and plains.
Though this beast king was very quickly killed, the beast tide had already formed, and still caused great damage.
Right, this time, they needed more time to recover.
Ling Han walked in the mountains.
He was searching for divine substance.
This time, he definitely wouldn’t open it again.
Instead, he would store it away for the empress, Hu Niu,
and the others.
Of course, he wouldn’t complain about having too much of such good stuff.
Don’t say, Ling Han’s luck was really not bad.
After roaming around in the mountains for
three days, he actually found two portions of divine substance.
If this was known to others, they would definitely die of envy.
Everyone more or less had some gains.

Some had obtained Celestial medicines, while others had obtained divine substances, but no one had obtained the even more precious celestial light aside from Ling Han, but this had not been obtained from the Heavenly Clouds
Mountain.
After resting for a few days, the sweep continued.
After a battle, everyone practically did not expend any energy.
“Continue, kill the last beast king, and the Heavenly Clouds Mountains will be completely cleared,” Zhou Mi said.
This was the long-cherished wish of more than ten generations of the Zhou Clan.
Now, it was only a sliver away from being fulfilled, which naturally excited the members of the Zhou Clan, though they had also paid the price of several hundred lives for it.
Zhou Miyang glanced at Ling Han, and a smile appeared at the corners of his lips.
However, it was filled with killing intent.
Thus, he quickly withdrew his smile.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I’ll leave the final beast king to you guys.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3889: Showdown
paragraphs: “Young friend Ling, what is the meaning of this?” Zhou Mi frowned.

Ling Han spread his hands and said, “The last Beast King is the weakest in terms of abilities. It’s at the early stage of Core Formation Tier, and its battle prowess is only at the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, at most. With the strength of Clan leader Zhou and the others, taking it down is absolutely no problem.”

“Hehe, young friend’s words are incorrect. Ferocious beasts have no intelligence, and under a life-or-death counterattack, even we would inevitably be injured. Hence, we still have to depend on young friend’s help,” Zhou Mi said with a smile.
“So that’s how it is.” Ling Han nodded.
“Young friend, there is only one last step left. Please continue.” Zhou Mi said seriously.
Ling Han nodded, “Alright, bring the Heaven Hunting Crossbow over.”
Instantly, the members of the Zhou Clan all fell silent.
After a while, after careful consideration, he forced a smile and said, “The Heaven Hunting Crossbow is currently being calibrated. There’s no hurry, right?”
“I’m not in a rush either,” Ling Han said with a nod. “I’ll move out whenever the crossbow is delivered.”
“Ling Han, what’s the meaning of this!” Zhou Miyang couldn’t help but rebuke.

“Nephew, you have to be respectful to your elders.” Ling Han looked towards Zhou Miyang. Zhou Miyang trembled in anger. Brat, do you really think that you are some mighty figure? “Young friend, it would be better for you to set out first. In any case, searching for beast kings would need time,” he advised carefully.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “I fear that if I set out now, I would really be on my way!”
“Young friend, why do you say such words?” Zhou Mi was surprised, as if he had suffered a great shock.
Ling Han shook his head, “Clan leader Zhou, your words are meaningless.”
He suddenly lashed out with his palm. Pa! Zhou Miyang was instantly sent flying.
This was too sudden, and no one had expected it. However, after the slap, all the members of the Zhou Clan stood up angrily, and glared furiously at Ling Han.
“What is the meaning of this, young friend?” Zhou Mi was still very calm, but the veins throbbing on his hands showed that his heart was actually not as calm as his expression.

Ling Han chuckled, and said, “I was thinking that if the Beast King appeared when I went to hunt down the last Demonic Beast, but you people didn’t give me the Heaven Hunting Crossbow, then wouldn’t I have died at the fangs of a Demonic Beast?”
When these words fell, the expressions of all the members of the Zhou Clan changed.
Zhou Mi carefully forced out a smile, “Young friend, you really know how to make wild guesses. How is this possible?”
“Thus, it would be best to give the Heaven Hunting Crossbow to me first, so as to calm my heart,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Young friend, please believe us!” Zhou Mi advised earnestly, his expression sincere. Ling Han’s expression was also sincere, “Clan leader Zhou, please believe me as well.”

Zhou Mi didn’t know how to continue. This brat was so young, but how could he be so slick? He would not accept gentle persuasion, nor did he fear threats; he was too hard to deal with. Ling Han smiled and said, “Previously, someone reminded me not to count money for others after being sold. I thought about it, and it made sense. For an upright and pure young man like me, it’s too easy to be deceived. I have to be more careful.”
Hearing these words, the members of the Zhou Clan all wanted to slap him.
And you call yourself upright and pure?
This was practically insulting to the words.

Ling Han, meanwhile, was completely unconcerned, and continued, “The Zhou Clan has Core Formation Tier martial artists, and as long as the wild beasts are all eliminated, you guys would be the masters. However, I am an exception, and am completely immune to your attacks. Thus, you guys are naturally very wary of me. Furthermore, hoho, half of the outputs from the Heavenly Clouds Mountain, so how could you surrender such a colossal wealth to someone else?”
“If it was me, my heart would also ache. I have to think of some way to kill this person.” “That’s simple. Even if you guys can’t kill them, aren’t there still ferocious beasts?”
“Am I right? I’m only a Cauldron Forging Tier. As long as a vicious beast of the Core Formation Tier comes, it’ll be able to easily kill me. Then, you guys can kill that final beast king. Perfect.”

“That’s why you placed the weakest beast king at the end and decided to use it to kill me. Even if you didn’t have the Heaven Hunting Crossbow, it wouldn’t be difficult for you to kill that beast king, right?”
When they heard Ling Han’s words, the members of the Zhou Clan all looked as if they had seen a ghost.
Could it be that it was a traitor that had told Ling Han about their plans? Otherwise, how could it be that Ling Han was not wrong at all?
However, how could they know that Ling Han had lived for so many years, and had seen all kinds of schemes and plots?

Conversely, though the Zhou Clan had four Core Formation Tier elites, they were limited by their hundred years of lifespan. With merely a few dozen years of experience, they still wanted to deceive Ling Han?
What a joke.
Since things had already come to this, there was no point in explaining any further.

Zhou Mi laughed loudly, “Young friend, you are really smart. That’s right, this is indeed our plan. Now, even if you know, so what? Seven beast kings have already fallen, and even without your help, we would still be able to kill the last one.”
“That’s right. I indeed can’t change the general trend.” Ling Han nodded, not angered at all, “However, if I want to beat up some people, or even kill some people in fact, who would be
able to stop me?”
Ling Han glared at Zhou Miyang, his killing intent on full display.
Zhou Mi carefully leaped out at the first instant, holding Zhou Miyang under his ribs. With his cultivation level of the Core Formation Tier, it was enough to protect his son.

Ling Han broke into a smile, “Does Clan leader Zhou intend to keep your son in your arms from now onwards? Furthermore, your son has not had a child yet, and Clan leader Zhou wants to watch from the sidelines when your son consummates his marriage?”
F***, so ruthless!
He couldn’t help but tremble slightly. One could only be a thief for a thousand days, but how could he be on guard for a thousand days?
There would always come times of carelessness. Could it be that he would have to be a conjoined infant with his son for the rest of his life?
Moreover, Zhou Miyang was not the only junior in the Zhou Clan. What about the others?

If there was anyone to blame, it would be Ling Han’s ability that was too strange, that even the four of them, the Core Formation Tier cultivators, could do nothing against him. Otherwise, there would have been no need to use the move of borrowing a wild beast to kill
him.
“I can’t possibly give the Heaven Hunting Crossbow to you,” Zhou Mi said after a moment of silence. Otherwise, Ling Han would have the ability to destroy the entire Zhou Clan.
He pondered for a moment, then continued, “I can give you 10% of the gains from the
Heavenly Clouds Mountain.”
Ling Han shook his head. “50%.”
“Impossible.” Zhou Mi shook his head, “There are so many people in our Zhou Clan, so how
could we possibly share half with you?”
Ling Han immediately moved. Zi, lightning flashed, and a junior of the Zhou Clan was directly
killed.
“You!” The members of the Zhou Clan all pointed angrily at Ling Han.
“Heh, to you people who want to kill me, it’s already very kind of me to be able to calmly
converse with you people here, and you still want to renege on what you rightfully owe me?” Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “One has to have integrity. If it’s your own words, you have
to do it even if you have to kneel!”
The members of the Zhou Clan were all enraged, yet were rendered speechless.
Could they do anything against Ling Han?
They couldn’t do anything to him.
And what about Ling Han?
Aside from the four Core Formation Tier elites of the Zhou Clan, no one else was a match for
him.
Thus, the Zhou Clan had to bow their heads.
“All right, I’ll give you half the profits!” Zhou Mi made a prompt decision.
Ling Han cracked a smile, then waved his hand, “Then, you guys have worked hard. Work
hard, I’m rooting for you!”
As for the last beast king, he would leave it to the Zhou Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 3890: Black Heaven Temple
paragraphs: Ling Han continued to roam around the Heavenly Clouds Mountain, searching for opportunities.
Unfortunately, though the Heavenly Clouds Mountain was huge, there was no trace of the celestial light anywhere.
Several days later, Ling Han returned to the Zhou Clan.

At this time, of course, all the beast kings had been cleaned out. Though the Zhou Clan had paid an exorbitant price, their gains were also very shocking. There were Celestial medicines, and a large number of dead beasts. These were all cultivation resources.
Ling Han directly took half. This made the Zhou Clan furious, but there was nothing they could do.
The outsiders were also envious, but even Li Chuang, an Eight Cauldrons, was no match for Ling Han. Which of them was a match for Ling Han?
Ling Han waited for a few more days, wanting to see if the empress and the others would come over, but ten days later, there was still no sign of the empress, Hu Niu, or the large black dog.
Helpless, he could only leave. He could still overlook the divine substance and Celestial medicine, but he was determined to get the celestial light.
He was sure that there were not many such treasures in the whole Mystery Realm, so he had to hurry.
Ling Han crossed over the Heavenly Clouds Mountain and entered into the Demonic Origin Region.
This was a vast place, and there were even more elites of martial arts here. The Zhou Clan wasn’t the only force with Core Formation Tier elites.
Ling Han kept a very low profile. Two days later, he arrived at a small town.

The members of the Zhou Clan had already fought their way here, and successfully occupied this place. Next, the Zhou Clan would first slow down, and use this as a stronghold to step onto the stage of the Demonic Origin Realm.
Ling Han first went to gather information about the Demonic Origin Realm. Where was it possible that a celestial light would appear?
The dissemination of information here was quite fast. A force would release a book on important current events every three days, describing the major events that had happened recently.

Ling Han bought a book, and flipped through it. He discovered that recently, a great many outsiders had entered into the Demonic Origin Realm. Of course, they did not just pass through the Heavenly Clouds Mountains, but also border areas like this.
Sure enough, the Heavenly Clouds Mountain wasn’t the only entrance.
Ling Han looked carefully again, searching for any traces of the celestial light.
Yi, there really was.

The mysterious Black Heaven Temple appeared once more, and according to legends, there was a blazing light of death in the temple. Any living creature that approached would be turned into a dried corpse.
What kind of place was the Black Heaven Temple?

Ling Han rummaged through the information again. He had really found it. This Black Heaven Temple had always belonged to the category of legends. Everyone thought that it was a fabrication, because no one in history had ever seen it before. It was said that it represented death, but there was also a Black Divine Willow that would bear a Divine Tree Heart. If one ate it, it could extend one’s lifespan by a hundred years.
A hundred years of lifespan was completely negligible to outsiders.

Because Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators theoretically possessed a lifespan of as long as two thousand years, extending their lifespan by a hundred years only increased it by five percent. Moreover, those who entered this space were mostly young people, so they were far from worrying about their lifespans running out. Thus, being able to extend their lifespan by a hundred years was naturally a good thing, but it wasn’t so urgent that they would risk their lives for it.
However, for natives, extending their lifespan by a hundred years was enough to drive anyone crazy.
That was because everyone here only had a lifespan of about a hundred years. If they could eat the Divine Tree Heart, it was equivalent to being able to live another life. Who would not be tempted?

“Extending one’s lifespan by a hundred years isn’t important to me. What’s important is the light of death. Is it some kind of celestial light?” Ling Han murmured to himself. “However, when I go to the Black Heaven Temple, I’ll definitely encounter the natives here. Extending one’s lifespan by a hundred years is too important to them. There’ll definitely be a huge battle.”

There was no shortage of elites of the Core Formation Tier here. Though Ling Han had forced the Core Formation Tier elites of the Zhou Clan to the points that they could only watch helplessly, that was a special circumstance.
“If I reach the Nine Cauldrons, who knows, I might be able to fight an early stage Core Formation Tier cultivator, but I definitely won’t be able to now.”
“Even so, I have to make this trip.”
The celestial light was too important. After refining them, it could form divine light, and their might was comparable to an Imperial Technique. This definitely could not be missed.

“The Black Heaven Temple is... over 350 km north of here.” Ling Han continued to look through the information, “That place was originally a swamp, but four days ago, a completely black temple appeared. There was a black-colored light shining, and then someone discovered a large black temple.”
“This is very similar to the legendary Black Heaven Temple, so it caused a commotion.”

Ling Han set out in a flash, heading towards the Black Heaven Temple. He was sure that whether it was the local cultivators or outsider adventurers, the number of people going would be considerably shocking. Thus, he had to hurry. Furthermore, a great battle was definitely inevitable.
After only half an hour, Ling Han arrived at the swamp. However, the following journey was extremely difficult.

Because there would occasionally be terrifying winds blowing over the swamp, possessing boundless destructive power, even those in the Core Formation Tier could only be easily torn apart. Thus, even if Ling Han could fly on his Tool, he could only travel on foot here. However, the ground was not necessarily safe either, because there were fierce beasts hidden in the swamp. Occasionally, they would break through the mud and rush out to attack.

Ling Han had not yet entered into the swamp, when he saw a ship sailing over. This ship was not driven in the swamp, but had rather sailed over from behind. It was not a warship, but was rather sailing on the ground. Strangely, this ship should have been astonishingly heavy, but as it made its way here, there was not the slightest trace left behind.

The ship was nine meters tall, and at this moment, there were two young people standing at the bow of the ship. They were both men. After discovering Ling Han, they pointed in Ling Han’s direction, and saw that the large ship had actually changed direction, crashing towards
Ling Han.

Ling Han was astonished. ‘There’s no animosity between us, so what’s the meaning of this?’ He had seen a considerable number of profligate young masters, and quite a few of them had been tyrannical and domineering, but he had never encountered one as deranged as this.
He was not the type to be willing to take a loss. Immediately, he raised his fist and threw a
punch.

“How dare you!” A furious roar rang out from the ship, and a figure leaped out of the ship. With a sweep of his palm, the force of Ling Han’s punch was instantly dispersed. That person did not stop because of this. Instead, he charged towards Ling Han again.
“What a vicious evil brat, die!” That person waved his palm again, and an incredibly deep
palm strike surged over, like a vast ocean.
This was a Core Formation Tier cultivator.

As expected, they were all in the same family. These two despicable young masters were completely condescending. As an elder, he was not afraid to give way at all. He did not even ask about the injustice, and immediately came up to commit murder.
Ling Han used Imminent Skyline, and dodged this palm strike.
After advancing into Seven Cauldrons, his speed increased to another level, and he was
already capable of matching Core Formation Tier.

“Yi, what a fast movement technique!” That person appeared slightly surprised. He had never imagined that a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator would actually be able to burst out with such speed, but this naturally could not possibly scare him off.
“However, if you want to escape from me, Tong Yongning, you’re dreaming!”
That person was a tall and sturdy man who looked to be in his early forties. His face was
rough, and his eyes were like copper bells, exuding a strong murderous aura.
He set off in quick pursuit of Ling Han.
Ling Han humphed. Did they really think that he was an easy target to bully?
He pointed at the large ship, and instantly, the power of lightning was activated. Zi, a bolt of
lightning shot out at an indescribable speed.

Unfortunately, though the Heavenly Clouds Mountain was huge, there was no trace of the celestial light anywhere.
Several days later, Ling Han returned to the Zhou Clan.
At this time, of course, all the beast kings had been cleaned out.
Though the Zhou Clan had paid an exorbitant price, their gains were also very shocking.
There were Celestial medicines, and a large number of dead beasts.
These were all cultivation resources.
Ling Han directly took half.
This made the Zhou Clan furious, but there was nothing they could do.
The outsiders were also envious, but even Li Chuang, an Eight Cauldrons, was no match for Ling Han.
Which of them was a match for Ling Han?
Ling Han waited for a few more days, wanting to see if the empress and the others would come over, but ten days later, there was still no sign of the empress, Hu Niu, or the large black dog.
Helpless, he could only leave.
He could still overlook the divine substance and Celestial medicine, but he was determined to get the celestial light.
He was sure that there were not many such treasures in the whole Mystery Realm, so he had to hurry.
Ling Han crossed over the Heavenly Clouds Mountain and entered into the Demonic Origin Region.
This was a vast place, and there were even more elites of martial arts here.
The Zhou Clan wasn’t the only force with Core Formation Tier elites.
Ling Han kept a very low profile.
Two days later, he arrived at a small town.
The members of the Zhou Clan had already fought their way here, and successfully occupied this place.
Next, the Zhou Clan would first slow down, and use this as a stronghold to step onto the stage of the Demonic Origin Realm.
Ling Han first went to gather information about the Demonic Origin Realm.
Where was it possible that a celestial light would appear?
The dissemination of information here was quite fast.
A force would release a book on important current events every three days, describing the major events that had happened recently.
Ling Han bought a book, and flipped through it.
He discovered that recently, a great many outsiders had entered into the Demonic Origin Realm.
Of course, they did not just pass through the Heavenly Clouds Mountains, but also border areas like this.
Sure enough, the Heavenly Clouds Mountain wasn’t the only entrance.
Ling Han looked carefully again, searching for any traces of the celestial light.
Yi, there really was.
The mysterious Black Heaven Temple appeared once more, and according to legends, there was a blazing light of death in the temple.
Any living creature that approached would be turned into a dried corpse.
What kind of place was the Black Heaven Temple?
Ling Han rummaged through the information again.
He had really found it.
This Black Heaven Temple had always belonged to the category of legends.
Everyone thought that it was a fabrication, because no one in history had ever seen it before.
It was said that it represented death, but there was also a Black Divine Willow that would bear a Divine Tree Heart.
If one ate it, it could extend one’s lifespan by a hundred years.
A hundred years of lifespan was completely negligible to outsiders.
Because Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators theoretically possessed a lifespan of as long as two thousand years, extending their lifespan by a hundred years only increased it by five percent.
Moreover, those who entered this space were mostly young people, so they were far from worrying about their lifespans running out.
Thus, being able to extend their lifespan by a hundred years was naturally a good thing, but it wasn’t so urgent that they would risk their lives for it.
However, for natives, extending their lifespan by a hundred years was enough to drive anyone crazy.
That was because everyone here only had a lifespan of about a hundred years.
If they could eat the Divine Tree Heart, it was equivalent to being able to live another life.
Who would not be tempted?
“Extending one’s lifespan by a hundred years isn’t important to me.
What’s important is the light of death.
Is it some kind of celestial light?” Ling Han murmured to himself.
“However, when I go to the Black Heaven Temple, I’ll definitely encounter the natives here.
Extending one’s lifespan by a hundred years is too important to them.
There’ll definitely be a huge battle.”
There was no shortage of elites of the Core Formation Tier here.
Though Ling Han had forced the Core Formation Tier elites of the Zhou Clan to the points that they could only watch helplessly, that was a special circumstance.
“If I reach the Nine Cauldrons, who knows, I might be able to fight an early stage Core Formation Tier cultivator, but I definitely won’t be able to now.”
“Even so, I have to make this trip.”
The celestial light was too important.
After refining them, it could form divine light, and their might was comparable to an Imperial Technique.
This definitely could not be missed.

“The Black Heaven Temple is... over 350 km north of here.” Ling Han continued to look through the information, “That place was originally a swamp, but four days ago, a completely black temple appeared.
There was a black-colored light shining, and then someone discovered a large black temple.”
“This is very similar to the legendary Black Heaven Temple, so it caused a commotion.”
Ling Han set out in a flash, heading towards the Black Heaven Temple.
He was sure that whether it was the local cultivators or outsider adventurers, the number of people going would be considerably shocking.
Thus, he had to hurry.
Furthermore, a great battle was definitely inevitable.
After only half an hour, Ling Han arrived at the swamp.
However, the following journey was extremely difficult.
Because there would occasionally be terrifying winds blowing over the swamp, possessing boundless destructive power, even those in the Core Formation Tier could only be easily torn apart.
Thus, even if Ling Han could fly on his Tool, he could only travel on foot here.
However, the ground was not necessarily safe either, because there were fierce beasts hidden in the swamp.
Occasionally, they would break through the mud and rush out to attack.
Ling Han had not yet entered into the swamp, when he saw a ship sailing over.
This ship was not driven in the swamp, but had rather sailed over from behind.
It was not a warship, but was rather sailing on the ground.
Strangely, this ship should have been astonishingly heavy, but as it made its way here, there was not the slightest trace left behind.
The ship was nine meters tall, and at this moment, there were two young people standing at the bow of the ship.
They were both men.
After discovering Ling Han, they pointed in Ling Han’s direction, and saw that the large ship had actually changed direction, crashing towards
Ling Han.
Ling Han was astonished.

‘There’s no animosity between us, so what’s the meaning of this?’ He had seen a considerable number of profligate young masters, and quite a few of them had been tyrannical and domineering, but he had never encountered one as deranged as this.
He was not the type to be willing to take a loss.

punch.

chapters.title: Chapter 3891: Counterattack of a minor character
paragraphs: This bolt of lightning was so fast that even Tong Yongning couldn’t stop it in time.
Zi, lightning flashed past, and struck the hull. Suddenly, a shield of light appeared on the hull, blocking this attack.

Though it did not cause any substantial damage, Tong Yongning and the two young men on the ship were both given a scare. This guy was really too tough, wasn’t he? He was being hunted down by an elite of the Core Formation Tier, and actually thought of counterattacking. In fact, he even managed to counterattack successfully.
If it wasn’t for the fact that their ship had a defensive formation, would they have directly exploded after sustaining such a blow?
“Junior, how dare you!” Tong Yongning was furious. Under his pursuit, Ling Han actually still had the spare energy to counterattack. Just how much was he looking down on him?
This was intolerable!
He pounced towards Ling Han again, wanting to catch up to this brat and blast him into smithereens.
However, Ling Han was no slower than him when he unleashed his Imminent Skyline, causing his hopes of killing Ling Han to fail time and time again.
Ling Han remained calm and collected, continuing to attack the ship as he dodged.

He didn’t believe that an Imperial Technique wouldn’t be able to break through the shield. -With his present cultivation level, if he activated the Imperial Technique, its destructive power would definitely be comparable to the early stage of Core Formation Tier.

If one attack couldn’t break through, then he would use two. If two didn’t work, then he would use three. Under the endless barrage of attacks, there would eventually come a moment when it would be destroyed.
Zi, zi, zi, the light of lightning blazed, dazzling to the eyes.
More and more people appeared on the ship. This large ship had been attacked, and they thought that it had crashed into some powerful force, but when they came out, their
opponent was actually just a mere Cauldron Forging Tier.
At the beginning, everyone was disdainful, but they soon discovered that Tong Yongning actually couldn’t do anything to this Cauldron Forging Tier.
This was practically a joke.
Furthermore, under the continuous attacks of this Cauldron Forging Tier, the defensive energy of the ship was declining. If this continued, its defenses would really be penetrated by the latter.

This was inconceivable. That was Tong Yongning, one of the three great elites of the Tong Clan, a middle stage Core Formation Tier, and he had actually been unable to take down a mere Cauldron Forging Tier for so long.
“This brat is strange.”
“Second, you help Third.”
“All right.”

Immediately, another person leaped down from the ship. However, this person was slightly older than Tong Yongning, and should be over fifty years old. However, he was energetic, and had an absolutely powerful aura that would make one shiver.
His name was Tong Shuhua, and he was also a cultivator of the Core Formation Tier. He was slightly more powerful than Tong Yongning, but he was also in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier.
Seeing Tong Shuhua leap down, Tong Yongning felt embarrassed, and said, “Second Brother, I can deal with him!”
“Humph, a mere ant dares to provoke our Tong Clan, what need is there for rules?” Tong Shuhua said coldly, “Furthermore, our time is limited, and we cannot waste it on him.”
Hearing his words, Tong Yongning did not object further.
Tong Shuhua charged out. By now, it had become two great Core Formation Tier cultivators joining forces against a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator.

Under normal circumstances, this wouldn’t be realistic. However, Ling Han didn’t face the two members of the Tong Clan head-on at all. He simply circled around with the Imminent Skyline and then launched a sneak attack at the ship.
However, how could the two great Core Formation Tier elites be to be trifled with? Under their combined attacks, Ling Han couldn’t help but be in a perilous situation.

He was like a raft in the sea, and could capsize at any moment. However, he was just a sliver away from capsizing. His ship did not capsize nor did he die. On the other hand, the shield of light on that large ship was already on the verge of collapse.
Was this a fantasy story?
How could Ling Han still have the spare energy to overturn their large ship when he was being ganged up on by two Core Formation Tier elites?
On the ship, everyone looked stunned. Those Cauldron Forging Tiers were even more shocked. If they were asked to exchange blows with Ling Han, then wouldn’t they not be able to survive
a single move, and be directly blasted into smithereens?

This was natural. Ling Han’s seven cauldrons were definitely comparable to the nine cauldrons of a supreme prodigy, and added with an Imperial Technique that could practically be used indefinitely, how could his destructive power not be terrifying?
Just ask the world, what other Cauldron Forging Tier could use Imperial Techniques to attack continuously?

Of course, there was actually an interval between these consecutive attacks, but compared with the Demonic Monkey Fists that could only be fired once every half day, this was practically a chain of attacks. At most, it would only take one minute for the light of lightning to complete the energy accumulation, and then deliver a grand attack.
The last Core Formation Tier cultivator of the Tong Clan, Tong Xiao, could no longer sit still. If this continued, it was really possible that their ship would be blown up by Ling Han.
If that really happened, the Tong Clan would become the laughing stock of the whole world.

Three Core Formation Tier cultivators were standing guard, and a mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator had destroyed the ship. In that case, they might as well slit their own necks and commit suicide rather than endure the embarrassment.
Tong Xiao wasn’t at the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, but rather at the late stage of the Core Formation Tier. Once he joined, the pressure on Ling Han was naturally even
greater.

It should be known that he actually did not have the power to oppose Core Formation Tier. He was merely relying on the Imminent Skyline to deal with them. This naturally made his circumstances extremely dangerous. He only had to take one hit, and he would definitely be
done for.
But the more he was under such circumstances, the calmer Ling Han became, and the more rebound there would be.
‘F*ck! I’m standing here, doing nothing! Who did I offend?’
But what about the Tong Clan? They deliberately turned the ship around to crash towards him, and in fact, three Core Formation Tier cultivators jumped out to gang up on him.
Was there any law in this world?
No, this was a world where strength was respected. Thus, elites could do as they pleased.
Since that was the case, he would use his own power to create his own expanse of sky. At the very least, he had to let others know that the weak were not easily bullied, and could also
counterattack.
The fury of even an ordinary man could spill blood in all directions!

Ling Han gritted his teeth. His mind channelled at high speed, and he activated his Eye Technique, taking in all the attacks of the three elites. Then, he analyzed them, finding the weak points within, and made a move to dodge in advance.
He could be killed at any moment, but he was just a sliver away. He continued to jump and flash, and then shot out bolts of lightning that blasted onto the ship.
How could there be such a freak?
He was clearly just a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, so how could he hold on for so long under the combined attacks of three Core Formation Tier cultivators? In fact, he could even
counterattack?
“Beat him to death!”
“This freakish person definitely can’t be allowed to continue living.”
“If he really broke through to the Core Formation Tier, then who would be able to deal with
him?”
On the ship, the members of the Tong Clan all shouted loudly. Not one of them reflected that
it was they who had attacked Ling Han first for no reason. Instead, they felt that Ling Han had terrifying potential, and had to be eliminated now.
Ling Han’s killing intent blazed. He really wanted to use Heavenly Dao Flames to burn all these people to death.
However, if they were allowed to die so easily, that would be letting these people off too
lightly. Pu!
Ling Han was scraped by a gust of wind from Tong Xiao’s fist. It clearly hadn’t hit him, but the
late stage of Core Formation Tier was really too powerful. Just a single strike was enough to make him throw up blood madly.
However, in return for taking the risk, Ling Han shot out another divine light of lightning at
the ship, and finally destroyed the shield.
He roared loudly, and his whole person rushed towards the ship.
Then, he threw a punch.
Demonic Monkey Fists!
He focused all his anger on this punch. Peng, with this strike, a crack actually appeared on the
large ship. However, in the end, it did not break through.
Ling Han threw another punch. This was the second move of the Demonic Monkey Fists.

chapters.title: Chapter 3892: Leaving Calmly
paragraphs: On the ship, everyone was shocked.
Under the pursuit of the three elites of the clan, Ling Han was actually still able to deliver a furious punch, almost blowing up the ship, causing them to break out in a cold sweat.
Thankfully, this guy was only a Cauldron Forging Tier, after all, and had not been able to break the large ship, though he had still managed to create a crack in it.
However, right at this moment, Ling Han’s second punch arrived.
This was the second move of the Demonic Monkey Fists.
If this was channeled alone, its might would not be much different from the first form, but if it was used continuously, it would be completely different.
Its might had doubled.
Peng!
The punch landed, and the entire ship trembled greatly. Then, even more cracks appeared, densely covering the ship.
Boom! In an instant, the entire ship was obliterated.
Members of the Tong Clan flew through the sky, all of them wearing expressions of astonishment and disbelief.
-Under the combined attacks of three Core Formation Tier elites, Ling Han actually still destroyed their vessel?

Behind them, the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan that were pursuing them were all in a towering rage. This was equivalent to a heavy slap to their faces, causing their expressions to become as cold as water. They were so furious that they wanted to commit murder.
Ling Han exited through the hole of the ship in a flash. He set his eyes on two people.

Those were the vicious young men who had commanded the large ship to crash towards him. The ship had already exploded, so Ling Han naturally had to leave. However, before he left, he still had to collect some more interest.
Peng, he shot out a punch. How could a mere Foundation Building cultivator block it? A young man was instantly blasted into a shower of blood.

However, just as Ling Han was about to kill the other person, Tong Yongning and the others had already caught up to him. They used great power, covering the surrounding air with mystical power, causing this space to become incredibly dense, and movement was extremely difficult.
He couldn’t continue fighting, or he would be in trouble.

Ling Han thought internally. Previously, it was still Tong Yongning and the others that had underestimated him, and had not used moves that would greatly exhaust mystical power, because this was too much of a waste.
However, the hull of the Tong Clan’s ship had been obliterated, and one of their clansmen had also been killed. Under such circumstances, could these three people still hold back?
“I’ll collect some interest first. This person’s head will be left temporarily, and I will eventually pluck it off!” Ling Han said calmly, and charged forwards without even turning his head.
Tong Yongning and the others hurriedly set off in pursuit. By now, all of them had the intention to devour Ling Han.
However, Ling Han flew on his Tool, directly piercing through the skies. So what if they were Core Formation Tier cultivators? They could only watch helplessly.
The cultivators in this world could not fly – unless they were born with wings.
“Ah!” The three Core Formation Tier elites of the Tong Clan were all driven mad, and blasted madly at their surroundings, venting all their fury on the innocent ground.
However, no matter how they attacked, the ground would not be injured.
Where the ship had been, the members of the Tong Clan were still yet to come to their senses. What was going on? They were actually forced to this extent by a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator?

At this time, Tong Yongning and the others also walked back with dark expressions. “Eldest Uncle, Second Uncle, Father, you must protect me!” That profligate young master that had not been killed said in a trembling voice. His name was Tong Bi, and the person who had died previously was his cousin, and also Tong Xiao’s son.
Pa, Tong Yongning immediately slapped him across the face, “It’s all your fault, trash, that caused such trouble.”
Meanwhile, Tong Xiao’s expression was livid, and he said, “Since that brat dares to trifle with our Tong Clan, he should be prepared to be smashed into pieces.”
“Big Brother, what do we do now?”
“The others return to the clan, and the three of us will go to the Black Heaven Temple. We must seize that supreme opportunity.”
“All right!”
Ling Han flew on his Tool. After circling around, he descended and entered from the other side of the swamp.
Pop, pop, pop! Black bubbles continuously bubbled in the swamp, and every time the bubbles burst, they would emit a foul stench that would make one want to vomit.
But it was in this kind of environment that there were actually living beings.

Ling Han had not walked too far, when his heart suddenly throbbed. Then, he saw the water in front of him split open, and saw a figure leap out of the water. However, upon a closer look, though his upper body was human, his lower body was a fish tail.
A mermaid?
This was Ling Han’s first reaction, but he immediately shook his head. In such a smelly swamp, would there be mermaids?
Just as his thoughts were flying wildly, that creature had already launched an attack at Ling Han. It opened its mouth and spat out a black pillar of water, which was extraordinarily
smelly.

Ling Han smiled faintly, stretched out his hand, and hong, stimulated the Heavenly Dao Flames. The water pillars that hit him were immediately evaporated, but it was not completely vaporized. Instead, there was a black-colored smoke wafting.
From this, it could be seen how dirty this pillar of water was.
It was actually spat out from his mouth?

Ling Han felt disgusted just thinking about it, and this “mermaid”‘s appearance was even more disgusting. Its head was bald, and there were signs of decay everywhere. More than half of the fish scales on its lower body had fallen off, revealing rotten flesh.
This wasn’t a mermaid, but rather a zombie fish.
Die!
Ling Han unleashed a palm strike, and the Heavenly Dao Flames instantly engulfed the corpse fish and incinerated it.
In the process of burning, Ling Han smelt an extraordinarily stinky smell, and there was not the slightest fragrance of meat.
He swore that as long as it was something from this swamp, he would not eat it, even if it was
Celestial medicine.

Ling Han continued to advance. He hadn’t expected that there would be so many rotten creatures here. There were five-legged crocodiles, toads with their stomachs turned upside down, and lizards with only half their bodies left. In short, there was nothing complete here.
These living beings should all be fierce beasts, and had no intelligence at all. They were only instinctively attacking the intruders, wanting to devour them.
Thankfully, there weren’t any powerful vicious beasts here, or Ling Han was lucky enough not to encounter them. Two days later, a stretch of darkness appeared in front of Ling Han.
This was like a cloud, but very low.
He headed in this direction, and after walking for half a day, he saw that there was a massive
black temple beneath this black cloud.
Black Heaven Temple!

Ling Han looked from afar. Occasionally, a streak of black light would soar into the sky from this temple, entering into the clouds. It was as if it was this black light that had condensed into the black clouds. From afar, it looked like a demon’s den.
Temples were not the “specialty” of the Buddhist Race. In truth, any larger force would have a
temple to worship their ancestors.

However, no matter how he looked at it, this black temple exuded a feeling of evil. It did not seem like it was a place for offering sacrifices to ancestors, but had instead suppressed countless demons. Now, it could no longer be suppressed, so its evil aura soared sky-high.
Xiu, another streak of black light shot into the skies.
Was that celestial light?
Ling Han thought internally. Merely this suspicion made him decide to take a risk.
He continued onwards, and soon arrived in front of the black temple.
This was not the main doors of the black temple, but rather a wall. It was slightly mottled,
and looked to be extremely old.
The wall wasn’t tall, and Ling Han wanted to climb over it. However, he had just leaped up,
when he saw multiple black seals appear on the wall, causing his heart to feel cold. He hurriedly turned around and retreated continuously.
He had a feeling that this seal was incredibly terrifying, and could easily kill him.

Under the pursuit of the three elites of the clan, Ling Han was actually still able to deliver a furious punch, almost blowing up the ship, causing them to break out in a cold sweat.
Thankfully, this guy was only a Cauldron Forging Tier, after all, and had not been able to break the large ship, though he had still managed to create a crack in it.
However, right at this moment, Ling Han’s second punch arrived.

If this was channeled alone, its might would not be much different from the first form, but if it was used continuously, it would be completely different.
Its might had doubled.
Peng!
The punch landed, and the entire ship trembled greatly.
Then, even more cracks appeared, densely covering the ship.
Boom!
In an instant, the entire ship was obliterated.
Members of the Tong Clan flew through the sky, all of them wearing expressions of astonishment and disbelief.
-Under the combined attacks of three Core Formation Tier elites, Ling Han actually still destroyed their vessel?

This was equivalent to a heavy slap to their faces, causing their expressions to become as cold as water.

What was going on?
They were actually forced to this extent by a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator?

chapters.title: Chapter 3893: Subduing Dragons and Subduing Tigers
paragraphs: He couldn’t barge in by force.
Ling Han immediately came to a conclusion. Now, he could only circle around to the main doors.
The black temple was huge, so it took Ling Han almost half an hour to finally arrive at the main doors.
There were two stone statues standing guard at the entrance, and each stone statue looked ferocious. One had a dragon in his hand, while the other had a tiger between his legs.
Subduing Dragons Arhat, Subduing Tigers Arhat?
Aside from these two stone statues, there were also some people watching from the entrance. What was there to watch about the stone statues?
Ling Han was still mumbling, when he saw someone walk out, heading towards the main doors.
After taking a few steps, he saw the stone statue subduing a tiger suddenly come back to life. The ferocious tiger that it had been suppressing charged out, pouncing towards that person.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

The two sides immediately broke out into a fierce battle. This fierce tiger was shockingly a Cauldron Forging Tier fierce beast, and its battle prowess definitely surpassed Four Cauldrons. As it pounced and bit, it gave that person a huge headache.
The battle had only lasted for a dozen over moves, and with a sweep of the tiger’s tail, its whip-like tail lashed out. Pa, that person was sent flying, throwing up blood continuously.
The ferocious tiger didn’t follow up on its attack. Instead, it returned to where the Subduing Tigers Stone Statue was, transforming back into a stone statue.
No wonder there were so many people watching. As it turned out, no one had the ability to
enter.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han turned around, only to see three people rapidly approaching from the distance. Who else could it be but the Tong Clan’s three Core Formation Tiers!?
Dodge for a while?
This thought flashed through his mind, and Ling Han immediately rejected it.
No, what if one of the three members of the Tong Clan stayed at the entrance to ambush him? Then wouldn’t he be unable to enter the temple?
He had seen the three members of the Tong Clan, so how could the three members of the Tong Clan not have noticed him?
Thus, Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all as he immediately charged toward the door.
He wanted to enter the temple first.
Immediately, the ferocious tiger from the Subduing Tigers Statue came back to life, and pounced towards Ling Han.
Peng!
Ling Han shot out a punch, and that fierce tiger was instantly sent flying. It was completely unable to block the might of his attack.
Pu!
Everyone spluttered in astonishment. This battle prowess was far too terrifying!
After the ferocious tiger, there were no more obstructions. Ling Han’s figure flashed, and he had already entered into the temple.

Meanwhile, the three members of the Tong Clan also arrived, wanting to pursue and enter. However, the Subduing Dragon Statue also immediately awakened. Not only did the dragon charge out, but even the golem strode out and delivered a palm strike.
‘F*ck! True Self Tier!’
The three members of the Tong Clan were astounded, and hurriedly retreated.
Thankfully, the stone statue didn’t follow up on its victory. The dragon and golem both returned, and then turned back into the Subduing Dragon Statue.
What the hell was this?

“Seniors, this is only a solo challenge here. The stone tiger corresponds to the Cauldron Forging Tier, and the stone dragon corresponds to the Core Formation Tier, and if there are many people attacking at the same time, it will be the Core Formation Tier or even the True Self Tier golem that would be making a move,” one of them explained, wanting to curry the favour of the three members of the Tong Clan.
The three members of the Tong Clan had gotten their answer, yet were completely disdainful of that person. A mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator wanted them to have a higher opinion of him?
“I’ll go first,” Tong Xiao said.
“Yes.” Tong Yongning and Tong Shuhua both nodded.
Tong Xiao stepped forward. True enough, only the stone dragon had awakened, and was charging towards him.

However, the battle prowess of this stone dragon was unexpectedly powerful. Tong Xiao was completely outmatched. In just over twenty moves, he had already fled back in a sorry state. There were a considerable number of places on his body that had been wounded.
The three members of the Tong Clan all wore dark expressions.
Ling Han had passed with a single strike, but even with Tong Xiao going all out, he had just barely managed to escape. Just what kind of gap was there between them?
It could not be denied that at the same cultivation level, that despicable brat’s strength was strong to the extreme.
What should they do?
They had come with great ambitions, yet were not even able to enter through the main doors. What was the point of doing this then?
“We can only wait for more Core Formation Tier elites to arrive, and work together to defeat that golem.” The three of them exchanged looks, and came to a conclusion.
The moment Ling Han entered the temple, he immediately discovered that the sky had darkened.

There were dark clouds enshrouding the sky, and it was indeed very dark outside. However, it was definitely not as dark as this. That was not the darkness from absence of light, but rather the darkness originating from an Intent Realm, with a bone-chilling coldness.
In fact, Ling Han could even see multiple black shadows floating in the air, as if they were vengeful ghosts.
“An!” he immediately shouted loudly. The Buddhist Race’s Six Characters Bright King Curse was specifically used to subdue evil beasts.
With this shout, his whole person was glowing, as if he was an enlightened monk.

Boom, the word ‘An’ was shouted, and turned into a flash of Buddha’s light, surging forwards. Instantly, the darkness on this path was completely expelled. Even those vengeful ghosts were like snow that had encountered flames, instantly turning into dust. However, after he shouted, endless darkness corroded over again, rapidly engulfing the path of light, and the black shadows in the distance were like a shark that had smelt blood, scrambling to float over.

This was just like how he had initially been a passerby, and no one had paid much attention to him, but all of a sudden, he was shining brightly, and had become incredibly dazzling. The Buddhist Race’s Six Characters Bright King Curse could overcome evil beasts, but on the other hand, for evil beasts, this was also extremely aggravating.
Water could extinguish fire, but if they encountered Incinerating Heaven Raging Flames,
what could they do even if they emptied all the water in the river?
Ling Han didn’t use the Six Characters Bright King Curse anymore. Instead, he threw a punch.
He wanted to see how powerful these black shadow figures were.
However, when he shot out a punch, those black shadows were completely unscathed.
Instead, they pounced towards him.
Ling Han channeled the Heavenly Dao Flames again, and the effects immediately changed.

Originally, these black shadows didn’t seem to have a physical body, so no matter how strong your power was, it was useless when you threw a punch. Now, however, it was as if a portion of their physical body had been exposed, and they could be hit.
Peng! His powerful strength exploded, and he threw a punch. Instantly, a few black shadows twisted, and he tore them apart.
However, there were astonishingly many black shadows. So what if a few of them were shattered? Even more black shadows were still pouncing over.
F***, Ling Han hurriedly turned around. A great number of ants could bite an elephant to death. He had no wish to be surrounded by these things.

Thankfully, though this place was enshrouded in darkness, it was not every place that had black shadows. Furthermore, the movement speed of the black shadows was not very fast. After a few steps, he had thrown off the main troops behind him.
Yi, why was this somewhat similar to the Buddhist Race’s Divine Temple on Moonlight
Planet?
Did this have anything to do with the Buddhist Race?
Ling Han saw a tree, but it was not a Bodhi tree. Instead, it was a willow tree. However, unlike
ordinary willow trees, this willow tree was completely black, as if it had been tainted with demonic power.
He looked closely, and there was actually not a single leaf on this willow tree that was the
same.
Interesting.
However, though this willow tree was filled with vitality, it was definitely not the Celestial Tree that could nurture a Divine Tree Heart that could greatly increase one’s lifespan.
True, if this was really that Black Divine Willow, would he be the only one here? Ling Han refused to believe that no one had been able to enter before.
He continued to advance. This Black Heaven Temple was astonishingly huge, and it was
possible that there was other spaces. This could accommodate tens of thousands of people.
Yi, wasn’t it said that there was a blazing light of death here, that a mere touch would cause living beings to immediately lose their vitality?
Ling Han guessed that it was celestial light. Previously, the light of lightning was also extremely frightening before it was absorbed, and could kill even a Core Formation Tier. And
the Demonic Origin Realm was only at the level of Core Formation Tier and the True Self Tier,
and that was why the legend of the light of death was left behind.
The problem was, where was that light?

chapters.title: Chapter 3894: Oil lamp
paragraphs: Ling Han continued to advance. Where were the people here? Why couldn’t he see a single one?
Ahead of him, a great hall appeared.

There was a fierce stone statue in front of the palace, its eyes wide with anger. One of its hands was raised high, and the other was lowered. Even if it was only a stone statue, one could still see the flames of fury that were gushing out, as if it wanted to smack someone to death.
Would it come back to life?
Ling Han strode forward, already prepared to make a move.
Sure enough, the stone statue immediately came to life. Weng! Its divine sense rippled out, sweeping toward Ling Han.

This was extremely terrifying. Ling Han was certain that for anyone under Four Cauldrons, his mind would definitely immediately shatter, and even if it was Four Cauldrons or Five Cauldrons, his mind would still be shaken, and he would have a splitting headache.
However, he had seven cauldrons, and they were the cauldrons of the Primitive Celestial Gate.
Weng, his Celestial Cauldron also trembled slightly, greeting this divine sense.
The two collided, creating a terrifying shockwave that was visible to the naked eye.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and charged towards the stone statue.
Peng!
He threw a punch, and the stone statue slammed down with its palm. A shockwave instantly surged into the surroundings, with the two of them at the center.
Ling Han stumbled slightly, but the stone statue wasn’t much better. Rings of ripples flickered on its body.
“Haha, again!” Ling Han laughed loudly. He had never encountered a decent opponent in Cauldron Forging Tier. Even those as strong as Lu Qi and Liu Chuang were no match for him at this moment.
He charged forwards, his fist wrapped with the Heavenly Dao Flames, increasing its destructive power.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

He exchanged a fierce blow with the stone statue, and he felt like his bones would tremble and groan with each clash. However, his fighting spirit was also becoming more and more intense. This kind of opponent would allow him to unleash his full power. This was far too satisfying. Let’s try out the Wind God Kick.

Ling Han’s legs danced rapidly. Pa, pa, pa! He delivered a series of kicks, and every gust of wind created by his kicks was incredibly fierce, especially when it was wrapped with the Heavenly Dao Flames. If it was any ordinary Seven Cauldrons, he would probably be kicked to death with a single kick.
Even as powerful as the stone statue was, it could only parry. It raised its right hand in front of it, blocking Ling Han’s kicks.

Ling Han kicked sixteen times in a row, and cracks appeared on the right arm of the stone statue. Then, they gradually widened, and covered the entire right arm. With a pa, this arm instantly exploded, turning into countless small rocks.
If it were an ordinary person, they would definitely be severely wounded. Perhaps they would abandon the battle and flee, but how could the stone statue possibly abandon the battle?
It opened its mouth, and shouted loudly, “Appear!”
Weng, this was not a sound, but rather divine sense. It turned into the word ‘appear’, and appeared in Ling Han’s mind, exuding a terrifying might, wanting to shake even Ling Han’s mind.
This was... the Nine Figures of Truth!

It was common knowledge that the Buddhist Race possessed two ultimate techniques. One was the Six Characters Bright King Curse, which could chase away evil beasts and enlighten one’s mind. The other was the Nine Figures of Truth, which was used to subdue and slaughter demons, possessing extremely terrifying destructive power.
The Nine Figures of Truth were Appear, Soldier, Fight, All, Formation, Column, Present, and Formation respectively.
Like the Six Characters Bright King Curse, it was known to all, but no one could unleash its true might, because this needed the secret technique unique to the Buddhist Race to activate.
Otherwise, these six characters and nine figures would be just like the normal ‘you’, ‘me’ and ‘he’, ordinary and conventional.
The problem was, one of the stone statues in the Black Heaven Temple actually roared out the Nine Figures of Truth, its might terrifying.
Boom, all of a sudden, a howl rang out in Ling Han’s mind. The Appear figure exuded a terrifying might, wanting to blast his mind into pieces.
“Humph!” Ling Han was calm and unhurried. The Celestial Cauldron trembled slightly, and the ancient aura circulated, resisting the Appear figure.
Peng! He counterattacked with all his might, and countless cracks instantly appeared on the Appear figure before it shattered.

It was not that the Imperial Technique could not even withstand a single blow. If it was another person, his mind would probably have exploded long ago, but rather that Ling Han’s Celestial Cauldron was too strong, and that was why it could stand against an Imperial
Technique.
Moreover, this was only a stone statue, after all. How could he hope to develop the Imperial Technique to the pinnacle?
How could the Nine Figures of Truth that the stone statue had grasped compare to the Buddha Son and Holy Daughter of the Buddha Race?
Ling Han wanted to see how many Nine Figures of Truth the stone statue had mastered. Thus, he only defended and didn’t attack.
However, he was disappointed. The stone statue merely repeated the figure “appear”, and he hadn’t mastered any more of the Nine Truths Figures of Truth.
He attempted to learn secretly, but without the unique cultivation technique of the Buddhist Race, how could he possibly glimpse the true essence?
Sigh.

He shook his head as he unleashed a flurry of kicks with his Wind God Kick. Pa, pa, pa, pa! The stone statue’s head, neck, and chest were all struck by Ling Han’s kicks. Cracks appeared on its body, and when these cracks reached a critical point, pa! The entire stone statue instantly transformed into a pile of rubble.
It was done.
Ling Han felt that it was a pity that he hadn’t been able to obtain the Nine Figures of Truth.
He shook his head, and strode into the main hall.
The great hall was not dark, because there was an oil lamp glowing. However, what surprised Ling Han was that when he was illuminated by this light, he actually felt as if his physique
was improving in all aspects.
How was this possible?
What kind of light was this? It was actually comparable to a Celestial medicine, and it definitely had to be a Six or Seven Stars Great Herb at that.
There was only a single lamp in the entire great hall, but it was precisely this lamp that allowed this great hall to be spared from the invasion of darkness.
Ling Han walked towards the oil lamp, but after a few steps, he was shocked, because the
pressure was too great.
That did not seem to be a lamp, but rather an incomparably powerful existence, whose might
was incredibly terrifying.
Ling Han had no choice but to stop. Then, he activated his eye technique and looked at the oil
lamp.
Hiss, what had he seen?
Planets crumbled, and rivers of blood flowed.
How could a mere lamp cause such a terrifying scene to appear in his mind?
Unfortunately, he couldn’t get close. Otherwise, if he could take this oil lamp, it would definitely be incredible.
Ling Han sighed, and decided to search again to see if there were any other treasures.
However, he had not even begun his search, when he immediately turned around, and saw two people walk in together at the main doors. They were a man and a woman respectively.

The man looked to be about twenty-three or twenty-four years old. He was tall and slender, and was extremely handsome. He also had an air of arrogance about him. That was an expression of incomparable confidence.
And the woman looked slightly younger. She was twenty years old, and was dressed in snow-
white monk robes. There was not the slightest bit of adornment on her, and she was
extremely plain.
However, anyone who looked at her would think that no ornament was worthy of her.
She was too beautiful, exquisitely beautiful, as if she did not belong to this world.
“Yi, I never thought that there would be another person here!” The man was slightly
surprised.
Meanwhile, the woman didn’t pay any attention to Ling Han. Instead, her eyes swept over the surroundings, and turned to look at the lamp.
This could improve one’s physique, and top-notch prodigies could naturally see this with a
single glance.
“Celestial maiden, I’ll help you retrieve the lamp,” the man immediately said, judging her expression. He then glanced at Ling Han, and said, “You, go and bring that lamp over.”
Heh, if I could bring it over, would it be your turn to spout nonsense here?
Ling Han completely ignored him. Since he couldn’t take out the light, he could only enjoy the
benefits brought by the light.
And in this great hall, aside from the oil lamp, was there any other treasure?
“What an arrogant brat!” the man said coldly.
