chapters.title: Chapter 3895: Saint’s Corpse Oil?
paragraphs: This man was called Kang Xinghai, and he had a powerful background. He was ranked thirtieth on the Cauldron Forging Tier Leaderboard of the Galaxy Network. In the North Heavenly Realm, he could definitely squeeze into the top ten.
Such a prodigy naturally could be arrogant, haughty, and condescending.
It should be known that with just a casual word from him, how many people would be willing to fight tooth and nail to do his bidding?
With such a prodigy, it was a sure bet that he would become a Venerate Tier elite in the future. In fact, it was even possible that he would become a Saint.

But now? He had already told Ling Han to retrieve the oil lamp, yet Ling Han only acted as if he had not heard anything, so how could he not be furious? More importantly, the goddess he was courting was just beside him, so how could he swallow this anger?
“Very good. You even dare to look down on me, Kang Xinghai. You are really bold!” he stated calmly, but his fury was already soaring.

Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh, “There’s really something wrong with you. Don’t you have any arms or legs yourself? Even if you don’t have any arms or legs, you still have to be polite when asking for help. What is it? Do you think everyone owes you something?”
Kang Xinghai was instantly enraged. Who would dare speak to him in this manner? They were really courting death!
“Humph, looks like your eyes have grown for nothing!” he said coldly, his killing intent already on full display.

“Brother Kang and this brother!” The woman in monk robes spoke up, her voice slow and unhurried, having an indescribable charm to it, as if it was the voice of Dao and the voice of Buddha. “We are all prodigies of the Human Race, so please work together, and don’t cause internal strife.”
Ling Han instantly felt a sense of calm, as if the disputes in the world no longer had anything to do with him.
His heart clenched. Was this some kind of cultivation technique that could actually affect his mind?
Yi!
He felt a sense of familiarity, and felt that this was similar to the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
Could it be that this woman came from the Buddhist Race?
Kang Xinghai’s killing intent immediately dissipated. He smiled slightly, “Since Celestial maiden has said so, I have no objections.”

Impressive, such heavy killing intent could be immediately dispersed. It had to be said that the Buddhist Race had a terrifying ability to affect the hearts of people. No wonder the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire resisted the Buddhist Race’s teachings so much; that was indeed too dangerous.
Ling Han looked at the woman in monk robes, and asked calmly, “May I ask how should I address you, Miss?”
“How dare you!” Kang Xinghai immediately rebuked.
Yet the woman in monk robes was completely calm, and said, “My religious name is Prosperous Heaven.”
Religious name?
She was indeed a successor of the Buddhist Race.
“Celestial maiden Prosperous Heaven is the Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter!” Kang Xinghai introduced, “And she’s a celestial beauty ranked tenth on the Exquisite Beauty Leaderboard.”
This woman was indeed beautiful, not inferior to Song Lan in any way.
However, could the Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Race marry?
Prosperous Heaven recited a Buddhist proclamation, “Monks don’t get involved in the mortal world. The so-called Exquisite Leaderboard is just a joke.”

Ling Han’s eyes narrowed slightly. Though this Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter called herself a monk, she still kept her hair. She said that the Exquisite Leaderboard was a joke, but he didn’t see her protesting on the Galaxy Network, rejecting this ranking.
Hehe, this Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter was the same as Song Lan. She was definitely not as pure as she looked, and was extremely scheming.
“I am Ling Han.” Ling Han introduced himself first, “May I know what the Holy Daughter knows about this Black Heaven Temple?”

“Nothing at all,” Prosperous Heaven shook her head, “Our Buddhist Race is enlightening all living beings, but the murderous aura here is extremely strong. It is definitely not a peaceful place of our Buddhist Race.”

She pointed at the oil lamp. Her slender hand was like beautiful jade, causing one’s heart to beat wildly, “Just like that oil lamp. If I have not guessed wrongly, that is corpse oil that has been refined from the corpse of a saint.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but grit his teeth. This was really a hardcore taste, but it was no wonder that the effects of this light were so great. It could actually improve one’s physique.
Those were Saint-level “materials”.

“That’s right. This can improve one’s physique, but Saints are already close to Dao. Absorbing this kind of benefit would inevitably contaminate one’s physique with heaven and earth’s karma, which is not a good thing,” Prosperous Heaven said seriously.

Ling Han nodded in understanding. Saints were far too powerful, and in fact, they were already close to achieving Dao. Yet, they had still been refined into corpse oil. This naturally went against heaven and earth, and absorbing such benefits would naturally lead to them being targeted by heaven and earth as well.
In fact, he would even be treated like a demon. The heaven and earth would descend supreme divine lightning, and directly kill him.

“What kind of place is this? Even a Saint can be killed, adn refined into corpse oil?” Kang Xinghai was slightly distracted. Even for someone as talented as he was, he only had the confidence to charge towards Venerate Tier. To become a Saint? It was too, too difficult. It was not something that could be done just by having enough talent.
But now, the Saint sitting high above the Nine Heavens had been refined into corpse oil. This naturally caused him to lose his composure.
“Celestial maiden, could you have seen wrongly?” he asked.
Prosperous Heaven shook her head, “Buddha saves all sentient beings. I am the most familiar
with this evil beast. I naturally have not seen wrongly.”
She paused for a moment, before continuing, “However, refining the corpse of a Saint into corpse oil doesn’t necessarily require one to possess the ability to kill Saints.”
Indeed, the corpses of Saints could either be killed, or... dug out.
However, did this woman really not have the slightest understanding of the Black Heaven
Temple?
“Let me study it,” Kang Xinghai said, as he walked towards the oil lamp. He spoke nicely, but the greed in his eyes could not be concealed.
This was oil refined from a Saint, so it didn’t matter whether it was corpse oil or not. The
effects were clear for all to see. If he could take away oil that could improve his physique, he would be able to cultivate under the light of an oil lamp every day. Just how much benefits
would that bring?
Perhaps the pinnacle he could reach was not Venerate Tier, but rather Saint Tier.
As for the karma of heaven and earth, as long as he was strong enough, what need was there
for him to care?
However, he had only taken a few steps, when his face immediately turned pale.
The pressure was like a mountain.
He couldn’t take another step, or he would definitely be crushed by the terrifying aura.
This was saintly might, and for Cauldron Forging Tiers like them, there was no solution to it. They were completely no match for it.
Only now did he know why Ling Han hadn’t taken the oil lamp even though he had clearly entered first. It wasn’t that he was stupid, but that it was simply impossible for him to do so.
After figuring this out, he became furious.
‘You clearly know this, so why didn’t you tell me? Are you deliberately watching me make a
fool of myself?’

“Ling Han, I won’t call you to account for your previous rudeness, but you actually tricked me on purpose. Even with Celestial maiden Prosperous Heaven’s words, I can’t tolerate you!” Kang Xinghai said balefully, turning around to press down on Ling Han.
Hu, right at this moment, a cold wind blew past. The light and darkness of the oil lamp changed for a while, before it was suddenly extinguished.
Instantly, a powerful chill rose up from the bottom of Ling Han’s heart. He hurriedly broke
into a run and fled outside.

Prosperous Heaven’s reaction was even faster. When Ling Han leaped out of the great hall, he saw that the latter was actually a step faster than him. Only Kang Xinghai, that idiot, was too proud, and was even less willing to appear cowardly in front of a beauty. He actually did not
flee at the first instant.

Ling Han looked towards Prosperous Heaven, and couldn’t help but inhale sharply. That was because there was a shocking ring of finger marks on the other’s jade-like neck, as if someone was strangling her; it was black and blue.
Seeing Ling Han stare fixedly at her neck, Prosperous Heaven couldn’t help but reveal a hint of
anger.
Even monks didn’t like being stared at like this.

This was saintly might, and for Cauldron Forging Tiers like them, there was no solution to it.
They were completely no match for it.
Only now did he know why Ling Han hadn’t taken the oil lamp even though he had clearly entered first.
It wasn’t that he was stupid, but that it was simply impossible for him to do so.
After figuring this out, he became furious.
‘You clearly know this, so why didn’t you tell me?
Are you deliberately watching me make a
fool of myself?’
“Ling Han, I won’t call you to account for your previous rudeness, but you actually tricked me on purpose.
Even with Celestial maiden Prosperous Heaven’s words, I can’t tolerate you!” Kang Xinghai said balefully, turning around to press down on Ling Han.
Hu, right at this moment, a cold wind blew past.
The light and darkness of the oil lamp changed for a while, before it was suddenly extinguished.
Instantly, a powerful chill rose up from the bottom of Ling Han’s heart.
He hurriedly broke
into a run and fled outside.
Prosperous Heaven’s reaction was even faster.
When Ling Han leaped out of the great hall, he saw that the latter was actually a step faster than him.
Only Kang Xinghai, that idiot, was too proud, and was even less willing to appear cowardly in front of a beauty.
He actually did not
flee at the first instant.
Ling Han looked towards Prosperous Heaven, and couldn’t help but inhale sharply.
That was because there was a shocking ring of finger marks on the other’s jade-like neck, as if someone was strangling her; it was black and blue.
Seeing Ling Han stare fixedly at her neck, Prosperous Heaven couldn’t help but reveal a hint of
anger.
Even monks didn’t like being stared at like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 3896: Evil Intent
paragraphs: “Don’t misunderstand.” Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, “Look at your own neck first.”
Prosperous Heaven condensed an ice mirror, and as her eyes swept over it, her pretty face couldn’t help but pale.
This marks must have come from someone strangling her, but she was completely unaware of it, which naturally made her feel shocked.

Ling Han was also apprehensive. This woman was the Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Race, and her abilities were definitely out of the ordinary. In fact, she had even grasped the complete Six Characters Bright King Curse, yet she had actually been silently strangled by a “ghost”. This was too inconceivable.
He turned around and looked towards the great hall, wanting to know how Kang Xinghai was doing.
He was naturally not worried, but merely curious.
“On your back!” Prosperous Heaven suddenly exclaimed, her tone carrying a chill.
Could it be?

Ling Han released his divine sense, and saw that there was shockingly a palm print on his back. It had torn his clothes into shreds, including his inner armor, and left a jet-black palm print on his back.
Upon a closer look, the length of the fingers was astonishing. It did not look human at all.
F***, was this place really haunted?
Ling Han looked at Prosperous Heaven, and Prosperous Heaven also looked at him, both of them filled with deep wariness.
To be able to cause two great prodigies to be hit while they themselves were completely unaware, just how powerful was the “mastermind” behind all this?
Now, Ling Han wanted even more to know how Kang Xinghai was doing. This guy still hadn’t appeared. If it was really haunted, what would he be like now?
Tap, tap, tap... The sound of footsteps was heard.
At present, Kang Xinghai was the only one in the great hall. Then, the sound of footsteps could be heard, so it must be him.
Both he and Prosperous Heaven took a few steps back. This was a kind of vigilance against the unknown.
Not long after, a figure walked out of the great hall.
It was Kang Xinghai.
Hiss!
Ling Han and Prosperous Heaven both inhaled sharply. Kang Xinghai had initially been filled with vigor and vitality. Now, however, it was as if he had fallen ill and was extremely dispirited.
Furthermore, his face was covered with palm imprints, black and blue.
Looking at his eyes again, there was no focal point at all. They were extremely lifeless, as if he had become a walking corpse.

“I’m going to kill you!” Kang Xinghai looked at Ling Han, and his eyes immediately lit up. Then, he looked back at Prosperous Heaven, and involuntarily, he couldn’t help but reveal a strong longing, “I want you to be my woman!”
Yi, had this guy been bewitched?

Kang Xinghai said that he wanted to kill him. Ling Han didn’t find this strange. Kang Xinghai had already wanted to make a move on him before. However, Kang Xinghai was blatantly saying that he wanted Prosperous Heaven to become his woman, and that wasn’t right.
This was a desire from the depths of his heart. No matter how filthy his thoughts were, it was fine, but could he say it out loud?

But Kang Xinghai actually said it out loud. What else could it be but that he was bewitched? Not only did this guy become dispirited, his vitality dropped drastically, and even his mind had become chaotic?

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel a lingering fear. Thankfully, he had ran out earlier. Otherwise, it wouldn’t have just been a palm print on his back, but would have greatly exhausted his vitality, and even caused his mind to become confused.
“Die!”
Kang Xinghai immediately charged out, and attacked Ling Han.
He was the prodigy ranked 30th on the Galaxy Network, so his abilities were indeed extraordinary. As he shot out his attack, multiple seals exploded, and brilliance filled the skies.
However, he had clearly chosen the wrong opponent.
Ling Han shot out a murderous aura. Even if Kang Xinghai was in an extremely chaotic state, his body couldn’t help but tremble, and a look of fear appeared on his face.

At first, Prosperous Heaven wanted to stop him, but when she saw this scene, she couldn’t help but stop abruptly. She turned to look at Ling Han, her beautiful eyes filled with surprise. This kind of intimidating technique was the specialty of the Buddhist Race. As the Buddhist saying goes, enlightening all sentient beings, it was actually influencing others mentally. Ling Han actually could as well. Though the method was slightly different, it had the same effect.
Kang Xinghai was a prodigy among prodigies, after all. After being startled for a moment, he returned to normal, and continued to charge towards Ling Han.
Another strike.
Kang Xinghai faltered for a moment before charging over.
Again, again, again.

Prosperous Heaven couldn’t help but be rendered speechless. Ling Han was practically toying with him, causing Kang Xinghai to ceaselessly pause in his movements. In truth, he only had to grab a single chance, and he would be able to send Kang Xinghai flying.
After playing for quite a while, Ling Han delivered a palm strike, knocking Kang Xinghai onto
the ground.

He examined closely. Kang Xinghai’s life force had been greatly expended, and there was also an incredibly evil intent entrenched in his mind. There was only a fragment, but it was extremely powerful, causing even Ling Han to feel apprehensive.
However, this streak of intent seemed to be in a deep slumber, and did not move at all.

Ling Han was astonished. This intent was only entrenched in Kang Xinghai’s mind, and it wasn’t even actively channeled yet. Yet, Kang Xinghai’s mind had already been affected. If this intent truly awakened, wouldn’t it be able to replace Kang Xinghai?
“Er, Holy Daughter, you are the expert at exorcising evil.” He stepped aside.
Prosperous Heaven walked over, and placed a hand on the top of Kang Xinghai’s head. Scanning it with her divine sense, she couldn’t help but pale, as if she had received a scare.
This woman must be hiding something.

That was because this was clearly a temple of the Buddhist Race. Previously, the stone statue had even in fact used the Nine Figures of Truth, yet she said that it had nothing to do with the Buddhist Race. This was naturally a lie.
And to be able to make a Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter lie, there must be too much involved.
“Say, Holy Daughter, do you know something?” he asked.
At first, Prosperous Heaven was thinking of something else, but when she heard this, the corners of her mouth involuntarily twitched, and a dark line appeared on her forehead.
Say, Holy Daughter?
She had a name, all right?
“I don’t know what you’re talking about.” She shook her head, then withdrew her hand. She focused slightly, and pressed another finger on Kang Xinghai’s forehead. At the same time,
she shouted, “An!”
Six Characters Bright King Curse!
Ling Han couldn’t help but compare it with what he had learnt, yet discovered that there was a
great difference between the two.
In essence, it was the same. It was similar, but in terms of might, the Six Characters Bright King Curse of Prosperous Heaven was much stronger than him.
Was this the genuine Imperial Technique?
Ling Han nodded internally. How could the Imperial Technique be easily taught?
Thus, in the ancient site of the Buddhist Race on the Moonlight Planet, the Six Characters

Bright King Curse that had been passed down was not only incomplete, but also a castrated version of the Six Characters Bright King Curse. Otherwise, aside from Brother Monkey, who considered brotherhood to be higher than the heavens, who would teach an Imperial
Technique?
Even among the Imperial Clans, only core members could cultivate the true Imperial
Technique.
Ling Han remained calm and collected, carefully comparing the parts of the other party’s Six Characters Bright King Curse, analyzing which parts of the latter’s were superior, and whether
he could learn it secretly.

He had a foundation, and did not start from scratch, so there was a sliver of a chance. “Ma!” Prosperous Heaven called out the second word of the Six Characters Bright King Curse. Obviously, merely the word “An” was not enough to drive away the foreign intent entrenched
in Kang Xinghai’s mind.
“Ne!”
“Pa!”
“Mi!”
“Hong!”
She chanted word by word, and a Buddhist circle actually appeared behind her head. Her whole body was shining with golden light, as if she had transformed into a female
Bodhisattva. However, after the chant of the six words, not only did Kang Xinghai not recover, his eyes
suddenly snapped open. His gaze was extremely terrifying, as if he was an executioner that had slaughtered millions and millions of living beings.
“Ah Han’s heir!” he said balefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 3897: Ancestral Buddha, Ah Han
paragraphs: “You are Ah Han’s heir!” Kang Xinghai suddenly exclaimed. Then, he stretched out his right hand, and grabbed out at Prosperous Heaven’s neck.
This was unexpected, because he should have been restrained by Ling Han, and could not move at all.
However, the strength of Prosperous Heaven could also be seen at this time. She chanted a Buddhist chant softly, and a golden light shield immediately formed on her body.
Peng!
Kang Xinghai’s palm strike arrived, yet was blocked by the golden shield.
He faltered upon hearing this. It was as if he hadn’t imagined that he would be so weak. There was a look of astonishment on his face.
“Who am I?” It was as if he had suddenly transformed into a philosopher, and asked this eternal question.
Ling Han moved, and delivered a palm strike to his forehead. A powerful force surged out, and peng, Kang Xinghai instantly collapsed, falling directly into a state of unconsciousness.
However, before he closed his eyes, he still swept an eye over Ling Han.
That gaze... was indescribable, as if it could penetrate deep into one’s soul.
F***, it seemed like he had been targeted by some powerful being.
Ling Han sighed. Why did he have to deliver this slap?
“Oh, that’s right, who is Ah Han?” he asked Prosperous Heaven.
At first, Prosperous Heaven did not speak, as if she herself was also in a state of shock. After a while, she said, “The Ancestral Buddha’s religious name is Ah Han.”
Yi, Ah Han was the Ancestral Buddha, the founder of the Buddhist Race, a supreme elite that had become an Ancestral King, invincible for an era.

Hold on, what era was Ancestral Buddha from? And looking at Kang Xinghai’s expression just now, it seemed like he was acquainted with Ancestral Buddha. Then what kind of old monster did he have to be?
“This is clearly a Buddhist temple. Furthermore, the intent in Kang Xinghai recognizes Ancestral Buddha. You must know something!” Ling Han looked towards Prosperous Heaven.
Prosperous Heaven’s expression remained unchanged, and she said calmly, “I indeed don’t know anything.”
“Hey, I say, miss, monks can’t tell lies. Otherwise, if you’re disliked by Buddha, you can only renounce asceticism, marry, and have children,” Ling Han deliberately mocked.

However, the tolerance of this Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter was clearly far beyond his imagination. She was completely unmoved, and even ignored him completely. Instead, she continued to cast the Six Characters Bright King Curse at Kang Xinghai.

She treated Kang Xinghai like a departed soul that she had to perform religious ceremonies for so he could find peace. Over and over again, and after at least a few dozen times, Kang Xinghai finally opened his eyes weakly, his gaze very blank, “Yi, why am I here? My head hurts!”
He got to his feet and rubbed the back of his head. To his shock, he discovered that there was a large lump on his head.
Who had done this?
Previously, when he was in the great hall, the oil lamp suddenly extinguished, and then a cold wind blew over, causing him to lose consciousness.
It shouldn’t be Ling Han.
He glanced at Ling Han, and there was still some suspicion in his heart. He kept feeling that this kind of style was very similar to Ling Han.

Ling Han couldn’t be bothered to pay him any heed. He did not have the slightest interest in Kang Xinghai. What piqued his curiosity was Prosperous Heaven. This woman definitely had no lack of knowledge about the Black Heaven Temple, but her mouth was too tight, and she was completely unwilling to reveal even the slightest bit.

Yet Prosperous Heaven explained that previously, something strange had happened in the palace, and she and Ling Han had managed to escape in time. Kang Xinghai, on the other hand, had unfortunately fallen victim to it, and was possessed by an evil spirit. Thankfully, she had dispersed it.

“Hiss!” Kang Xinghai gritted his teeth. Only now did he realize that he had lost a great deal of his life force and Source Power. He wanted to cry but had no tears. Though he had absorbed the benefits of the Saint’s oil lamp and improved his physique, he had still expended a great deal of his life force and Source Power. It was still a massive loss.

“No wonder it is rumored that there is a brilliant light flickering in the Black Heaven Temple, that would cause the death of living beings,” Prosperous Heaven said slowly, “Looks like it is precisely this evil spirit.”
Ling Han listened quietly from the sidelines.
Was this just an evil spirit?

That was clearly an old monster that he had met with Ancestral Buddha. He had touched its intent before, and although it was still in a state of slumber, and even though it was only a fragment, it was definitely inconceivably powerful. If it was an evil spirit, it was far from something that Prosperous Heaven could expel.
However, she was brimming with confidence, and this confused Ling Han greatly.
The other party was definitely not that stupid.
Thus, this woman must have grasped some core secret, and that was why she was so
confident.

“Heh, then I’ll take my leave.” Ling Han waved his hand at Prosperous Heaven. This Buddhist Race Holy Daughter was also extremely scheming, and it was possible that she would betray him at any moment. Thus, it would be better for them to part ways.
“You want to flee?” Yet Kang Xinghai was unwilling to give up. Previously, he had wanted to make a move on Ling Han, but a sudden change had taken place, so he had not been able to
make a move.
However, this did not mean that he would let it go.
Ling Han glanced at him, his eyes filled with pity.
-This guy had absolutely no idea that he had already dealt with him just now.
Ling Han turned around and left. With his back facing Prosperous Heaven and Kang Xinghai,
The waved them off.
Kang Xinghai wanted to give chase, but was stopped by Prosperous Heaven.
Ling Han continued to walk around. There were many large halls here, with more than a dozen side by side, and there were hundreds of them.

He took a look. There was an oil lamp in every hall, and its effects were the same. It could improve one’s physique, but it could not be maintained for long. Very soon, it would be extinguished, and then something strange would happen.
Even if Ling Han had reacted at the first instant, he had still suffered a “sneak attack”, and
there were palm imprints on his body.
Once or twice was fine, but once the number of times increased, he discoveredYin Qi in his body, causing even his blood to become cold.
He hurriedly used the Six Characters Bright King Curse and shouted inside his body, expelling
and chasing away evil.
After shouting dozens of times, Ling Han finally felt his body become a little warmer.
What kind of existence was buried in this temple? Refining oil from the corpse of a Saint, and even knowing the Ancestral Buddha from the ancient era? Their background was frighteningly
powerful.
The waters were very deep.
Ling Han felt a sense of urgency. He did not care about the Black Divine Willow. Once he found
the celestial light here, he would flee.
After circling around, he finally discovered others. However, many of them were dispirited, and their faces and hands were covered with dark green palm imprints. Just the sight of them
was harrowing.
Boom!
A great battle broke out in the distance. With a thought from Ling Han, he immediately
rushed over.
At first, he had thought that a celestial light would appear, but he had not thought that it would be five people fighting over a mat.
It was just a mat, so what was there to fight over?
Ling Han activated his eye technique and couldn’t help but feel surprised. This mat wasn’t

ordinary. It looked like it was woven from bamboo, but there were flashes of divine light flickering on it. There were also astonishing seals appearing, as if they corresponded to some kind of true meaning of great dao.
If he could sit on the mat and cultivate, he would definitely be able to help him comprehend
Dao. It would be half the work, but double the effect.
No wonder those five people wanted to fight over it.
Without any reservations, Ling Han also charged out.
“Scram!” In the first place, the five of them were already locked in a fierce battle, and were

just worrying about how they were going to sweep aside all their opponents and take the treasure for themselves. Yet Ling Han still wanted to interfere, so they had to unite to deal with him at the first instant.
Ling Han laughed loudly as he unleashed his murderous aura. Pa, pa, pa, pa! The eyes of the five people instantly rolled back, and they collapsed to the ground, unconscious.
Unless his cultivation level surpassed Ling Han’s, his murderous aura would be able to deal
with everything.
Ling Han easily picked up the mat. The moment he touched it, his mind calmed down, and
multiple flashes of enlightenment arose.
This was indeed a treasure, and was too helpful in comprehending Dao.

“Hiss!” Kang Xinghai gritted his teeth.
Only now did he realize that he had lost a great deal of his life force and Source Power.
He wanted to cry but had no tears.
Though he had absorbed the benefits of the Saint’s oil lamp and improved his physique, he had still expended a great deal of his life force and Source Power.
It was still a massive loss.

“No wonder it is rumored that there is a brilliant light flickering in the Black Heaven Temple, that would cause the death of living beings,” Prosperous Heaven said slowly, “Looks like it is precisely this evil spirit.”
Ling Han listened quietly from the sidelines.
Was this just an evil spirit?
That was clearly an old monster that he had met with Ancestral Buddha.
He had touched its intent before, and although it was still in a state of slumber, and even though it was only a fragment, it was definitely inconceivably powerful.
If it was an evil spirit, it was far from something that Prosperous Heaven could expel.
However, she was brimming with confidence, and this confused Ling Han greatly.
The other party was definitely not that stupid.
Thus, this woman must have grasped some core secret, and that was why she was so
confident.
“Heh, then I’ll take my leave.” Ling Han waved his hand at Prosperous Heaven.
This Buddhist Race Holy Daughter was also extremely scheming, and it was possible that she would betray him at any moment.
Thus, it would be better for them to part ways.
“You want to flee?” Yet Kang Xinghai was unwilling to give up.
Previously, he had wanted to make a move on Ling Han, but a sudden change had taken place, so he had not been able to
make a move.
However, this did not mean that he would let it go.
Ling Han glanced at him, his eyes filled with pity.
-This guy had absolutely no idea that he had already dealt with him just now.
Ling Han turned around and left.
With his back facing Prosperous Heaven and Kang Xinghai,
The waved them off.
Kang Xinghai wanted to give chase, but was stopped by Prosperous Heaven.
Ling Han continued to walk around.
There were many large halls here, with more than a dozen side by side, and there were hundreds of them.
He took a look.
There was an oil lamp in every hall, and its effects were the same.
It could improve one’s physique, but it could not be maintained for long.
Very soon, it would be extinguished, and then something strange would happen.
Even if Ling Han had reacted at the first instant, he had still suffered a “sneak attack”, and
there were palm imprints on his body.
Once or twice was fine, but once the number of times increased, he discoveredYin Qi in his body, causing even his blood to become cold.
He hurriedly used the Six Characters Bright King Curse and shouted inside his body, expelling
and chasing away evil.
After shouting dozens of times, Ling Han finally felt his body become a little warmer.
What kind of existence was buried in this temple?
Refining oil from the corpse of a Saint, and even knowing the Ancestral Buddha from the ancient era?
Their background was frighteningly
powerful.
The waters were very deep.
Ling Han felt a sense of urgency.
He did not care about the Black Divine Willow.
Once he found
the celestial light here, he would flee.
After circling around, he finally discovered others.
However, many of them were dispirited, and their faces and hands were covered with dark green palm imprints.
Just the sight of them
was harrowing.
Boom!
A great battle broke out in the distance.
With a thought from Ling Han, he immediately
rushed over.
At first, he had thought that a celestial light would appear, but he had not thought that it would be five people fighting over a mat.
It was just a mat, so what was there to fight over?
Ling Han activated his eye technique and couldn’t help but feel surprised.
This mat wasn’t
ordinary.
It looked like it was woven from bamboo, but there were flashes of divine light flickering on it.
There were also astonishing seals appearing, as if they corresponded to some kind of true meaning of great dao.
If he could sit on the mat and cultivate, he would definitely be able to help him comprehend
Dao.
It would be half the work, but double the effect.
No wonder those five people wanted to fight over it.
Without any reservations, Ling Han also charged out.
“Scram!” In the first place, the five of them were already locked in a fierce battle, and were
just worrying about how they were going to sweep aside all their opponents and take the treasure for themselves.
Yet Ling Han still wanted to interfere, so they had to unite to deal with him at the first instant.
Ling Han laughed loudly as he unleashed his murderous aura.
Pa, pa, pa, pa!
The eyes of the five people instantly rolled back, and they collapsed to the ground, unconscious.
Unless his cultivation level surpassed Ling Han’s, his murderous aura would be able to deal
with everything.
Ling Han easily picked up the mat.
The moment he touched it, his mind calmed down, and
multiple flashes of enlightenment arose.
This was indeed a treasure, and was too helpful in comprehending Dao.

chapters.title: Chapter 3898: Meeting Hong Tianbu again
paragraphs: “Put down what you’re holding!” A woman’s voice rang out. It wasn’t loud, but it was very proud and clear.
Ling Han turned around, only to see a man and woman standing behind him.
It was clear that the speaker was the woman, but Ling Han didn’t look at her. Instead, he looked at the man in surprise.
F***, this was too coincidental, wasn’t it?
Hong Tianbu!
Ling Han had really not foreseen that he would encounter Hong Tianbu here.
Since the parting at the Holy Land of Metal Element, Hong Tianbu had completely disappeared, and there was no further news of him.

Afterwards, no matter what ancient site opened, or even when the Nine Suns Holy Land opened its doors, Hong Tianbu still didn’t appear, making Ling Han think that this guy had died in some corner of the universe.
After all, there were really too many prodigies that had died halfway in the world. They were not inferior to Hong Tianbu.
But now, Hong Tianbu had actually appeared.
Hong Tianbu naturally saw Ling Han as well, and his eyes involuntarily narrowed, exuding a strong killing intent.
To him, there was a very good reason for him to hate Ling Han.

However, the woman beside him was enraged. What kind of existence was she? Her words were no less than an imperial decree, and Ling Han actually dared to ignore her completely. Furthermore, he did not even cast a second look at such an exquisite beauty like herself, and actually stared at Hong Tianbu. Have you gone blind?
“How dare you!” she shouted coldly.
Hong Tianbu smiled, and said, “Hai Lan, let me introduce you. This is Ling Han.”
“So you’re Ling Han?” The woman showed a hint of arrogance. She crossed her arms over her chest, appearing very disdainful, “Lowly commoner, you actually dare to oppose Tianbu. Kneel down!”
Hehe, what arrogance.
Ling Han looked at Hong Tianbu and said with a smile, “Is there something wrong with this woman?”
“You’re seeking death!” the woman roared.
Xiu, xiu, two figures suddenly appeared, sweeping towards Ling Han.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han was astounded. These two people were originally outside the wall, and it was only after the woman shouted that they charged out.

Strange. After entering this space, everyone should have been separated, but this woman obviously had two lackeys. In fact, she and Hong Tianbu should have known each other since long ago, so why hadn’t they separated?
Was this heaven-defying luck, or did he have some other trick up his sleeve?
Just as he was pondering, the two of them had already arrived.

They were both men in their thirties, expressionless, but their cultivation level was early stage Core Formation Tier. They shot out a palm strike, and the image of a dragon and tiger blasted out. Symbols circulated, terrifying without bounds.

Ling Han used the Imminent Skyline to dodge. He was extremely surprised. That woman was clearly only a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, so what right did she have to command two Core Formation Tier cultivators?
This could only mean one thing, and that was there was a powerful force behind this woman.
“Hong Tianbu, I don’t remember that you needed women to stand up for you in the past,” Ling Han said with a smile as he mocked him.
However, Hong Tianbu weren’t provoked at all, and they said calmly, “You can’t find a noble daughter like Hai Lan because you’re incompetent, while I’m more fortunate than you.”
These words instantly caused the woman to feel elated, and she smiled sweetly at Hong Tianbu.
F***, being a pretty boy, he still had to be so high-profile, and so self-righteous?
Ling Han’s heart clenched. With Hong Tianbu’s pride, how could he deliberately curry the favour of an ordinary woman?
As if seeing Ling Han’s confusion, Hong Tianxing smiled faintly, and said, “I forgot to introduce you. Hai Lan’s surname is Di.”
Di Hailan.
There was actually someone with the surname of Dio?
A person’s name suddenly flashed through Ling Han’s mind: Di Shitian!

Some Ancestral Kings only left their titles. For example, Ancestral Buddha, Ah Han. Did anyone else know his name before he became Ancestral Buddha? There was also Ancestral King Pan Shi, who had ascended Dao from his beginnings as a rock. Who would know his real name?
However, there were also some Ancestral Kings whose names were unknown, but their surnames were widely known.
For example, the Four Directions Great Emperor. His surname was Chang, and the present Chang Clan was also boundlessly powerful, and was one of the strongest forces in the
universe.
Or... the Wolf Tribe’s Great Emperor, the Demon Emperor, Di Shitian.
This was probably the only clan in the world that dared to take the surname of Di.
It was no wonder that even with Hong Tianbu’s pride, he would put down his airs. As it turned out, this woman was a member of an Imperial Clan, so everything could be explained.
“Heh, you’ve married into the Wolf Tribe?” Ling Han said with a chuckle.
This naturally was also a mockery. Just ask the men of this world, how many of them would be willing to marry into the family of his wife?
Hong Tianbu was extremely shrewd, and he wasn’t angered or shocked at all. He simply gazed at Di Hailan with deep affection.
The meaning could not be clearer. He had not taken a fancy to Di Hailan’s background at all, but merely liked this woman.
F***, what an eyesore.
Ling Han shook his head. Hong Tianbu was truly impressive, playing the role of a pretty boy with deep feelings for his beloved.

“You two trash, it’s been so long, and you still haven’t taken down a mere Cauldron Forging Tier?” Di Hailan rebuked delicately. Her slender brows slanted. The two great elites of Core Formation Tier had joined forces, yet were still unable to take down Ling Han even after so long, which made her feel embarrassed.

“There’s no need to rush,” Hong Tianbu said in comfort. “This Ling Han isn’t so simple. The Imminent Skyline is also an ancient ultimate technique, allowing cultivators to exert speed that surpasses cultivation level. However, the Imminent Skyline places an extremely heavy burden on the body, and the expenditure on mystical power is also extremely shocking. Thus, it’s impossible for him to last long.”
This kind of judgement was very logical, and it could also be seen that Hong Tianbu was very experienced. He did not look like a young man in his twenties at all.
Di Hailan nodded. She liked Hong Tianbu’s confidence as if everything was under his control, which enchanted her and made her withdraw the pride of a member of an Imperial Clan,
willing to become a little woman.
However, Ling Han’s actions didn’t make sense.

He had cultivated the mortal level to perfection, and the toughness of his physique was not inferior to even Wu Qiyuan, who specialized in cultivating his physique. Furthermore, his reserves of mystical power were endless, enough to compare with the level of Sect Master. To wait until he was no match for the burden of Imminent Skyline?
Hehe, this was not something that could be done in a short while.
Ling Han was preparing to counterattack. Being on the back foot had never been his style.
After being unable to capture Ling Han for a long time, even Hong Tianbu’s expression
changed slightly.

Although he hadn’t mastered the Imminent Skyline, he had been the first to obtain this secret technique. Thus, he still had some understanding of it. He knew that channeling this movement technique was extremely taxing on oneself.
Thus, Ling Han was still able to channel the Imminent Skyline even now, which surprised him
and made him unable to understand.
Ling Han suddenly shot out a palm strike. Zi, lightning flashed, and a bolt of lightning
instantly shot towards a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
One of the two Core Formation Tier cultivators had long hair, while the other’s was slightly shorter. The one Ling Han was attacking now was precisely the short-haired one.
Pa!
The short-haired man had not expected that Ling Han would be able to deliver such an attack
either. This was too unexpected. Thus, even he did not manage to dodge, and could only forcefully stretch out a hand to parry the blow before his chest.
The lightning dissipated, and a large area of charred flesh appeared on the short-haired
man’s arm.
Unfortunately, he was still unable to kill him.
Ling Han sighed internally. After all, his opponent was early stage Core Formation Tier. Even
if he blasted out an Imperial Technique, he would just barely be able to reach this kind of might, and in a battle of equal battle prowess, who would be able to insta-kill his opponent in
a single move? However, if he took another step further, and reached Eight Cauldrons?

chapters.title: Chapter 3899: Final Battle
paragraphs: If Ling Han only felt that it was a pity, then Hong Tianbu, Di Hailan, and the others were all stunned.
Under the combined attacks of two Core Formation Tier cultivators, not only did a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator not die, but he even launched a counterattack, wounding one of them!
F***, this was a fantasy story.
Hong Tianbu frowned slightly, revealing a hint of wariness.

After the battle at the Holy Land of Metal Element, he coincidentally met Di Hailan and successfully won her heart. From then on, he stepped into the Imperial Clan, enjoying the resources provided by the Imperial Clan.
In this way, his cultivation level instantly soared, successfully reaching Cauldron Forging Tier.

With his freakish talent, Heaven Cauldron was naturally not the end. By now, he was already at Eight Cauldrons. Even in the Di Clan, he was still quite valued, and was promised the position of a general in the future.

He no longer took Ling Han seriously. The two of them were no longer from the same world. When they had encountered each other just now, he was also calm and composed. He looked down on Ling Han with a lofty attitude, thinking that Ling Han was only able to survive because of the Imminent Skyline, which he had stolen from him.
In terms of mentality, Hong Tianbu felt extremely superior.
But now, Ling Han’s counterattack was absolutely shocking, causing even a Core Formation Tier elite to suffer minor injuries. This was too terrifying.
Hong Tianbu asked himself, could he do it?
No!
He shook his head internally. Even if he was Eight Cauldrons, and had fused with the eye of a Primordial Vicious Beast, he still had no power to fight back against a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
How was this possible?

He had already entered into the Imperial Clan, and could casually browse through all the cultivation techniques and secret techniques below Saint Tier. How could Ling Han possibly have the good fortune that he had?
But why was Ling Han still not the slightest bit inferior to him?

His hands clenched into fists. Previously, his cultivation level had far surpassed Ling Han’s, yet he had still lost to Ling Han in their repeated clashes. Now, he had already entered into the Imperial Clan, and it could be said that his conditions were already extremely good. If he was still unable to suppress Ling Han, what else could he do?

“Good one, brat!” the short-haired Core Formation Tier cultivator exclaimed softly. Though his arm had been charred by the lightning, merely channeling his mystical power was enough to suppress his injuries, and the injury was still continuously improving.
Only after a while, he returned to normal.
A Core Formation Tier elite was a Core Formation Tier elite, after all, and had the advantage of a major tier in cultivation level. The suppression was too obvious.

Ling Han frowned. His ambition was higher than the heavens, and he directly wanted to injure or even kill a Core Formation Tier cultivator. However, reality proved that even if he was caught off guard, he could only slightly wound a Core Formation Tier cultivator. Moreover, it was only one in the early stage at that.
In that case, he could only settle for the next best thing.
Ling Han’s killing intent flickered as he stared at Hong Tianbu.
Hong Tianbu wanted to kill him, and he also wanted to kill Hong Tianbu. This was something that both sides were well aware of.
“Seniors, leave this opponent to me,” Hong Tianbu said loudly.

-Di Hailan could order the Core Formation Tier cultivators around as she liked, but he could not. After all, he was still an outsider, and had to adhere to the necessary etiquette of superiority and inferiority in cultivation.
The two Core Formation Tier cultivators gave him face and stepped back.
“Tianbu!” Di Hailan was slightly worried. This opponent was too freakish. He could even wound a cultivator at the Core Formation Tier. She was worried that Hong Tianbu would be outmatched.
“Believe me!” Hong Tianbu smiled faintly, his pride soaring sky-high.
The present Ling Han was indeed strong, but he was not weak either.
That was because he was Hong Tianbu!
Di Hailan couldn’t help but look dazed, and couldn’t help but nod. She was completely besotted with Hong Tianbu in this kind of temperament.
Hong Tianbu strode out to greet Ling Han.
“Hong Tianbu, long time no see!” Ling Han said calmly. His tone was as if he had seen an old friend that he had not seen for a long time, but his killing intent was incredibly resolute.
This time, he would completely sever this link of karma.
“From today onwards, there will no longer be a person like Ling Han in this world,” Hong Tianbu said, similarly extremely resolute.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Where do you get such confidence from?”
“Because I am Hong Tianbu!”
Shua, Hong Tianbu charged out, his hands spread open, one yin and one yang, as if he was embracing Taiji.
Ling Han merely smiled, and merely shot out a punch, aimed directly for the middle.
Peng!
He shot out a punch, and the Tai Ji immediately shattered. Hong Tianbu gave a muffled humph, and retreated backwards seven steps.
No matter what secret technique you use, I will destroy it with a single punch.

Hong Tianbu frowned slightly. Ling Han’s mystical power was far too profound. Thus, even if they were both at Seven Cauldrons or Eight Cauldrons, the power that he unleashed would be more concentrated and more powerful.

But the problem here was that he had forged a Golden Celestial Cauldron. Furthermore, he had previously obtained a great opportunity, and had used a divine substance to further temper it, and it had evolved into a Tricolor Glass Cauldron.

The quality of the Celestial Cauldron was closely related to the purity of the mystical power. This was because the Celestial Cauldron could filter the mystical power and remove impurities. The higher the level of the Celestial Cauldron, the better the effects of the
mystical power.

Therefore, logically speaking, among those at the same cultivation level, his mystical power should be the most profound. At most, there would only be others that could match him, and there was no way to surpass him.
What grade was the Celestial Cauldron that Ling Han had forged? Could it be five-colored or even seven-colored?
“Tianbu!” Di Hailan was extremely worried. She signaled with her eyes at the two Core Formation Tier cultivators, signaling them to make a move at the first instant when Hong
Tianbu was in danger.

The two of them nodded. Though Di Hailan was not the princess with the highest status in the Di Clan, she was still from the main clan, after all. Furthermore, Hong Tianbu was indeed very favoured, and they were duty-bound to do so.
Only then did Di Hailan feel relieved. She looked at the battle without blinking an eye, her
fingers gripped tightly.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Hong Tianbu immediately launched a counterattack. He was an extremely extraordinary person, and was born with great fortune. Afterward, he entered into the Imperial Clan, and could even freely flip through the precious techniques below Saint-level.
For others, biting off more than one can chew. Rather than learning everything, it would be
better to choose the best.
However, he was different.

Because he had fused with the eye of a Primordial Vicious Beast, ordinary precious techniques could be seen clearly with a single glance. Thus, the number of precious techniques he had grasped was astonishing, and they had all reached the level of proficiency.
They had only exchanged over twenty moves, and Hong Tianbu had already channeled seven
different techniques, one after the other. Each technique was at the pinnacle level. If it was any other opponent, they would have long since been defeated and killed by his myriad of
techniques.
But for Ling Han, he had too many ways to resolve this.
– Merely Starlight Screen was enough to cause Hong Tianbu to blast it for a long time, and he
also had an eye technique. When he activated it, what change of moves would be able to
deceive him?

However, Ling Han was using a precious technique against a precious technique. The Great Overarching Heaven Technique, Wind God Kick, Celestial Crossing Finger. There were some precious techniques that were inferior to Hong Tianbu, but with his powerful strength, he was able to forcefully make up for his shortcomings, while there were some that were far superior, forcing Hong Tianbu to retreat continuously.

However, Ling Han didn’t use the Imperial Technique all this while, nor did he use the divine light of lightning. This was because he knew that if Hong Tianbu encountered a life- threatening danger, the two Core Formation Tier cultivators definitely wouldn’t sit by and
watch.
Thus, he needed a chance to deal a fatal blow.
“Ling Han, you truly astonish me!” Hong Tianbu laughed loudly, and the space between his brows suddenly split apart, revealing an eye.
This was definitely not a human eye, and was filled with a murderous aura. The moment it
opened, it would cause a chill to run down one’s spine, as if one had fallen into an ice cave.
The eye of the Primordial Vicious Beast! Hong Tianbu finally unleashed his trump card.

With his freakish talent, Heaven Cauldron was naturally not the end.
By now, he was already at Eight Cauldrons.
Even in the Di Clan, he was still quite valued, and was promised the position of a general in the future.
He no longer took Ling Han seriously.
The two of them were no longer from the same world.
When they had encountered each other just now, he was also calm and composed.
He looked down on Ling Han with a lofty attitude, thinking that Ling Han was only able to survive because of the Imminent Skyline, which he had stolen from him.
In terms of mentality, Hong Tianbu felt extremely superior.
But now, Ling Han’s counterattack was absolutely shocking, causing even a Core Formation Tier elite to suffer minor injuries.
This was too terrifying.
Hong Tianbu asked himself, could he do it?
No!
He shook his head internally.
Even if he was Eight Cauldrons, and had fused with the eye of a Primordial Vicious Beast, he still had no power to fight back against a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
How was this possible?
He had already entered into the Imperial Clan, and could casually browse through all the cultivation techniques and secret techniques below Saint Tier.
How could Ling Han possibly have the good fortune that he had?
But why was Ling Han still not the slightest bit inferior to him?
His hands clenched into fists.
Previously, his cultivation level had far surpassed Ling Han’s, yet he had still lost to Ling Han in their repeated clashes.
Now, he had already entered into the Imperial Clan, and it could be said that his conditions were already extremely good.
If he was still unable to suppress Ling Han, what else could he do?
“Good one, brat!” the short-haired Core Formation Tier cultivator exclaimed softly.
Though his arm had been charred by the lightning, merely channeling his mystical power was enough to suppress his injuries, and the injury was still continuously improving.
Only after a while, he returned to normal.
A Core Formation Tier elite was a Core Formation Tier elite, after all, and had the advantage of a major tier in cultivation level.
The suppression was too obvious.
Ling Han frowned.
His ambition was higher than the heavens, and he directly wanted to injure or even kill a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
However, reality proved that even if he was caught off guard, he could only slightly wound a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
Moreover, it was only one in the early stage at that.
In that case, he could only settle for the next best thing.
Ling Han’s killing intent flickered as he stared at Hong Tianbu.
Hong Tianbu wanted to kill him, and he also wanted to kill Hong Tianbu.
This was something that both sides were well aware of.
“Seniors, leave this opponent to me,” Hong Tianbu said loudly.
-Di Hailan could order the Core Formation Tier cultivators around as she liked, but he could not.
After all, he was still an outsider, and had to adhere to the necessary etiquette of superiority and inferiority in cultivation.
The two Core Formation Tier cultivators gave him face and stepped back.
“Tianbu!” Di Hailan was slightly worried.
This opponent was too freakish.
He could even wound a cultivator at the Core Formation Tier.
She was worried that Hong Tianbu would be outmatched.
“Believe me!” Hong Tianbu smiled faintly, his pride soaring sky-high.
The present Ling Han was indeed strong, but he was not weak either.
That was because he was Hong Tianbu!
Di Hailan couldn’t help but look dazed, and couldn’t help but nod.
She was completely besotted with Hong Tianbu in this kind of temperament.
Hong Tianbu strode out to greet Ling Han.
“Hong Tianbu, long time no see!” Ling Han said calmly.
His tone was as if he had seen an old friend that he had not seen for a long time, but his killing intent was incredibly resolute.
This time, he would completely sever this link of karma.
“From today onwards, there will no longer be a person like Ling Han in this world,” Hong Tianbu said, similarly extremely resolute.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Where do you get such confidence from?”
“Because I am Hong Tianbu!”
Shua, Hong Tianbu charged out, his hands spread open, one yin and one yang, as if he was embracing Taiji.
Ling Han merely smiled, and merely shot out a punch, aimed directly for the middle.
Peng!
He shot out a punch, and the Tai Ji immediately shattered.
Hong Tianbu gave a muffled humph, and retreated backwards seven steps.
No matter what secret technique you use, I will destroy it with a single punch.
Hong Tianbu frowned slightly.
Ling Han’s mystical power was far too profound.
Thus, even if they were both at Seven Cauldrons or Eight Cauldrons, the power that he unleashed would be more concentrated and more powerful.
But the problem here was that he had forged a Golden Celestial Cauldron.
Furthermore, he had previously obtained a great opportunity, and had used a divine substance to further temper it, and it had evolved into a Tricolor Glass Cauldron.
The quality of the Celestial Cauldron was closely related to the purity of the mystical power.
This was because the Celestial Cauldron could filter the mystical power and remove impurities.
The higher the level of the Celestial Cauldron, the better the effects of the
mystical power.
Therefore, logically speaking, among those at the same cultivation level, his mystical power should be the most profound.
At most, there would only be others that could match him, and there was no way to surpass him.
What grade was the Celestial Cauldron that Ling Han had forged?
Could it be five-colored or even seven-colored?
“Tianbu!” Di Hailan was extremely worried.
She signaled with her eyes at the two Core Formation Tier cultivators, signaling them to make a move at the first instant when Hong
Tianbu was in danger.
The two of them nodded.
Though Di Hailan was not the princess with the highest status in the Di Clan, she was still from the main clan, after all.
Furthermore, Hong Tianbu was indeed very favoured, and they were duty-bound to do so.
Only then did Di Hailan feel relieved.
She looked at the battle without blinking an eye, her
fingers gripped tightly.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Hong Tianbu immediately launched a counterattack.
He was an extremely extraordinary person, and was born with great fortune.
Afterward, he entered into the Imperial Clan, and could even freely flip through the precious techniques below Saint-level.
For others, biting off more than one can chew.
Rather than learning everything, it would be
better to choose the best.
However, he was different.
Because he had fused with the eye of a Primordial Vicious Beast, ordinary precious techniques could be seen clearly with a single glance.
Thus, the number of precious techniques he had grasped was astonishing, and they had all reached the level of proficiency.
They had only exchanged over twenty moves, and Hong Tianbu had already channeled seven
different techniques, one after the other.
Each technique was at the pinnacle level.
If it was any other opponent, they would have long since been defeated and killed by his myriad of
techniques.
But for Ling Han, he had too many ways to resolve this.
– Merely Starlight Screen was enough to cause Hong Tianbu to blast it for a long time, and he
also had an eye technique.
When he activated it, what change of moves would be able to
deceive him?
However, Ling Han was using a precious technique against a precious technique.
The Great Overarching Heaven Technique, Wind God Kick, Celestial Crossing Finger.

There were some precious techniques that were inferior to Hong Tianbu, but with his powerful strength, he was able to forcefully make up for his shortcomings, while there were some that were far superior, forcing Hong Tianbu to retreat continuously.
However, Ling Han didn’t use the Imperial Technique all this while, nor did he use the divine light of lightning.
This was because he knew that if Hong Tianbu encountered a life- threatening danger, the two Core Formation Tier cultivators definitely wouldn’t sit by and
watch.
Thus, he needed a chance to deal a fatal blow.
“Ling Han, you truly astonish me!” Hong Tianbu laughed loudly, and the space between his brows suddenly split apart, revealing an eye.
This was definitely not a human eye, and was filled with a murderous aura.
The moment it
opened, it would cause a chill to run down one’s spine, as if one had fallen into an ice cave.
The eye of the Primordial Vicious Beast!
Hong Tianbu finally unleashed his trump card.

chapters.title: Chapter 3900: Killed
paragraphs: Though he had entered into the Imperial Clan, to say nothing of the fact that Hong Tianbu was still the son-in-law of the Imperial Clan, even if it was him that had married into the clan, he may not be able to learn the Imperial Technique.
Imperial Technique was the greatest trump card of an Imperial Clan, aside from the Imperial Weapon. How could it be easily taught to others?

Only a bold, boundlessly heroic person like Brother Monkey would be so generous. On the other hand, Brother Monkey’s Imperial Clan was really quite shabby. He was the only descendant left, and had not formed a powerful force at all.
Otherwise, even if the Battle Saint Emperor had died, how could he have been suppressed by a Venerate Tier-level force for two thousand years?
The Imperial Clan was not to be trifled with!
Thus, Hong Tianbu’s greatest trump card, and strongest ultimate move was still the eye of the Primordial Vicious Beast that he had fused with.
When the eye opened, the murderous aura was boiling, and a death ray shot out. Ling Han’s whole body instantly stiffened, and he couldn’t even move a single finger.
However, Ling Han was neither anxious nor alarmed. A murderous aura shot out, blasting towards Hong Tianbu.
Hong Tianbu couldn’t help but grunt, a pained expression appearing on his face.
This time, it almost caused his mind to explode.
He couldn’t help but feel shocked. Ling Han’s technique seemed to have improved as well. Ling Han trembled slightly, and his body had already regained mobility.
Hong Tianbu frowned. Even the might of the death ray was unable to suppress Ling Han, causing him to completely miscalculate.
As he saw it, this move was time-tested. Even a cultivator of the Core Formation Tier would be frozen by his glare, winning him the chance to escape.
However, Ling Han actually recovered after only a slight pause. His speed was comparable to a Core Formation Tier cultivator, which was unacceptable to him.
He humphed, and the vicious eye opened once more, shooting out death rays.

The speed of this streak of light was so fast that even Ling Han was unable to dodge it. It was like the barrage of murderous aura, which actually belonged to the level of divine sense, and defense also had to be done on the level of divine sense.
Weng!
Ling Han’s Celestial Cauldron shook slightly, and waves appeared in his mind. Ripples surged out, instantly expelling the might of the Vicious Eye.
It would be indecent to not reciprocate.
Ling Han charged forward, unleashing a murderous aura that instantly caused Hong Tianbu to pause for a moment. He then unleashed a deadly attack.
Demonic Monkey Fists!
This was the Imperial Technique, and once it was channelled, a powerful pressure overflowed, causing Di Hailan and the two Core Formation Tier elites to feel their hair stand on end.
They came from the Imperial Clan, and even if they had never learnt the Imperial Technique, how could it be that they had never seen the Imperial Technique before?
What, this guy that was only an ant in their eyes was actually capable of using the Imperial Technique!
How was this some minor character? He was clearly the heir of an Imperial Clan.

“Sh*t!” The two Core Formation Tier elites pounced at the same time. Although Hong Tianbu was strong, he was definitely no match for the Imperial Technique. He would be severely wounded after this attack, so they had to charge out immediately to prevent Ling Han from launching another powerful attack and killing Hong Tianbu.
Hong Tianbu naturally went all out as well. He crossed his arms in front of him, forming a complicated seal that turned into a shield of light.
Peng!
The Demonic Monkey Fists arrived, and how could a mere shield of light withstand it? Instantly, it was shattered into pieces.
However, this also removed a portion of the power of the Demonic Monkey Fists, winning Hong Tianbu a sliver of life.
As long as he wasn’t killed with a single punch, the two Core Formation Tier cultivators would naturally be able to save him.
However, how could it be that Ling Han did not know this?
What was a fatal strike?
Ling Han raised his right hand, and the light of lightning surged out, striking towards Hong Tianbu.
What!
This time, Hong Tianbu’s expression changed drastically, as if he was ashen.
How was this possible? Two Imperial Techniques could actually be cast at the same time; how could there be such a freak in this world?
This was equivalent to the combined attack of two young Great Emperors. Who in the world could block this attack at the same cultivation level?
At least, Hong Tianbu couldn’t compare. No matter how freakish he was, there was no way he could compare to a young Great Emperor.
Zi, the light of lightning struck, and Hong Tianbu was instantly sliced into two.
Ling Han didn’t even turn his head as he unleashed the Imminent Skyline. He left after a single strike, as if he were an assassin.
“Tianbu—” Di Hailan released a wail of grief, and at the same time, there was boundless fury, “Kill him! Kill him!”

The two Core Formation Tier cultivators gave chase. Their faces were also filled with fury. Right in front of them, Ling Han actually blasted Hong Tianbu into two halves. Even if he didn’t die, without the Saintly medicine, Hong Tianbu would definitely be done for in this
lifetime.
But even in the Imperial Clan, Saintly medicine was still incredibly valuable, and needed to be used to extend the lifespan of Saints. How could they be wasted on an outsider like Hong
Tianbu?

Kill, they definitely had to kill this main culprit, or they would not be spared either. However, Ling Han used the Imminent Skyline, and his speed was not the slightest bit inferior to theirs. Furthermore, there were black shadows floating everywhere here, unafraid of the attacks of power, directly attacking the soul, which was very hard to deal with.
Ling Han made use of this special terrain to continuously circle around, and in a few moments, he had thrown off his pursuers.
Hong Tianbu should have died by now, right? He had already been severed into two halves. If
he could still survive this, he would really be too lucky.
Ling Han wasn’t very excited. In his eyes, killing Hong Tianbu was a matter of course, so how could there be any emotional fluctuations?
The great halls here connected to each other, continuous and unbroken.

Ling Han only wanted the celestial light. He leaped onto the top of the palace hall to check on the situation, but he had just set foot on the top of the palace hall, when he was forcefully shaken down by a deep power.
It was as if the great hall was sacred and could not be tarnished.
Ling Han was exasperated, so he could only continue to enter the main hall to investigate.
He finally encountered those who had entered here earlier, blocked at a plaza.
The plaza wasn’t empty. Instead, it was filled with bronze statues that were densely packed together like an army.
Someone barged in, and those bronze statues immediately came back to life. Peng, peng, peng! With three punches and two kicks, they sent that person backwards.
He couldn’t win.
Ling Han also shook his head. He could see clearly that these bronze statues were all in the Core Formation Tier, and their numbers numbered in the tens of thousands. How could they
possibly pass?
He didn’t know if he could sneak over using the Void Beast hide.

Ling Han thought to himself. He took out the beast hide to wrap around himself, and quietly walked over. However, he had just stepped onto the plaza, when his hair stood on end, because the bronze statue closest to him had already awakened, and a palm struck out at him.
Ling Han hurriedly retreated with all his might, but he was still scraped by the force from the palm strike. Instantly, he felt a burning sensation, and an extraordinary pain pierced into his
heart.
What was he supposed to do now?
Boom!
All of a sudden, he felt a powerful fluctuation in the air. This should be the eruption of a great

battle in the distance. He carefully sensed the energy that was seeping out of the air, and couldn’t help but frown. This was a battle between elites of Core Formation Tier, and there were quite a few of them at that. The energy in the air was extremely mixed. Could it be that a large number of Core Formation Tier cultivators were going to charge in? This was good as well. It would be a good opportunity for them to break through the formation.
Ling Han used the hide of the Void Beast to hide himself. As expected, it wasn’t long before a
large group of people charged over, and the Tong Clan’s three Core Formation Tiers were shockingly among them.

These people were all injured. Obviously, though they had defeated the True Self Tier-level Subduing Dragon Stone Statue at the main gate, they had also paid a considerable price. There were at least 200 Core Formation Tier elites. The scale of this was a little frightening, and the people on the plaza all gave in. By now, probably even the descendants of an Imperial Clan would not dare act arrogantly, because even the hands of an Imperial Clan would not be
able to reach here.
